tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgris mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon rma chog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/
rdorte sgo sbyin ‘ ke / tsho tshu snadzo ༵ rdo rdo bye ke / pre pa tho / 5 rdo rdo de / / / rdo rdo la / / / de dod dod dodang sgyu snga ho jiXtshwaskye

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i le bcu cam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i ten kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig stags bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yan/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mcheg sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las ga tshon 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'byug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu skrungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags wo gyi slob grwa wo mo — 1 —

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ /shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'gyung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhud bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ skyon pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'gyung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mche/na mkhra/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal rnga'i nad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di gi// gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod —1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la ye ri chas tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras skrungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sprungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi tsho rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈pho 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di1 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5 —

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song bi krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ dhi~X sgro 1 6 3 'byung gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ ga tsā yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/ chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/ju de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bzhes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'gyung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu rte nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang g.yin la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mjad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/ de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/

brjod pa'i deb gter shin tu zhib mo ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba'i stod cha bzhugs/༄༅/ /na mo gu ru bzhi bo dhi sa te khyuX oX swa sti sarba pra dzā khyuX rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i deb gter shin tu zhib mo ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag brtan g.yung drung 'od gsal rdo rje sems/ /gdod nasarnam dag mkha' bzhin 'phel 'grib bral/ /cho se/ kun 'byung ba sangs rgyas sa bon te/ /rang sems gdod ma'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig /gang zhig dngosagrub gnyis kyi rin chen gter gyur byin rlabs rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba gdams pa'i chu gter rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /gang las 'gro rnams so so'i bsam pa dang mthun tshangs pa'i 'khor lo bskor mdzad don gnyis phun sum tshogs gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dang / /gang 'dir zab zhi spros bral rang bzhin gdod nas dag cing dri ma rnam spangs 'gog pa'i bden gyur lung rtogs dang bcas dam pa'i chos/ /srid 'dir nag phyogs mun sel mtha' dag yon tan cha shas rab rdzogs theg gsum 'phags tshogs rnams la'ang gus pas de yis po kun sa 'dud/ /sems nyid thog tha medape'i brjod bral las/ khred —1—

zhi kun tu 'char ba gnyug ma'i ngang / /'di ni cho 'phrul mtha' yas ston pa'i phyir/ /de 'dra mtha' dag su yis brjod par nus/ /blun pos brjod pa ji ltar 'bad na yang / /g.yin gyi don du 'gyur ba ma mthong bas/ /re zhig mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa mchog /smra na 'phags pa'i rnam thar brjod par smon/ /rang gi yon tan brjod pa dman pa'i lugs/ /rdzun du brjod na 'phags pa rnams kyis khrel/ khyad 'phags yon tan bdag la brjod rgyu med/ /gnas tshul/sgro skur med par brjod na ko /gzhan gyis nan tan bskul ba'i phyir/ /rang gi rnam thar mdo tsam bshad/ /dus kyang dron du 'gyur mod kyi/ khres ldan thams cad bzod par mdzod/ /de yang gdod ma'i mgon po dang / de bzhin nyid dang / zag pa med pa'i dbyings dang / chos nyid kun tu 'gro ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang / rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / rgyu'i rdo rje 'chang ba la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs brjod kyi mi lang bas bsnyad par bya ba/ sems nyid rig pa'i skyes bu chen po gang de'i mdzad 'phrin rmad du byung ba ni/ rnam par byang ba'i chos mtha' dag yongs su spel ba dang / phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / ye shes dang / yon tan dang mdzad pa 'phrin las thams cad 'dus byas kyi dbus su nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i gter chen po/ mi 'drul zhing bsrung bar mdzad pa dang / nam zhig rigs yongs su sad pa nas brtsams te/ gter gyi bum bzang de nyid rim pas phyung ste/ rang bzhin gyi 'dod dgu bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa ni/ srid zhi thams cad kyi mgon po dpal —2—

yongs grub chen po'i rnam thar bzang po 'phel 'grib med pa'o/ /de ltar yang /de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la/ khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ 'gro kun de yi snying po can/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/gcig pur ma bas te mkha' khyab mkha'i rdo rje can dang / cha med dang / kun 'gro dang / khyab bdag dang / klong yangs dang / khyab gdal chen po yin no//de lta bu'i gdod ma'i ye shes de dang lhan cig skyes pa ngo bo de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa kun gzhi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba/ srid pa'i bdag po zhig yod de/ ji skad du/ de bzhin kun gzhi'i chu bo yang / /rtag tu yul gyi rkyen gyis 'byung / /rnam shes rba rlabs sna sna gos kyis/ /rab tu g.yo bas gar byed do/ /zhes pa ltar/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i chu klung bye ba phrag brgya 'bab cing bsten pa'i rgya mtsho chen po srid pa thog ma med pa nas/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du ma byas pa de srid du rtag tu 'bab pa rnam par shes pa'i tshogs bdun dang / sna tshogs pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes tha dad pa dang / gzhal du med pa'i 'du byed dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyi rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba/ gnas snod kyi 'jig rten dang / don gzugs sogs yul lnga dang / lus dbang po lnga ru snang ba'i rnam rig gi gzugs brnyan rnam par bkra ba rtag tu 'char zhing nub par byed pa'i kun gzhi'i chu gter chen po de las/ 'gro ba drug tu brgyud ma nas brgyud mar 'khor ba'i rnam par thar pa'i mtshan ma ya ma zung brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa dag yod mod kyi/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas srid par 'byams pa'i snang tshul de lta bu ni brjod kyis kyang ga la lang zhing / ma rig —3—

pa'i sgrib g.yogs kyi gzhan dbang las phal cher dran pa'i lam na mi snang bas der bas la/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / ye shes la sogs pa sa dang lam gyi yon tan khyad par can ma thob ba'i phyir/ mi chos bla ma las gyur pa yang dag pa ma yin pa'i tshig gis las kyi sgrib pa mchog tu lci ba sgrub bar ga la spobs/ der ma zad rgyas ba sras bcas kyi yon to khyad par can brjod du yod bzhin du/ so so skye bo nyon mongs pa'i 'dam du bying ba/ rmongs pas rnam par g.yogs pa/ srid pa'i chu bo las ma brgal ba/ sred pas bcings pa/ yang dag pa'i don la kho re chung ba/ bdag lta bu'i las snang gi 'char sgo yi ger dgod par rtsom pa ni ngal ba kho na'i rgyu yin mod kyi/ bskul ba po shin tu mang po dag gi ngo ma chogs pas cung zad smra bar bgyi na/ sngon dam pa'i chos kyi phyogs su cung zad bya ba byas shing / smon lam rnam par dag pa lan 'ga' zung btab pa 'dra ste/ tshe 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi bya ba sgrub pa la bar chad kyi sgo med pa'i khyim du skyes shing / gang gis khyim du srog gcod pa spangs shing dkon mchog gsum dang /yi dam gyi lha rnams dang chos skyong dam pa ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams gus pas bsten pa dang mchod pa la brtson zhing bzlas brjod dang sgrub pas dus 'da' ba'i rigs su skye ba nye bar bzung / chung ngu nas rje btsun thugs rje can rnams kyi bka' drin las chos kyi snang bas dus 'das chog pa byung ba dang / ngar 'dzin gyi snang ba cung zad srab cing / dam pa'i chos kyi gtam zab mo dang /sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rmad du byung ba dang / skyes pa'i rabs rnams dang / bla —4—

ma dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa mthong ba'am thos na yid dga' ba dang skyo ba zung du 'brel bas khyab cing ba sbu ldang ba dang / gting nas mchi ma 'khrug pa'i dad pa gsum lhag par stobs su gyur pas/ chos brgyad kyi snang ba rags pa 'phral du 'gog nus pa tsam rtag tu 'ong zhing / khyad par byis pa mno mi shes pa'i dus nas kyang / gsang sngags kyi lha'i sku brnyan mthong ba'am/ cho ga dang bzlas brjod byed pa dang / kun spang gi spyod pa can dag mthong ba dang /bskyed rdzogs kyi gtam dang che ba cung zad thos pa dang / mi rtog pa dang lung sgom pa la sogs pa'i rnam cha mthong ba'i tshe/ bdag kyang 'di lta bur gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa dang / dga' bdes nye bar drangs te nyin mtshan gyi snang ba yul yul por 'gyur ba dang / 'gro ba la brtse sems kyang chung ja'i dus nas cung zad 'char ba dang / sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pa gting tshugs pa zhig kyang dran pa rnyed tsam nyid nas yod cing / da lta zab mo'i chos mang po la snying thag pa nas nges pa cung zad skye bar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /'dir smras pa/ rang blo rang la lkog tu ma gyur bas/ /'di dag rang gis rang la ma khrel tsam/ /'di tsam rdzun med 'di las lhag pa'ang med/ /gang gi dpang por spyan ldan 'phags rnams bzhugs/ /de ldar gleng slang pa'i dge mtshan yongs su spel nas bdag nyid kyi rigs rus dang 'brel ba'i gtam cung zad cig brjod na/ skad gnyis smra ba mthu stobs dbang phyug rje btsun rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa zhes mtshan srid pa gsum du yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi sku'i rigs su 'khrungs shing thugs kyi sras su —5—

gyur pa ni/ skad gnyis smra ba chos rab yin la/ de nyid kyi sku'i rigs la rwa shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las/ nub par mtshan gsol ba/ slob dpon chen po rwa ye shes seng ge dang / de'i sras rwa 'bum seng ste/ yab sras de dag ni sprul pa'i skyes mchog lung dang rtogs pa mtha' yas pa'i mnga' bdag chen po yin no/ /rwa shar par grags pa dharma seng ge ba/ de'i sras dkon mchog seng gede'i sras shes rab rgyal mtshan te/ de gsum yang mkhas shing nus pa thob pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po sha stag tu byon no/ /rwa sher rgyal la sras gsum mnga' ba las/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sku mched ni g.yas ru nub mdar 'khrungs shing / gtsang rong dang ru mtshams su 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa zhig byung zhes grags la/ sras che ba rin chen rgyal mtshan ni/ yar 'brog 'phrang du yon bdag mo nam mkha' 'bum zhes bya ba las 'khrungs shing / cher skyes nas yab la gzhin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum dang mgon nag la sogs pa'i rgyud lung man ngag thams cad gsan te mkhas par sbyangs/ dus 'khor la sogs pa yab chos gzhan yang ci rigs pa mkhyen/ sman dpyad dang skar rtsis sogs la mkhas pa zhig byung / yar 'brog 'phrang rigs kyi nub stod du gnyan dang jo bo la sogs pas sbyin bdag byas nas gzhin rje'i lcags mkhar la dpe byas pa'i mkhar brtsigs nas der bzhugs pas/ rwa lcags mkhar ba zhes thogs so/ /sgrub pas nus mthu chen po yang mngon du gyur/ thong lcags chag pa la ljags btab pas zhi zhing 'brel ba dang / thog ser dang cho 'phrul la sogs pa thogs med du sgrub pa zhig go /—6—

'dir smras pa/ de la rigs sras lnga tsam yod pa las/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mtshan grags thon pa ni/ /gsum pa chos dbyings pa nyid yin zhes thos/ /sngags kyi lag len bshad bka' la sogs pa/ /lhad med tshig gi brgyud pa ma nyams shing / /bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs rgyun yang che bar yod/ /yar 'brog phyogs dang gtsang rong la bzhugs pa'i/ /rwa yi rigs brgyud mang po yod pa rnams/ /phan tshun thugs mthun grwa rigs mang ba dang / /yon bdag la sogasaphun sum tshogs par byung / /de yi sras ni brtson 'grus seng ge yin/ /gsang phur 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhon nu la/ /phar tshad bslabs shing pha mes chos la mkhas/ /'ba' ra ba las rlung phyag zhus te 'byongs/ /de la sras gnyis chosakyi bsam 'grub dang / /chos kyi bkra shis zhes byas rnying ma bslabs/ kha thun tshe bdag 'char khal sogs pa'i/ /gzhin rje gshed dang phur pa jo mo lugs/ /nyang gi gter cho se sogs la mkhas par byas/ /tshe bdag bsgrubs pas nus pa che bar byung / /dang po'i sras ni shes rab seng ge dang / /phyi ma'i sras ni tshe bdag skyabs zhes brjod/ /phyi mas la stod phyogs su byon zhes zer/ /dang po'i sras ni kun dga' seng ge yin/ /mngon dga' chos sder pod chen bzhi la bslabs/ /phyi nas bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / /gzhan yang bla ma mang po bsten pa las/ /gsang sngags gsar ma'i chos lugs mang po thos pha mes rnams la las tshogs sna tshogs pa'i/ /lag len khrigs chags mthong brgyud yod na yang / /pha chos rnams kyi dbang bka' bar du nub/ /chos rje ngag dbang pa la dbang rnams zhus/ /mos zhon dbang gis rdo rje 'jigs byed —7—

bsgrubs/ /re ma tī yi zhal yang mthong bar grags/ /skabs der yar 'brog khri dpon dang zlos nas/ /g.yor po stod kyi phyogs na slob ma dang / /yon bdag mang du yod pa'i phyogs su phyin/ /dgra bo'i yul du mthu rtags mang du bstan/ /gnas gzhi ri khrod chung ngu mang du btab/ /sdig bshags don du bcom ldan kun rig gi /bsnyen sgrub byas shing gzhan yang byed du bcug /gdung la rdo rje sems dpa' rang byon byung / /de la sras gnyis seng ge dpal ldan dang / /chos kyi seng ger bod pa rnam pa gnyis/ /phyi mas kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba yi/ /ye chas grwar byon zhing rab 'byams smra ba dang / /rig gnas phra mo yang ni mang po mkhyen/ /yi dam dmar nag 'jigs gsum yun ring bsgrubs/ /rab 'byams smra ba 'jam dpal grags pa la/ /bo dong lugs kyi chos lugs mang po gsan/ /g.yas ru shangs su pha rgod bsod bzang la/ shangs chos yongs rdzogs zhu༅nas yun ring bsgoms/ /chos skyong myur mdzad ye shes mgon po dang / /dpal mgon ma ning dam can mang por bcas/ /bsgrubs pas grub ste mthu brtsal dpag tu med/ /drag po'i las grub dge slong yin na yang / /las su mthu gtad ser ba dag la brtson/ /g.yo ru gzhung du dgra bo'i mkhar khyim la/ /dgun dus gnam lcags lan gsum bstud mar phab/ /yul dpon la sogs gnod byed thams cad stongs/ /'on kyang ni gu'i 'pho ba thebs nas gshegs/ /seng ge dpal gyi bu gnyis byung ba ni/ /'jam dbyangs blo gros dang ni 'jam dbyangs bzang / /'jam dbyangasabazang pos chos rje bsod grags la/ /sbyor drug zhus pas nyams rtogs bzang —8—

po skyes/ /snga mas gtsang gi phung po ri bo cher/ /rjogs chen yun ring bsgoms pa'i lo rgyus snang / /dang po'i sras ni bdag gi bla ma yin/ /mes po'ang yin te rig sngags 'chang chen po/ /mtshan ni tshul khrims rnam rgyal zhes pa yin/ /byis pa'i dus na chos grags rgya mtsho'i drung / /yig drug bzlas lung tsam zhig gsan zhes gsung / /cho che/ rje 'phrin las pa la phar tshad bslabs/ /rlud sems dbyer med la sogs chos 'ga' zhus/ /dbus smyon pa dang pad+ma gling pa dang / /zur dbon pa dang so ston kun gzhon sogs/ /snga phyir phyag rdzogs bla ma mang po bsten/ /rnying ma'i phyogs la mkhyen pa shin tu che/ /'jigs byed la sogs gshed skor rnams dang ni/ /stod 'brug skor dang ngan song sbyong rgyud sogs/ /gsar ma'ang mkhyen cing skar rtsis sman dpyad dang / /rten 'brel phra mo sna tshogs mang du mkhyen/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag na rdo rje dang / /ma ning nag po bsgrubs pas rtags kyang thon/ /snga phyi'i yul lha bran du 'khol bar mdzad/ /mkhyen brtse nus mthu gsum ka mnga' ba'i phyir/ /'gro ba rnams la phan pa rgya cher mdzad/ /gang 'di'i drin las bdag gi pha yis kyang / /thog ser la sogs nus pa 'ga' re thon/ /de dag rdzun med 'dul ni da lta'ang yod/ /de ltar kho bo'i rus pa'i byung khungs ni/ /rwa lo'i rigs las byung ba yin zhes gleng / /nged kyi pha mes brgyud 'di chos nas gzhal na lo tsā ba chen po dang chos mkhas pa dang mthu bo che'i brgyud pa de yin/ 'jig rten gyi dpal 'byor ni/ rwa lo chen po chos rgyal khri ral dang 'dra bar grags pa de lags/de rjes rwa lo 'bum seng dang sher rgyal yan chad kyang 'phrin las dpag tu med/—9—

dper na bla chen 'phags pas ldong ston dang rong pa rga lo gnyis rwa'i bu chen slob brgyud yin pa de bla mar khur ba lta bu yin/ bod kyi bla ma bzang tshad rwa'i chos 'og tu ma chud pa med pa des ma sna ni/ pha mes phyis kyi tsho khas drag dpung pa 'dzoms pa dang nor shed ngom thub pa rang med de/ rang rang so so'i thad ka der grwa slob yon bdag skyong rgyu yod nges shes pa'i 'phrin las dang yi dam chos skyong la gsol ba thebs tsam gyi nus mthu yod nges pa yin/ de la nged kyi mes dang pha yan chad khyim btsun sngags pa thams cad kyang dge slong la phar phyag 'tshal/rten gsum la zhabs tog byed/ bza' ba dang rin gyi don du srog chags la 'tshe ba nam yang spangs/ lo bcu'i bar du klog sogs sbyong / nyi shu'i bar du dpe 'dzin bshor/ sum cu'i bar du sgro 'dogs gcod/ bzhi bcu'i bar du bzlas sgom sgrub zer/ de rjes khyim pa rnams bag ma'i bya ba sogs mi chos byed/ sngon gyi bram chen dang bod kyi'ang sngon gyi sngags pa'i mig ltos bzang po de ma nyams par skyong mkhan rang shas che/ deng sang ngam phyis kyi bla ma brgyud can bla brang sngags pa ba bla chen dang bla chung khyu gcig srog gcod la ni mi 'dzem/ sku gsung thugs rten la ras chod byed/ mno ma shes pa'i byas pa nas nal bu rlog khyim thab snga mo nas len pa la dpa' dpa' mo byed pa de tshad min/gsar ma'i spyod pa shas che ba'i sngags pa mkhan po tshad ma rang byon/ mi brgyud de rwa shar ba yin/ chos rwa nub pa yin/ gnyen gra sgrigs dang rdzun rib dang lag 'phrul la skyabs tshol mi dgos pa'i sngags pa kha yod lag yod rkyang ba byung ba lags so/ /—10—

da ni kho bo nyid kyi gnas tshul sgrag par bya ste/ de la bdag gang du skye ba bzung ba'i yul ni/ dbus gtsang gi mtshams na bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces grags pa/slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ga ya dha ra dang / /gnyos lo tsā ba yab sras rnams dang / gzhan yang ā tsar+ya gnyan dpal dbyangs dang / kha rag sgom chung la sogs skyes mchog du mas bsten pa'i gnas de nyid dang nye ba/ bod yul dbus kyi char gtogs pa/ lu hi ta'i chu klong la snyen par 'grogs pa/ 'brang zhes bya ba'i yul grong khyer gyi bkod pa yid du 'ong bas brgyan pa/ bza' shing gi rwa ba'i skyed tshal du mas rnam par khyab pa/ ri bo sman ljongs nyams dga' ba du ma dang / tshal sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ sngon gnyos jo sras rdo rje bla ma la sogs pas yun ring du bsten pa'i gnas gzhi zhig tu phyis chos rje kun dga' seng ges chos 'khor sdings zhes pa'i dgon gnas chung ngu zhig 'debs par mdzad pa 'di lags te/bdag skye ba 'dzin rgyu'i lo snga ma de tho rangs keng rus chen po dngos su byung ba mi mang po rang gis mthong ba dang / stes dbang yin pa gzhir bcas na'ang bkra shis brag zer ba cig yod pa de'i rdo che ba gcig gas shing lhung ba la ma ṇi rang byon chen po cig byung ba ni da lta yang brag logs la yod pa 'di yin/ de la sngags 'chang dam pa tshul khrims mtshan can la rigs kyi sras bzhi yod pa las/che shos rnam rgyal phun tshogs zhes bya ba bdag gi pha lags shing / skye ba 'di nyid kyi lus skyed par byed pa la gcig tu drin che ba mar gyur pa ni/ mtshan rdo —11—

rje bu dga' zhes bya ba yin zhing / bdag gi pha ni mkhyen rgya mi che yang yi dam lha'i bskyed rim dmigs pa la brtan pa cung zad thob pa yi dam dang chos skyong gi bzlas bsnyen grangs med pa song zhing / byin rlabs dang nus mthus brgyan pa/ chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtog pa nub pa'i 'khrul zhig chen por bzhugs/bdag gi ma yang thugs snying rje che zhing dge ba la dkar ba/ zab cing dkyel che ba'i ngang tshul can no/ /de la yab kyis dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe drug yum gyis dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa'i tshe/ bdag gi yang srid yongs su bzung bar 'dug cing / yum gyi mnal lam du 'brang phu gzims khang khang pa brgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba zhig tu gyur pa la yum gyi thog rtse nas dung dkar phyogs bzhir 'bud pa dang / yang lan cig rmi lam du rin po che ba la dbang zhus pas/gser gyi rdo rje zhig spyi bor bzhag slar de sku 'phrag tu bcug pa'i snang ba byung zhing / de'i gnas tshul mes po rin po che la zhus pas/ de srid 'khor ba de'i ltas yin/ 'di la dga' mo zhig 'ong ba yin te 'ong / zhes gsung / de nas bdag rum na yod pa'i skabs de nyid la rgyal gyi zla ba'i skabs ldum ra'i rgyal men gyi rtsa ba 'ga' re zhig kha 'bus shing / cho 'phrul gyi skabs su rkang mi mngon pa'i me tog kha bye ba yang tho re long nge ba byung 'dug pa mthong zhing rgyus yod pa'i mi da lta yang mang du yod/ de kun yang dge mtshan gyi ltas tsam yin par mngon no/ /de nas na tshod ldan zhes pa/ shing mo phag lo chu stod kyi zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nyi ma rtse shar la bdag btsas par 'dug cing / de yang grod pus g.yogs pa'i rnam pa can du byung / lte ba gcod pa sogs ni gang yang ma dgos/—12—

de la mes po rin po ches lde mig gis grod pu'i rgya dral pa sogs rten 'brel mdzad/ de skabs skra phra mo g.yeng g.yeng ba kha dog dkar po nyag gcig yod pa zhig byung / phyis rim pas kha dog nag por 'gyur/ skra dkar bo yeng yeng 'di'i rigs la shes rab chen po 'ong / spib gyis ma bsgribs pa gyis gsung /sri ngan bzlog pa'i phyir/ sri gcod rdo rje zhes ming stsal/ zla ba brgyad tsam nas 'gro ba dang / lo dus smra shes pa zhig byung 'dug btsas nas lo gnyis su nye bar tsam na/ 'khru nad drag po zhig gis btab/ a khus sman dpyad shin tu mkhas par mkhyen pas/ sman dang rim gro sogs gang drag mdzad 'dug na'ang /khyad cang ma byung zhing / byis pa nad theg chung ba nas sna yang zhom/ do nub tsam thub bam sang zhogs tsam thub bam zer ba las/ gzhan 'chi bar thag bcad pa'i tshe/ de'i sang zhogs nam langs tsam la nang gi skas nas yar a tsa ra lnga tsam zhig 'dzegs nas byung nas/ sngon ma des po ti zhig gis nged la byin rlabs byed kyin mang po zhig lab kyin yod par 'dug de rnams slar yang skas la babs/ de phyin chad gar song cha med/ pha dang zhung bo sogs nang mi lnga tsam yod 'dug pa thams cad kyis mthun par mthong zhing / mthong ba las bya byed kyi blo gang yang ma byung bar 'dug 'di ni de ltar bar chad kyis gtses pa la snga rol gyi skye ba gzhan du bla mar gyur pa rnams kyis bar chad de bzlog par mdzad pa yin par sems/ de kho nas nad de drag ste/ theg gsum bzhi nas sor chud par snang ngo / /btsas tsam nas de skabs phan chad du nyin mtshan phal cher mig mi 'dzum par gnyid du 'gro ba la mi phal cher gyis smra brjod nyung zhing bem —13—

lugs 'dis glen lkugs cig 'ong ngam zer/ mes po rin po che'i gsung nas mig mi 'dzum par gnyid du 'gro ba ni 'od gsal zin pa la 'ong bar grags/gang ltar na'ang 'di ma'i lus la 'khris pa tshun chad nas/ dmigs ltas dga' rab kyang byung bas mi phal pa rang min tsam zhig 'ong zhes yang yang gsung zer/de nas smra shes tsam gyi dus zhig na thog khar ni ma la bsnyal ba'i tshe/ rlung sems cung zad dbu mar chug pa'i rtags yin pa 'dra/ nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon dra ba ris su 'gyung zhing / de dag gi bar bar na lha sku'i rnam pa sku mdog dang dbyibs sna tshogs pa kho nas nam mkha' 'khrig mer gyis 'gro ba yang nas yang du mthong ba byung zhing / da lta'ang blo yul na gsal bar snang / de dag dang dus mi ring bar mes po rin po che la jo gdan 'ga' zhig dang / chu byang kha nas 'ongs pa'i sngags pa so sos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang dang / mgon po ma ning dang gu ru drag dmar nag dang / phyag bzhi pa gter mgon dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang bskur la sogs pa pha chos 'ga' zung stsal te de kun zhor chos la thob yod par 'dug cing / dkyil 'khor dang mchod bshams la sogs pa da lta'ang yid yul la ci rigs par 'dug cing chos kyi tshig don la ni go rtogs cang ma byung / chos gral du sdod tshugs shing dbang rdzas zhu tshul sogs mkhas par byung bas rin po ches dges dges mdzad zer/ bskang gso 'chag med du mdzad kyin 'dug pas gtor chab sbron pa dang / rnga g.yog 'bul ba sogs phyag g.yog chung chung —14—

dgos pa rnams la brtson par byas/ pha mes kyi 'du shes tsam min par bla ma'i mos gus kyang dga' rab skyes 'dug phal cher pha ma'i zla la ma nyal bar mchod khang du mes po'i drung du nyal/ de skabs mchod bshom la bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i sku brnyan che rab zhig bzhugs kyin 'dug pas/ de'i dri rtog yang yang zhus pas mdzad bcu la sogs pa'i lo rgyus 'ga' re gsung / lo rgyus rtsa rtse tshang ba ni blo la ma chags pa 'dug na'ang dad mos chen po skyes shing sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pa bcos ma min pa byung / gshed dmar gyi thang sku lha mgron la kyai rdor yod pa zhig 'dug pa/ lha de gnyis mthong ba tsam gyis sems dga' cham cham pa rtag tu 'ong / ltad mo gzhan la dga' tshor chung zhing /yi dam chos skyong gi sngags sku zing zing 'dug pa kun la yang yang blta 'dod pa'i dga' sems che bar byung bas/ mes po'i gsung nas 'di rdo rje slob dpon zhig gi skye ba yin par 'dug ces gsungs pa'ang dran/ yang re 'ga' ri dwags shor mkhan 'dra mthong ba'i tshe/ snying rje chen po skyes te rang dbang med par mchi ma 'chor ba 'byung zhing lung ba 'di'i ri dwags rnams ngas bsrung dgos pa 'dug snyam pa dang / 'di bsrungs kyang de'i pha rol na lung ba dang ri dwags yod/ de'i pha rol na'ang yod snyam pa sogs mtha' med du shar nas gcig bsrungs kyang gzhan rnams ji ltar drag snyam pa'i gang drag ci drag mi tshugs pa rtsim yong ba zhig yod cing / yang lan cig sgo rtsa na bya btang 'ga' re slong zhing 'dug de nas pha tshad kyi zhing kha na lus gnad bcas sgom byed byed ltar 'dug pas yid la ngo mtshar dang dang ba chen po skyes te/ nga yang 'di lta bu zhig tu gyur —15—

na snyam pa yang yang byung / yang mon rtse ba'i rtogs ldan 'ga' re rlung bzung zhing 'khrul 'khor byed pa mthong bas kyang de dang 'dra bar gyur/ da lta ltas na khong tsho'i de rang chos gzugs kun gyi spyi nor de ka yin pa 'dra ste rang re blo 'gyur ba ni byung / dgon pa ba rnams kun rig gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas sgrub mchod byed pa mthong ba la'ang dga' ba chen po skyes shing cho ga'i sgang la gral la sdod tshugs par byas/ lan cig kha rag gam phu ba'i sngags pa chos rje yon rgyam ba de/ mes po rin po che'i drung du don spyod pa zhig la 'dug mngon spyod kyi gsung bgros mang dag zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ nga rang gis kyang 'di lta bu mang po zhig byas snyam pa sogs yid la ji snyed cig shar/ yang thog kha na yod pa'i skabs shig 'jol mo rnams skad mang po 'don gyin 'dug pas skad kyi gdangs la dbon po sri gcod ces nga rang gi ming nas 'bod pa dang / yul mi 'dra'i skyid sdug yod tshul lab pa sogs lan 'ga' yar du byung / de skabs gnyid min sad min pa rmi lam shin tu gsal snang che ba/ yul mi so sor na tsha shi chad sogs kyi rtags mtshan gsal bar things pa dang / re 'ga' mngon sum du'ang mi ma yin gyi spyod pa re re tsam mthong ba byung / phyis sde dpon gyi rdzong gzhis sogs su phyin pa nas gsal snang de kun yang 'gribs nas song / yang lan cig a tsa ra 'ga' shas lam zhor la sgo rtsa na lto slong gin 'dug pa mthong nas kyang dga' spro dpag tu med pa skyes shing rgya gar gha ya nywa sogs pa yin snyam pa'i yul mang po zhig yid yul du wal wal shar ro/ / 7smras pa/ sngon goms dbang las mtha' dag dge ba'i chos/ /gcig car —16—

shar ba 'di las legs skrugs ni/ /ma myong med pa nam yang 'byung ba yang / /sngon gyi dge ba'i mthu dpal 'ba' zhig yin/ /de ltar smra shes pa nas rang lo bzhi'i steng du sleb pa tshun chad du smra brjod kyi sgo la/ nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin/ nye gnas dpal 'byor zer ba zhig yod de/ rngog rong 'og ma ba chang go nang la song zer ba zhig gzhan gyis rtsed mo dang kyal ka sogs kyis dris pa la'ang yang yang smra ba zhig brgyud mar byung 'dug gzhan 'ga' re la yong ba'i slob mkhan de 'dra'i rigs ni gtan nas med pa rang sems dpang bo thub par yod/ pha ma dang yul ba rnams ni rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi zhal mthong ba lta ci smos/ mtshan thos pa tsam yang med pas thog mar re zhig rang babs su smra ba zhig yod pa la/dge 'dun sgang pa'i jo gdan 'ga' zhig gis rje dam pa de nyid dbus gtsang yongs kyi bla ma yin tshul brjod 'dug pas/ de skabs bu gcig po yin pas nged rang la yang de bzhin ma zer gsung ba'i dam bzhag mdzad kyang / byis par song bas sngar bzhin ka smras/ de skabs chos dbang bzang po ba gzims khang du yang yang yong ba zhig yod pa/ khong gi a khu rje btsun dam pa la mos pa can cig yod pa la khong bas glengs 'dug cing / de sde ba'i dpon yig pa yin pa 'dug pa nas/ yar 'brog tu khri dpon chen po bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po la zhu bar phyin pa bzhin/ sde pa rang la'ang mnal lam bzang po khyad par can byung gsung zhing / de 'phral dngos la gos chas sogs bzab rgyas su stsal/ de nas sde pa bstan 'dzin drung gis/ mkhan chen rin po che dang / rgyal —17—

rtse nas brtsams te/ zhabs drung stobs rgyas drung gi bar tshun chad kyi/ rjes dam pa'i yon bdag dang bu chen rnams kyi sar gnas tshul re yang 'bul ba gnang 'dug khyad par chos rje rig 'dzin pa ched kyis mngags nas/ khong la rje dam pas gnang ba'i dbu rgyan bya sbu ma zhig yod cing / gzhan yang gong dkar chos sde sogs nas dbang rdzas mang du g.yar nas/ 'brang phug gzims khang gi sgo rtsar 'ongs/ thog kha nas ngas bltas khong 'dug pa mthong ste/ chos rjes rig 'dzin pa sleb 'dug byas/ chos rje thal byung du nang du shor/ dbang rdzas de kun bkrams nas nged la bstan pa la dbu rgyan sgro ser ma de blang te/nga rang gi yin tshul sogs cal col mang du smras/ chos rjes bus shing byin rlabs zhus/ de nas mi ring bar bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po'i drung yang phebs byung zhing / gsol ja bzhugs gral zhig 'dug nged la gdan dma' ba zhig byung bas khro zhing sdod ma 'dod/ zur sbug cig tu logs se ba byas te cang ma smras par bsdad/ jo gi zhig dang gsung 'phros mdzad kyin 'dug pa cung zad go ba snyam byed/ nges kyang phan ma byung / bal po rgya gling pa gnyis 'dug pa'i sar phyin/ zhabs drung yang dgyes rgyu med tsam la de 'phral phebs song / bka' las kyang sku khams ni dwangs po 'dug ste/ rje dam pa rang ni min pa 'dra zhes dbus phyogs kun la gsungs 'dug cing / gong dkar na phyag ris ngos ma rang 'dug pa dngos su mthong / dngos cag lta bu bar dor mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i slob dpon spyod pa ba yang srid 'dzin pa'i tshul ston pa lta ga la zhig sa thob pa'am de la nye bar bsnyen pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun —18—

tsam la yang gnas pa ma yin/ 'on kyang de dang der byin gyis brlabs te 'gro ba'i don spyod pa yang srid pa'i phyir gcig dang tha dad pa'i dpyad pa mi dgos so/ /de nas mi ring bar smon lam gyi stobs r+ṣa pos dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ mkhan rin po che lung rig rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ de gong mnal lam du lung bstan rim pa gsum tsam byung 'dug pa dang / sngon dus rje dam pas snga phyi'i lung bstan mang po gnang ba'i tshigs bcad du yang / nam zhig rang gnas ri bo'i phug tu mjal/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dus kyang 'di yin zhes/ nged kyi gtam gsan 'phral chos lung byang rtse sogs la mi gtong par mdzad de/ mched grogs dpal sdings pa dang / ga thog pa dpal kun dga' legs rgyal gnyis kyang zhabs 'bring du 'phral 'byor byung 'dug cing / de mtshams dpon slob rnams myur shad du phebs byung ba/ phebs 'phral dngos la gdan mthong sogs bkur bsti ches che ba mdzad/ zas sna shing thog la sogs pa'i ston mo mang po dang / gnang spyin gyi skyes rgya cher stsal/ de'i nang bar nas zhag 'ga' rer rnam 'joms la sogs pa'i bkru byabs kyis lus ril gyis bkru ba yang yang mdzad/ zhag lnga tsam bzhugs nas bzhis ka gong dkar du phyag phebs/ gong ma khu dbon dang mjal 'phrad legs tshogs che bar byung 'dug cing / nged kyi skor bseng bkrol yang gnang / gzhis ka nas kyang dngos cag la ja 'dren byung / de skabs gnam gang ba la rje dam pas gnang ba'i byin rlabs rten 'ga' re 'dug pa rnams ngos 'dzin byed zer nas nged kyi sar khyer byung ba gsal bar dran cing brjod sgo yang 'ga' re smras 'dug—19—

dpal legs grogs mched kyis rgyal sras chos rdzong pa'i thugs dam rten bde mchog dang dmag zor ma'i shing sku/ rje dam pa'i 'bral spang mi g.yo ba dang sgrol ma'i zangs glegs sogs khyer byung bas ngo shes pa'i rnam pa dang / khyad par de gong sgrol ma ma gtogs lha rigs de dag mthong thos med na'ang / lha rnams ngo shes shing ngos 'dzin bshad pa byed rgyud yang don dang mthun pa mang dag byung / yar 'brog nas hṝ ya sa mu rdzo dbang rdzas kyi sa gzhong zhig bskur ba mdzad pa'ang ngo shes shing / dkar mdung yod med kyi rtsad gcod kyang byas/de gong skra rnams ral bar yod pa tshogs gsog ring mo ba dang chos dbang pa gnyis kyis bseng na sa sil bur 'cho yin yod tsa na/ ral ba'i thor tshugs byas rus rgyan zhig gyon shing nags kyi gseb la cham cham 'gro ba yin pa la snyam par byung / de nas hor zla dgu pa'i nyer lnga la/ mkhan rin po che'i phyag phyir dkris te/ rang yul nas gzhi bteg pha mas kyang lung pa'i phu'i la mtshams na bkra shis brag zer ba ming bkra bzang ba zhig yod pa de bar skyel mar phebs/ de nas skabs skabs su pha ma dran pa'i gdung shugs ci rigs par byung mod kyi/ phal cher ni ma snying bu dang / bu snying rdo'i rnam par song de skabs ni zla bo rnams kyis kyang a ma rim pas rjes la phebs kyin yod do zhes brid pa ltar yang byas so/ /de nub yar 'brog dpal der sleb/ gur chas bzang po bshams gzhi len gzab ma byung / gral gyis tsam na mkhan rin po che yang bzhugs shing khong tsho'i mi 'ga' re 'dug pa la mno mi shes pas dpal de ba rang gi mdog stabs la bya ba zhig kha nas shor/ byis pa'i kha la la nye yod —20—

pa'i dpe de 'phral du gsal bar byung / de'i sang ya sribs phyogs la lam mdzad de phebs skabs/ de phyogs rin sbungs kyi lam yin nga mi 'gro byas nas bslab nyes mang du byas/ 'dab lung du sde pa bstan 'dzin drung dpon g.yog kyang bsu ba la phebs/ sna dkar rtse'i mdun gyi skyed tshal der zhags gsum bsdad/ nyin gcig tsam rtser yang phyin/ skyed tshal der yod dus ja 'thung 'phro la dkar yol zhig khri steng nas zhal ba'i dkyil du 'phangs pa gas chag gang yang ma byung / dkar yol de sde pa bstan 'dzin drung rang gi phyag tu bzhes song /de skabs yar 'brog nas sku mched dge skyon gyi stabs byus dpangs shin tu dma' bar yod pa/ slar mi ring bar sku mched kyang nang 'dums shing / rbang srid mtha' rgyas su byung song ba de lta bu'i dge mtshan gyi rten 'brel yin par mngon no/ /de nas rim pas brgyud nas blo bder sleb/ dpon po kun bsam pa byung ba ngo shes byung zhing / de'i sang rgyal rtse nas bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te rgyal rtser sleb/ der zla phyed tsam song nas rtse chen du phyin/ yum sras rnams dang sde ba drung 'tsho ba sogs kyis zla gcig tsam gyi bar phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor bas bstabs/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes dang yang mjal zhing shin tu dgyes pa dang dang pa dpe med pa mdzad kyin 'dug bla brang shar chen du phyin pa sogs da lta'ang shin tu gsal ba yid yul na 'dug cing /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin byed cig stsal 'dug ste ha cang gsal bar mi dran/ rtogs ldan zla grags pa dang / shākya ba dhi gnyis byung ba'ang gsal bar ngo shes/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen gyi bla brang dkar por mched —21—

grogs thar ba bslebs pa'ang ngo shes/ zhag shas song skabs/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas dang / sbas pa'i sangs rgyas rje btsun lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs dang / bla ma dam pa rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang po dang / rje kun dga' bstan gsal ba'i drung dang / dpon drung 'phan ne ba dang / ngam ring nas mi sna la khang gsar nas kun dga' legs grub pa dang / rje dam pa'i phyag g.yog rnying pa rnams dang bcas phebs/ kun chos pa gzhung pa 'phan ne'i ba'i drung rnams ngo shes 'dug de nas rim pas 'brong rtse/ stag rtse khyung rtse pa snam brgyud tshong 'dus dbu rtser ka brgyad mar bzhugs gral zhig byung ba'i rten mchod la/ sku skye bcu gcig gi ze'u lha khang zhig 'dug pa de la dag mi dag gi dpyad pa mang po byas pas/ zhal ngo rnams thugs mtshar mtshar mdzad kyin 'dug de nas bsam 'grub rtser phyin skabs gser ma'i thad tsam du gser mdog can gyi dge 'dun brgya tsam byin rlabs zhu bar byung / de gong gser mdog can pa tshos/karma pa'i phyag g.yog la rdo brdungs byas/ de'i chad sgrub sogs 'khrun chod grub nas rgyang tsam song skabs yin 'dug na'ang / zhing gis zhe ma sdug mdzad pa'i dge 'dun rnams thugs gu dog tsam gyi dus yin pa dngos cag bsam rtser 'ong pa'i rkyen gyis gnas tshul de rang grol du song / der zhal lnga tsam bsdad/ byis pa'i spyod pa kho nas khro tshul dang bcas gral la ma phyin pa'i rkyen gyis sku mdun drung de'i nang bar rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi thags sku la sogs pa 'bul ba cung zad zhig dang bcas snga mo rang phebs nas/ nged rje btsun rin po che la mi —22—

phyed pa'i dad pa yod cing / bla mas kyang dgongs par shin tu bzhugs pa yin pa la da lam dgongs khrel ba'i rnam pa 'dug pa rgyu gzhan gcig kyang med/gser mdog can pa'i skor 'di yin pas/ sngar byas la bshags pa 'bul zhing da nas gser mdog can pa la gang drag rang byed gsung pa phebs de nas snar thang du zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ de nas gnas su zhag rtsis byas 'dug pa sngon gyi bag chags shig gis sdod pa'i blo gtan ma byung na'ang g.yog rnams kyis 'brid thabs byas/ de nas bo dong du byang ba'i bdag po sku gzhon pa'i drung bzhugs sar 'byor zhing gzhi len dpe bral mdzad/ de nyid dus mdos kyang 'dug grangs chen rab 'byams pas rje btsun rin po che'i dbu zhwa zhig nged la lan gsum ston du byung ba de la cang lab pa ni ma byung mthar tshig pa zos te khong rang la 'phangs/ sku 'dra dung khung ma sogs mjal/ de'i nang bar ri khrod wo po jo mo nang du sleb/ rdo bol gyi chos 'byung rang byon/ thug sna lnga la sogs pa rtsad gcod byas pas/ rje drung rin po che'i gsung gi chos 'byung rang byon mgon khang du bsdus yod mchis/ rnga thug kyang phyi ru nag po spron pa yin/ sna lnga nang na yod gsung gin 'dug de nas smon 'gror phyin dus ga da la nas zhabs drung bkra shis stobs rgyas pa dpon g.yog rnams kyis bsu ba gnang zhing / phyag g.yog la 'gro lung chos rje 'dus pa ngo shes byung / smon 'gro'i gzi brjid kyi phug gi gzims chung der sdod sa byung zhing / de na sprul sku ngag dbang gis bris ba'i sku skye bcu gcig gi thang kha rnams kyang bkram 'dug der bag chags shig kyang sad rgyu byung / mkha' spyod rtse mor phyin pas rdo'i —23—

maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod mas rnams ngo shes shing / rnal 'byor ma'i bris sku rnams mthong pas rkyen byas te/ o gsum ma ma bslabs par blo la shar/ de'i sang nyin chos lung byang rtser brtol te/ mchod khang rtser phyin dus 'jigs byed kyi zhal 'bag sogs rtsad gcod byas shing / dge slong rnam grol la zhang 'khrul zhig gi thugs dam dgra nag gi sku sogs rtsad gcod byas pas/ dge slong pas mchi ma btang / sngags sku sngar ma mthong bar phal cher yang ngo shes pa rdzun med dpang po can yin no/ /gang gi rigs dag sad gyur pa/ /de la de yi phun tsho gis 'byung / /yongasasmin pad+ma'i ge sar rnams/ /nyin byed shar na lhag par rgyas/ /de nas mi ring bar dus chen yang tshugs/ de grol nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang thog ma'i rten 'brel du zhus/ slar gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ de dus dbang zhu ba'i 'dun pa dang bla ma lhar bsgoms pa sogs gsal zhing mos gus skye bar byung / gzhan yang de skabs sgrub sder gsung ngag lam 'bras la sogs pa chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor ba gnang gin 'dug pas/ gang la gang 'tsham gyi rjes gnang byin rlabs sogs kyang zhus shing / khyad par dpal kyai rdo rje yab bka' yum bka'i dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun ldan gyi tshul gyis nos/ 'di dag gi gong du bla med kyi dbang gnyis gsum tsam zhu myong yang gsang mtshan tsam yang blo la ma zin 'dug 'di skabs tshig don gyi go rtogs ji bzhin rnyed pa ma byung rung / maṇ+ḍal —24—

'bul mtshams dang dbang rdzas sogs kyi rim pa krig ge blo la chags/ dkyil 'khor du bla mas dbang bskur ba'i go ba dang bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med du byed pa sogs kyi rnam gzhag chags pa tsam byung / gshed dmar gyi dbang dang / kyai rdor gnyis ka la me tog gtso bos bzhes de dang mthun pa'i ming stsal/ gsang mtshan yang grogs kyis 'dzin pa la ma bltos par rang blos ma brjed par bzung thub/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rje btsun brag stod par yang / sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / bla med kyi dbang 'ga' zhig dang / tshe dbang brgya tshar/ khyung khra dus 'khor lugs/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ grub brgya'i chos skor sogs thob/ rje drung rin po che jo nang pa'i drung du yang / pu ṭa'i zur bka' sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig zhus/dbyar smad byang du sde pa sku mched gzigs phyogs mi gcig pa'i dus mi bde la brten zhabs drung stobs drung yang yul bud gal/ khong pa yod na rje dam pa'i bstan pa cung zad spel ba'i 'dun pa yod mod kyi/ so so'i dus mtshams kyi dar rgud 'byung ba 'dus byas spyi'i chos nyid du 'dug de rjes su'ang sku mdun zhing bshag pa lo shas bzhugs na'ang 'phral phun sum tshogs pa yong ba yod na'ang de'ang de lta'o/ /'on kyang gnas skabs 'jig rten phyogs kyi spros spros bkur bkur cog cog med pa de ka phan yon du song ste/ rang gi tshugs khyer la bltos pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel bar byung bas/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rjes ma dor par nges shes skyes so/ /de skabs yar lam yon bdag so sos byin pa'i rdzas kyang bzang rab yod pa/ smon 'gro ba dang yon mchod —25—

gcig byed pa'i khungs byas/ skyos mar ming btags pa'i sum cha tsam smon 'gror bstab pa yin na'ang gzhan gyis sel bcug pa yin nam sems/ bar skabs nas 'phan ne rang gis kyang reg la ma 'byar ba'i 'phra' lag pa dam la bsam gtan gyi dogs pa khong 'chang rang byas/ gzhan byang phyogs kyi bla ma 'dra dang ci rigs pas/ de skabs nged rang rtsed mo'i bya ba la gtor rgyag dang /'jigs byed kyi phyag mtshan thams cad dpal lags kyis bcos shing de rnams thogs pa'i 'cham byed tshul sogs rtsed mo tsam la sgro btags pa'i bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po sogs la/ khong dpon slob kyis zhabs drung stobs kyi phyogs zhen byas/ gtor rgyag byed kyin yod par 'dug tshul sogs mang po byung ste la cha/ de la bden zer 'cha' ba ni de las kyang rgod bro/ gzhan yang brjod gleng sna tshogs la brten pa'i bdag po sku mched de kun khong tsho rang 'das 'das kyi bar du ma mgu pa'i khungs rang gda'/ de skabs chos lung gi chos ra na/kun mkhyen don dpal ba'i thugs dam 'jigs byed kyi ras bris zhal ba la sbyar ba de mthong res kyi yid la dga' ba dpag tu med pa skye zhing / khyad par du 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs kyi tshigs bcad dang / 'jigs byed kyi sngags gsum po dpal lags kyis lan re tsam 'don gyin 'dug pa 'dzin rtsol ma dgos par rang babs su blo la chags/ skabs shig mchod khang rtse nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil thang chen mo de blangs nas lta yin yod skabs/ lha mgron myur mdzad mgon po'i sku dang nged rang gi bar der bya rog cig lhung thabs su babs/ ma hā ka la de na zer dbyangs gda'/ dgun dus yin na'ang thugs —26—

la me'i rnam pa ci yang 'bar ba zhig byung / smon 'gror yang phyin nas zla gcig tsam bsdad/ yang chos lung du 'ongs dgun zangs kyi 'phral chas dkon ne ba byung / de la rgyu mtshan mang po 'dog 'brug lo hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig la klog yig slob pa'i 'go tshugs/ ka mad sum cu la de nyid tshar gsum bzhi zhig ngos sbyor byas/ sang zhogs klog pas he'i thad du cung zhig bsam dgos/gzhan rnams thogs med du shar gyis byung / brtson 'grus cher ma byas pas klog byang rab tu 'gro ba la lo lhag tsam thogs/ yang de skabs zla bo 'ga' dang lhan cig rdo chal du rtsed mo byed 'phro la 'phral du zla bo tsho la ma sdod 'gro byas nang du sleb 'phral rbab shin tu rang che ba zhig lhungs pas ngo mtshar du rtsi ba byung / de skabs gting skyes nas 'bod mi byung zhing lam kun na tseg ge'i bags che bar yod zer bas/ 'phan ne sogs phal cher gyis ma phyin pa legs tshul mdzad kyin 'dug na'ang / tseg ge la rdo brdung btang bas chog byas/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig la bteg nas rim gyis gdong dgar 'byor/de skabs dpon sa dpon sgrel po dang rnam rgyal lags gnyis yod/ rim pas mdos 'drar sa skyong rab mdzes pa dang mjal zhing / de'i sang nyin mkhar chen du 'byor/ bsu ba sogs kyi bkod pa rgya chen po yang mdzad/ bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can dang yang mjal/ de skabs mos gus dga' tshad yod/ rjes su mos gus cher gtong dgos rgyur 'dug ste/ bred po gsum la chos bred thu/ zer ba de rang yod par gda'o/ /de nas zhug lnga nas bla ma rin po che ni gser mdog can du chos 'khor la thegs song / nged kyis —27—

de mtshams chos grar spos/ brag stod du spyan 'dren brdzangs ba bzhin/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po phebs/ ni gu'i khrid gnang skabs nyid mtshan thams cad yid dga' bas khyab pa'i gnyid kyang 'di byung mi shes pa yul yul pa zla ba lhag tsam gyi bar du byung zhing / khrid gnang ba'i tshig don gsal bar go ci rigs blo la yang chags/ phag dkar gyi rjes gnang zhig zhus nas chos dbang pas grogs byas te zhag bdun bsnyen pa bskyal/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhus dus sta gon gyi nub mo rmi lam ya mtshan can mang po byung / phyis mched grogs pa rnams kyis nang du dam sel byed pa'i rmi ltas kyang gsal bar byung / gzhan yang chos bka' dpag tu med pa thob/ gting skyes chos grwar zla ba drug bsdad/ de skabs yar 'brog nas myur shad yong dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin shar phyogs la bskyod de/ gam pa rdzong dang gad dang rgyang ro'i gzhung ded nas phyin/ stag lung rdzong du zhag bcu skor song / de nas chos sde'i bla brang dkar por spos/ ston dang dgun de'i ring 'dul ba lung gi po ti gnyis gsum dang / skyes rabs brgya rtsa sogs la klog dar 'dra byas pas lo rgyus mang po blo la zin gzhan la bshad du btub tsam byung / 'di yan la bstan pa spyi'i chos spyod rnams blo la chud cing / ston ka 'di nas bzung ste dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs dang yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo ma chag par byas pa yin/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du tseg ges thebs pa yang myur du sor chud/de skabs nyin mo skad 'gags pa la mtshan mo gnyid kyi skabs bla rdol thabs su mtshan brjod sogs chos spyod kyi rigs dang / yi dam gyi mngon rtogs che chung —28—

rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba bzhugs/rnams ma nor bar gtsang sing nge skad gsal por 'don pa kho na de'i ring la rtag tu byung 'dug zla bo tsho ni dkyus ma min pa bar chad yin nam snyam blo skyog zer/ cho 'phrul gyi sgang la tshe dpag med kyi bzlas mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig dang sgrol dkar gyi bzlas pa mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig byas/ zla ba gza' 'dzin zhig dang bstun nas phyag rdor gyi bzlas pa mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig kyang byas te zla ba gang yin brjed 'dug dpyid phyogs rje btsun dpal stag lung pa chen po lha sa'i zhig gsos dang gser phibs 'bul bar phebs skabs/sog yul du 'gro don rgya che ba'i legs lam 'bul bar kun dga' snyan grags btang / de nas bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can spyan 'dren du chos mdzad kun rgyan btang / khong tshos kyang 'phral du sku gzhogs su 'byor/ hor zla drug pa'i tshe lnga la yar 'brog stag lung gi chos sder zhabs zung dgod par mdzad/ tshes bcu gcig nas thar gling chos sde'i bla ma slob dpon drag bsdus thugs dam la gzhol ba lnga bcu skor dang / bdag cag la sogs pa kun bsgril ba brgya skor zhig la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag dbu tshugs par gnang zhing / 'di skabs lam 'bras kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa dang / snga phyir rjes gnang zur bka' bzhi bcu lhag tsam dang / de dag dang 'brel ba so so'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa mtha' rgyas su gnang zhing / bdag gis kyang 'di nas brtsams nas lam dus thun re re dang / lam zab dang / bir srung thun mong ba/ rnal 'byor ma rnams 'chags med du 'grub cing / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zhus pa'i nub rmi lam —29—

gyi snang ba shin tu gsal ba la/ bdag rang gangs bzang gi mgul nas yar gos dmar po zhig gyon nas 'gro yin 'dug pa/ gangs kyi phug cig nas bud med gshone nu zhig byung nas ngas lam sna bya'o zhes/ gangs la zhig brgal nas phyin pa nas phyogs nyams dga' ba/ me tog shin tu che bas khyab pa zhig nas phar sleb pas/ snang ba 'gyur zhing yid dga' sems chen po zhig la lung pa de gang yin dris pas o rgyan yin zer/ de'i mthar dur khrod kyi rnam pa 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba zhig gi sbubs nas yar phyin tsa na/ phug pa chen po zhig gi nang na bud med stong tsam 'dug cing / dbus na khri chen po zhig la gzi brjid dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i mi'i bud med kyi rnam pa las 'das shing 'di lta bu'o zhes brjod par dka' ba'i gtso mo zhig bzhugs 'dug pa/ de la phyag cig byas nas drung du 'dug tsa na/ gtso mo des phyag bdag gi spyi bor ba theg pa'i mod la/ bud med de thams cad gad mo theg theg pa zhig byed kyin 'dug pa/ de ka'i ngang la gnyid sad de rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur pa'i mtshan mar go /de skabs gsung ngag sogs mthar phyin tsa na yar rgyab kyi dpung chen thams cad yar 'brog stag lung du lhags shing / 'on kyang bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis chos sde de nyid du gdan phab pa'i bar chings yang yang 'gyung ba la brten nas rdzongs 'tshangs drag po rang ha cang mang ba ma byung / spyir stag lung rdzong la zla ba gsum tsam dmag gis bskor/ mthar khrigs kyang legs par thob/ skabs der byang stag lung nas rje btsun bla mas a ho bkra shis phun tshogs pa ja 'dren du gnang / bdag cag der yod pas —30—

kyang yar 'brog tu phan thogs shin tu che bar byung / dus gzings de skabs thams cad du yang bka' chos thun gcig kyang ma chag cing / yar rgyab nas sde pa dpon chen drung sku mched dpon g.yog rnams kyang thugs shin tu mos gus che bar 'dug hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun la dmag rnams kyang gyes/tshes bcu dgu la yar 'brog stag lung nas gzhi bteg 'brug sprul gyi lo 'di tsho la zhabs drung stobs dang yang yang mjal byung / rim pas rgyal rtser phebs/de skabs ngos kyis kyang mkhan rin po che dang mjal ba'i chos bka' ci rigs zhus/ de mtshams te skyes su sde pa rab mdzes drung gshegs par brten/ bla ma dam pa spyan 'dren byung bas gting skyes phyogs la phebs song / rgyal rtse zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang zhig phul/ ngos kyis rim pas spos khang du/ mkhan chen kun dga' chos skyong bas 'bod mi gnang ba ltar phyin/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i snam sbyar dang rdza sku don zhags kyi bris thang sogs tshogs chos lung pa'i rten khyad par can thams cad mjal/ de nas pa snam du sde pa kun lha'i drung dang mjal/ bkra shis rdzong khar yang phyin theg bdun tsam bsdad/ mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub dang thog mar 'di dus mjal/ gnas bcu'i thang ka cig bkram 'dug de'i yan lag 'byung dang sku'i rnam pa 'dra ba'i gtam rgyud cig yod/ de nas tshong 'dus su mkhan chen zla ba bzang po sogs gser mdog can gyi mkhan slob rnams dngos 'phrad par phebs/ chos 'brel tsam phul/ lu gu rir theg gsum bsdad/ myur shad du lam bcad de/ mda' rgyab kyi dar la thon nas dga' por sleb pa'i nub/ jo nang gi sgrub pa mo thams cad —31—

'phrad par byung / de nub rang jo mda'i thad kar dar mi theg tsam chags/ sang snga dro khong thams cad la ma ṇi'i lung zhig byas/ rtsed chung gi 'phrang mtshams par sgrub pa mo byings skyel ma la byung / khong rnams ldog dus dar khyer grub 'dug zer/ kun chos pa nas dang po rje dam pa la yang 'di bzhin byung ya mtshan po yin pa 'dug zer/ de nyin nyer lnga yin zhing de nub chos lung du sleb/de res cho 'phrul dus chen gyi skabs su tshogs la sdod rtag par byas/ cho ga rnams blo la byang bar yod cing / dmigs pa rnams kyang gsal rab dang tshogs la sdod pa la mi sun zhing dang spro bar byung ngo / /mkhan rin po che'i zhabs drung dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs rin po che sogs zhal mthun pa'i bka' bkod du/ khyod kyi gnas kyi slob dpon dang klog pa'i slob dpon du bsten par 'os pa ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa lhun grub nyid yin te/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan thams cad kyis nye bar brgyan pa dang grub mtha' bzang zhing rje dam pa'i dngos slob gtsang mar gyur pa dang khyad par gser mdog can du rje dam pas chos 'khor mdzad skabs mjal dar 'bul bar mdzad pa la yang dar 'di/ dar ba chen po chos kyi tog bya ba yin zhes pa'i lung bstan khyad par can brnyes pa yin pas so/ /zhes phebs pa ltar/bla ma gnyis kyi bka' la brten dus chen grol mtshams kyi tshes bcu bdun la phebs/ zla 'phro de ni ci bder bzhugs/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig gza' skar bzang pa nas/ tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi dpe 'dzin gyi 'go brtsams shing de nyin rang bsdus rkang brtsi ba'i yang 'go tshugs/ phebs sgo la —32—
