yang dang po rje dam pa la yang 'di bzhin mdzad 'dug pa bzhin/ don bzang zhing tshig bkra legs pa zhig byed dgos gsung zhing / gzhi grub na brtson 'grus ma yin pa bud zer na/ shes rab chos can zhes pa nas brtsoms zhal nas blangs/ rtags chos don gsum khyab pa 'bud gshog rjes khyab zlog khyab rnams lan gcig gsungs pa tsam gyis mod la go ba chags/ dpyid la dbyar btags te brtson 'grus che ba rang ma byung na'ang / bsdus rkang sum brgya tsam/rnam 'brel gyi thal 'phreng ci rigs pa dang bcas gsung ngag las len pa bla bar byung / go ba dag blo nus 'bring tsam yod pa la/ gzhung dpe 'dzin shin tu kha dog par byung ste/ rigs gter 'dzin pa la'ang zla ba lnga tsam thogs/ de la slob dpon rin po che nas/ nged la chung 'a dus nas yul spyod nyid kyis nya phag sgong gsum dang srog chag sna tshogs pa'i sha zos pas de lta bu'i zas grib kyis bsgribs pa yin nam/ rigs pa'i 'jug sgo 'di la dpags na/ dpe 'dzin yang yangs po zhig yong thang ba la/ sngon dpang lo chen po sku chung ngu'i dus lug gi 'o mas gsos pas rnam dpyod kyi phyed 'gribs zhes gsung pa sogs lo rgyus dang bcas yang yang gsung ba/ de dus kho bo'i sems la shes rab che chung skal ba bzang ngan yin/ zas kyis sgrib rgyu rang ci yod snyam pa shar mod/ lar ni rten 'brel mtha' yas pas de 'dra'ang srid pa 'dug dpyid dus bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can yang phebs/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dbang 'phags zhabs lugs gnyis ka'i rgyud lung man ngag yongs rdzogs/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi chos skor dpag tu med pa dang /—33—

lam skor phyi ma rnams dang / bde mchog lha hi pa'i dbang khrid lung man ngag yongs rdzogs dang / rgyu sde lnga'i dbang chen po sogs snga phyir bka' chos grangs med stsal bas ser kha la thug gi bar nyin zangs kyi chos zhu bas dus 'das pa lta bu byung / skabs der slob dpon dam pa sbyan shin tu bsnyung ba zhig byung bas bsam sdings kyi chos skyong 'khren du thugs dogs pa dang thugs brel 'ga' zhig gi dbang las re zhig shar phyogs su thegs/ snga sor dus chen grol 'phral chos mdzad kun rgyan la sogs pa byang stag lung du/ sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal stag lung pa chen po spyan 'dren pa'i phyir brdzangs pa/ 'bri stag gi zir bun 'phro cung zad yod 'dug pas thugs 'gor che ste/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin par dpon slob zab rgyas cog grwa dang bcas pa chos lung byang chub rtse mor zhabs zung gend cing / de'i sang nyin chos grwar dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po dang / rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun brag stod nas dang / rje drung rin po che rnams dang bcas dpal stag lung pa chen po dang mjal/ gral dang gdan la rtsod pa dang che 'dod sogs ye med thams cad chu la chu bzhag gi thugs snang dag pa legs tshogs shin tu che bar byung / nyer gsum gza' skar bzang ba nas bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus shing / dpal stag lung rin po che spyan 'dren zhus pa'i don gyi gtso bor bka' drin zhu ba nyid yin pa ltar/ rang lo brgyad pa sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i lo khrums stod kyi zla ba'i tshes lnga'i nyin/ chos lung byang rtse'i rtse mchod khang gi yang thog tu snga mor slob pa byas skra bregs rab tu byung ba'i rtags ma yin pa —34—

rnams dor/ skra 'breg mkhan ma chen chos ye ba yin/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te dpal stag lung ba chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi mkhan po dang / mtshan brjod par dka' ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dka' dpal bzang pos dus go ba dang / chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan pa mdzad/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po lnga zhu ba'i yul dang las gral du bzhugs te/ nyi ma bzhi cha shar ba'i dus skyes bu gcig dang rkang pa gnyis kyi dus su chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang rtser/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par mnos te/ 'jig rten gsum du thob par dka' ba'i ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan drang srong gi rtags kyis yang dag par brgyan pa'i bka' drin stsal lo/ /de mtshams mkhan slob dge 'dun bla ma dam pa so so phyogs kyi mi sna sogs gzhi byes shin tu mang ba la dga' ston rgya che ba dang / mkhan po dam par gser zho sum cu so bdun gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs gzhan yang so sor bka' drin rjes dran gyi 'bul ba rang nyid kyi rgyu dngos la bltos pa'i gang 'grub bgyis/dngos cag gi cha nas blo tshim zhing legs tsho gos che ba'i mthar thug tu byung ngo / /srid gsum ma lus skyes bu thob gyur kyang / /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan thob pa'i char mi phod/ /srid kyi 'byor ba 'di ni nam yang 'jig /ngur smrig thob pasa'achi med grong du bgrod/tshes bcu skor la bstan 'dzin rin po che yang dpon slob zab rgyas su byas —35—

nas phebs/ legs ja bzab mar gnang zhing sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dpag med kyi sgom lung zhus/ de nas mi ring bar stag lung rin po che dpon slob rnams kyang shar phyogs su phebs/ 'di skabs thams cad du 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can la/ sa skya gong ma dkar po rnam gsum gyi bka' 'bum gyi lung zhu ba'i skabs yin/ rdze btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug gi drung du yang / 'di res phebs 'phral nas ras chung snyan brgyud kyi smin grol yongs su rdzogs par zhus shing / dpal rtag lung rin po che bzhugs skabs kyang / chos drug sras mkhar ma'i chos thun chag med re dang / skabs 'dir rgya gar gsang spyod yongs su rdzogs par thob/ de mtshams 'tshed nas spyan 'dren gnang ba ltar dgongs bzhed bzhin 'tshed du phebs/ slar yang chos lung du zhag shas bzhugs skabs bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang zhig zhus pa'i dngos gzhi ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs/ lus la bde nyams dpag tu med pa zhig byung zhing / dbang thob nas kyang lus 'gul mi shes pa 'dra ba zhig byung / de nub rmi lam du chu chen po zhig la mi mang po dang lhan cig gru brgal te/ po ta lar 'gro rgyu yin zer ba zhig byung / gzhan yang tshe ring mched lnga'i bka' gtang sogs mang po thob de nas kyang lug lo'i dus chen ma tshugs kyi bar la/ bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can gyi drung du gsol ba thon nas nyi ma nub kyi bar bka' chos kho nas dus 'da' ba'i chos thob shin tu che ba dang / snga dro re bzhin sdom gsum rab dbye'i dpe rgyugs re byang bar bzung / hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu skor la mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan slob dpon rin po che yang phebs byung / lug —36—

lo'i dus chen la mchod khang rtser bla ma rin po ches rdo rje slob dpon gnang shing /'du khang gi tshogs dbu la dngos kyis phyin/ bla ma dam pa dpon slob dus chen grol nas kyang zla gcig skor bzhugs pa gnang skabs/ sa paṇa gyi bka' 'bum gyi lung dang / gzhan yang chos thob shin tu che bar byung / kā ri kā lnga bcu pa dang bzhas springs sogs blo 'dzin byas shing / slob dpon dam pas zhib bshad gnang bas/ rang res kyang dbu zhabs med par 'khru non pa tsam byung / rtags rigs dang blo rigs zhib rgyas su zhal ngag nas bzung de skabs chos lung gi dkar me'i ru ba khri tshang bas bdas/ rmi lam du 'tshub 'gyur dpe med byung / de 'phral rang nas rtags rim par bstan pa yin/dngos la rta lo'i sked tsam man chad nas chos lung du bag mi phebs pa'i snang ba sha stag dang / chos lung nyid du'ang kha mchu sogs ci rigs pa byung zhing / khyad par de skabs su dmigs ltas rtsub cing mi bsrun pa brgyud mar byung / dngos kyi lag na drag drag yod pa kun gcig kyang ma lus par gtsang gi grwa sa dang sde dgon ris med du tshogs gsog spong thag tu btang / da bsams dus bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs pa'i dge ba de yang a re re las mi gda' snyam mo/ /de skabs khri khang nas sde pa grwa lnga'i drung gis 'bod mi byung ba ltar 'gro ba'i rtsis byas/ smon 'gror zhag bcu tsam zhig bsdad skabs grib cham zhig gis btab/slar yang chos lung du yud tsam phyin skabs myom pa shin tu na ba zhig byung / mar lam smon 'gro ba zhal ngo rnams dang sdebs te jo nang du 'ongs/ smon 'gro dpon sas kyang chos gzugs mdzad/ nged la ming zhu bar byung ba kyal ka'i —37—

tshul du 'jig rten ma nus pa'i khar chos kyang ma nus pa zhig 'ong / kun dga' ma nus btags na yong ba 'dra byas/ phyis lo gang yang ma 'gor bar de ka rang byung ba de yin/ de nas snar thang sogs brgyud nas tshong 'dus su 'byor/ zhag gsum tsam skyed tshul du bsdad/ pha jo yang 'brang nas phebs byung / mes po rin po che chos dbyings su gshegs pa'i skad cha yang go /dgongs rdzogs sogs kyang grub par gda'/ de skabs rdzas rnams thams cad spong thag tu btang zin/ 'phral gyi 'tsho ba'ang bya tshol byi tshol las rang dbang thob pa cang med na'ang / 'phral chas yon bdag dad ca' la brten pas chog pa byung bas rtsol sgrub 'phran bu 'dra byas nas/ zha lu snar thang gnyis su mang ja 'gyed bcas tsam dang / thang kha gsum tsam zhig bzhengs nas mes po rin po che'i dgongs pa rdzogs par smon lam btab/ de skabs gsos la dbyar btags pa zla ba lnga'i bar du chos rgyal pho brang du bsdad shin tu skyid cing slob gnyer 'pher bar byung / de bar du snga dro re bzhin zhogs rgyugs cung zad re ma chag par bzung bas/ mngon pa mdzod dang spyod 'jug gi gzhung rdzogs par zin/rtog ge snying po'i bar bar du mtha' gcod kyi spyi don dang thal ngag nyer mkhos brgyan pa/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun las bzung / dgongs re bzhin blo gsal 'ga' re dang bsgro gleng yun ring rab re ma chag par byas shing / bar bar du spyod 'jug la go bshad zhus pa yang mgo zhabs tshar gyis yongs su rdzogs par song / shes rab le'u la go ba ji bzhin rang zhig de dus ma chags/de min tshig thams cad la go bshad kyang pher ba byung nas slob dpon rin po —38—

ches ma gsan par lkog tu gzhan la rdzogs par bshad/ bzod pa'i le'u dang bsam gtan gyi le'u'i skabs kyi bzod pa sgom pa dang bdag gzhan brje ba sgom tshul rig pas dpyad pa mang po 'dug pa de kun la ya mtshan cher skye bar byung / spyod 'jug 'dzin skabs rmi lam kyang bzang / 'di skabs nas gzung dpe 'dzin gyi kha yang snga ma las gsum 'gyur tsam gyis che bar song / nyin re bzhin du gzhung 'dzin dpe rgyugs dang gsung ngag nas bzung ba sogs nyin rgyugs mang rab re yong gin 'dug pas gshor sbyang rem par byas/ 'dir sdod ring mngon rtogs rgyan yang gsung spor gyi ngang nas blo la chud/ mas kyi 'jig rten bstan pa dang las bstan pa gnyis 'bru bshad thub pa byung / phyis byung rang bla ma la la gsung lugs rang gi yon tan la zad rgyu med par khas len/ la las zhogs rgyugs re rer glo ka lnga brgya zin/ zhogs rgyugs re la 'jug pa'i gzhung zin zer ba yong 'dug nga ni de 'dra'i rigs ye min sgo dog po gcig ka yin/ gang zin de la go blo rang bzang rab 'dog rje grol mchog ni thugs rtsol che ba rang yin par 'dug nga ni le lo dang snyoms las kyi mnga' bdag rang yin no/ /deng mthun par snying thag kyang shin tu ring ba gcig lags pa re chen po ma mdzad cig de skabs hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum la pa snam lhun grub rtser phyin zhing / sde ba grwa lnga'i drung sogs zhal ngo thams cad dang mjal zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ sa n+ya shi mang po dang rgya gar gyi gleng slang mang po byung / de nas bsam sdings su phyin zhag gsum ngal gso byas/ nyin gcig jo mo sman gcig phur thang gi rtse la ri ltas la phyin/ phyogs thams cad mthong gsal che dzā—39—

zhing nyams dga' ba zhig 'dug pas des rkyen du gyur te phyi nang gi snang ba thams cad yul yul ba zhig gi ngang nas ngos gzung dang bral ba'i rjes lhag ge ba zhig byung ste de skabs ngo ma shes/ de nas zla ba gcig mtshams dam par bcad de gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i mngon rtogs kyi steng nas sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa bskyal/ rmi lam du khron pa chung ngu gting zab pa zhig gi kha na 'dug pa/ khron pa'i gting nas chu chen po gyen du brdol te/ lung ba thams cad mtsho chen po zhig tu mer gyis song / mtsho de'i dbus na me tog shin tu che ba ser po dang sngon po shas che ba 'dug de mtshams nas rmi lam yang zin cing / snang ba de la yun ring du blta rtog byas/ yang lan gcig lung pa gcig na sa rdo ri klung med pa g.yu las grub pa 'dra ba zhig la nags chen pos khyab pa/ brag phug kyang mang du 'dug pa zhig la brag phug thams cad na gsung rab gser ma re 'dug de rnams zhal phye zhing bltas pa thams cad na sgrol ma'i sngags 'ba' zhig bris 'dug sa phyogs 'di yang g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing yin snyam pa dang /nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' tshon dkrug dkrug pa dang rol mo'i sgra chen po grag cing me tog sder ma tsam gyi char 'bab kyin 'dug pas/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma nam mkha'i mthong na bzhugs nges snyam pa'i mos gus chen po byed kyin 'dug de nas mi gcig na re sa cha 'di rgya nag gi shar na yod zer bas rkyen byas te/ kha sang rang bsam sdings na yod pa yin pa la 'di rmi lam du 'dug snyam pa dang / de thams cad yul gyis yal nas song / de nas mtshams grol nas bkra shis rdzong khar phyin/ dpe mtshams kyi tshul du zla gcig bsdad/—40—

zhogs rgyugs la dbu ma 'jug pa bzung zhing / gro thon nas tshad ma'i spyi don gyi 'phros nas ngag slob tu zhus shing / dgongs ja nas srod la thug gi bar sher snying dang sgrol ma sogs kha 'don ci smar byas/ rmi lam gyi ltas kha cig byung /snga sor rta lo'i nang du chos lung gi gnyer la kun chos pa dang smon 'gro nas dpon sa'i drung gi gros steng nas/ nged kyi lag g.yog snyan grags pa bskos pa yin na'ang / bsam sdings nas mched grogs dpal sdengs pa myur shad stod phyogs la song / smon 'gror phyin rgyang tsam song skabs mched grogs pa dang tshe dbang don grub pa gros kyi steng nas snyan grags gnyer tshang dang chos grwa sogs na yod na/ dgon pa la rtsis med kyi lag thal du gtong rgyu yin pa 'dug na'ang sgrub sde'i 'du khang du chos lnga sgrub mchod kyi sar bros thar/ kun chos pa la'ang skyon de 'dra yod grabs byung / de ka'i gnas tshul tshor ba la brten nas chos dbang pa dang tshong 'dus nas mi sna 'tsho byed lhas byin dang bcas chos lung gi gnyer gyi sar btang zhing / de lo'i ston sdud skabs/ smon 'gro nas kyang mdzad sgo ngan pa ci rigs pa dang / mched grogs dpal bas ngan smra mang po dang / chos lung bkra shis pas kyang smon 'gro'i rgyab skyor ba'i bka' bkyon mche ba gtsigs gtsigs pa 'dug tsa na/ zla ba gnyis gsum nas khong rang 'ur song / de nas slar yang bsam sdings su khor gcig phyin/ de skabs bdag slob dpon rin po ches sgrub gnas bsam sdings kyi khri thog tu ba6ga de nas mkhan rin po che'i bka' bkod ltar dpal 'khor bde chen du 'byor/zhag shas sku gzhogs su ngal gsos/ smon 'gro nam mkha' rin po cher yang ci —41—

rigs zhus pa'i kun chos pa zur du 'jog dgos tshul gyi bka' nan phebs pa ltar 'jog dgos byung / dngos kyis rtse rgyal du zla gcig zhag nyi shu tsam bsdad/sngar gyi dpe cha rnams skyor sbyang tsam ma gtogs de bar du slob gnyer 'di yin rang zhig ma byung / hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga skor la slar yang chos sde'i bla brang dkar por bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i mkhan rin po che nyid kyi zhabs 'bring du 'byor/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid dang / skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim zhib rgyas stsal/ blo sbyong dang lam rim gyi yig lung mang po dang /rgyal sras bka' 'bum/ mi tra khrid drug sgrol ma nyer gcig jo bo lugs/rjes gnang zur bka' shin tu rnam grangs mang ba/ man ngag khrod phu rgya rdza ma/brgyad stong pa dang sher phyin gyi mdo phran rnams dang / snying po'i mdo bcu sogs kyi lung / gzhan yang rdo rje 'jigs byed skor sogs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs shin tu mang ba dang bcas pa thob cing / 'dir sdod ring zhogs rgyugs la rnam 'grel le'u dang po yongs rdzogs/ dgongs mo theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i 'phrin las kyi phyed tsam yan zin cing / phar phyin gyi spyi don thal ngag sogs gsung las thun che rab re ma chag par bzung nyin gung mkhan rin po che'i sku gzhogs su dam bca' bsgro gleng re ma chag pa dang / nub mo yang bsgro gleng rgyang tsam re 'chag med byas/ gzhung don la blo bskyed kyang che bar byung / spre'u lo de nyid kyi sa ga zla ba'i nang du dge tsha sogs kyi thugs brel la brten pa'i chos thob sogs mi yong ba 'dug pas/ tshes lnga nas gzims khang mkha' spyod du bskyas/ tshes brgyad nas mtshams bsdams te/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam —42—

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen pa la zhugs/ zla ba gcig tsam nas sde gzar gyi zir bun langs pas/ slob dpon rin po che'i drung bsam sdings phyogs su phebs song zhing / dngos kyis bsnyen pa'i 'phro bskyangs hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu la mtshams grol/ bcu gsum la mkhar kha rdzong du phyin/ zla ba gnyis tsam zhabs 'bring du bsdad/ der mdo rgyud thams cad kyi snying po/ dus gsum sa ngas rgyas thams cad kyi sgrod pa gcig pu'i lam/ zab lam thams cad kyi rgyal po/ nges don mthar thug las kyang shin tu mthar thug pa/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa thob ste/ de yang jo nang lugs la khrid dmigs zhig rgyas su stsal/ sngon 'gro'i dam po grol nyin mchog dbang gnang zin tsam na/ nang rol lung pa'i mi rnams nged la ma ṇi'i lung zhu ba la byung / bka' las sbyor drug gi 'gro don sa 'ur rdo 'ur 'ong pa 'dug gsung /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i dam po'i skabs rnams lus mnyen pas zug gzer ni cher ma byung / bar bar du gnyid du thor re ba song / lus gnad lta stangs kyi bye bcings kho na'i mthu las rtags snang ci rigs pa shar/ jo lugs kyi 'khrid grol nas/ bu lugs la mgyogs 'khrid du gnang ba zhag po bcu skor la tshar/jo zhal bla ma dam pa lugs kyi yig skor tshang ma dang / rgya gzhung dang yig rnying phal cher dang / nges don rgya mtsho sogs kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung mang po'i lung / dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs dang khrid/ rgya gzhung dang yig rnying skor po ti gcig 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba'i yig skor gyi lung /grub thob chos drug mdo sde dkon brtsegs kyi lung la sogs pa chos kyi rnam —43—

grangs shin tu mang ba so so'i 'dod chos su stsal ba rnams kyang thams cad thob/tshe 'dir nyams khrid thob pa'i thog ma sbyor drug lags shing / dam po grol nas mkhar khar sdod ring de la rgyud bla'i 'phros dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po brtag pa gnyis pa rdzogs pa bzung / bka' chos kyi bar bar bzhugs gral thams cad du phar tshad gang rigs re la bshad pa dang / bsgro gleng yang yang byed dgos/de min mkhar khar sdod ring de sor sdud dang srog rtsol la sgom thun re yang byas/mdo phyogs kyi dpe cha rnams ni bzhag brtags gnyis la blo 'gro bar byung /'grel ṭīka sogs lta rtog lcogs pa med na'ang rgyud nyid la go ba ci rigs pa blo la 'char thub pa tsam byung ngo / /smras pa/ gang zhig bdud rtsi 'thung la mngon dga' ba/ /de dag nges par 'chi med gnas su 'jug /dbul po'i khyim gnas rin chen gter brnyed dang //bcud len dam pa thob 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /de nas slar yang phyag phyir dkris nas phu'i la la bcad de chos sde chen por phebs/ su kha co lo drug 'bri gung ba'i zab chos dgongs gcig bstan snying sogs der yang chos mang po thob/ de skabs slob dpon rin po che yang phebs byung zhing / bka' phebs la kha sing nas mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer 'phro chad pa ma legs/ sngar gyi tsho la brjed gsos kyis gsung / gzhud rnams sngar byang po yod pas brjed gsos cher dgos pa ma byung / spyi don bshad pa sogs la brjed gsos kyang byas/ de nas hor zla brgyad pa'i nyi shu lnga drug tsam gyi tshe/mkhan rin po che dpon slob rnams gzhis ka rin sbungs pa'i dmag sgar khyung —44—

rtser brtol ba la/ chos sde chen po'i zhu don rgya che ba dang / mjal 'phrad sogs la phebs pa gnang song zhing / nged kyis de mtshams blangs pa gser gling du phyin/ zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bsdad pa chos rje kun bkras pas mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa la brten skyid du tshor ba byung / der yang slob gnyer gyi ngo bo sngar gyi 'phros la phar tshad kyi khyi ka so so nas gang la gang 'tshams slob dpon mkhas pa'i zhal las blangs shing / rgyud bla la bshad pa tshar gcig gnang bas gzhung gi 'bru bshad pher pa tsam byung / shoges rgyugs su mdo sde rgyan dang 'byed gnyis byang bar bzung / 'di skabs rmi lam du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugs kyi rnam pa sha stag yong ba zhig byung / hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin khrom dbang zhig dang dgon pa'i rten mjal zhib par byas shing / khyad par dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra phyag gnas ma de la mos gus chen po skyes shing gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ zhal ras la zil pa khrom khrom byung ba sor mos blangs te mid pas lus sems bde cham me ba la snang ba 'gyur ba nyi ma gnyis tsam byung / de skabs sdod yul gzims khang chos 'khor du grags pa de gnas rengs kyi rnam pas shin tu 'tshub cing cho 'phrul che ba zhig 'dug de nas rtse chen nas 'bod mi gnang ba dang bstun zla ba bcu pa'i 'jug tsam la rtse chen chos sde'i bla brang shar du sleb/ rgyud bla ma'i gzhung gi 'phros dang / rnam 'grel gyi le'u gnyis pa dang bzhi pa dang gsum pa'i grags che che rnams 'dir sdod skabs bzung ba yin zhing / khyi ka'i nye bar mkho mkho nas kyang mang du bzung / bka' las kyang tshad ma'i dpe cha sngar yang mang du song da —45—

dung 'di legs par shes pa rang zhis byed dgos phebs kyin 'dug na'ang / de skabs tshad ma'i chos skad la blo 'gro ba zhig ma byung bas dpe 'dzin sogs dkyus mthun byas mod kyi/ tshad ma la chos skad lhongs su gyur pa ma chags/phyis tshad ma'i dpe cha la dpe klogs 'dra byed dgos byung ba'i tshe sngar dang mi 'dra ba go ba 'char 'char 'dra ba yong gin 'dug na'ang / chos byed lugs nged cag gi rigs 'di la dgos don chung bar shes nas rtsol ba byed pa ma byung ngo / /spyir nas byang chub sems dpa' mchog shing rta chen po'i ring lugs la 'gangs chung zer ba lta ga la yin/ mkhas mchog thams cad kyi 'jug ngogs yin pa gzhir bcas/ dgun de bla brang shar gyi dpe cha rnams la dpe blta chi kha mor byas/ de skabs bla brang na'ang dpe cha shin tu mang bar 'dug cing / dpe cha klogs pas don go bas blo bskyed 'phral 'phral thon pa rang ma byung na'ang /mdo sngags kyi gzhung rgya bod kyi 'grel pa yig cha so so'i 'jogs kyi yong thang la 'di lta bu yod par 'dug snyam pa'i chos rgyus la shin tu phan par byung / bya lo'i cho 'phrul kyi skabs/ gsung rab dang rten bzhengs gsar pa mdzad pa rnams la/ slob dpon rin po tshes rab tu gnas pa mdzad pa'i phyag phyir dkris te nged rang gis kyang cho ga byas/ lan gcig po de kha la rab gnas kyi phyag len nges par byung / snga sor spyan 'dren btang ba ltar de'i sang nyin brag stod nas rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal snga nas kyang phebs/ tshes bcu dgu la slar yang dpon slob thams cad lhan du bla brang shar du byon/ de'i sang nyid na bsre 'pho'i khrid dang 'bum nag gi lung gi dbu tshugs/ zla ba gcig la —46—

chos skor rnams yongs su rdzogs par gnang / bla ma dam pa ni zhabs drung bkra shis stobs rgyas drung gis ra lung du khor tsam spyan 'dren gnang song zhing slar yang rtse chen du phebs nas gyi ljang lugs mgon po lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang dang / 'gro mgon zhang gi bka' 'bum po ti dang po'i lung sogs stsal zhing /hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum gza' skar dge ba la/ ngos cag rtse chen chos sde'i khri thog tu mnga' gsol/ sras yum rnams dang / rgyal rtse nas yon mchod/phyogs kyi dad can so so nas legs ja yang mang dag byung / 'di nas bzung nas mthun rkyen yang ma 'phongs tsam dang / khyad par ja bskol rgyu 'bad med du byung / de nas tshes bcu la 'brong rtser sleb tsam byas/ stag rtse dang lhun grub rtser khor tsam phyin nas/ dpon slob thams cad ri khrod chen po bsam sdings su phyag phebs/ zla ba gnyis tsam gyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen por/chos kyi sgo bgrang ba las 'das pa thob ste/ zha8 'tshal pa'i chos skor thams cad dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang / ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ dwags po bka' 'bum sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma snga phyir byon pa'i gsung rab shin tu mang po dang / mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang /sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang sogs thob cing / o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid dang lung yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bcu gsum phag mo'i byin rlabs sogs dpag tu med pa thob cing / chos bar du zab mo'i chos kyi gleng slang las brtsams pa'i sku rtsed bzhad gad theg ge ba/ nyin mtshan kun tu nyams dga' yal le bas 'da' ba byung / de nas bkra shis rdzong kha nas spyan 'dren bzhin —47—

rdzong khar phebs zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs/ rje btsun mar pa'i thugs bcud thugs sras rngog la bka' 'babs pa'i dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug dang smra ti nas brgyud rngog pa la byung ba 'jam dpal gsang ldan rnams kyi dbang bskur ba dang / so so'i rgyud 'grel/ rgya bod kyi yig sna shin tu mang ba dang bcas pa'i lung stsal zhing /dgyes pa rdo rje'i zab khrid/ bsre 'pho'i 'khrid tshul zab rgyas su gnang /dgyes rdor yab yum gdan bzhi ma hā mā ya rnams kyi dbang gnang skabs rmi lam gyi ltas ngo mtshar can yang mang du byung / byin rlabs kyi tshad ka zla med par yid ches brnyed/ bar skabs su thob rgyal du 'bod mi nan can byung ba la brten khor tsam zhig phyin/ ra lung nas spyan 'dren gnang ba ltar rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po slar yang ra lung du phebs pa gnang song zhing / bdag gis bsam sdings su 'ongs/ de skabs dus 'khrug gi zir bun yang che bar yod/rtse chen nas 'ong nas de bar du chos thob che zhing zab mo'i don la blo skyed che bar byung yang / mdo phyogs kyi slob gnyer 'phro chad/ slar yang 'phro 'thud pa'i khungs tsam du yod na'ang / gtam bya rin chen 'phreng ba gsar 'dzin thub/ de min ston la thug gi bar dpe cha byas rjes cang ma byung / snga sor zha lu pa'i bka' srol skyong ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug rje byang gling pa la chos gang zhu zhu yod kyang 'dun pa med pas zhu ma thub/ 'di skabs sku gshegs pas phyis 'gyod par byung / de nas sde pa gtsang pa'i dmag kyang pa snam du lhags/ rdzong la 'pho 'byug byung / sde pa grwa lnga'i drung smin drug khyung rtser 'byor dgos shar/—48—

ser kha de rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po slar yang bsam sdings su phebs shing /bla sgrub dang rten 'brel yongs su rdzogs par thob/ ro snyoms sgang dril tsam zhig dang / 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma'i dbang sogs yid tshim par byung / dus gzings grol 'phral khri snar lhun rtse gting skes sogs brgyud nas sgrub gnas dam par phebs pa gnang song / de nas mi ring bar rje drung dbang phyug rdo rje pa snam du phebs pa la/ bdag gis kyang zhal mjal zhu bar phyin cag mal zhig bsdad/ slar yang dgon par log phyin nas theg shas shig song skabs/ stod phyogs nas bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can yon mchod rnams kyis 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar stod phyogs la 'ongs/ smin drug khyung rtser sde ba grwa lnga'i drung dang mjal tsam byas/ tshong 'dus dbu rtser sde pa rje drung dang lhun chen sogs dang mjal zhag shas bsdad/ lo chen rat+na bha dra'i sprul sku yang karma pa mjal bar phebs pa'i lam zhor du dbu rtser phebs/ nged la shin tu thugs dag snang che bar mdzad kyin 'dug thog mar ngos kyis 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig zhus shing / phar yang chos 'brel zhig dgos gsung ba ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig ka phul/ yar lam snar thang sogs brgyud nas/rje klu sgrub pas 'bod mi gnang pa ltar bya rgod gshongs su khor tsam phyin rim pas jo nang du sleb rje drung dang mjal tsam byas shing / hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la chos lung byang chub rtser son/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can dang mjal/ zhal ras mthong ba tsam la lus nyams dpe med pa zhig byung / zla ba de'i ngo sgang la bka' chos mang du —49—

zhus/ cho 'phrul dus chen gyi tshes lnga'i nyin/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas mchog chos lung byang rtser khri thog tu bsko ba gnang zhing / bla ma dam pa nyid kyis phyag nas kyang gtor/ snga sor bsam sdings nas yar yong grabs yod pa'i skabs nas nyin re bzhin sna khrag than thun yong ba byung / yun ring pa nas skabs 'di tsa na lus kyi shed kyang cung zad bri/ de skabs smon 'gror 'phan ne drung gi nang rten gser gdung bzhengs grub pa'i skabs yin pas dus chen grol nyin rang / bla ma dam pa'i phyag phyir dkris nas smon 'gror phyin/ de nyid rang rab gnas kyi sta gon 'jug pa gnang / nang bar dngos gzhi'i cho ga rnams nyi phyed yan la grub/ dga' ston bzhugs gral gyi steng du dngos kyis pod chen bzhi la dam bca' re byas/ chos rje ngag dbang bkra shis pas bgro gleng gtong ba mdzad de rigs lung bag chags par byung / rab gnas rang gi rten 'brel ni 'os bab las ma byung / ngos cag sngar gyi na ba'i rgyun de thur song ba mngon pa tsam byung / nyer gsum la lhun sdings zhol du sleb tsam pas/ nyer bzhi la bsam 'grub dga' ldan du phyin/ khong rnams kyis bsu ba sogs bzab ma byas/ nyi ma gnyis po de shin tu khams ma bde/ khyad par se mkhar chung gi lho thad der grog po zhig tu rta babs nas cung zad sdod dgos byung / ja dkar yol gang 'thung ring tsam dbugs kyi rgyu ba yang 'gags slob dpon rin po che dang / zla bo rnams thugs 'tshab la gtad par gda'/ nga rang gi snang ba la da lta'i snang ba 'di nub cing / he ru ka'i sku'i rnam pa mang pos nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab pa'i snang ba tsam byung / phyis bsams dus 'di yin pa byin —50—

rlabs kyi ltas cig yin par 'dug de ltar byung ba gsangs pas gzhan gyis ma shes/ sang zhogs bsam 'grub dga' ldan pa rnams kyis chos 'brel dgos zer/ nged kyis khri thog tu 'ongs pa dang dung bus pa dang nyi ma shar ba gsum dus mnyam du byung / rten 'brel des da res bar chad kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba 'dug snyam nges pa brnyed/ nang par ngam ring du 'byor zhing / bla ma dam pas bdag cag dang sde bdag zhal ngo dang yon mchod du sbrel ba'i bka' bkod gnang ba la/ snga sor zhal ngos kyang zhal len mdzad yod 'dug na'ang / bar skabs der gzhan rkyen gyis bsgyur 'dug bla ma dag pas drung chen sangs snying ba sngon la rdzong ba mdzad pa'i bka' nan chags kyis stabs mi mdzes pa med tsam om so ba byas/ der yang zhag gsum bsdad skabs khams shin tu ma bde/de nas rma bya shug khrod du phyin/ de la ngam ring du sleb pa tshun chad nas shug khrod du zla ba gcig gi bar du snga dro re bzhin sna khrag bzed zhal gang gang brdal/lus kyi shed stobs thams cad bri/ tho rangs ja sbyor re tsam ma gtogs mtshan mo gnyid kyang mi yong zhing / gnyid cung zad de'i ring la skye ba sna tshogs su 'phos pa de dag gi spyod pa sna tshogs pa'i rmi lam zad mi shes pa re rtag tu 'ong /nyin bar chos zhu ba sogs la mi bde ba rang ma byung / de skabs sman dang sngags gdams ngag sogs 'di ma byas bya ba med de ci yang phan pa ma byung / chos skyong gi 'khu ldog yin nam zer bskang gso stong tshar sogs byas kyang ma phan/ zla gcig tsam song skabs der rmi lam du ri chen po zhig gi rtse na/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje'am kha che a mo gha yin nam snyan pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam pa gzi brjid can —51—

zhig la bud med sum cu bzhi bcus bskor ba zhig 'dug de'i zhal nas khyod sngar 'khor lo sdom pa la mchod pa rtag tu byed pa yin pa la/ phyis ma byas par yun ring rab song / bde mchog gi rgyud la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis nad 'di 'phral du grag 'gro/ de nas bsnyen pa zhig byas na bar chad thams cad sel zhing dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rjes su 'dzin par 'dug gsung ba cig byung / sang slob dpon rin po che la zhus pas/ 'o na bla ma dam pa la dbang zhig kyang gsan na dga'/ rgyud kyi dpe ni 'di ka na yod pas da rang nas ka 'dzin pa gnang na gsung gin 'dug pas/ spyir gsang sngags dang khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos la dang spro bar byung nas de nyin rang nas dpe cha bzung / theg gsum song ba nas sna khrag rje nyung la song / de mtshams slob dpon rin po che cung zad bsnyung nas rdo rje gur khang du bzhugs pa gnang / bla ma dam par bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhus pas dngos gzhi'i snga dro nas sna khrag chad/ dbang gnang dus so sor dmigs pa dang lha ngo bstan pa'i dus su dkyil 'khor gyi dmigs pa shin tu gsal ba dngos su mthong ba snyam pa dang dbang gi ring la lus bde cham cham pa byung / dbang grol nas tshogs 'khor gyi tshe lus la sngar las shed cher song ngam snyam pa 'dug de phyin chad khams bde zhing lus kyang yar sor byung / de nyid kyi 'phro 'thud nas dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang yang zhus/ nag po pa dang dril bu pa'i khrid tshul yongs grags rnams dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud zhal shes rnams kyis legs par brgyan pa dang / rtsa bshad so so'i zugad 'doms dang lung sogs mthar rgyas —52—

su stsal/ byams chos kyi bshad 'doms khog phubs kyang nyin re bzhin stsal ba yang lhag par blo la 'jag cing nges shes skye ba byung / bla ma dag pa'i bka' lung gis shug khrod kyi khri thog tu bsko bar gnang / bla ma dam pas phyag nas gtor/ bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po sku mched kyis kyang khri ston sogs gnang ba yin kyang / phyis bla ma dam pa sku chos dbyings su gshegs rjes/ drung chen pas nged la gros tsam yang ma dris par byang rang du phul ba yin/ de nas hor zla gsum pa'i 'jug la sku gzhogs nas dgongs grol zhus phyir yongs skabs brtan bzhugs bzab rgyas su phul te/ cu pa rong sogs brgyud nas mar lam khrod phur gnas mjal la phyin/ byams pa'i zhal ras lha khang du zhag gcig nyal/ de nub rig pa dwangs shing gsol ba yun ring du btab pas byams chos kyi tshig don sngar ma go ba 'ga' zhig la go ba lam lam 'char ba zhig byung / de nas sna thang khrid khang sogs brgyud nas rang gnas bsam gtan sdings su sleb/de mtshams zhag shas nas bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyang tshang bar blo la 'grig de lo chos lung du mkhar las shig byas pa dka' las che la ngo mtshar chung ba zhig byung / de bar la slob dpon rin po che'i drung du dag ljon skor gsum dang rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i 'dzug khrid zhib len zhus/ brtag gnyis la sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad sgros blo la 'them zhing go ba chags/ bla ma sa lugs kyi bshad sgros la ches dges shing thugs rtsis che ba 'dug na'ang / nged rang 'bru bsnon rngog lugs de khyad kyis blo la 'bab pa byung / hor zla lnga pa'i nyer lnga nas bsnyen mtshams bsdams/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du bsnyen pa 'jur bar —53—

bgyis shing / grangs bsnyen kha skongs lhag bcas sbyin sreg dang bcas pa grub/kha skongs kyi bzlas ba'i skabs rmi lam du rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang / rnal 'byor pa dang / bod kyi bla ma 'ga' re dang bcas pa kun bsgril phyed dang nyis brgya tsam 'dug nged rang gi lus po shin tu che ba zhig 'dug cing / de rnams kyis ste'u dang sog le dang gzong sogs kyis lus la gzhog pa sogs bzo bcos mang po byas te/ lhag ma thams cad chu la bor/ rus pa la bcos pa yin zer ba'i bde mchog gi sku mda' gang tsam zhig 'od khrom mer 'dug rang gi lus sogs 'di yin med pa la de la phar blta zhing ngo mtshar che snyam pa zhig shar ro//rab dwangs sems kyi chu mtshor srid zhi yi/ /snang brnyan gsal bar 'a myong la ya mtshan ci/ /byin rlabs zer ma gcig gis dngos grub kun/ /'grub 'gyur bla ma dam pa'i mthu 'di mtshar/ /mtshams grol 'phral la nye skor gyi yul mi rnams la khrom dbang tshe dbang zhig byas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi thang ka dang dpe ster mkhan byung ba la nye bzang khri snar gnyis nas 'bod mi nan can byung ba ltar khor tsam re phyin/ tshur lam khri khang nas sman lung du theg gcig bsdad/ nā ro pa'i phyag dril dang thugs dam dgyes rdor gyi dkyil thang mjal gsol ba btab/ nang bar mdol byung du sleb zhag shas bsdad cing / gzims khang la rab gnas dang dgongs bzhed kyi chos than thun phul/ bsam sdings su khor tsam phyin/ 'jag pa dpon slob grwa rigs thams cad nged la 'phrad pa dang chos 'brel nod par phebs/ 'jag bsam lhan du tshogs pa de ga la dus gtor chen mo yang mdzad/—54—

mkha' 'gro ma'i dbu thod byin rlabs kyi rtags can gcig kyang lag tu byung /de dus nang mchod la bdud rtsi ril bu gcig rang brdungs nas btab/ de nas chang rnams la cung zad re gtor/ chang de tsho 'dres tshad dam rdzas dri zhim mtshungs pa med pa rang gis khyab/ phud mchod byed zer ston mo tshogs 'khor nyin re la lan gnyis re tsam yod pa la snyad pa'i chang 'thung gi yo lang zhag mang po byung ba'i rting ma chang lhag tshun chod la dri bzang chil chil rang yod pa byung ba mi mang thams cad kyis 'thung myong ba'i rdzun med rang yin/ slar stag rtse brgyud rtse chen chos sde'i bla brang shar du sleb dgun zangs kyi bsdad/ mtshams ha cang dam pa ma yin pa phyi mtsham med pa byas/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang ma hā mā ya'i grangs bsnyen re song / bde dgyes kyi rgyud 'grel kun la dpe blta re yang ma chag par byas/ de skabs mkhan rin po ches/ rje 'phags pa'i drung gdan sar bsko bzhag gnang ba dpon slob gnyis car du ja zhus gang bzab re phul zhing /mtshams grol 'phral mkhan rin po che mjal ba dang chos zhu'i bzhed chen po yod na'ang / gsang stabs nas nub chos lung du 'phral phebs shar/ cho 'phrul gyi ring la sgrol ma lha khang du gsung rab rnams la rab gnas kyi rdo rje slob dpon byas/ de skabs kun dga' chos ldan pa lo gsum grol zhing /mkhan rin po che'i dgongs pa'ang grol ba nas nged kyi zla la byung / hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la shar phyogs su bskyod/ de gong blo bde nas yum drung gshegs pa'i dmigs ltas gsal po zhig byung ba skabs 'dir dngos gsal du gyur/ bcu bdun gyi nyin stag lung rdzong rtser sleb/ yab sras rnams —55—

dang mjal/ phyag gi rten mjal rnams zhib par byas/ rje btsun o rgyan mtsho mo'i sku skye ye shes dbang mo dang yang mjal ba rmi lam bzang bar mngon pa tsam byung / yar 'brog bsam sdings pa rang gi phyag gi rten mjal rnams zhib len byas/ sde pa g.yu lo ba'i nang rten sman pa'i rgyal po'i gser sku la rab gnas bgyis shing / slar yon mchod lhan du stag lung bla brang dkar por phebs nai gu'i khrid dgos phebs pa ltar sgyu lus dbang mo ches sgo phye nas/ khrid tshul shin tu smin pa zla ba phyed gnyis kyi bar du phul/ chos rje sngags ram bas gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon rin po tshes dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid yongs su rdzogs par gnang song zhing dam po rgyag pa'ang mang du byung / de skabs sde pa bstan 'dzin drung gis dngos la mjal res kyi phyag rten bzang po 'chag med mdzad/ bkra shis kha btags bzang ba rang yang phyed nyis brgya tsam byung zhin /de thams cad lha sa dang rwa bsgreng gi bar du snyan dar 'bab zhig la phul bas gnyis thang du dge tshogs 'phel bar byung ngo / /nga ni bla ma nor po che de min/gang yod dge ba la gtong mkhan cig de dus nas yin/ sde dpon dang mi nag pa la yon gnas 'chol mkhan gyi bla rdzus tsho dang cung mi 'dra lags/ de nas dzo gi mang po dang yang lam sdebs byung ste rang yul du brtol/ drin can gyi ma dang mjal zhing theg shas bag phebs par bsdad/ chu bo ri'i gru la thon/ kun chos pa yar 'brog nas gzung nas chu nad byung ba la sman dpyad sogs gang drag bgyis kyang ma phan te/ skyor mo lung du sleb i yod la re ba'i blo snyun yin na'ang / chu shul gla ra'i gong tsam du 'das/ 'on kyang phung po la 'ja' r+sā —56—

zug pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i rtags mang du byung / gye re lha khang du tsha thog la sleb/ bris sku khrag 'thor ma'i rten mjal dgos tshul zhal ngo rnams la 'phrod phul bas/ rje dam pa'i skye ba yin na rang re'i rje sangs rgyas ras chen dngos yin 'dug pas mjal dgos par 'dug de min bris sku rten mjal la bskur gtong gsung nas brtag bsgril mdzad pas brtag pa thon gsung / de 'phral lha rin po che sku mched gnyis car phebs te/ phyag sogs gus pa'i bkur bsti dpag tu med pa mdzad/ rten mjal rnams kyang shin tu zhib cing blo khog tshim par zung / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel zhig kyang phul/ sang nyin snye thang 'or gyi lha khang rnams mjal/ rim pas skyor mo lung du 'byor/ zhabs drung yum drung dang mjal bas shin tu dgyes pa'i ngang nas dgongs bzhed kyi dbang cho lo ci rigs pa phul/ zhag bzhi tsam bsdad/ de nas dpal gyi chos 'khor lha sar sleb cing zhag bcu gsum tsam bsdad/ nyin re bzhin 'phrul snang rang la rten mjal lan gnyis ma re dang / ra mo cher lan re 'chag med du phyin/ de skabs rgyu dngos bzang po med na'ang gang yod mchod rdzas la 'bungs shing /tsan dan dkar dmar dzā ti gur kum sogs dri bzang gi phye ma ka to ra do tsam zhig la ser zho bcu drug tsam bsres/ nyin re bzhin sku rnams la gtor/ dri bzang gi bdug spos dang snyan dar kyang rang blo tshim par 'bul rgyu byung / lha sa rang dang ra mo che dang lha khang rme ru pho brang dmar lcags grib mda' lha khang tshun chad kyi lha thams cad la/ gser zhal yang bzang rab byung / lha khang so sor smon lam yang mang du btab/ de nas yer ba mjal bar phyin/ stag lung nas —57—

dpon sa'i drung shin tu dgyes pa'i ring nas zhag shas bsdad/ zhabs drung stobs rgyas drung 'bri gung phyogs nas der phebs pa dang mjal shin tu dgyes par byung / der stag lung nas 'bod mi gnang byung ba bzhin yer pa'i la rgyab/jog po'i nang la babs yongs/ mkhar rtse ba'i sde pa rgyal bu yer ba mjal bar phebs pa'i phyag g.yog rnams dang lam der 'phrad byung zhing / sde pa rang lam gzur ba tsam mdzad song / de nub gnyag grong du bsdad/ sang nyin lhun grub rdzong du sras yum tshor tshe rta sbrags ma zhig dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ sang snga bar phyag la brgal phyin mtshams grwa nang gling gsum gyi mkhan slob mi sna so so dang bcas pa rnams ja 'dren dang bsu bar phebs/ nyin phyed tsam la gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba rgya chen po dang bcas te gzigs spyil du 'byor gnangs nyin de gza' skar bzang ba yod 'dug pa nas/ mchod khang rtser rigs brgya'i mgon po sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs drung dang mjal/ shag byang du sna len gyi bzhugs gral bzab rgyas su gnang zhing /phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i tshe dbang de nyid chos 'brel gyi thog mar zhus shing / de mtshams nas bde mgon lha mo sogs kyi dbang rjes gnang so so'i chos skor yongs rdzogs/ khyad par sku rags skor gyi 'khrid tshul zhib rgyas su stsal/ 'gro mgon rin po che phag gru'i bka' 'bum nas zab bsdus kyi glegs bam gcig tsam dang / stag lung thang ba chen po'i bka' 'bum/ gzhan yang rgyud sde mang po'i lung sogs thob cing / dngos kyis lha khang shod du tshogs pa rnams la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang dang / nai gu sogs ci rigs par —58—

bshad/ bka' nan cher stsal ba la brten te/ zhabs drung du 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang zhig gis thog ma'i legs byas kyi sgo phye nas/ dgongs bzhed ltar chos bka' ci rigs pa phul/ 'di skabs stag lung du zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam song / bar skabs shig rwa bsgreng mjal bar phyin/ phar lam ser gla'i gnas mjal byas nas phu mdor sde pa yab sras rnams dang yang mjal rwa bsgreng du zhag po bdun tsam bsdad/ gser zhal dang mchod pa sogs rang la bltos pa'i gang grag 'bul rgyu byung / 'di skabs rje grog kha ba dang yang mjal/bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang zhig zhus/ stag lung nas phyir 'ongs dus zhabs drung rtser rten 'brel gyi bkra legs pa'i dbang du byas/ tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang zhig zhus shing / brtan bzhugs bzab rgyas shig kyang phul/ lha 'phreng gi rnam pas char brdungs yang yang byung / de nub dbu ma ba'i nang du bsdad/ sang nyin po to'i gnas mjal byas te/ lhun grub rdzong brgyud lcang lung chos sdings su zhag bzhi bsdad/ tshogs chos 'chag med dang so rbo'i 'dod chos ci rigs pa bshad/ spyan snga rin po ches 'bod mi nan can gnang ba ltar glang thang du phyogs khrom che grags pas ma shogs nas khong tsho byings kyis byang sgo la byon/ nged kyis mas brdzus nas shar sgo la 'ongs/ phyis khong tshos nged la glang thang 'dzin bdag khyed dgos tshul gleng slang mang po byung na'ang byed mi dgos pa'i rten 'brel du song 'dug zhal lnga tsam bsdad de chos dang 'byor pa shin tu rgyas par byung / de nas sgo la la thon nas slar yang ra sa 'phrul snang du sleb/ theg drug tsam zhig bsdad/ 'di skabs nas 'brang du sdod skabs yan —59—

la/ drung sngags 'chang don grub pa la rang gi pha mes tsho'i nyams bzhes kyi chos mang dag la dogs gcod dang gsar du zhu ba sogs byas/ de skabs chu shin tu che bas lha sa dang ra mo che'i bar gyi chu la yang ko ba gtong dgos zhag kha yar byung / skor lam thams cad kyang chus khengs shing chu rags 'phral 'phral brtsigs kyang 'phral 'phral zhig 'gro ba'i mi thams cad sun zhing gtsug lag khang la chu nyen shin tu che bar 'dug ste dka' tshegs la ma 'dzem par jo mjal la lan gnyis gnyis dang / ra mo cher lan re 'chag med dang / chu gseb la yang skor ba gnyis gsum re gang 'grub byas/ rta skyog zhon nas 'gro ba khad de 'dra ye ma byas/ de nas shun du zhabs drung grags pa rgya mtsho dang mjal zhing / shin tu dgyes pa'i phyag sogs bkur bsti dpe med gnang / chu rgyas pas 'dza' 'phrang dzo 'phrang la mi thar ba 'dug pas/ bang la zer ba ri mthon po zhig bskor te nyi ma phyed yol la 'ga' grong du sleb/ sngar 'dris med rung 'ga' grong gi gnyer pas gzhis len bzang po dpe med byas/ mgron po'i bsod nams lam gyi dper byung / 'jangs pa'i sde pa zhal ngo rnams la ma ṇi'i lung zhig byas/ 'jangs dang 'tshar pa sna'i bar yang 'phrang gi lam chus nub nas rtas 'gro mi thub pa 'dug pas bye la zhig la bcad nas 'ongs/ rta khal sogs chad/ la shin tu gzar bas sbyong spyod che bar byung bas 'tshar pa sna'i ne thang der cung zad ngal gso yin bsdad/ dgon pa na rgyang nas dpon sa'i drung bzhugs 'dug pas 'bod mi byung / de nub bla ma lha khang der bsdad/ theg gcig shin tu skyid par byung / nang bar chu shul du mthun rkyen bzab ma mdzad/—60—

chos 'brel zhig kyang byas/ khong zhal ngo rgan pa rnams mos gus skyes bstan 'dzin rin po che'i gsung cho zong mar song zer bar gda'/ sang yol ri gong du sleb tsam byas/ smyug lar sde pa dpal bzang pa la rtswa shing gi mthun rkyen dgos tshul zhu bar ma ṇi ba dge 'dun rin chen gyis phyin kyang mthun rkyen ni sna gcig kyang ma byung / ri gong du zhug gsum bsdad/ rang byung mgon po la phyag mchod smon lam yid tshim bar byas/ de nas lhun rab tu 'bod mi nan can byung ba bzhin phyin/ gzha' ri skyed tshal ba rnams nang 'khrug gi skabs shig na 'dug zhal ngo rnams kyis rigazhi len bzabs/ de'i sang 'brang mda'i chugs la 'thon 'brang phu dgon par sleb/ de mtshams slob dpon rin po che bsam sdings la phebs/ nged kyis zla ba gcig tsam bsdad cing / mi ngo rnams la nai gu'i khrid cig kyang bshad/ a khu rab 'byams ba zhig byung 'dug pa khong gi phyag dpe rnams la blta rtog 'dra byas/ tshad ma mdo'i gzhed zhig 'dug slob dpon rin po che tshad ma'i dpe cha bzung ba la shin tu dgyes par 'dug pas/ kun las btus kyi gzhung de byang bar bzung / de nas dpal de brgyud g.yu mtsho la ko ba btang ste sgo lung bar sleb/ yul pa dang dgon pa so sor tshe dbang sogs 'dod chos 'dra bshad nas/ lhun grub smon mkhar du sde pa bstan 'dzin drung dang mjal/ de ma myo las nas zla gcig mcha los dam par bcad/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i bsnyen pa zhig byas/ de grol mtshams 'dzam gling chos 'khor nas rin po che grags pa lhun grub pa gtso bor byon pa'i do nang gi bla mar smos pa bdun brgyad zhig dang / gzhan yang don gnyer sum cu skor la skyes bu gsum —61—

gyi lam rim dang / ni gu'i khrid tshul ngag nas bshad cing / lhag ma khrid brgya lung khrid kyi tshul du rdzogs par btang / gsang 'dus sgron gsal gyi dpe zhig ster mkhan byung ba dga' ba dang gus pa chen pos blta rtog klog 'thems pa zhig byas/ de skabs go rtogs ni gcig kyang ma byung yang phyis go ba rang zhig byed snyam pa'i zhe dam byas/ dgon pa lha lung du phyin pas ya mtshan pa cig yod/rim pas yon mchod lhan cig rgyags kyi gzhis kar phebs sang snga bar byon sngon dus mar pa do pa'i bzhugs gnas rgyags mda'i lha khang zhig ro der phyin/sa phyogs de grub pa'i bsti gnas su 'dug pas gus pa chen pos phyag dang skor ba zhig byas dar lcog cig btsugs/ 'dzam gling chos 'khor du gung tshigs byas/ sna dkar rtse'i klu sdings su sleb/ de nub rmi lam du bud med cig na re/mar do lo tsā ba de bde mchog 'khor lo rang yin te mkhas su re ba 'ga' zhig gis skur pa byed kyin 'dug khyed rang mar do'i gsung la ltos dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i nges gsang rnams de na yod zer ba zhig byung / phyis glang mtsho'i 'gram du bud med khyim ma gcig gis lnga tshan gcig byin pa'i sdebs la mar do'i 'gyur rtsa rgyud ma rman ma gcig byin byung ba de la bltas dus rgyud kyi tshig don 'ga' re'i go ba la phan pa byung ba dang / lar phyi nang gi byang phyogs skor do ba lugs bshad pa bzang pa la lta ba 'dra/ gzhan dmigs gsal rang ni ma byung / de nas nged yon mchod lhan du mkha' ro gangs phug tu phebs/ zhag po lnga pa zhig bsdad/ de nas gnam gru bzhir sde pa grwa lnga'i drung dang mjal byung /rgyal rtser sde pa zhal ngo rnams la tshe dpag med lha dgu ma'i dbang bskur zhig —62—

phul te/ de'i sang nyin rtse chen du sleb/ de skabs dpon mo rgyal bu khrid phebs 'phral yin/ rtse'i gtsug lag khang gi gnas brtan lha khang du zhag shas bsdad gtso cher sgrol ma byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs pa kho na byas/ zhal ngo so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'dra phul/ 'di skabs chos sder rgyang tsam bsdad cing so so'i 'dod chos 'dra bshad/ de nas mar lam stag tsher gyi gong tsam der yur ba zhig na 'od 'tsher ba 'dug pas mgyogs por phyin nas blangs tsa na/ don thegs kha che paṇa chen lugs lha lnga'i rdo sku zhig brnyed/ de nub rang gnas bsam sdings su sleb/ de skabs hor zla bcu pa'i 'jug yin zhing /bcu gcig pa tshes 'phral mtshams bsdams zla ba gsum du gzhan rje'i gshed kyi rigs 'dra'i bsnyen pa dang / de rjes zla ba gnyis bstan srung gi bsnyen pa 'dra byas/ 'di skabs rmi lam gyi ltas rtsub 'gyur che ba mang po byung / sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mkhas pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon rin po che'i drung gis don gnyer mang dag zhig gi ngor/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/dbang bskur cha gsum bzhi gnang bar sgo dod pa/ dngos kyis kyang bdag po chen po'i dbang gi bar rdzogs par zhus/ 'di'i gong tsam du chos lung byang rtser mched grogs dpal sdings pas/ gzhung pa'i khang pa la me bcug gzhung pas kyang dpal sdings pa'i mas ka mang po bcol po'i sa nas bskor/ gnyis kar bla ma dam pas chos lung nas 'bud pa gnang 'dug skabs 'dir dpal sdings pa bsam sdings su sleb byung chas ka sogs gang drag byin nas brdzangs/ khong —63—

smon 'gro ba'i rtsa mi rang yin te rang la tshugs kha ma byung tsa na gnas skabs der khyi bskyur wa bskyur la song / de nas rim pas khri khang du zla ba phyed tsam bsdad sde pa rje drung dang zhal ngo gzhan so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos than thun phul/de nas snar thang du zhag bcu bdun tsam bsdad sdod sa byams lha khang du byas/zer bzhi'i slob dpon sogs dge bzhes mang dag la ni gu dang snying po don gsum bshad/ byang chen la nyin 'khor zhig mjal du phyin/ de nas lu gu rir zhag gcig bsdad/ chu mig gi rje btsun ma bzhugs kyin 'dug pas phyag mchod smon lam mang du byas/ srad rin chen rtser smyug grong nas mchog lags kyis bzab ma mdzad/ byi lo'i sde gzar gyi 'go yang mngon du gyur/ de nas bzang ja'i la brgyud bkras gling du gting skyes nas zhal ngo thams cad bsu ba la phebs chos grwar zla gcig zhag po nyi shu skor bsdad cing zhal ngo rnams la rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang / dpal mgon lha / da kyi rjes gnang sogs rjes gnang zur bka' mang rab dang / chos rje stag sna ba'i dgongs bzhed ltar dgon gsum gyi grwa rigs drag bsdus rnams la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang dang khrid tshus thad thud 'dra bshad/ de skabs dus 'khrug gi skabs yin/de nas la smad kyi dkar la'i sgrub gnas de mjal du phyin pas bag chags cung zad zhig sad/ byang phug gi jo bo mjal zhing zhag gsum gyi bar du phyag dang skor ba ci nus byas/ dkar me snyan dar yang mang rab 'bul rgyu byung / stag sna chu 'dus nyi shar rnams brgyud nas drang so'i mda' der/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po grub pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas kyang / bsu bar phebs pa dang yang —64—

zhal mjal bong chu'i rab brgal/ mtsho sgor dpon sa khye 'dren gyis bzab ma byas/ de nas 'brang dpon po'i sar theg gcig bsdad/ khong tshos rus gcig pa yin zer ba'i zhen gyis sprug sprug bsigs bsigs byas/ de nas sa la gnas pa'i 'og min brag stod ye shes kyi pho brang du sleb/ bla ma'i bka' bkod dang bstun nas/ sgrub sde rnams la ni gu zhig bshad/ snga phyir pha drug gi yul mi 'phrad du byung ba rnams la'ang chos kyi 'brel pa re thogs/ bla ma rje btsun gyi sku drung du grub snying a ma na si'i skor yongs rdzogs dang / chos chung brgya rtsa'i skor/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma sna tshogs pa'i rnam thar mang po'i lung / ma hā mā ya'i khrid tshul zhib mo/ gzhan yang zab khrid ci rigs pa dang bcas pa zhus/chos rjong gi jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyang phebs byung ba mchod pa bzang du phul/de skabs zla ba phyed gnyis tsam sku gzhogs su bsdad/ de kha'i dbyar la ston btags kyi ring de la slob dpon drung du dbu ma 'jug pa'i bshad pa yongs rdzogs dang / gzhung phran 'ga'i bshad pa dang / dbu ma rtsa ba sogs gzhung che ba 'ga' la gnad bsdus gal che che'i bshad pa rnams thob pa blo la nges par byung / phyir yong skabs tshogs 'khor rgyas pa zhig zhus shing brtan bzhugs phul/ 'di skabs bla ma rin po ches ni zla ba phyed kyi bar du zhabs skyil dkrungs lan gcig gnang ba ma zhig par bzhugs 'dug dngos kyis mtsho sgo dang mang mkhar bde skyid gling brgyud/ lha rtse rdzong du bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po dang mjal/ hor zla dgu pa'i zla smad sgrub gnas chos lung rtser sleb/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang zhal mjal/ de nas mi ring bar —65—

gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras kyi dbang khrid shin tu smin pa de'i 'go tshugs/mai tri mkha' spyod sogs sngar ma thob pa'i chos sna'ang mang du thob/ gsung ngag gi khrid tshul rnams yig spyi la ma bltos pa'i smar khrid du thebs/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i nges gnas thams cad ma 'dres par phyed pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas par byung / 'di skabs chos rje byams rin pa/ rin po che ka bzhi nas kyi mi sna'i go chod dang / khong pa rang nged la 'phrad par phebs pa yang yin par 'dug gang na'ang ka bzhi nas kyis 'bul ba shin tu bzab pa rang gnang /dang po rje dam pas khyod rang bla ma ma byed gsung ba yod na'ang bar skabs su bla chen gyi khungs byas pa de bka' bcag par song bas de'i bshags pa yin zhing da sgos bla tshugs mi phyed pa'i dam bca' 'bul/ da lta yig brgya 'bum ther tshar gang ma'ang byed kyin yod pa'ang de la dmigs pa yin gsung ba phebs byung / khong rnams la yang chos 'brel bshad/ de rjes khrid grol nas zhag gnyis chos mtshams shig gnang ba/ bla ma dam pa sku khams shin tu zi ba'i nyen che ba rang zhig byung ba/ sku rim du gsang ri sogs gnas chen rnams su tshogs mchod re ga|nga du bcug brtan bzhugs zhig phul ba brtan bzhugs kyi tshogs grol 'phral sku khams dwangs sor gyis byung bas blo bde sangs kyis song / zhag bdun sku mtshams bcad rgya gnang bas sku khams shin tu dwangs par byung zhing /de lo rtse'i bde mchog sgrub mchod kyi rdo rje slob dpon bdag la gyis bka' bkod phebs pa ltar sa chog nas rdul tshon spyan 'dren gyi bar lhag chad med pa dang / dngos gzhi nyi ma bcu gsum byung / de skabs bka' nan cher stsal te —66—

chos lung gi khur len byed dgos phebs pa nas/ spyir dngos cag gis dgos gzhis rgya chen po 'dzin thub pa'i rigs su yang med/ da lta slob gnyer 'dra dang thugs dam 'dra yong du re ba'i 'dun pa kho na yin pa dang / khyad par dgon gnas 'dzin pa'i blo bzhed kyang med pa dang / sgos su sde pa rnams kyis kyang dgongs par bde ba med pas bzung yang bstan pa'i zhabs tog tu mi 'gro ba dang / yang sgos bla ma dam pa dpon slob bzhugs phyin du nged rang la 'os bab med pa'i snyan zhus theg mang po sbel te dgongs grol zhus kyang ma byung / slar yang zhu nan ches na thugs log pa'i rgyud 'gro ba 'dug pas bka' bzhin mi sgrub mthu med byung zhing / de nas sku ji srid 'tsho'i bar du chos lung rang du gdan phab pa'i bzhugs sa gnang dgos tshul gyi gsol 'debs kho na zhus pa/de skabs zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar byung na'ang lo de'i ngo sgang tsam ma gtogs/chos lung du ma bzhugs/ nged rnams de skabs hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la shar du phyogs te/ jo nang du rje drung rin po che mjal/ kun mkhyen chen po'i rnam thar 'ga' rong pas mdzad pa'i lung dang sbyor drug gi khrid lung mgyogs khrid cig zhus/ jo mo nang gi khri thog tu 'god par mdzad cing rje drung nyid kyis phyag nas kyang gtor/ de nas bya rgod ga gos sa su yongs zhag gsum sdod dgos byung / 'od dpag med kyi lha khang dang jo bo dang rnam sras kyang mjal/jo bo la gsol ba btab dus 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dngos yin pa la dri mas gos pa'i sku las 'od mthing kha zhig byung rang la thim snyam pa zhig byung / mar lam snar thang du theg dgu bsdad/ gzhi rgyang sogs kyi dpung chen —67—

thams cad 'dug rin skrungs nas sa skyong ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug yab sras/ rgyal rtse nas bdag po rgyal ba'i drung / sde pa gser ma nas dang /khyung rtse nas sde pa'i drung sogs dang mjal zhing / so so'i dgongs brjed kyi dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba tsam phul/ rim sbungs zhabs drung yang de gong brjod sgo sna tshogs la brten pa'i zhu 'phrin zab pa rang med rung / de skabs dad gus yang dag pa gnang gin 'dug slar bsam rtse klu sdings su theg gcig bsdad/ nang par mi pham rgyal ba'i mdun sa thub bstan gser mdog can gyi chos grwar 'byor mkhan slob dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba mdzad cing /bla brang du sleb ma thag bkra shis brtsegs par gzhi len bzhugs gral bzab mar byung / zhag bzhi'i bar du tshogs chos re ma chag pa dang / gzhan so so'i 'dod chos ci rigs par bshad/ 'phrad mi shin tu rnam grangs mang bas brel ba che bar byung / rang gnas bsam gtan sdings su sleb 'phral nas phyi mtshams se byas/ spyir snga phyi thams cad du le lo dang g.yeng bas dus 'da' ba zhig rang re'i mdzad spyod kyi sku skal du yod na'ang / lo 'di la brtson 'grus kyang dga' tshad tsam byas/ de lo dus gzings shin tu 'khrugs pa yod na'ang chags sdang gi rnam rtog dang chos brgyad kyi skyed 'phel gcig kyang ma byas par thos bsam sgom gsum kho na la bsgril te/ dpyid gsos mdo rtsa'i gzhung rdzogs par blo la bzung / mngon pa mdzod kyi dbu zhabs thar chags su zhib bshad mtha' gcod dang bcas pa/ mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa'i mtshan can nyid las zhus/ de yang nyin phyed nas nyi ma bzhud du nye ba tsam gyi bar paṇa —68—

chen rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi lung stsal zhing / dgong mo thugs dam gyi thun rnams grol ba'i rjes su/ srod la bshad pa thun che ba rang la nan chags re zhus shing / tho rangs snga mo thun grol mtshams sgron me'i 'od la dpe blta rgyang tsam byas/ snga dro gdan bzhes grol 'phral mdang gi zugad pa de nyid slar skyor ba re byas/ dbyar ka 'dul pa'i bshad pa zhus te sngar lugs bzhin byas/ston ser de sgra ka lwa pa'i kun bshad dang po yan la blo steng nas sa ris shin tu zhib pa zhus shing / de mtshams rgya 'dre'i cho 'phrul che ba byung / bla ma dam pas kyang kun bshad man chad slob dpon snga ma la dpe steng nas gsan/ phyis lha ldongs pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal ba'i slob brgyud la thugs steng nas bslabs par snang bas rtog dpyad tsam byung / de man chad dpe steng nas 'dzug khrid rdzogs par zhus/ lo snga ma gting skyes su chos rje blo bzang pa dang mnyam du snyan dngags kyi rtsom rgyugs ci rigs pa song ba de skabs 'phro ma lus pas/'di skabs de'i 'phro nas blangs te rtsom rgyugs rdzogs par song / mdo sde rgyan la rgyas sras thogs med pa'i ṭīk+ka dang / 'byed gnyis la rong ṭīka sbyar ba'i bshad pa rags rim dang lung yang mnos pas go ba legs rab shar/ de lhar tha snyad kyi gtsug lag la cung zad bslabs shing / gzhung lugs chen po rnams la'ang ro bro blta ba tsam re byas pas kyang / phyis kyi mkhas grags can 'ga' zhig gis rtsom pa byas pa'i dpe cha mthong ba dang / mkhas pa rnams bshad pa dang 'bel gtam byed pa la ye nas rang 'gram mchu mi ldang ba tsam snang ngo / /'dir smras pa/ thogs med lung rigs shing rta'i rlud stobs kyis/ /yid —69—

'ong legs bshad 'od stong 'char ba las/ gang blo'i rgya mtshor mtha' dag shes bya yi/ /gzugs mdzes nam yang 'char ba su yis 'gog /de nas rtsas ma phyed chod tsam nas bsnyen mtshams dam par bsdams te/cho 'phrul grol gyi bar du gdan bzhi ye shes dbang phyug ma'i dkyil 'khor dang /gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje gnyis kyi bsnyen pa yongs rdzogs dang / dus 'khor lha dgu la brten nas rgyud sde g.yin gyi rung mthun sbyar ba'i bsnyen pa zhig rnams song / dus kyi 'khor lo'i nges gsang gi tshig don rnams la cung zad cung zad sbyangs pa dang / bskyed rdzogs rnams la nges shes dad pa cung zad thob pas sgom 'dod thun mong ma yin pa skyes te/ slob dpon mkhas mchog dam par gsal 'debs zhus nas cho 'phrul grol mtshams nas sa ga'i tshes bco lnga'i bar du mun khang bsten te sbyor drug rtse gcig tu bsgoms/ dngos gzhi'i mun mtshams zhag gsum nas zla gcig tsam gyi bar du lus nyams mthong nyams kyi rtags snang sogs zad mi shes pa nyin mtshan khor mor 'gro ba zhig byung / de nas zhag shas gcig kyang ma byung bas bshad sna ri ltar spogs chog rnams byas/ de'i rkyen gyis rtags bcu'i rim pas phal cher dang don dam bsnyen pa nas bshad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtags de yang byung / de la gegs sel gyi rlung sbyor dang byed bcings de byas pas gegs kyang ma byung / de nas bzung ste da lta'i bar du thig le lu gu brgyud sogs rtags snang rtag tu 'char ba byung zhing / de skabs lus gnad byed bcings la bzhur pa'i tshe gnas pa 'thug po yun ring du gnas par byung / de nas zla gcig tsam zhig de kha'i —70—

ngang nas rmi lam 'dzin sbyong 'dra byas pas zin sbyong gnyis car gyi sne zin nges shes pa tsam byung / lo snga ma glang lo dang stag lo 'di la 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku gtsang du bzhugs skabs yin/ spyir gar phebs su 'phrin las 'ur langs pa lta bu dang snyan grags lhag par che ba rlabs chen lung med du snang na'ang / sngon gyi las smon lam zhig gis mjal ma thub/ 'di skabs rtse chen chos sde'i kha 'dzin yang spyir dus mi bde'i g.yeng ba ches pa dang / khyad par sde pa gzims dpon pa sogs kyis blos chod ma chod sna tshogs kyi stabs dge sbyor 'chag pa rang zhig byung nas slar rtsis phul bas zos bde ba rang byung / hor zla lnga pa'i nyer gsum la tshong 'dus su sleb par byas zhag bdun tsam bsdad/ ni gu'i mgyogs khrid cig phul/ slar snar thang gi chos sder phyin zla ba gnyis tsam bsdad/ de bar la snga dro re bzhin slob dpon bzhi dge bzhas dge 'dun mang dag dang dogs gcod 'bel gtam gsung gleng 'phel ba dang / de nas byams khang du phyag 'bul brgya rtsa re dang skor ba sum cu re/ nyin gung zhal ngo so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos thun ci rigs dang / chos sde tshogs pa spyi la blo sbyong gi khrid shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos chung brgya rtsa'i lung sogs bka' gdams kyi chos thun che nges re dang / dgong mo 'dul ba lung gi gsung sgrogs yid la gcags pa'i sgo nas thun gang che re bklags zla ba gnyis po la lung bzhi rdzogs par klog thub/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i gzhung dang spyod bsdus sgron me'i gzhung nyid la lta rtog dang go ba btsal bas phal cher la go ba 'bad med du shar/ phyis kyang mtha' gcod sogs kyi blo skyed cher 'phel ba ma gtogs —71—

gzhud tshig gi go ba la spod dgos cher ma byung / de skabs gnas brtan bcu drug gi yol thang zhig bsod dpal ba dang tshe ring 'phel gnyis kyis ri mo mkhan byas te bzhengs/ yol thang bkram ma thag gi thog ma'i tshig bkra la yang / dpe cha ster mkhan zhig byung ba'i kha yig klog pas bkra shis don grub dang bkra shis ring mo bzhugs zer ba zhig byung / rab gnas zin pa'i dga' ston gyi skabs su/ slob dpon pa rnams la gnas brtan gyi mdo dbyangs shig mdzod byas pas/ chos rje don yod dpal 'byor ba na re/ dang po gcig gi bkra shis skor re ma'i dpe yin/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shog rang la 'dam gsung ba sogs tshig bkra rten 'brel legs par byung / de nas hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis kyi tho rangs rmi lam gyi ltas shin tu ngo mtshar ba mang po dang khyad par na gar ko ṭa'i grong khyer dza lan+ta ra'i rgyal po grub pa thob pa zhig yin yang zer/ shar phyogs lwa ba pa yin yang zer ba zhig gis sha chen kham gcig nged la gnang byung zhing / zos pa na lus sems bde cham gyis song ba snyam byed pa na gnyid sad/ de nas nam langs kyi bar du rig pa dwangs shing lus sems bde cham me 'dug tsha ba thon 'phral mnyam med sangs rgyas sgom ba'i gnas chen byang chub chen por yon mchod lhan du thegs/ dgon pa lho'i g.yag ra der gur 'bibs pa mdzad 'dug pas gur rang der sleb nas ja sbyor gnyis tsam song mtshams/ rje btsun sbas pa'i sangs rgyas gu ru lho phyogs pa bzhi gubha nā tha'i zhabs phebs byung zhing / de yang dzo gi me tog ser pos thod bcings ba mthong ba tsam gyis zil che ba zhig byung / ja sbyor gcig tsam yul —72—

gyi gleng slang ci rigs pa zhus/ de mtshams nged kyis tshogs su khri thog tu phyin khri ston sogs kyi brel ba la yun ring bar 'gor/ de grol mtshams nas dgon pa byang gi gtsug lag khang du spos/ grub chen gyis steng gi thigs khang der bzhugs/ bdag chung ngu nas rgya gar yul dbus kyi 'phral skad 'di sus bslabs med pa zhig la shin tu byang bar shes pa zhig byung / 'di skabs tsa na legs sbyar gyi skad kyang mang rab shes shing / yul tha dad pa'i skad rigs mi gcig pa sna tshogs 'dug pa kun yang ci rigs pa phran tshegs shes kyin yod pa nas/ thog mar yul so so dang / chos lugs sna tshogs dang / rgyal rabs la sogs pa snga phyi'i lo rgyus las brtsams te dri ba mang po zhus pas/ gzhan rnams dang mi 'dra bar lo rgyus dpyis phyin pa 'thad ldan 'ba' zhig gsung pa 'dug pa dang / sangs rgyas pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyi lo rgyus dri ba zhus pas kyang / a tsa ra blun po rnams kyi gtam dang gtan mi 'dra ba shin tu yid ches par byung zhing / de nas rim gyis sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas tshul yang go phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po zhes bya ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor de thog ma'i chos 'brel du zhus/ rdo rje phag mo'i chos skor mang po dang /dza lan+ta ra'i rdo rje'i glu bi muk+ta mañja ri'i bshad pa dang man ngag sogs zab don dpag tu med pa thog sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dbang zhus pa'i sta gon gyi nub mo/ nged rang gi lpags pa rnams dras te shog bu byas/ khrag gi snag tsha byas/rtsibs ma la smyu gu byas/ bud med mdzes ma drug bdun zhig gis yin mkhan byas te rgyud chog yin nyog yin gyi po ti mang po yud tsam zhig la bris grub/ sha —73—

rnams kho rang tsho la drangs/ skras glegs thag byas/ nang khrol dang rus pa sogs yon du byin pa zhig rmis/ bla ma la zhug pas shin tu bzang gsung / mi g.yo ba'i byin rlabs zhus pa'i nub mo'ang rmi lam ches bzang ba zhig byung / zla shas nas nan gyis gsol ba btab na'ang bzhugs par ni ma gnang bde mchog bla sgrub de chos 'brel gyi tha mar zhus so/ khrub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa 'di'i bka' drin gyis theg pa bla na med pa'i gzhung lugs kyi grub mtha' la sngon med pa'i blo skyed du mngon pa grangs su btab pa'ang lnga brgya tsam byung ba da lta'ang gcig kyang ma brjed bar bkra lam me yod/ gsang sngags kyi go ba la rje 'di kho na bka' drin che ba yin no/ /'di smras pa/ gang gi zhal lung lho phyogs dri len ma/ /nges gas pa sbrang rtsi'i dog pas 'khyud pa 'dis/ /snying la reg pa'i mod la mtshan rtog gi /gdung ba nam mkha'i dbyings su thim par gyur/ /phyir phebs rjes su zhag shas yid 'phreng zhing skyo shas che bar byung / bzhud ba'i nub tho rangs gnyid zi ba zhig la bla ma phebs byung bas yid la dga' ba dpe med byung ste/ bla ma phebs pa legs bzhugs sa gang du mdzad dam zhus pas/ khyod kyi mgo la lo 'bum phrag gcig sdod do gsung ba rmi/ rim pas de'i gnangs nyin gangs can chos 'phel du sleb tsam byas/ de nas mtshan 'gros kyis myur bar bcad nas rang gnas chos lung du sleb/ de mtshams rje drung rin po che jo nang pa gting skyes phyogs nas sku 'khor 'phral chos lung du phebs pa dang mjal/ de'i sang nub nas 'brum pa'i skya nad kyis the bas/ rmi —74—

lam du khrag gi mtsho zhig gi nang du lus bying ba/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi yin zer ba'i mi dkar po zhig gis bton pa rmis/ de lo bzlas pa'i rigs dang zas spyod sogs 'brum pa yang ba'i thabs byed pa ma byung zhing / de gong nas kyang rtog pa rtsing nge ba dang / nad khog tu zhugs nas kyang skya nad mngon du ma gyur bar du spyod log 'dra yang byung song bas yin pa 'dra/ zhug nyi shu skor du shin tu na ba rang byung / 'on kyang nad gzhug yun ring ma byung / 'khrum lkogs byed gogs tsam la sde pa rin po che ka bzhi nas bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhu bar phebs byung / snga sor nas gsung phebs pa dang sku snangs che bas chos sgugs yin rings gnang dgos byung na mi legs par shes te/ kha gso'i bsnyen pa 'phral du btsugs/ bar bar du dpe lta dgos par byung bas phyis mig la gnod pa zhig byung / mtshams grol 'phral sku rkyang du dbang bskur tshar gcig dang / gzhan dbang cha gcig pa zhig byas/ de skabs rin po che'i drung gis mngon rtogs 'chag med gnang ba'i dam bca' gnang song na'ang / zla ba lnga tsam nas dbus nas mi ched btad gnang ba zhig la bde mchog gi mngon rtogs chen mo mi lcogs pa 'dug pas dam bca' 'grol dgos phebs byung /dpal gro nas rje btsun drung yang chos lung du khor tsam phebs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs shig dgos gsung pa ltar phul/ de yang yin ni gnyis thad nas phyi'i mdzes khrigs tsam gyi tshul ka yin khog pa long mnyam du gda'/ lar yang 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi chos zhu ba rang mang lags/ bar skabs su sgrub sde'i sgrigs lhod por song 'dug pas phan du re nas bslab pa 'chal nges mngon —75—

mtshan can gnyis bskrad/ gzhan rnams la snyan 'bul gang drag byas kyang chos lung smon 'gro yon mchod thams cad dges pa ni mi 'dug go /spyan 'dren nan zhus byas pa ltar brag stod nas rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal snga nas dpon slob rnams kyang 'di skabs phebs/ thog mar zhag gnyis gsum tsam kun gsal du sku ngal gso ba gnang zhing / de mtshams nas skyid phug nyid du bzhugs yul gnang / 'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung mang po dang bcas pa'i lung nod cing / spyir bla ma dam pa 'di dang 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can las legs par thob pa rnams bsdoms na/ dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang /gzhan yang rgya gar gyi gzhung 'grel dpag tu med pa'i lung thob bo 'di skabs rdo rje gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa dang / ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ rngog pa'i rgyud ṭīka dang man ngag sa ra he'i chos lnga sogs kyi lung thob cing / gzhan yang rjes gnang dang byin rlabs 'ga' re zhus/ de ltar na chos sna rnam grangs re'i chos thun che ba re ma chag pa dang / phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dang / sems nyid ngal gso'i khrid la nyams khrid du zhus te zhag po gsum gsum nas 'char sgo dang bstun dmigs pa spo ba sogs gnang /dus chen gyi snga phyi thams cad bsdoms pas zla ba lnga tsam sgom blo byas pas mi rtog pa kra kri dang gsal rig ngo mthong tsam ma gtogs thag chod rang zhig ma byung / dus chen gyi bde mchog sgrub mchod la rje btsun bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon por phebs shing / las kyi rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis bgyis/ gzhi byes —76—

bsdoms pas bde mchog sgrub mchod pa mchod khang du mi shong ba tsam byung / lo snga ma stag lo de dus chen chen mo yin yang dus gzings kyi stabs zhabs tog bzab rgyas rang ma byung 'dug pas/ de'i dod du de lo rgyal gyi zla ba nas brtsams dus chen gtso bor gyur pa'i 'jug gi hor zla gnyis pa'i mgo sgang yan chad tsam la lag nas mang ja lnga bcu tsam dang / 'bras 'jam bcu tsam/dar 'gyed gsum/ skam 'gyed snga phyir lan bzhi tsam/ yon bdag so so'i phyogs nas bskul ba dang bcas pa kun dril bas mang ja brgya drug cu tsam/'jam bzhi bcu zhe drug tsam byung zhing / yar 'brog yan chad nas yon bdag so sos/ rje dam pa'i dus dran nyin la dmigs pa'i 'gyed sogs dpag tu med pa byung zhing / cho 'phrul dus chen gyi tshes dgu la ngam ring nas mang ja sbrel ma dang bsngo rten bzang ba bcu gcig tshan/ gral 'gyed dkyus mthun dang /spyir nas khal sum cu tsam zhig byung / phyi ltar du sku rim yin pa'i khungs 'dug na'ang / ngo bo ni bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs su 'dug dus chen grol khar yar 'brog nas sde pa sgo mang shod pa gshegs pa'i mang ja bsngo rten rnams kyang 'byor/ rje btsun bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon por bzhugs/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu zhig gi sgrub pa brtsams te/ phye ma dang lde gu'i zhag la dri bzang che ba rang yod na'ang / tshogs rdzas la dam sel can zhig 'dres pa'i rkyen gyis de 'phral rang dri bzang yal ba zhig byung / yang zhag gsum tsam sgrub pa skyor ma mdzad pas ka pā la'i nang du bdud rtsi dkar po dngos su babs pa dang / rdzas rnams las tsheg sgra brgyud mar byung zhing dri bzang chen pos rtse zhol —77—

thams cad khyab pa byung / ril bu'i sgrub pa zin skabs/ rje btsun bla ma'i drung du ril bu thod pa gang nam mkha' la 'phar ba dang / mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i gsal snang khyad par can byung bar 'dug de skabs bstan 'dzin rin po che ni 'brum 'dzem gyi stabs bla ma dam pa spyan 'dren gnang stabs ma bde gsung nas yar ja zhus shig gnang byung / 'dir sdod pa'i snga phyi bsdoms pa la 'dul ba'i 'phros nan tan du bklags mdo rtsa dang gtam rgyud thams cad sbyor thub pa tsam byung / de nas dngos cag lho phyogs su 'gro ba'i rtsis yin na'ang / yar 'brog nas sde pa bstan 'dzin drung sku khams ma 'tsho ba'i stabs nas chos dbang ba 'bod mir byung zhing gsang brtol dang sgo bstun gyi sleb dgos tshul 'dug pa nas mar phyogs 'gro dgos shar/ slar ma phyogs 'khor ba'i lho mtshams ri khrod cig la bsgril bar blo thag gcod pa'i lugs su byas/ de nas smon 'gro khram phu jo nang o rgyan rdzong snar thang tshong 'dus bsam sdings sogs brgyud 'dol byung du zhal bcu gnyis tsam sgug dgos byung / de nas rtse chen gyi klu sdings dang rgyal rtser yang bcags mal zhig 'gor/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes drug la sna dkar rtser sleb/ de skabs dgongs rdzogs kyi sgrub mchod mngon dga' ba thar gling pa 'dzam gling chos 'khor ba rnams la re re bzhin grwa pa brgya skor gyis kun rig gi chog grwa dang / gzhan yang dgon pa so so'i chog grwa chung chung mang po 'dug cing / dngos can dpon slob bcu bzhi tsam gyis gdung gi rtsar snga dro mi 'khrugs pa dang / phyi dro rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga re byas shing /bdag rang la yon bdag gi sa nas sde pa de drin can yin/ sku sdig kyang che rab —78—

yod pas dngos kyi lag nas kyang dgongs rdzogs gang grag bgyis shing / khyad par thugs yid bsre ba'i khungs su byas te de'i ngang nas bzlas brjod sogs sku sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs la nyin mtshan du 'bad rtsol bton/ gdung 'bul ba grag grag thams cad kyis bsngo zhus re yang 'bul ba srol du 'dug pas nyin re la yang bsngo ba lan mang du byed dgos thams cad la yang bsam pa thag pa nas smon lam btab/ dgongs rdzogs ngo bo zhal nyi shu rtsa gnyis song zhing / dngos gzhi'i nyin mo 'tshom chen du dge 'dun stong bud pa tshogs pa'i gral dbur phyin/de mtshams 'dzam gling chos 'khor du zhag gcig bsdad/ 'di skabs kyang 'brang du khor tsam phyin nas drin can ma sogs mi ngo rnams dang 'phrad/ so so'i thugs bzhed kyi chos 'dra byas nged rang skyes dus nas mi ring bar skyes pa son 'debs po med par rang skyes pa'i bse ba mon pa tsho nam se zer ba de tshan la me togo dmar chil ba shar 'dug pas/ de'i rtsar chos thun re byas/ slar tshul lam sna dkar rtser sde pa ma chen gyi gdung 'od bzhu byas/ yon mchod lhan du stag lung gi chos sder byon/ zhal ngo so so'i dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i dbang chos ci rigs pa dang / sde pa rgyal bu'i drung gi dgongs bzhed ltar dgyes mdzad kyi dbang dang mgon po che chung gi rjes gnang sogs phul nas yar 'ongs/ thog mar rgyal rtse'i gzims shag tu theg shas bsdad/ blo bde nas dpon g.yog tshor sgrol ma nyer gcig dang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang sogs bzhed chos 'dra bshad/ de skabs shin tu 'tshub cing rmi lam du blo bde nas tsho rang lhag par mos shing lug gnyis kyi brtad so'i bla ma zhig gi bsang gtong —79—

gin 'dug ci mdzad pa yin dris pas bsang dud 'di btang bas sngar yang blo bde ba'i skyed tshal 'di'i shing 'di tsam bskams pa yin zer byed tsam bskams 'dug pa rmis/ de sogs sde pa blo bde ba rang la mi dge ba'i rmi ltas mang du byung ba/ sde pa dpal drung rang la ci rigs snyan du phul/ sku rim shin tu rgya che ba rang zhig gnang dgos tshul zhus/ de mtshams rtser yang zhal ngo so sor dgongs bzhed kyi dbang chos 'phran bu phul/ rtse chen du zhag bdun tsam gyi ring la smar khrid bsdus pa zhig dang tshe dbang sogs phul zhing / de nas bka' drin mnyam med mkhan rin po che de nyid kyi sku gdung zhugs 'bul la blangs pa gser gling du phyin/ chos 'khor gyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug zer ba'i g.yabs der thog mar sku gdung rin po che dngos la sku khrus gsol dri bzang sogs kyi mchod pa rgya cher phul zhabs la gtugs te smon lam mang du btang/ bla ma dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis mchi ma rang dbang med par byung / de nas thab kyi dbus su mchod yul dam par bzhugs su gsol te bsregs blugs kyi mchod pa phul ba na zhugs kyi 'od la dpal be'u dang pad+ma'i rnam pa shin tu gsal ba yun ring po'i bar du byung / phyi rol tu yang sgra dang 'od dang me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma kun gyi mig lam du phebs/ de'i sang nyin 'du khang steng der gzhi byes rnams tshogs pa'i dbus su bka' drin mnyam pa med pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mchog nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo rdzogs pa dang thugs rje'i gzigs pa rtag tu 'jug pa'i don du mchod bsngo rgyas par phul/mar lam stag rtser phyin pas/ de nas 'dol byung du 'gro rgyu char zhod che grags —80—

pas nyang chu rgyas te rab la ma thar bar rtse chen gyi zam pa bskor/ 'dol byung du zla phyed skor bsdad cing / sde pa dmag dpon drung dpon g.yog rags bsdus la dgongs bzhed ltar nai gu chos thun gnyis gnyis dang dbang rjes gnang ci rigs pa dang bcas pa phul/ de skabs 'tshub cha che zhing nor bu khyung rtse ba rang gi sde 'jig pa'i ltas yang yang byung / grong dkar thub skyel ma la yang sde pa dmag dpon drung rang gis phebs/ phyis mi 'phrad pa'i rten 'brel gsal por byung nas zla bo rnams la'ang de 'phral glengs/ bsam sdings su bdun phrag gnyis pa zhig mun mtshams la brten te sbyor drug bsgoms/ tshong 'dus su pha rin po che tre bo sprul pa'i sku dang mjal/ dpon slob tsho dang lhan du zha lu ri phug gi rten mjal zhib rgyas mdzad/ de nas lu gur rir sde pa rin po che dang mjal zhing zla phyed skor bsdad dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'ga' zhig phul/ dben gnas byang chub chen por bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid cig bshad/ lhun po rtser 'bod mi gnang ba ltar phyin zhag bcu tsam bsdad dbang chos dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ srad rin chen rtse brgyud nas rim pas gting skyes su 'byor mkhar chen du theg gsum tsam bsdad nas/ chos grwar rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa (rdo rings ba 1'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs 'bring du sleb/ shin tu dgyes pa chen pos bka' stsal lhug par gnang zhing / 'di skabs zla ba gsum tsam nyin re bzhin gsol ba thon 'phral nas nyi phyed par sku gzhogs su bsdad cing / zab mo'i chos gyi gleng slang ba las brtsams te phyi nang gi nges gnas khyad par can dpag tu med pas yid sim par mdzad/ res 'ga' snying po'i don gyi —81—

bka' chos zhal kyal gyi tshul du gnang bas ba 'ad gad chen po'ang yod/ de skabs kyi bka' bkod ci rigs pa zhig ma 'ongs lung bstan kho nar snang zhing /bdag gi bla ma de thugs rgyud grol ba zhig yin 'dug na'ang / de sngon sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ 'di skabs sbas skungs bton par gda'/ dbang rjes gnang gi rigs ni sku khams log gi dogs zhu ma nus/ rang lo bcu gnyis pa nas 'di yan chad du rang res ni nag po gzhus drug la bu skor gsum/ lha hi smad lnga/ gshed dmar la bi rū ba'i gzhung brgyad/ mā ya la ku ku ri ba'i cho se bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang ba/dpe med mtsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/ dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs la legs par sbyangs shing don khong du chud pas rnal 'byor ma rgyud phyogs la blo gros byang bar byung / hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun dus tshes bzang pa la 'dul ba 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan/ mngon pa smra ba thams cad kyi dbang phyug mdo sde 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtso bo/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yab/ rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi rdo rje slob dpon/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi mkhan po/ bla ma dam pa mkhas pa'i dbang phyug chen po slob dpon rin po che byams pa lhun grub pa'i zhabs kyis las kyi slob dpon/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams sogs kyis las kyi kha skong mdzad de/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa yang dag par thob bo/ /—82—

'dir smas pa/ khams gsum bdag po sngon yang lan brgyar thob/ /tshul khrims rin chen rnyed pa brgya la 'ga'/ /snam sbyar rgyal mtshan bsgreng pa'i 'od dmar gyis/ /mtha' dag sa 'di gcig car zil gyis gnon/ /de nas cho 'phrul gyi dus su sde pa zhal ngo rnams kyis bskul ba dang / bla ma'i bka' yis gnang ba la brten te dam rdzas kyi sgrub pa zhig kyang byas pas/phyi ltas su sgra lan gnyis tsam bstud mar byung zhing / nang ltar du yang mthong snang ya mtshan che ba tsam byung de skabs bla ma dam pa 'di'i bka' las da lta nas la stod lho phyogs su sgrub pa la bsgril ba ye mi legs pa'i bka' nan yang yang byung bas re zhig de las 'os ma byung / slar yang hor zla gsum pa'i nang du bsam sdings su 'ongs/ sleb 'phral nas mtshams dam par bcad/ zla gcig tsam lha phran 'ga'i bsnyen pa byas/ de mtshams su mkhris pa thog babs kyis shin tu na ba nyen po rang zhig byung yang / a khus bcos mdzad pas grag slob dpon rin po che yang gser mdog can dang snar thang sogs la phebs shing /slar khyung rtser sde pa dmag dpon drung sku bsnyel ba'i sngas srungs la spyan 'dren zhus/ mi ring bar sde pa'ang sku che'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa nas gdung gi 'dog mal dang khrus chog sogs kyang gnang dgos byung 'dug cing / khyung rtse ba rang gi zer bun la yang skabs su bab pa'i legs lam gang 'os gnang / bdag gi de bar thams cad du rgyal khams kyi 'gyur ba ci rigs pas skyo shas kyis yid drangs nas mtshams dam du bcad cing / rmi lam gyi dge sbyor la bsgril bas rmi lam gyi rtsal yang bzang rab byung / de sngon chung pus nas rgyal 'gong gi —83—

cho 'phrul gyis rmi lam 'jigs shing mi srun pa sad nas kyang yid bsgyur nus pa yang yang yong ba zhig yod pa/ rang lo bcu drug gi skabs rmi lam cud zad sbyangs pas/ rang nyid rta mgrin du sprul nas 'dul ba'i snang ba zhig byung ba nas rmi lam rtsub 'gyur de khyad kyis nyung ngu song / 'di skabs zla ba gsum tsam song skabs shig rmi lam du shin tu zhud che ba'i rnam pa zhig la thang stong chen po zhig nas yar phyin pas/ mi dkar zhwa theb gyon pa'i rta ba shin tu che ba 'jigs pa zhig la 'khor btsun pa dang khrab pa dang mo btsun rgyan can mang po dang 'bag pa dang sngags 'cham pa mang bo sogs sa phyogs de thams cad khyab cing lang long du 'gro ba dang gos sku'i rnam pa zang zing mang pos sa gzhi ri klung med khra chem chem khyab cing / de'i gseb nas rta ba 'jigs pa zhig gis nged rang gi gnya' ba nas tshir gyis 'jus nas sga gong du rgyab byung nas phaṭa tsha re rgyal po pe dkar gyi bar chad kyi cho 'phrul yin pa 'dug snyam sems shin tu 'tshab pa la/spre'u gnyis ltag par zhon nas so shad dang sbar sha byas zhum bu nag po zhig gis mdun nas tshur brad kyin rmugs 'jigs sgrag chen po yod tsa na/ ga re 'di thams cad sems kyi snang ba yin pa 'dug snyam pa dang sems kyi rang snang la bzang ngan dgag sgrub blang dor gang yang med pa'i ngo shes thag chod cig lhang gi byung nas de thams cad lhan gyis song / snang ba de thams cad kyang rim gyis yal nas 'od gsal yun ring du skyong thub pa zhig byung / de'i sang nub rmi lam du rta ba nag po zhig gis snying khar mdung rgyab byung bas snang ba kun sprug thom pa zhig la yal song / yang rmi lam gzhan shar ba na 'di thams cad bar do yin —84—
