par 'dug snyam par ngo zin cing yun ring du sbyang thub par byung / 'di phyin chad nas sngar gyi rtsub 'gyur de rtsa ba nas zhi/ yang lan cig rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shin tu gsal ba'i rnam pa 'ja' tshon las grub pa zhig dang rdo rje'i glu che chung de rnams rmi lam du gsal bar byung ba lags te yiṭage'i logs su bkod pa las shes par bya'o/ /de'i phyi nyin dkyil 'khor de dang cho ga'i rnam spyi blo la gsal seng nge ma brjed par 'dug pas slob dpon dam pa sogs mtshams 'og yod pa rnams la gleng slang byung / de 'phrul la rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga chen mo shog bu sum cu lhag tsam zhig nyin mo gcig la zin cing byang bar byung rdzun med dpang po can yin/ spyir gyi 'dzin blo che ba min de skabs byin rlabs su gda'/ de lta bu'i mthong snang re zhig bar gzhan la ma bshad na yong rgyur gda' ba la bshad pas cung zad 'phyugs 'dug de nas dbyar gung zla ba gnyis tsam zhig 'dod lha 'ga'i bsnyen pa drag tu byas shing rmi lam gyi dmigs pa'ang zhor la sbyangs/ nam phyed phyed dge sbyor rang la bsgril bas tho rangs 'od gsal re yang rtag tu zin/ de skabs blo bde nas sde pa dpal drung sku gshegs pa la brten te rgyal rtse dpon blon nang 'dzings kyi zir bun de yang byung zhing / bsam rtse'i dmag rnams nyang la song mtshams tshong 'dus su zhag gsum bsdad/ sgrol dkar mngon rtogs kyi bshad pa brtsams nas phul ba la shin tu dges pa'i dogs gcod kyis dus 'da' ba byung / byang chen du sleb 'phral nas mcha mis bsdams/ sgrub sde pa rnams la slob dpon dam pa'i zhal snga nas gcod khrid la sogs pa'i bka' —85—

chos mang du gnang / sngar bsnyen pa ma song ba'i chos skyong kha cig gi grangs bsnyen tsam re bskyal/ de mtshams shig sman dpon bsod nams phun tshogs rgyal rtse nas 'bod mir gnang byung ba ltar mi ring bar rtser sleb/ drung pa rin po che gu shri grags don pa lho brag la phebs lam rgyal rtse phyogs la byung ba klu sdings su mjal tsam la phyin/ de skabs rgyal rtser zla gcig lhag tsam bsdad/bdag po ma chen drung rtse chen du bu gter phebs dgos sogs nas sku grib kyi rnam pa dang thugs la'ang bde dog mtho dman che ba rang 'dug pa dang / rtse rgyal gyi 'phel gdung yang kha dog nag por song ba sogs nas nyin re bzhin bum pa bsgrubs pa'i rten khrus dang / zhal ngo tshor sku khrus phul ba'ang shin tu 'phrod pa'i zhug bcu tsam nas 'phel gdung yang kha tog sor chud/ bdag po ma chen sku grib kyis bying bying de yang sangs/ gshed dmar gyi dbang zhig phul spros med kyi spyan dmigs 'dra yang btab pas thugs kyi bde dog de yang gragade nas myur shad kyis rang gnas bsam sdings su sleb bsnyen mtshams shig byas/ de nas tshong 'dus su theg shas bsdad/ zha lu'i rten mjal zhib rgyas dang ri phug tu'ang zhag gcig bsdad/ gnas dgon gyi rten rnams la phyag mchod smon lam/ dge 'dun rnams la zhabs tog brda mtshon re thub cing /bstan pa spyi sgos dar ba'i smon lam snying thag pa nas yang yang btab/ yang byang chen du zla gnyis tsam lha phran 'dra'i bzlas brjod smin par byung / 'di skabs dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan chos bzang spyan drangs te/ don zhugs rdor dbyings sogs dbang bka' chen mo 'ga' re zhug/—86—

bla ma'i gsung gis nged bu lugs kyi dbang chos mang po'i dgongs bzhed yod tshe/ rtse chen dbon po ba la zhus na yong phebs kyin 'dug pas/ thog mar 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi zhu 'bul byas/ rten 'brel 'grig na khong pa rang la sku tshe dang 'gro don legs po yong ba yod na'ang / ye mi mdzad gsung nas rten 'brel ma 'grig phyis khong pa sgom mdzad pa'i rjes kyang med/ chos bshad pa'i rjes kyang med pa la dus 'das so/ /de nas dge sdings su dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa bdag chen bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs drung dang mjal/ theg gnyis sdod phebs pa ltar bsdad/ shing mgon dang 'phel gdung sogs rten khyad par can de dag gi byin rlabs kyang thob/ yar lam 'tshe du mjal 'dod yin yang sku mtshams dam po gnang 'dug pas mjal ma thub/'di skabs chos lung byang rtser zla ba phyed gsum tsam bsdad/ nged sleb nas zhag po bdun brgyad tsam song dus/ gnas 'byi dpon gnyen blo gros dpal ldan bsnyung ba'i stabs nas/ slob dpon dam pa gser mdog can la phebs song bas/ phyi mtshams se ba la srod thor snga dgongs rnams rje btsun grags pa'i yi ge'i nang nas bshad pa ltar sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i lha rnams kyi bsnyen pa de byas shing / nyin gung chos rje lha mchog pa la dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi thig rtsa rnams bslabs/ lag pa mi bde bas bris ni 'bring tsam ka shes/ de skabs dpon gnyer yang thegs 'dug mi ring bar slob dpon rin po che nyid gser mdog can spyi bla brang gi mi sna dang bcas chos lung du phebs pa gnang byung ba khong gi phyag rdzas rnams chos 'khor gyi mthun rkyen du sbyor ba yin pas/—87—

da lam cis kyang gser mdog can du yong dgos tshul nan chags phebs pa nas mi ring bar 'gro ba'i sgo dod cing / snga sor chos lung du dngos kyi mi sna gnyer pa snga phyir gnyis tsam bskos pa yin na'ang / rtse sgrub sde smon 'gro rnams khog gcig pa'i 'dzugs reng gis spod dgos sha stag byung zhing / yos lo yar 'brog la 'gro khar khang gsar nas kun dga' legs grub pa bsko bzhag gi skabs/ rtse sgrub kyi mi sna so so dang / khyad par smon 'gro nas dpon sa ye shes drung rang la sger du sbyor gtod zhus pa'i legs slob nyes sub mgo 'don gnang dgos tshul zhus nas phyin pa yin na'ang / nged kyi mi sna 'bud gang thub rang gi 'phral rtse sgrub sde la 'bog bcog bcol ba'i zar zir zhig gis mgo thon dka' ba zhig byung bas lo gcig song mtshams yos lo'i dpyid ka/ rtse sgrub sde'i mi sna rnams la gnyer rtsis sprad/ de phyin rtse sgrub kyi khog sgrongs smon 'gro rang nas byas pa yin dus/ de mtshams smon 'gro rang nas mgo 'don dgos rgyur 'dug na'ang / dgon pa nas za rgyu byung na za/ phyi nas dgra byung ba sogs gang la'ang khur mi 'byer bar 'dug pas/ rtse sgrub kyi mi sna gnyer 'dzin mi rnams dka' la don chung nge ba zhig gi gnas tshul la brel ba than thun 'dra byung ba nas/ 'di skabs zhug shas 'gor/ de 'dras byed pa de la'ang smon 'gro dang khong tsho rang la gnad cig 'dug nged kyis kyang de go nas cha la ba 'ag de nas mi ring bar smon 'gro/ khram phu/ jo nang sogs su khor re phyin/ de lo jo nang du rdza shar pa dang gling pa zings che ba byung bas dus khrid chag 'dug pa nas/'di skabs nged la rje drung rin po che'i bka' phebs pa nas tshogs pa rnams la —88—

sbyor drug mgyogs khrid rang zhig bshad/ phu phag dpon chen drung dang rgyal lags la dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang dgos gsung ba ltar byas pa gtor ma lan gsum mgo ma thon par lan bzhi skyor dgos byung / de nas lam 'gor sogs gang yang med par mar lam bsam rtse'i klu sdings su zhag gcig bsdad/ sde pa sku mched dang mjal tshe dbang tsam phul/ de nas thub bstan gser mdog can du 'byor/ thub dbang gnas bcu'i gos sku yang zhal 'byed mdzad 'dug pa bzhin phyag mchod smon lam rgyas par byas/ sleb pa'i gnangs nyin nas tshogs chos kyi dbu tshugs/ 'di skabs snga dro re bzhin dpal 'khor lo bde mchog slob dpon spyod pa pa'i bzhed srol ltar dngos gzhir dang sta gon re/ de nas tshogs su sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang / rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa'i thun re ste nyin re la rjes gnang brgyad dgu re byas/ dgongs phyogs mkhan slob bka' bcu rab 'khyams thams cad dang bcas pa sum cu bzhi bcu re la gsol ja bzang nges pa 'debs gnyis gnyis zhus shing / de bar du nyin re bzhin dge bzhes re res bshad pa mtha' skyong bar mdzad/'bel gtam mang pos dogs gcod gleng slang yon tan la phan tshun du thams cad la phan nges byung / 'di skabs tshogs su yang mang ja sum cu lhag tsam/bdag cag dpon slob gnyis thad nas dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu 'bab rgyu rnyed pa'i bkur bsti yang mi lod thub/ bde mchog nag po'i dbang cha sum cu tsam dang / tshogs chen du paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po nyid nas brgyud pa'i shangs chos kyi skor tshang ma dang / bka' gdams lha bzhi la sogs pa'i rjes gnang zur —89—

bka'i rigs mang dag zhig dang / khro phu brgya rdza'i lung / dril bu rim lnga'i khrid tshul/ bshad pa zhib mo mtha' gcod dgag sgrub dang bcas pa la sogs pa chos sna mang rab dang / dge ba'i bzhas gnyen rags bsdus rnams la bde mchog pū hi pa'i dbang / dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang / ma hā mā ya/ gdan bzhi sogs dbang bka' 'ga' shas shig dang / mkha' spyod ma skor gsum gyi byin rlabs sogs bgyis shing / slar bla ma rin po che rnam pa gnyis mjal ba ched kyis yar yong / snar thang dang byang chen du theg shas bsdad cing / blo sbyong sogs khrid ci rigs pa yang bshad/ srad brgyud de gting skyes su 'byor/'di skabs chos grwar zla gcig tsam bsdad/ de skabs sngar gyi rgyun las ri khrod 'grim 'dod rang rtag tu yod pas/ skyed lcags phug gi skor de la sdod thub na bsam pa zhig gis yon bdag la khang pa bco tsho thabs kyang zhus/ rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can gyi zhabs drung du sleb cing shin tu dges pa chen po'i bka' stsal mang du gnang ba dang / phyin chad yang yang mjal bar dka' ba'i 'dun pas rtse gcig pa'i gdung shugs kyis gsol ba yang yang btab/ bka' phebs thams cad zab cing rgya che ba'i bka' chos kho nar yong ba 'dug cing /de min chos bka' ni sku khams log dogs zhu ma nus/ sku gzhogs su bsdad pa la dges par 'dug pas nyin re bzhin sku drung du rgyun ring ba re bsdad/phyin chad mjal bar dka' ba 'dug snyam pa'i yid skyo sang nge ba yang yang byung /phyi mtha' ji bzhin gzigs pa'i bka' phebs la yang da 'u cag lo gcig tsam —90—

e sdod ces yang yang gsung gin 'dug pas mchi ma rang dbang med pa 'khrug par byung / 'di skabs sde pa zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang dang rjes gnang sogs ci rigs pa dang / grwa rigs grag bsdus dang bcas pa la gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang dang rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dbang zhig byas/ rim pa brag stong rdo rje'i pho brang du sleb/ 'di skabs sku drung du zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun bsdad cing / sgrol ma nyer gcig nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi skor rnams dang / sgrol ma bla med kyi phyi dkyil dang / lus dkyil gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ mchog tu zab pa'i sems khrid phyag chen ga'u ma zhig kyang bskyar nas zhus/ 'di nas khyi lo sku gzhogs su ma 'byor gyi bar tho rangs phyag chen gyi sgom thun re 'chag med byas/ skabs 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes kyi bka' babs mchog dang ldan pa'i bum can phyi nang byed bcings dang bcas pa zhus shing / lo bzhi'i bar du srid la rlung thun 'chag med re yang bsgoms/ 'di skabs kyang sngar ma thob pa'i chos kyi cha lag mang du zhus shing / ras chung ba'i bsre 'pho'i gdams skor lhad med rnams dang / zhi byed brgyud pa phyi ma'i skor cha tshang ba rnams te zhag nyung yang chos thob shin tu che bar byung / spa lung du khor gcig phyin/ rje btsun bla ma dam pas kyang phebs zhag gsum tsam bsdad cing khrom dbang zhig dang / chos rje ngag dbang pa dpon slob rags bsdus shig la ma hā mā ya'i dbang bskur zhig bced pa ltar byas/ slar yang brag stod du 'byor/ 'di skabs slob dpon pad+ma'i chos skor la rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig la khang pa la 'phyugs pa zhig byung /brag stod sgrub sde ba rnams la dril bu rim lnga'i khrid zhig dang / bla ma chu bo chung —91—

ba'i sku skye yang dngos la skra bcad mdzad cing / rngog lugs dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang zhig bzhed pa ltar bskur/ yong khar bla ma la brtan bzhugs phul bas rang gi tshe 'phel ba'i ltas cung zad byung / de nub bde ba can du bsdad/ nang par lha chur zhag gcig bsdad cing / chu 'khor ba sogs kyi mi dmangs rnams la tshe dbang zhig byas/ de nub rmi lam du jo mo g.yu ri ma yin zer ba'i bud med 'khor mang po dang bcas pa zhig byung / phyag gsum btsal nas mdun na bsdad 'dug kho na re/ nga ni gu ba la mos pa zhig yin/ khyad par bla ma lha dbang pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa zhig yin pas/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa skyong ba zhig byung na sa gang na 'dug kyang mthun rkyen sgrub/ chags sdang gi skyed 'phel byed na mi sleb pa 'dug zer/ gnyid sad nas bsam mno la rang gis sgrub pa nus na mthun rkyen dam can thams cad kyis sbyor ba zhig yin 'dug pa la yon bdag grwa rigs sogs kyi ngo dga' ma 'phongs pa'i chos brgyad kyi snang ba kha thal ba'i snyad gzhan phan yin no zer ba'i ling ling chom chom 'di la sangs rgyas byang sems rnams thugs khrel ba lta ci smos/ dkar phyogs kyi 'byung po thams cad kyang zhe khrel 'ded kyin yod par 'dug snyam pa zhig snying nas shar/ de nas yang byang nyi shar chu 'dus sogs brgyud/ dpal ldan rtser bcags mal zhig byas/ byams gling du tsha ba la sleb khong rnams kyis de nyin sdod dbang mo che zhig byed dgos zer/ de 'phral tshe bum bzhengs brda' btang bas khrom chen po rang tshogs ma ṇi'i lung dang tshe dbang zhig byas me tog 'bab pa sogs dge ltas kyang byung / de nas mdos 'drar bcags mal zhig bsdad/—92—

rim pas snar thang du sleb/ gzims tshe ba bsnyungs nas zhag shas song 'dug cing de nub rang tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs de'i khrus chog sogs byed dgos byung /tshong 'dus dbu rtser zhal ngo rnams dang mjal zhing dus rim dang thug pa'i zing zing mang po 'dug pas snang ba sgyu ma lta bu la nges shes skye bar byung / bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang gi zhabs dang yang mjal/ rang gnas bsam sdings su sleb ste mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig byas lha phran zhig gi bsnyen pa bskyal/de nas 'dol byung rtse chen sogs brgyud rgyal rtser 'byor/ sde pa mchen drung snga sor gshed dmar gyi thugs dam rgyun de ka gnang na bar chad zhi ba zhig yong ba yod na'ang / zhabs drung bdag po khri chen gyis/ gshed dmar spros med 'dra sprang po'i chos yin/ rdo rje brag rdzong ma rang gis gsungs pas gshed dmar gyi thugs dam 'phro bcad/ mi ring bar sku khams log pa'i thugs la bde dog cher byung 'dug pa/ zhabs drung spyan 'dren gnang 'dug na'ang zhabs drung gi 'chibs dpon dang sde pa gam pa nas kyi phyag g.yog rnams 'khrugs/ thugs sun la gtad rkyen des sku khams shin tu thu bar song 'grongs la khad byung /dngos kyis sleb dus zhabs drung ni phyir phebs grub 'dug cing / sku khams lod pa rang gi skabs der 'dug pas zla phyed tsam sdod dgos byung / gtor dbang dang dmigs pa sogs phul bas bdag po'i drung gi sku khams kyang sor chud cing / mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i drung du sku khams bsnyel ba zhig byung ba'ang byabs bkru lan 'ga' yar phul bas 'phral du dwangs/ de skabs gtsang rgyud pa dpon slob thams cad la chos 'brel tsam zhig byas/ bdag rgyud gsang ba —93—

'dus pa mos pas de dus mtshams sbyor zhus pas/ da lta gtsang rgyud pa la rgyal rtse nas chos bar 'degs pa 'di de dus nas byung ba yin/ de gong thugs 'brel mi gda'/ de nas sna dkar rtser sde pa zhal ngo rnams dang mjal/ nan chags kyis sdod gsung bas zhag bdun bsdad/ dgongs bzhed ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang dang tshe rta sogs phul/ rang yul tu 'byor zhag po lnga tsam bsdad/ slar chu bo'i ri'i gru la thon te lcang gling khang gsar du chu shul ba'i zhal ngo rnams dang zhabs drung bkras stobs drung gi lcam chung chung zhig 'phrad par phebs byung / de nas skyor mo lung du'ang yum drung dang mjal/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang dang gcod khrid bsdus pa zhig phul/zhag gsum nas zhabs drung rin po che yang phebs byung zhing / tshe rta sbrags ma zhig dang mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang zhig dgos phebs pa ltar phul nas slar chos 'khor lha sar sleb zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ phyag mchod smon lam gang 'grub byas/ de nas yer ba lcang lung sher chas sdings su ma 'phrad gnya' ri khug rnams brgyud nas phyin/ phyag la dgon par stag lung gra nang gling gsum gyi nas bsu ba ja 'dren sogs sleb/ de nas gsol ba gung tshigs kyi thog dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo 'gro ba'i mgon po stag lung pa chen po don gyi slad du mtshan smos te/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong zhing / sang nyin drung pa rin po che bar le ba rnam rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po yang 'phrad par phebs byung zhing / de'i sang gling du sprul pa'i sku dang mjal/ de skabs —94—

bzhugs yul ni mgron khang na gnang 'dug grog khar yang mjal bar phyin pas sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i shin tu dges pa chen pos da ni shin tu yid ches pa rang yin no zhes gzengs bstod pa mang po dang bcas bka' stsal yid la 'bab pa dgyes dgyes dpe med gnang / chos kyi 'brel ba than thun zhus myur stabs bzhugs sgar 'degs pa gnang song / de nas zla gcig skor chos rdzong rnam rgyal rab brtan rang du bla ma mchog gi zhabs drung kho na bsten cing / sngar ma thob pa'i 'gro mgon ri bo che pa'i gsung 'bum ci rigs pa'i lung sogs zab chos mang du zhus shing / dngos can lta bu ma bsdams pa/ mi mkhas pa/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa/ sems rnam par ma grol ba'i rang bzhin can 'di lta bus/dam pa mchog 'di lta bu la chos tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang 'bul ba'i rngo thogs pa ga la zhig ste/ 'on kyang bka' nan ches lci ba nas mi 'bul kha med du shar ba ni/ bka' stsal las/ nyid kyis rgya gar ba'i slob dpon 'dra las chos gsar ba mang du thob yong 'dug pa/ de rnams cha tshang ba zhig dgos phebs pa ltar phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i byin rlabs thog ma'i rten 'brel du byas nas phal cher 'bul thub/ 'di skabs sgrol ma'i rgyud chen po bsgyur ma grub/do ha dang sems kyi phyag rgya sogs zhus dag ma grub pas 'gyur ma legs tsam zhig yod/ chos 'di rnams la mchog gi bla ma shin tu thugs dgyes shing tshim pa'i tshul gnang gin 'dug pas chos 'di rnams phul bas bsod nams kyi phung po mtha' med pa thob par shes so/ /de ltar zla gcig tsam nas gnas bcu'i gos sku khyad par can bzhengs pa'i dgongs bzhed kyis bka' phebs so sor —95—

gnang ba ltar sprul sku sman thang pa blo bzang rgya mtsho la sogs pa yang sku gzhogs su 'byor/ nged rnams stag lung gling gi gzims spyil du bskyas/ de'i gnangs nyin nas gos sku 'tshem pa'i gra yang tshugs shing / dngos kyis zla gcig tsam gyi bar du sprul pa'i sku ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs pad bsten pa la/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong klu sgrub lugs kyi dbang dang gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dbang / mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang / rgyud sde mang po'i lung sogs thob/ bka' nan phebs pa la brten te/ phar phul ba yang bde mchoge nag po pa'i dbang / bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa nyer lnga ma'i dbang / grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs lung dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma nyer gcig jo bo lugs kyi rjes gnang dang / de la yang rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi lung spel mar mdzad pas/ gang ltar na'ang nyi ma gnyis la byin rlabs rjes gnang brgya dang brgyad lung po ti gcig song /gzhan yang dbang bka' rjes gnang ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug mi tri pa'i a ma na si'i chos skor nyer gnyis/ bka' yis bskul ba'i chos bzhi sogs lung yang mang du phul/ stag lung tshogs su yang sbyor drug shin tu rgyas pa kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po'i bzhed srol ltar mthar rgyas su byas/ drung pa rin po che bar le bar yang sbyor drug jo zhal gnyis ka'i lugs tshang mar phul/ de ltar zla gcig gi mtshams su gos sku yang legs par grub/de mtshams dngos la rab gnas byed dgos par bka' stsal te/ mchod khang chen mo'i lha khang shod du gza' skar gyi stabs nas/ sta gon gyi cho ga thams cad —96—

srod la grol bar byas/ nam byed nas dngos gzhi'i cho ga btsugs te/ rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga tsha gong du rdzogs par grub pa byas/ slar snga sor bzhengs pa gnang ba'i thub dbang gi gos sku nyid gtso bor mdzad cing / de res gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i gnas bcu'i gos sku gnyis po g.yas g.yon du ldem gyi tshul du gnang / bla ma dam pa khu dbon dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pas brtan bzhugs dang mchod bstod bzab rgyas su gnang / me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung / slar rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid seng ge'i khri la gdan chags par mdzad de/ dngos cag cho ga ba rnams kyis rab gnas rjes chog gi shis brjod rgyas pa rnams phul zhing / nyin gung bla ma dam pa khu dbon gnyis gtso bor phebs gral pa gzhi byes kyi mi drag tshad 'dus pa la bzhi brgya tsam zhig byung / rab gnas dga' ston bsam gyis mi khyab pas gzhi byes thams cad yid brtas par gnang zhing / de'i nang bar chi sku 'bum ltag tu gzhi byes rags bsdus la yang dga' ston rgya chen po gnang /slar rab gnas rjes kyi rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg sogs kyang phyag len mtha' rgyas rang byas/ de mtshams nas dpal rwa bsgreng gi gtsug lag khang la phyag mchod bgyid par phyin/ jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje sogs rten byin rlabs can thams cad la gser myong rgyas par phul/ gzhan yang rten thams cad la snyan dar dang / lha khang mchod rten thams cad la dar cog sogs gcig la'ang ma chad par 'bul thub cing / thams cad la smon lam gyi yi ge sogs thebs/ rmi lam du 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku tshad shin tu che ba zhig kyang gsal bar byung / de —97—

bzhin du rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sku tshe la gsal ba zhig kyang rmis/ 'di skabs kyang zhag bdun bsdad cing / tshogs pa rnams la bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang dang khrid bsdus pa zhig byas te zang zing gis kyang der bzhugs rnams yid kyi re ba gang bar gyur to/ /'di smras pa/ mtha' yas dge ba'i 'od dkar 'bum 'char ba/ 'di dag sngon goms stobs kyis drangs pa ste/ /zla ba gsar ba gcig 'chang ma myong ci yod/ /'gro kun yid mkhar rtag tu 'char 'di mtshar/ /de nas slar rnam rgyal rab brtan du ri bo che ba'i chos skor 'ga' zhig dang /gzhan yang chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig zhus shing / 'di skabs rin po che ka bzhi pa'i drung yang sgrags su sku mtshams lo gsum ma song 'phral yin la/ stag lung du rje khu dpon mjal ba dang / nged la'ang dbus kyi lto kha la yong dgos tshul nan chags gnang ba dang bcas phebs byung zhing / nged kyis kyang de'i gnangs nyin rang stag lung thang nas 'ongs te/ yar bzang du khong tsho la tshe dbang dang mgon po'i rjes gnang zhig dgos zer ba ltar byas/ glang thang du zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ mi dmangs dang bcas pa thams cad la ma ṇi'i lung sogs chos thun re 'chag med dang / so so'i 'dod pa'i chos than thun 'dra bshad/ 'di skabs kyang lha sar rten rnams la zhal gser rgyas pa rang 'bul thub cing / yer ba nas nan chags gnang ba'i yong dgos tshul phebs pa ltar yer bar phyin/ zhag shas nas sde pa g.yul rgyal drung dpon g.yog 'ga'/'tsho byed dge slong na 'o ba/ sman thang blo bzang pa sogs la bde mchog nag po —98—

pa'i dbang dang / don gnyer so so la mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyi byin rlabs/rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi rjes gnang / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi lung bshad/ yum drung du nai gu'i dmigs 'doms bsdus pa zhig dang / sde pa'i drung mkha' spyod ma dkar mo la thugs dam gnang bzhed yin 'dug pas mngon rtogs gsar rtsom zhig dgos gsung ba ltar so sor brtsams nas phul/ slar chos 'khor lha sar zhag gsum bsdad/ lha sa nas snga bar langs te/ 'bras sprungs su tsha ba la sleb/ 'di skabs rig grwa chen mo'i skabs yin pas tshogs shin tu che bar 'dug mngar hang rdum lnga'i mang ja bzang ba zhig zhus/ 'jam dbyangs /chos rje 1bkra shis dpal ldan gyi dngul gdung sogs rten rnams la so sor snyan dar dang mchod rdzas gang 'os dang / khyad par sngags khang gi rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi sku brnyan chen po'i thugs ka na rwa lo'i sku gdung bzhugs par grags pa la snyan dar gos yug lcags nag gcig la rim gnyis dang mthun pa'i bstod pa brtsams nas bris pa zhig phul/ gsol ba rgyun ring du btab pas byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma cung zad byung / thon mi'i yig phud dang rje btsun tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri sogs la'ang dri bzang gi mchod pa dang / rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i sa 'bum de la snyan dar kha bcu tsam phul/ smon lam drag tu btab/ mchod rten gyi gung nas/ ta du thā/o ga ti ga ti sogs kyi sgra gsal ba zhig byung / de nub nor bu dge 'phel du dkon gnyer dpon tshang gi sar gnas tshang byas/ sang gru la thon te 'ongs mgon po gdong gi mgon po la gtor ma zhig phul/ de nub lum par sleb/—99—

zhag lnga drug tsam bsdad tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel gyi chos than thun 'dra byas/drang srong srin po ri mjal bar phyin 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku brnyan dang / byang chub chen po'i zhal tshad/ bde mchog pū hi pa dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil thang bi bhu ti tsan+t+ra'i thugs dam rten rgya gar ma yin nges ri mo'i rnam cha phul du byung ba 'dug rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i li ma dang / thugs rje chen po nga long ma dang / rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa'i zhal thang de gsum po de/ sngon gyi de dngos rang min pa'i sku tshab yin nam sems pa zhig 'dug pa gang ltar yang de rnams mjal/ phyag mchod gang 'grub byas shing / sde pa ka bzhi pa'i drung nas bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang zhig dgos gsung ba ltar de nub byas/ nub mo'ang gtsang khar de kar nyal/ rmi lam du 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha khang shin tu mang ba zhig tu phyin pas/ bud med rgan mo zhig gis gser pod chen po zhig gtad byung / zhal phye nas bltas pas 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa rgyud du 'dug cing /mchan bu rig mi gcig pa shin tu mang ba rgyab pa'i yi ge rnams kyang gser dngul spang mthing mtshal sogs sna tshogs pas bris pa'i khra chem chem pa zhig 'dug de nyid du ni de dbyer med/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ 'dod pa dug gi lo ma dag /sgrub po nyamasang med spyod pa/ /rigs lnga la ni mngon bgrod nas/ /sman gyi dbang po rigs gcig brtag /lha dang lha min zil gnon cing / /pho nya rnams kyis rab tu 'byud/ /sbyor ba bde ba'i ngang tshul can/ blo ldan rnal 'byor ma la bsrub/ /ces pa'i tshigs bcad yod pa zhig dang / 'jug na/shin tu rnyed par dka' ba ni/ /gzhan gyis rtogs pa ma yin te/ blo ldan khyod —100—

la bstan pa yin/ /'o(na kyang rkyen g.yin dag gi na / bsgribs/ /zhekhakhapa chi kha/ 'dug der rmi lam du shes de bud med rgan mor 'ong ba 'di dam tshig gi skyon cung zad yod pa'i brdar 'dug snyam nas/ bshags bsdams mang du byed kyin 'dug pas de nyid bu mo gzhon nu zhig tu song nas lus kyi g.yon phyogs la thim pa snyam byed pa na/ rmi lam gyi snang ba yal zhing bde bas rgyal ba 'dra ba'i 'od gsal 'thug po yun ring bar byung ngo / /sang nyin yang rdzong du ma sleb bar du snang ba 'gyur zhing lus bde cham me 'dug pa la rdzong nang du sleb pa na yal nas song gnas kyi grib yin nam sems/ srin po rir bde mchog gi bstod pa rim lnga dang mthun pa de brtsams so/ /de nas sgrags mdar sgrags rgyal byed tshal pa dpon slob rnams kyang phebs byung zhing / slob dpon pa la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang dgos gsung ba ltar bgyis/ sngags grwa'i bla ma bgres po rnying ba rang yin kyang bla med kyi dbang zhu mi mkhyen pa cig 'dug de'i sang rdo mchod thang kha'i rdo'i mchod rten rnams la byin rlabs re zhus shing mchod pa dang na bza' re phul smon lam btang/ chos 'khor chen po bsam yas su sleb lha khang rnams la zhib mjal du byas/ byang chub chen po la gser zhal phul/ ar+ya pa lo gling gi spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/ 'od zer can ma gsum/ sems bskyed byang chub gling gi de bzhin gshegs pa ma chags pad+ma rnams la'ang gser zhal re sbyon/ srod la rmi lam du lung pa skyid po zhig gi nags gseb cig na khang pa dmar po chen mo blos mi 'byud pa zhig 'dug de'i nang du sleb tsa na rtsig rdo thams cad mi mgor song ste/ kha 'phrul mig 'phrul byas gad mo dir dir —101—

'jigs pa ston du byung / de thams cad bden med sgyu ma lta bu shes nas cham me mnyam par bzhag pas/ khang stong de'i gseb nas nga ma 'ching zer ba'i sgra lhang lhang byung / de nas ji zhig na de rnams yal te skyes pa gzhon nu lus che zhing mdzes pa gos dkar po gyon pa zhig gus gus ltar phyag btsal dar dkar po zhig phul/ sha khog gcig gtad pa rmi/ sang nyin mchims phu mjal/ de nyin gnas tshang ba'i gnyen tshan khyo kha zhig chus khyer nas shi/ de nub rmi lam du mdang gi mi dkar po de byung nas khyod kyi gang dgos ngas byed pa yin zer/ nga la khyed kyis sgrub dgos cang med byas pa rmi/ sems bskyed bsdus pa zhig de la bsha/da pa lta bu ha cang gsal ba min tsam zhig byung / phyis bla ma dam pa la zhus dus/ rang re la tshar chad chod tshad 'grig pa ni yin/ mi gzhan la gnod pa yong ba de dam thogs ni min gsung / dwags la skor du bde mchog gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i bcu bzhi pa dang tshes brgyad nyin/ de yi dus tshigs yin par bshad/ khyim du mdung rtse gsum pa yang / /bris nas de ni rtag tu mchod/ /ces pa'i rnam cha gsal por mthong / /de res gong du lha sa na yod dus mi ldog ma'i mtshan nyid can gyi /brdab ka pho nya mo'i rigs cig yod pa'i gtam bden nges byung / mthong ni ma mthong / bsam yas rang na'ang zhing gi rnal 'byor ma dngos su 'dug par mthong zhing shes/ de gsum zla gcig gi nang du yin/ de nas de ka'i thad nas ko ba la zhugs te/ 'brong zhol du bcad de yar lam bye rdzing tshogs pa rnams kyis bsu ba bzabs/ grub chen khyung po'i thugs sogs rten ngo mtshar can rnams kyi byin rlabs thob/ tshogs pa rnams la'ang chos —102—

'brel gyi rten 'brel legs tshogs che bar byas te/ de nub byams pa gling du sleb/ sde pa sku ga6zhe pa phebs 'dug thog mar byams pa'i lha khang mjal/sang mchod rten chen po'i rten mjal zhib rgyas byas/ mchod rten gyi logs bris rnams mthong ba'i tshe sngar yang lan cig yongs pa 'dra ba zhig gi rig pa yul yul ba dang / bde mchog lha hi pa'i gser sku de mthong dus dga' skyo zung du 'brel ba zhig byung / de nas rgyal chen gling du zhag bzhi bsdad/ tshogs pa dge 'dun sgang pa rnams kyi tshogs khang du dpon slob thams cad la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig spyi chos su byas/ rting la rang rang so so'i 'dod chos zhu mkhan rnam grangs mang ba rang byung / mkhan po kun blo ba yin/ sde pa lcam sring du yang tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba phul/ nyin re bzhin bde yangs der khrom 'dus che ba la chos thun re bshad/ grwa thang du theg gsum tsam bsdad cing / bde mchog ྅ hi pa'i dbang bskur sogs so so'i 'dod chos ci rigs pa bshad/ 'di skabs rgya gar tri liṅga nas sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa phyi rol gyi rig gnas sogs la'ang mkhas shing / theg pa mchog gi man ngag la shin tu 'dris pa tsang ga shrī zhes pa dpon slob gnyis lha sa mjal zin nas slar rgya gar la ldog phebs pa dang dus 'dzom zhing / chos zhu 'dod tsam byung na yang zhu ma thub/ khong yang zhag gcig la yang rtseg 'dam mdzad nas myur por 'byon par 'dug yin na'ang zhag po gnyis lhan du byung ba la gling slang gi sgo nas dogs gcod mang po dang sngar shes pa'i chos kyi yan lag 'dra'i khungs kyang chod par byung/ khong byon pa'i rkyen gyis gang ga gi ri'i gnas tshul 'dri —103—

mkhan mang du byung bas/ ngas lar bod la yong ba'i a tsa ra phal cher phyi pa ka yin/ khong pa yang mu stegs pa yin zhing bslabs shes kyi yon tan rang ni yod rigs su mi 'dug gzhan gnas tshu 9 / ni mi shes zhes smras/ sa skya zhabs drung khri chen gyis grub thob yin rgyu'i bsngags brjod mdzad 'dug pas/ nged kyis drang por smras pa la/ dpon sa'i drung sogs thams cad bden par mi 'dzin pa 'dug ste phyis rang rtags bstan pa de yin/ de nas dol mda' lhun grub lha rtser sde pa a khu drung pa khu dpon rnams dang mjal zhag bdun tsam bsdad/chos zhub mang dag yod pa rnams la khrid lung sogs kyi chos smrar ba dang /zhal ngo rnams la'ang rkyen sel than thun phul/ yul tsho yul tsho'i mi dmangs rnams la ma ṇi'i lung / smyung gnas la sogs pa 'phral 'phral byed dgos byung /chos rdzong tshogs pa rnams kyang chos 'brel zhu bar byung / dar phyung du'ang zhag gcig phyin/ byi rdzing mkhan po dpon slob rnams la bzhed don gyi gtso bo khrid brgya bshad lhan du skyid gshongs su 'ongs/ gsang phu ra ba smad pa dpon slob tshang ma la rjes gnang 'ga' zhig chos 'brel du byas/ mkhan chen dpon slob dang g.yin don gnyer mang rab la lung gi 'phros dang / ma hā mā ya'i dbang bskur/ bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs/ de gnyis kyi khrid chen mo ngag thog nas mgyogs khrid rnams phul/ gong dkar nas gong ma khu dpon gyis yong dgos tshul phebs/ lam mi 'chag la chos sder phyin/ klu dbang gling du chos rje 'bul dpon pa dang co 'dri byed res 'dra byung / bla ma lha khang du bla chen drung yang phebs rten thams cad la chos rje ri grong bas rten bshad bzabs/ de —104—

nub sa srib la gzhis kar sleb/ sang zhogs zhabs drung mi dbang drung dang mjal 'phrad kyi legs lam thog mar spel/ ka bcur gong ma rin po che ma chen dang mjal kha zhus dus/ phyag len dang gdan mthong sogs mthong zos dpe med gnang / de'i sang nyin chos sde'i nang mjal zhib rgyas byed par phyin/de dus yo ga sgrub mchod kyi skabs na 'dug pas yo ga'i dkyil chen rnams la bshad pa cung zad byas/ dge slong rdor grags sogs mchog tu ngo mtshar zhing dgyes/ chos sder mang ja dang spos shel brgya lhag pa'i brgya phrang sogs spyi 'bul byas/ yangs pa can du rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal gyi gdung rten la phyag mchod 'bul bar phyin/ sprul sku spyin pa'i nang du'ang shog zer ba bzhin phyin/ slar yang gzhis kar zhal ngo so so'i dgongs bzhed ltar chos sna mang tsam phul zhing / mi dbang drung du gnyos mgon gyi rjes gnang zhig dgos zhes nan gyis phebs pa ltar 'bul dgos byung bas shin tu 'tshub pa rang zhig byung /gzhan chos 'dod mang por chos sna sad sud mang du bshad/ zhal ngo rnams sngar gzhan zer gyi dbang las de gong du thugs mthong cher med na'ang dngos su mjal ba nas brtsams thugs mos kyang che bar gnang gin 'dug zhabs drung mi dbang drung gis brtag dpyad kyi tshul du thugs dam thang ka mang po la bstod pa smon lam sogs kyi rgyab yig 'bri dgos dang / gsol 'debs dang zhal gdams sogs sku gzhogs su 'phral du 'bri dgos mang du byung / de rnams thogs med du bris rtsom shin tu myur ba dang tshig don yang legs rab byung bas/gzhan dag la phebs sgor yang / rje dam pa'i rnam 'phrul yin min gang ltar —105—

yang kho rang gis chog pa 'dug gsung / de skabs ga ri pa de ba zer ba'i dza gam mthu chen gcig gis khol brnyas pa byas zer/ gong ma zhal ngo rang la ngan byed grabs 'dug pa la ngas zhib sed sel sbyangs byas kho rang yang sems zhi song / de nas 'brang phur theg gnyis gsum ngal gso byas shing / de mtshams drin can gyi ma la nai gu'i zab khrid snying por bsgril ba chos drug stan thog gcig ma zhal shes dang bcas nas phul/ mi ngo byings la dang po mes po rin po cher dbang bskur thob sa de nyid du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur zhig byas/ bla ma dam pa slob dpon rin po cher yang / mi nge rnams ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa nag po dang / mgon po yid bzhin nor bu sogs kyi rjes gnang zhur bcug mkhan chen rin chen shes rab pas de skabs 'bod mi nan chags gnang ba ltar gnam bzhir phyin/ dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang zhig dgongs bzhed ltar dpon slob 'ga' shas la byas/ de skabs chos lung byang rtse'i chos gzhis 'ga' shas rje btsun dpal groms btsan phrogs byas nas mtshod du phul/ mtshod nas kyang chos dam tshig mi dgos par bla ma'i gdan sa rlag par bzhed pa'i dar 'dzugs sogs mdzad 'dug bstan 'dzin rin po che gzhis ka gong dkar du phebs 'dug pa la de thad la zhu mkhan btang bas/ sku dbang gi phebs sgo 'ga' rong gi snyem gnam slongs 'di ngam ring chos sde'i brgyad brgya ma'i mchod thes yin pa chos lung du sbyar bas byang ba'i zhal ngo gang stongs kyi rgyud song zhes sogs ra thon lug thon mang po gsung gin don ma mthong / de nas nged rnams skyas su sleb dus/ rgya gar lho phyogs bhi na da'i ri'i —106—

khongs bha dwa zhes pa'i yul nas rig sngags grub pa'i rgyal po pa la bha dras/dngos la 'phrin yig go ra'i yi ge sa spro ta'i skad kyis bris pa/ bod skad du bsgyur na 'di ltar/ ri kha ba can gyi khongs na grub thob zhi ba sbas pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa gcig pu gnyis su med pa ni/ tā ra gu ru khyed yin zhes thos/bsod nams kyi stobs mi dman par spyod pa'i rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug nga dang yang / srid pa gzhan du 'thams pa yin zhes grub pa'i lung las 'byung / de'i don du ba ṭo la dza ste gnyis dang sur dza kran t+ya gcig zung mchis/ rā dzā pā tra/zhes pa'i 'phrin yig rten bcas gser chu'i tha khas mnan pa/ i li kha zhes pa'i rgyal rigs ldom bu'i chas su zhugs pa zhig lha sa mjal ba la ched kyis 'ongs pa la bskur nas byung / 'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa gsar du dar bar mdzad pa'i rgyal po khong gcig pu yin par thos shing / khyad par grub chen zhi ba'i slob ma thams cad rgyal po de'i bsngags pa mdzad pa yang yang thos pas/ bstan pa nub tu nye ba na/ ri bo 'bigs byed kyi nang du dam pa'i chos gsar du dar bar byed par 'byung bar rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa de nyid yin tshul sogs kyi bstod bkur rgya che ba kha gsag dang bcas pa'i lan yang brdzangs/ sang gi lam du longs spyod chen po dang bcas bzhin du slong mo pa mang po yang phyi bzhin du 'brang bzhin pa la kha zas dang yon gyi spyin pas tshim par byas te/ sna dkar rtser sleb de mtshams nas thog mar stag lung gi chos sde'i bla brang dkar por 'byor zhing / sde pa zhal ngo rnams dang gzhan mang por gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ gur zhal gyi rjes gnang /—107—

mgon pod me 'bar ma dang zhal gyi sgrub yig cha tshang ba'i lung / sgyu lus dbang mo che'i byin rlabs kyis sgo phye ste/ nai gu'i 'khrid tshul spyi nye bar bsdus pa 'bring po'i dbang du byas pa rnams phul/ chos rje sngags ram pa dang / shar chen slob dpon pa sogs slob dpon las thog pa gsum/ grwa rigs don gnyer che ba mang dag dang bcas la bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang / dril bu rim lnga'i khrid/pū hi pa'i khrid rnams dmigs pa nges shing mtha' gcod bshad pa zhib mo byas/chos rje sngags ram pas nan tan gyi dgos gsung nas nyung bsdus la nag po rim bzhi smar khrid de yang bshad/ de rjes chu shul nas dpon sa phebs pa'i shis brjod sogs kyang bgyis/ zhal ngo spyi mthun du tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang rjes gnang 'ga' shas phul/ rim pas brgyud nas chos sde'i ser bsgreng sogs bsu ba bzab ma dang bcas nas rgyal rtser sleb/ 'di skabs zhag bcu lhag bsdad/ rtse chen dang stag rtser gzims dpon thad smad pa tsho brtib pa'i zar zir gyi skabs yin/ khyung rtse dang 'dol byung nas 'bod mi nan chags byung na'ang ma phyin/ lhun grub rtser kun spangs drung gis sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / tshe dbang 'dra dgos gsung ba ltar byas/ slar bsam sdings su sleb phyi mtshams su bsdams/ zhag bcu skor zhig mang bskol 'gyed bcas kyi bkod pa dgos pa byung ba nas nang mtshams ma thub/ de nas mang bskor ba rnams kyang brdzangs te/ gtsang phyogs kyi mdo sngags kyi grwa sa dang / chos sde grags chen thams cad la mang ja 'gyed bcas bzang ba re grub/ sems nyid rtogs par smon lam btab/ thag nye ba nas ri phug dang dga' ba gdong du mang ja —108—

'phral 'phral drangs/ gser mdog can du yang dgun thog de la mang ja nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam zhu thub/ mang bskol ba rnams brdzangs 'phral nang mtshams dam du bcad/ de gong zla ba gnyis tsam gyi sngon nas bsag sbyangs 'go tshugs zin pa dang zhag bcu skor de la srog thor snga dgongs rnams smar po byed rgyu byung bas/nang mtshams bcad nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa sngags kyi bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi la zhugs/ zla ba gnyis su nye ba tsam song skabs/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bdun gyi tho rangs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can gyi sku'i rnam pa shin tu gsal ba snam sbyar gser ma sku la gsol ba zhig byung / bdag la byin rlabs shig gnang nas skas shin tu ring ba rtse mo mngon mi mngon zhig la yar phebs song ba zhig byung / gnyid sad tsam na blo yang ma bde zhing nyin gung thun mtshams kyi skabs slob dpon rin po che dang pha rgan dang mtshams g.yog rnams la'ang rmi lam yang bshad/ tshes bcu la dbyings su thim pa'i gnas tshul skyel mi byung ba/ bsnyen mtshams yin na'ang hor 'don byas te 'phral du 'gro rtsis kyi grabs kyang byas/ grang reg skyob pa'i gos 'dra yang brtsems/ gnas tshul skyel mi rnams la bla ma dam pa chos dbyings su thim khar sku gzhogs su 'byor ma thub pa 'dis nged ma sleb par zhugs 'bul 'then dgos tshul nan chags rang byas/ khong tshos kyang myur shad phyin pa'i nged kyi yi ge dang ngag lan thams cad 'byor 'dug ste/ de la ma nyan par tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin zhugs 'bul byas 'dug de kas phyogs de'i rten 'brel 'ga' re sgrig rgyu yod de cung zad 'chugs pa der 'dug de'i gnas —109—

tshul yang 'phral du byung bas de phyin bla ma'i phyag rdzas za bar phyin pa la dgos pa mi 'dug pas/ de bas bsnyen pa rang don che bar bsam te/ nye skor gyi dgon sde che sa rnams la dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i mang ja 'gyed bcas gang drag bgyis shing / bzlas pa'i ngang nas bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i smon lam nyin re bzhin yid kyis 'debs pa bsnyen pa 'di ma grol bar la byas/nam dus bzang bas rig pa dwangs pa dang rtsol ba bskyed de nam gung cung zad tsam ma gtogs gnyid kyang ye ma log par bzlas pas grangs bsnyen zla ba bdun du nye ba tsam la song / de mtshams rgyal rtse nas zhabs drung bla ma dpon slob gser mdog can du phebs pa'i lam zhor du bsam sding su'ang phebs byung ba/ gang spyi'i snyan bskul yang nang sbyar blo la shar tshad phul/ de nas hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun gyi nub mo rmi lam du bud med cig la bkra shis kha btags kyi mdud pa zhig byin te shi ba gsos pa yin no zer ba zhig rmi/ sang nyin rgyal rtse nas nang so dpal 'phel ba byung nas dpon sa gting skyes nas 'phral du sku shin tu bsnyel ba zhig byung ba/ sku 'tsho mi 'tsho'i thad du sleb 'dug 'phral du yong dgos phebs pa zhig byung ba mdang gi rmi lam dang sbyar na de res cang mi yong bar nges bsam nas/ da lam yong mi dgos shing skyon mi yong ba'i khag 'khur sku rim 'di tsho mdzad dgos zhes sku rim 'dra phog bkra shis kha btags kyi sngags mdud zhig kyang yar bskur/ khong de dus zhabang nge byed kyin 'dug na'ang phyis nged kyi tshig bden par byung / de nas zhag gsum tsam bsnyen pa kha gsos nas zhag bcu'i bar kha skong gi spyin sreg rdzogs par byas/ de ka'i —110—

ring la gtsang rgyud pa rnams kyis drug cu pa dang / mgon po'i gtor chen zhig mdzad du bcug pas byad kha bzlog pa'i ltas shig kyang byung / nyer lnga'i nub zhig nyams dang rmi lam cha mi phyed pa zhig la o rgyan gyi dur khrod yin zer ba dur khrod zhig gi dbus na chos khri chen po zhig 'dug pa'i steng na/ he badz+ra zhal phyag yongs rdzogs sku tshad thog so do tsam shel sngon po las grub pa 'dra ba/ de spyan hrig hrig zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad pa mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs kyang 'jigs la dga' yang dga' ba zil bzod par dka' zhing bag kyang dro ba rig pa la dpa' ngar yang bskyed thub pa zhig 'dug ro langs yin zer ba brgyad dang lhan du nga rang yang rnal 'byor pa'i chas su bsgyur nas/ aṣ+ṭa la 'dzab dbyangs byed kyin 'chod rgyug dang skor ba byed kyin 'dug de nas bud med mdzes ma gos sngon po gyon pa gsum byung nas/ thod pa 'o mas gang ba gcig 'dug pa la 'di ci yin dris pas bskyed rim yin zer/ thod pa sbrang gis gang ba zhig 'dug pa la dris pas rdzogs rim yin zer/ khrag gi gang ba zhig 'dug pa la dris pas dam tshig dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag yin zer/ 'o na nga gang nas 'thung byas pas/ sngon la 'o ma 'thung / /sbrang dang khrag 'di phyis rim gyis 'thung zer/ der 'o ma de 'thung pas lus nyams mer mer shig shig la yun ring rab song / gnyid sad nas kyang nyin gung thugs ma sangs par 'duga'adi rting gzhan yang bsnyen mtshams che ba zhig byed 'dod yong na'ang / jo nang du rje drung rin po che gshegs pa'i stabs/ jo nang pa rnams kyis 'bod mi nan can dang / smon 'gro nas tshe dbang don grub pa dang dpon sa'i drung gi gsung —111—

yig yong mi yong gi 'thangs len dang / yong par shar tshe gang myur yong dgos pa'i tshul byung / ngag mtshams grol nas de 'phral yong ba'i grabs byas/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin mo khri khang du bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang mjal tsam byas/ bsam 'grub rtse nas 'bod mi byung ba bzhin tshes brgyad kyi nyin bsam rtser sleb pa'i gzims khang bde ba can gyi logs bris la rab gnas kyi sta gon tshugs par byas/ de'i sang gza' skar bzang ba la rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi byas pas logs bris kyi lha 'ga' res me tog mang du bzhes pa byung / me tog byings rnams de 'phral drung 'khor rnams kyis byin rlabs rten la khyer/ gsum bzhi zhig zhag mang rab bsdad par gda'/ sde pa rgyal bu'i drung gis de gong mjal ma myong bas de'i nyin mjal/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin ri khrod chen mo jo mo nang du sleb/ sdod sa 'du khang steng gi thigs khang du byas/ gdung 'bul gang bzang bzang gi khungs dgu tshan gsum pa zhig dang de nyin mang ja zhig dang de'i sang mang ja sbrel ma 'gyed bcas dang bcas pa zhig btang / jo nang bla brang na ni de skabs rgyu yod pa'i rigs su mi 'dugagazims chung bzang rab yod pa smon 'gro ba rang dang gcig nged rnams sleb pa'i nyin gdung gi drung du cho ga zhig btang / sang nyin gung tshigs grol mtshams la sku 'bum thang du gzhir bzhugs kyi sgrub sde rnams kyi steng du jo nang rang gi dgon lag rnams dang chos lung sgrub sde dang dkar po ba sogs tshogs dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i 'byed de yang mdzad cing / de mtshams mol gtam rgyas pa dang bcas mchod bsngo rgyas par phul/ dpon drung sku mched la —112—

'du khang steng du ja 'dren gang grag dang shis brjod bkra shis sogs byas/sgrub sde rnams kyis da res dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i sbyor drug yongs rdzogs shig sgrub sde ngo rkyang la byed dgos tshul nan chags su byung bas zla ba gcig gi bar du sgrub sde spyi nas dkor zos/ sang nyin tshes bco lnga de kha nas khrid kyi 'go btsugs/ sngon 'gro mdor bsdus dmigs pa 'dri ba gtso bor byas zhag bdun tsam la bsdus/ dben gsum gyi dam po zhag bdun gyi skabs mtshams la 'jug khar sgrub sde rnams kyis brtan bzhugs shig kyang mdzad pa bzhin 'du khang rang du mtshams bcad nas bsdad/ rig pa dwangs shing skyid pa la nub re bzhin 'tshub cing cho 'phrul che ba dang / dbang gong ma'i skabs mi tshogs kyang shin tu che ba zhig byung zhing / dngos gzhi dam po sogs ni ma thub/sngar gong jo nang gi tshogs su sor spong tsam las sbyor drug yongs rdzogs gnang ba ma byung ba lo mang dag rang song 'dug pas/ 'khrid tshul yongs rdzogs mi nub par bya ba'i phyir yan lag drug kar zhib par bshad cing / khyad par rgyud don zhib mor bshad na der tshogs mi rnams kyis mgo rung / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams dgyes par nges shes skyes te/ rgyud don ltar mtha' gcod bshad pa yang shin tu rgyas par byas/ spyir da lta yang kun mkhyen chen po nas brgyud pa chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i khrid yig gi steng nas 'chad pa tsam dang / dam po'i phyag len tsam yod pa 'ga' re 'dug na yang / kun mkhyen jo nang pa yab sras kyi grub mtha' shes bzhin du skyong ba shin tu dkon par 'dug pa dang / jo nang gi gdan sar phebs pa la'ang rje o rgyan —113—

rdzong pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis jo nang pa'i lugs kyi dbang khrid sogs gnang yang / kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed srol rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gsang tshig don dam gzhan stong du ston pa rdo rje'i gsung seng ge'i sgrar grags pa rnams la zur za dang dgag sgrub mdzad pas/ chos srung phyin chad ma mnyes pa'i gsung ngag mi bde ba sogs ji snyed zhig byung 'dug spyir dngos can gis shing rta chen po su la'ang dgag sgrub nus pa ma yin pas mchog tu gus par byed mod kyi skabs 'di dag tu ni brton pa bzhi ldan chen po nyid kyi bzhed pa ltar dgag sgrub kyang mtha' chod par byas so/ /de nas sde pa o lo'i 'bod mi nan chags yod pa ltar gtsang go gnyis ma'i dgon pa bde mchog rtser byin/ 'di skabs gtsug lag khang sogs gsar bzhengs dang mnga' zhabs la grwa khral yang mdzad 'dugazhag bcu bdun tsam bsdad de bar dgon pa ba rnams la 'du khang der snga gro theg chen blo sbyong gi chos thun re dang dgongs mo ni gu'i chos thun re spyod/thos btsun rab byung byed mkhan gsar ba bdun bcu tsam byung zhing / kun dga' dpal bzang yang de skabs kyi grwa pa yin/ bsnyen rdzogs pa'ang bde mchog rtse ba rang bcu gnyis tsam dang phyogs pa 'dra yang bsnan mas bcu bdun tsam byung / sde pa rang la sgos su'ang dbang bka' 'dra byas/ de nas rang re'i grwa rigs 'dra dang yon bdag 'dras yang yang bskul ba dang / ngam ring nas shog gsung nan chags yod pa ltar blos ma longs pa 'gro ma 'dod pa gcig la yar chas te/ rdod phug po cher chos rje grags bkras pa dang gsung 'phros smar bar byung / sang nyin ngam ring gi pho brang du 'byor/ sleb pa'i gnangs nyin rgyal —114—

bu'i zhabs drung dang 'jal/ ka bzhi lhor bzhugs gra' zhig kyang byung / de skabs gcung tshul bas tshod bgam pa'i tshul du/ dus 'khor la brten pa'i dri ba cung zad byas pa la de mthun gyi lan rgyas par btab/ 'di gong du smon 'gro nas tshe dbang don grub pa jo nang du dgongs rdzogs grol 'phral ngam ring du byon pa'i mtho dman phyi nang thams cad du kha log gang shes bcug 'dug zhag shas ma go bar rdzu bskyabs su byas na'ang / de mtshams smon 'gro bas jo nang du mi sna zhig phab/ jo nang spyi sa dang smon 'gro ba kha mchu thug ngam rings su zhu gshugs byas/ jo nang pa'i phugs su nged tsho zhugs zer phyogs 'phul glan ga bsnyad brko mngon tshan can byung ba rkyen du song / chos lung gi khur len kyang nged gyis byed skabs yin pa la brten pa'i smon 'gro ba dang 'dod pa ma mnyam phyi ltas legs lam chung ba rang zhig byung song / bsam 'grub dga' ldan pa'i 'du khang logs bris la rab gnas bsdus pa zhig byas/ rje btsun ce lnga kha pa chen po'i sku thang rnying pa gcig dang logs bris gyi lhas me tog bzhes pa mang du byung bas slob dpon pa sogs shin tu dgyes par gyur/ 'di skabs bzang ldan chos sde spyi bas khor gcig cis kyang yong dgos tshul byung bas nyer gnyis kyi nyin phyin/ khong rnams kyis kyang ser bsgreng sogs bzab ma mdzad/ sleb pa'i sang nyin 'jam dbyangs chos khri nas thog ma'i rten 'brel 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang zhig byas pa/ nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la nyi ma thog phub nyis rim dang me tog gi char chen po babs pa bsnyon med der tshogs thams cad kyi mig lam du phebs shing / grwa pa bgres po thams cad mos gus stobs su gyur pa'i spo115—

spyan chab rang dbang med par 'byin pa byung / da res dus 'khor gyi dbang zhig cis kyang byed dgos zhes thams cad mgrin gcig tu gsung gin 'dug pas/tshogs pa thams cad la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa zhig byas/dbang mi bdun brgya lhag tsam byung / de rjes drag bsdus la bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang zhig dang / tshogs pa byings la nyeng mkho'i lung dang rjes gnang mang du byas/ tshogs su mang ja gsum tsam dang 'gyed bzang ba zhig dang / smu rdzing du chos bdag ma la'ang spyan gzigs sogs bzab rgyas phul/ 'di skabs zhag bdun bsdad/ nyer dgu'i nub na dmar du bsdad sang zhogs bzang ldan gyi chos bdag ma 'phreng ba'i rten 'brel gyis khal ma thams cad ngam rings phyogs su mi 'gro bar bzang ldan phyogs la yang yang phyir ldog pa zhig byung /ngam rings su 'di skabs rje btsun ma ngag dbang drung la bde mchog yab bka' yum bka' rtsa dbu ma'i khrid sogs gsung phebs ltar byas/ shig khror sgrub sde pa rnams la kyai rdo rje dang dus 'khor gyi dbang / gzhan yang bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang cha gnyis tsam dang / 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang / khrid lung rjes gnang sogs chos mi 'phel ba med tsam byung / smon 'gro nas chos lung gi phyogs la nged la thob thang gcig kyang med tshul chos lung gi lugs gnyis thams cad smon 'gro ba rang yin tshul kho na zhu ba dang / gzhan yang snga phyir blo btang mtshams sna tshogs zhig 'dus pa rnams skabs 'dir mngon mtshan du gyur/ de phyin khong tsho rang la gtod 'dod pa zhig deng rang gi bsam pa la byung na'ang zla po rnams kyi blo la ye mi ran pa 'dug de sta bas nas —116—

lo gcig gnyis 'dzin dka' ba zhig yong 'dug pas sde srid rang la dgon bcol zhus/ dbyar gzigs sar yol thang rab gnas la dga' ston ye med pa skam po rang zhig kyang byas/ snga sor jo nang gi khri thog tu rje drung gong ma nyid kyis 'jog pa mdzad pa'i phyag nas gnang ba yin kyang de la 'di yin rang gi dgos pa ma byung bas/ 'di skabs jo nang gi gdan sa la 'gro dgos tshul gyi phebs sgo byung ba/ spyir ni dgon pa sogs kyi zhe 'dod ye med cing gnas nges med du dge sbyor gang 'phel byed pa zhig rang la smon pa yin pa dang khyad par dog 'tshangs kyi rigs la 'dod pa ye med na'ang / bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can gyis kyang bka' bkod kyi rim pa mang du gnang ba dang / de skabs kyang 'phral du slob dpon rin po che'i bka' las kyang stod phyogs 'dir yon mchod kyi 'brel byed pa la jo nang cis kyang 'dzin pa 'thad/de 'dra'i chos brgyad kyi snang ba la mi lta na'ang / phyogs 'di kun na grub mtha' rang blo'i lam du 'dren pa tsam las jo nang pa yab sras kyi bzhed srol skyod pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ grub mtha'i phyogs 'go things pa tsam yang mi 'dug pas chos tshul gyi bstan pa rang la bsam dgos pa yin zhes nan tan tu gsung bas de blo la gzhag nas sde par yang jo nang gi gdan sa'i khas len zhus/ de min bgyed du sgrub khang yang btab/ der sgrub pa la gzhol ba zhig lag tu longs nad tsam na tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas la yang dka' ba rang med dam snyam pa dang / khyad par rang gzhan thams cad la phugs su phan che ba rang zhig yong ba yod na'ang / 'gro don du rdzu pa'i bdud kyi 'jug pa 'di spong dka' ba rang —117—

zhig byung / bla chen gzhan rnams kyis kyang 'di ye ma dgongs par gda'o/ /ngam rings nas phyir 'ongs dus chos rje grags bkras pa cung zad bsnyung nas zhag shas song 'dug pa khong gi gzims khang du 'phrad par phyin/ de nub rang ya mtshan pa'i ltas dang bcas nas grongs/ de nas ri khrod chen po jo mo nang du hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga la sleb/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin gza' skar bzang ba la gdan sar 'khod cing bsko 'ja' sgrog pa dang bla brang gi snga phyi'i rtsis sprod gyi dbang po la gro lung nang so gnang byung / de skabs bla brang rnying pa nas sprod snying gi ming btags phran bu las sprod nas sogs ni gcig kyang med/ rtsis len grub mtshams nged rang gis skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam mtshams dam pa rang byas/ phag mo'i rigs shig la bsnyen pa bskyal/ hor zla dgu pa'i gzhug na mar skyid phug gi se ba rnams la me tog mang po gsar du kha 'bus pa'i dung 'dab skya chil le byung / dus tshigs ma yin par me tog 'byin pa dge ltas su bshad 'dug pas dge ltas tsam yin la che 'am yin du re ba ni mi gdog 'di skabs rmi lam du ri chen po zhig gi ngos la 'dzeg pas spang gshongs nyams dga' ba zhig tu sleb byung / de na slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas yin zer ba rnal 'byor pa dbu breg mtshar la gzi brjid che ba zhig 'dug de'i drung na bod kyi dge ba'i bzhes gnyen bgres sang gis song ba shin tu gzi brjid che ba zhig 'dug pa dwags po rnyi ba rin po che yin zer/ rnal 'byor pa de'i gsung nas nga dang dol po ba ngo bo gcig gsung / gzhan de'i gsung nas nga dang yang gcig go gsung ngo / /de nas lha khang zhig na rta mgrin gyi sku chen po bzo khyad blo yul —118—

las 'das pa zhig 'dug thugs ka'i thad na sbar mthil tsam gcig la drod tsha ring nge ba/ me bzhin du 'od dmar lam lam 'dug rta mgrin 'di kun mkhyen wo po nyid mar+sā par 'dug rnal 'byor pa de'i gsung nas 'di lung pa 'di'i rten gtso 'di yin/ rab gnas kyang ngas byas pa yin/ dang po sku gzugs thams cad thugs ka'i 'di 'dra ba zhig yod pa yin phyis lta grub kyi skyon 'gas 'di ltar song gsung / sngon gyi byin rlabs kyi rgyun da lta de tsam gnas pa'i brda' ru go /chen po de dag rgyud gcig gsung ba de dag kho rang gi gnas tshul bsam las 'das pa dang / de skad gsung ba la'ang dgos pa gzhan rang e yod mi shes 'di skad gsung pa 'di bdag la nyams myong skye tshul lung bstan par 'dug dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad yong la khad la phyir log kyang des sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dpal sgam po ba'i chos kyis rtogs pa mkha' ltar khyab/ de kas rgyud smin nas phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba 'di la lta bar 'dug go /'dir smras pa/ dkar nag las kyi ri mo tshor ba bkra /legs par smon lam phyag rgyas btab pa'ang de/ /blo ldan de ltar shes nas nam du yang / /zhing sbyong ba la nan tan 'bad par mdzod/ /de nas bde mchog rtse'i rten bzhengs kyi rab gnas la 'bod mi nan can yod pa ltar phyin zhag brgyad tsam sdod dgos byung / rab gnas kyi cho ga'ang bod kyi phyag len la rgya gar ba'i phyag len gyis brgyan te gnyis car tshang bar byas/ dngos gzhi'i nub mo rmi lam du gdams ngag rmi lam ma de byung / de grol —119—

nas sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje rdo rings pa chen po'i dngul gdung gi rab gnas la gting skyes la 'gro dgos skabs/ bde gling du dbang chos thor bu 'dra byas/ yang mas te 'gor med bkra shis rtser sleb/ de'i sang nyin mkhar chen du sleb pa'i gnangs nyin nas/ dngul gdung rin po che'i rten sgrig gi 'go brtsams/ skye tshang du bzhugs rgyu'i sku 'dra rin po che la thog mar rab gnas shig byas/ de nas dngul gdung rin po che byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od mkha' mthar chags pa la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye ste/cho ga shin tu rgyas pa'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa phul/ rab gnas kyi dga' ston dang yon rdzogs sogs bzang la gya nom pa byung / gam pa rdzong nas 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar khor tsam phyin/ dge grong du phyin khrom dbang zhig bskur/ slar gting skyes su yongs dus/ drung chen sangs snying pa ni thegs 'dug 'di skabs bde mchog bong zhal can dang sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang bskur sogs dbang chos kyang ci rigs par bsgrubs/ de nas myur bar bskyod de/ tshur lam dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas mjal zhib mo byas/ zhabs drung rgyan la mjal kha cig zhus te gu dog mdzad nas mjal ma byung / de rjes gdong dga' brgyud lha rtse'i dgon pa bde chen du khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ myur stabs ri khrod chen po jo nang du sleb/ de nyin tshes lnga yin zhing tshes bcu bzhi la dus khrid tshugs par byas/ de lo khrid yig sogs ma rgyab pas khrid gsar pa mang po ma byung / khrid lo ni shin tu legs de khrid ma thebs pa gcig —120—

kyang med/ hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu dgu la khrid gtor byas/ thog mar dge ba'i khrid ngo sprod dang bcas pa rgyas par bshad/ khrid gtor gyi skabs bzo bo'i rgyab la yod pa'i smon 'gro ba'i nang bzan 'ga' res drag chas sprad pa'i 'khrug pa slong pa'i rtsis 'dra byas na'ang / kha rog bsdad pas zar zir med tsam byung / 'di skabs rje drung rin po che'i sku gdung yang chos grwar bzhugs pa gling gi rdo sper spyan 'dren byas/ de nas smon 'gror gdan drangs/ de la kyal ka mang po byung ba'i lo rgyus yod/ gser 'bum yang gzungs bzhugs sogs med pa'i stong par bzhag rten khog stong bzhengs pa'i rten 'brel gyis smon 'gro ba rang la mi shis pa brgyud mar byung / de nas hor zla gnyis pa'i 'gol lung nag shel dkar brgyud lhun rtser phyin zla phyed skor zhig bsdad/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma sogs dbang bka' rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba tsam byas/dpon rigs so so'i 'dod chos than thun zhu bar yang mang bar byung / sde pa sku mched la mgon po'i rjes gnang zhig phul ba shin tu zil che ba'i thugs kyi snang ba cher 'gyur ba zhig byung / de skabs byin rlabs yin khungs byas te/ yin ni 'tshub ka yin par 'dug rgyal bu na phra mo la tshe dbang sogs mang po phul/ sde pa sku bgres pa'i drung dang yon mchod lhan du khrod phu'i gnas rnams mjal/'ja' sprin ya mtshan can mang po byung zhing / byams chen la gsol ba btab pas me tog gi char yang rdzun med du babs/ sang nyin o rgyan rdzong du slob dpon sa'i drung gi dgongs bzhed ltar tshe dbang brgya tshar dang ni gu bsdus pa zhig phul/ bsam 'grub rtse nas 'byor rgyas pa 'bod mir gnang byung ba bzhin —121—

bsam rtser sleb pa'i nyin khyud rtse phyag tu 'byor pa'i spyan 'dren pa rnams sleb pa'i thugs brel gda'/ dgongs bzhed ltar zhal ngo thams cad la tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul/ kun spangs drung snga sor 'khrug sbrul rta gsum lug gi stong tshun gyes dgyes mdzad nga zhig yod kyang / bar der smon 'gro nas rgyug rag btang /rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub kyi 'bral spang bde dgyes legs legs mo rgya gar ma'i khungs gnyis dang po chos lung byang rtse'i rten gral na yod pa brkus nas smos 'gror yod pa de tsho dang / nor sna bzang la mang ba kun spangs drung la phul/ rdzi lung zhi ba'i zhor la zhu log mang po bcug 'dug pas/ kun spangs pa thugs 'gyu/ra ba zhig 'dug nged kyi bsam pa la ni e e bsam pa las ma byung / sku 'bring bas zhug bcu skor sdod gsung ba ltar bsdad/ rgyal rtse bla ma'i drung la dgongs bzhed kyi bka' chos 'dra phul/ zur rba khang slob dpon pa chos rje bsod nams dar rgyas ched btang nged 'phrad pa la phebs/ sngar phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i gdams pa zhig khong la bshad pa de la nyams len mdzad pa'i gsal snang 'dra shar 'dug khong da res min pa mi 'phrad gsung gin 'dug pa de kha bzhin byung / byang chen du smyung gnas dang sgrub sde rnams la ma hā mā ya'i dbang bskur dang 'khrid tshul than thun 'dra bshad/ dang po bsnyen rdzogs byas pa nas 'di yan chad du gsang 'dus 'phags zhabs lugs gnyis kyi gzhung bzang la mang ba rnams dang / gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs sogs dang / gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/ sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci —122—

rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / 'phreng ba skor gsum sogs dang / rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang / bslab btus dang byang sa la sogs gzhung chen mang po la yang 'dris par sbyangs pas rang re'i thos bsam dag dpe lta kho na la brten pa'i blo gros kyi lus phal cher rdzogs song / bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs dang nyams myong rgyu mtshan du byas pa'i legs bshad dang nges gsang gi blo gros ni phyis rgyal ba rang shin tu mang bar yod do/ /de skabs slob dpon rin po che'i drung cung zad sku khams bsnyel ba zhig byung / bsam sdings su phebs bzhed che bar 'dug pas chas de phar lam tshong 'dus su rab gnas shig byas pa bkra mi legs pa rang byung / de 'phral bsam gtan sdings su phebs/ de mcha mis nas sku khams je long du song sman dpyad kun yang cung zad log pa'i zla ba gnyis tsam gyi bar du shin tu nyen pa byung / sleb 'phral nas mtshams dam par bcad/ dgongs re bzhin sku rim du dmigs pa'i drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa gtor ma'i cho ga rnam grangs mang tsam btang de min dge sbyor rang la 'bungs bskyed/ tho rangs snga mo nas sngon 'gro gtor ma sngon du 'gro ba'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rim nyin thun bzhi po gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar 'dor len du bsgrubs shing / bzlas brjod la shin tu 'grus par byas/ srod thun la lag mchod dang / phyi rol mchod pa rgyas pa re gtor ma'i sngon du ma chag pa dang /nang phyed du nye ba na bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor dang / dpyid thig bsgom pas 'da' bar byas/ zla ba phyed gnyis tsam gyi mtshams su tshong 'dus nas sde pa —123—

lhun chen sku gshegs pa'i stabs dgongs rdzogs kyi snying po dang / mtshan byang bzhu ba la 'gro dgos kyis mtshams seng pa dang 'gro ba mnyam du byas shing dbu rtser 6ga gcig sdod dgos byung / sang dgongs ka mtshams bsdams/ slar yang sngar gyi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la zhugs/ de'i snga gong lha'i gsal snang dang bde stong gi nyams mang po 'char ba zhig yod pa zla phyed tsam gyi bar du sor ma chud/ de nas drung 'tsho ba sa lung pas slob dpon rin po cher gsol sman sogs phul ba 'phrod rten gyi ngo che bar byung zhing / nged rang bad mkhris kyi zhag shas gyong nge ba na ba zhig la nad 'don gyi dmigs pa dang rlung sbyor 'phran bu byas pas snga gro zhig dud khu 'dra ba sla nga do tsam skyugs/ de gong bad mkhris mtho mo de lo shas bde bar byung / des na man ngag khungs ma'i gegs sel thams cad des mtshon par go dgos/ rim pa de nyid kyi hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga yan chod du dpal sdom pa pū dril nag gsum car gyi bsnyen pa yid rnam g.yengs kho na'i dbang du ma song tsam du grub/ gsum car gyi rdzogs rim la yang so sor myong ba cung zad thon/ yang 'di skabs nas tshigs grum la brten rkang pa shin tu na ba zhig rgyun chags rang du byung / zla ba de nyid kyi nyer gcig la rgya gar shar phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon ni khyu ṇa shrī yang phebs byung zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bzhugs shing / sngar grub chen lho phyogs pa la legs par mnos pa'i gdams pa dang bshad pa'i 'phro rnams la shin tu phan thogs che bar byung / 'di skabs zam brag nas sde pa ka bzhi'i drung gis rab gnas la yong dgos tshul gnang byung na'ang / slob dpon rin po che sku khams —124—

yid brtan thub pa mi 'dug pa dang dgongs pa'ang ma grol ba'i stabs nas 'gro ma thub/ des khong tsho dang sde pa kun spangs drung yang shin tu ma dgyes te thabs kyang ma byung mod/ nged la khyad kyang ma mchis la khong tsho la snying po yang ci yod/phaṭa/ brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga man nas 'tshams ma grol gyi bar du rje btsun ma zhal gnyis ma la bsnyen pa byas shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags mtshan yang ci rigs pa byung / nyin mtshan du dge sbyor 'phel bar byas pa'i phan yon gyis gnyid kyi skabs su yang dran pas zin cing rtags snang mang po shin tu gsal bar 'char ba dang rmi lam mi zin pa mi srid pa lta bur song lha sku'i sbyong spel gyi rtsal shin tu che bar byung / lkog gyur yul snang than thun gtan la phebs pa dang rmi lam gyi dus thams cad du bzlas brjod kyi snang ba rgyun mi 'chad bar 'byung ba dang nyin par lha sku drag tu bsgoms pa'i shugs kyis mi rtog pa gsal stong la cham cham 'gro zhing / res 'ga' gzhan gyi sems shes pa snyam byed pa la so sor bsgrims te bltas pa'i tshe du bas gzugs bsgribs pa bzhin mun mun 'gro ba zhig byung / phyis bla ma dam pa la zhus pas g.yin sems shes pa snyam byed pa la ci dgar bskyur na yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro ba la ched 'dzin byas pa des bsgribs pa yin gsung / spyir nas dbang shes bde stong du gnas ma gyur gyi bar du dngos gnas ji lta ba bzhin du shes dka' zhing / nang gi rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi byed pa la brten te nyams kyi tshul du skye ba dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha lta bur snang ba ngo bo nyams snang du shar ba rnams kyis ci rigs pa ston pa yong bar snang ste dngos gnas yin pa dka'o/ /'di —125—

skabs phyin chad nas dben par mtshams bcad de 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgom bzlas la zhugs pa'i tshe rmi lam du sa gsum gyi pho nya'i rnam pas khyab pa dang bde stong gi nyams gzhig par dka' ba rtag tu yod snang / 'on kyang phyis chos sna tshogs gzhan la smra dgos 'di dang / dam sel gyi grib mas non pas gong 'phel du 'gro ba ni med do/ /de nas slob dpon dam pa re zhig sku khams bde ba'i rnam pa byung / sngar sor nas so sos 'bod mi nan chags yod pa ltar hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du bsam sdings nas btegs khyung rtser zhag gcig bsdad/ de'i sang nyin yol mo sprul sku'i drung dang mjal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig dgos gsung pa ltar phul zhing / nged la shin tu thugs mos stobs su gyur pa'i zhabs dbang dgos phebs smon lam mang po 'debs pa gnang gin 'dugagasung las bdag tsho lus kyang bde mo mi 'dug pas gson gshin ji ltar byung yang thugs dam skyabs 'og tu 'jug dgos so gsung ngo / /'dol byung du dbang chos rang mi rang las byas/ rje rgyud pa ba sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yang nged 'phrad par phebs byung / dgongs bzhed ltar rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi rjes gnang kyang phul/ sngags phyogs kyi gsung gleng shin tu 'phel ba byung /shin tu dgyes shing thugs dang ba dpe med mdzad kyin 'dug de nas stag rtser kun ra bas mthun rkyen bzang po sbyar/ de nas rgyal mkhar rtser zla gcig lhag tsam li ma lha khang gi mdo'i g.yabs khra der sdod yul byas/ rten bzang ba sogs kyis yin nam rig pa dwangs shing rmi lam bzang ba sha stag byung / rwa lo chen po'i thugs dam rten yin nges dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi thang sku de sngas —126—

'gor bkram te srod tho rangs bzlas sgom dang gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ lan cig rang nyid 'jigs mdzad kyi sku nyang stod kyi lung pa de yang zhabs gcig gis khengs pa tsam gyi sku tshad shin tu che ba zhig tu gyur te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po mthong ba snyam byed pa zhig byung / bdag po chen pos snga sor sku la yang yang phan pa'i drin bsob tu 'bring mtshams dge grong phyed ka dang / mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i drung gis bsam sdings kyi sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs kyi thes su dpal be lha lung gi chos gzhis gnang / 'di skabs don gnyer so so la/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad smar ma sogs kyi lung dang /grub chen dza lan+ta ra ba'i do ha'i man ngag dang bshad pa/ de nyid bdud 'grel gyi bshad pa/ dmar po skor gsum gyi man ngag yongs rdzogs kyi lung / grub pa sde bdun dang / snying po skor drug gi lung / bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang cha gnyis bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang / thod pa nyer lnga ma'i dbang /gshed dmar gyi 'od gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs/ ni gu chos drug dril bu rim lnga/ gshed dmar spros med sogs chos shin tu 'phel bar byung / bha ṅga la'i paṇ+ḍi ta ga rdo nan+da te gang ba kun dga' dang / pra ya mā nan+da te byams pa kun dga' gnyis kyang byon byung ba nged kyis chos kyi gsung gleng mang du byas pas khong gnyis shin tu dgyes/ ngas kyang paṇ+ḍi ta rdzi yin tshul rgya cher bsgrags/ khong tsho mar lam paṇ+ḍi ta yin pa sus kyang ma shes/ khong rang tshos yin gsungs kyang rtsis gdab ma byas 'dug na'ang / phyis song dus de skabs ka paṇ+ḍi ta yin par yang shes/ thugs dam 'di la byed ces sogs gnang chung de 'dra la yang cha —127—

med rgyus gtam gyi chos brgyad mdzad mkhan yang snang ngo / /mar lam rtse chen du zhag gsum bsdad/ chos sde'i slob dpon so sor 'dod chos than thun dang /rtse'i lha khang du logs bris zhig gsos dang gsung rab rnams la rab gnas rgyas pa zhig kyang byas/ slar bsam sdings su sleb/ de'i sang dgongs nyid nas mtshams bsdams/ bde mchog gi bsnyen pa kha gso zhag bdun pa zhig byas nas/ yab bka' yum bka' gnyis 'dus kyi spyin bsreg zhag bcu gsum tsam byas shing grangs kyang thim/ de mtshams nas thab kyang kha bsgyur te sdig sgrib sbyang bar rang la dmigs rang gi skra bregs pa'i bubs sum cu tsam yod pa thams cad spyin bsreg gi tshul du bsregs/ 'di skabs 'char sgo ngo mtshar che ba rang zhig byung / de rjes dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa'i thun che ba re 'chag med du byas shing / lhag ma gshin rje gshed dmar po'i bzlas brjod dang / srung ma'i dbang po 'ga' zhig gi bsnyen pa byas/ rgya gar nub phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon chen po puṇ+ḍa badz+ra ba dpon slob kyang phebs byung ba la yang 'phral zhabs 'degs gang drag byas chos kyi 'phros mang du zhus/ sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad nas bcu'i bar du 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas de nyin re la thun re bris pas legs par grub/ rang la blo brtad pa'i gshin po 'ga' zhig gi rjes sgrub dang dus mtshungs byung bas yan lag bdun pa'i smon lam rnams de dag la dmigs pa gtso che bas btab/ 'di'i tshes bcu'am dgu la yol mo sprul sku yang gshegs/ sngags kyi mngon par ming btags pa'i rtsom pa de yang byas/—128—

'phags yul mkhas grub kyi thugs bcud phyogs 'dir nged rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i legs bshad nges don gyi gsang tshig 'gos che ba brtsams pa'i thog ma yin/ de nas mi ring bar zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i sprul sku yang pa rnam du phebs/ de'i gnangs nyin sde pa ka bzhi'i drung yang bsam sdings su 'phrad pa la phebs/ rje zhwa dmar ba mjal bar phyin dus dpe med kyi bsti stang gnang /rdo rje'i bsung brgya lnga bcu pa'i lung zhig dang / sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid yig chos rje rang byung bas mdzad pa de'i lung dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor kun 'dus nor bu lugs shig dang / phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid yig bsdus pa rje dkon mchog yan lag gis mdzad pa'i lung zhig kyang thob/ de 'phral rgyal rtser dpon sa mnga' bdag drung gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi cho ga la yod dgos kyi 'bod mi byung bas/ de nub bsam sdings su sleb tsam byas/ sang snga bar shad nas phyin nas dgongs ja thog tu rgyal rtser sleb/ de nas dgongs rdzogs ma grol gyi bar sbur gyi rtsar mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga tshar bzhi bzhi bdag mdun bum bskyed rnams la bzlas pa brgya tshar re dang thun tha ma la lho sgo 'chag med re byas/ dpon sa yul de nyid rje dam pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i gdung shugs gang dang yang mi mnyam pa dngos la'ang shin tu thugs brtad pa cig yin pa nas dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i chos sder sman bla chen mo'i lugs kyi nyin thub kyi rnyed bkur zhig dang / dge 'dun rnams kyi phyag tu khal re thob pa'i rtsis kyi 'gyed dang / sman bla phyed langs kyi dbang du byas pa'i rnyed bkur dang 'gyed sogs btang zhing / dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi grol mtshams nyi —129—

phyed cam la thon par byas te/ sang nyin bsam sdings su sleb par byas/ yol mo sprul sku rin po che gshegs khar zhal chems su dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i gral dbu nged la chos gsung ba yod 'dug pa ltar khong rnams kyis snga sor nas yong dgos tshul yod pa bzhin de'i sang nyin skyid sbug tu sleb/ phyi na gur rgyab 'dug pas de khar cho ga btang nyi ma phyed yol tsam la rnal 'byor pa shas che ba'i dgon sna mang po nas 'dus pa'i tshogs pa lnga brgya tsam la dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi bzab ma byung / gral 'go la nged kyis phyin/ sang nyin chos rje gdan sa pa sogs la shis brjod dang tshe dbang sogs byas nyi phyed tsam la yongs/ pa rnam zhol du gser mdog can nas mkhan slob tshos gnas tshang du gsol ja la shog gsung pa ltar phyin/ gsung rab kyi gling slang dang bzhad gad 'dres mas nyams dga' bar byung / de nub rang gnas su sleb zhag nyi shu skor phyi mtshams se byas shing / snga gong stag lung nas skyabs gnas dam pa'i bka' las/ 'phags yul nas byung ba'i chos gsar pa 'di rnams rgya gzhung kun lag tu longs dka' bar 'dug pas thams cad la yig cha gsal ba re byed dgos bka' stsal ba ltar 'phral du byed 'dod tsam yod na'ang le los rgyu byas brel ba dang kha 'don sogs kyi stabs nas cher ma grub/ yos lo'i nang du dran bskul gyi phyir sa bcad tsam re bris/ skabs 'dir dza lan+ta ra'i sgrub thabs ltar gyi phag mo las bdun/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rngon pa'i gdams ngagarnal 'byor ma sna tshogs mdog can rnams kyi sgrub skor dang / do ha rnam grol snye ma'i khrid yig sogs man ngag gi yi ge drug tsam bris shing / de nas mtshams —130—

bkros te tshor 'dus su sleb tsam byas dgongs bzhed kyi chos than thun phul/sde pa rgyal bu sku bgres pa'i dgongs bzhed ltar phyag drug pa'i gtor chog snga ma de brtsams/ dza lan+ta ra'i do he'i khyi ka rtsom pa'i 'go yang btsugs shing / de nas snar thang du gtsug lag khang gi rten rnams la phyag mchod rgyas par phul/'di skabs skor du sde pa snar thang nas dang mthong legs pa khong rang dpon g.yog 'phrogs pa/ khong dpon g.yog gnyis thad nas/ nged la thugs rtog zos pa'i gsung 'byon pa zhig 'dug spyi babs ni rang gis bzang ma btang ba'i gnod pa yang yin srid pa dang / khyad par lung bstan sad sud la thugs brtad rang 'cha' ba zhig 'dug pas de ltar yin nam cha ma mchis/ gang ltar na'ang thugs rab che shos dang thugs dran gsal shos dang thugs chod che shos dang lung bstan mdzad pa po rnams kyi rang 'tshang ston byed tsam du gda'o/ /gnas srin po rir shog gsung ba ltar zhag gsum tsam bsdad cing / dgongs bzhed ltar gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur zhig byas lung nag shel dkar du yang gnas bcu'i thang ka gsar bzhengs la rab gnas byas pa bkra lod pa rang zhig byung bas de rjes lo de ka'i nang du shel dkar gyi gdong de la 'gro dgos lan gnyis byung na'ang khong tshol gsangs nas phyin/ de nas jo nang du sleb gtsang bde mchog rtse la 'bod mi nan can byung ba bzhin phyin/'di skabs 'du khang gi logs bris skyes rabs brgya rtsa dang gtsang khang gi logs bris dang lam 'bras bla brgyud kyang gcig gnyis ma gtogs phal cher grub 'dug pa bzhin rab gnas rgyas par byas/ rten rnams snum zhing bkrag che —131—

bar 'gro ba sogs thun mong spyi mthun du byin rlabs kyi ltas mngon tsam byung /dgon pa ba rnams la kyai rdor gyi dbang bskur zhig dang / sngar lam 'bras zhu myong ba'i grwa pa 'ga' zhig la lam dbang zhig kyang byas/ slar jo nang du dus 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skabs su byung ba rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i steng de nyid nas sgrub sde gang yod kyi steng du rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis pa dpon slob sogs ci rigs dang bcas pa yongs sgril bdun brgya tsam la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bcu gcig yongs rdzogs su bskur/ dza lan+ta ra pa'i do he'i 'grel pa yang 'di skabs su bkod grub/ sangs rgyas byang chung sems dang rdo rje ma/ /skad cig de la nam mkha' gang bar snang / /zhes pa'i tshig gi 'grel pa rtsom skabs/ nyin mo gnyid yur du song ba'i rmi lam na gzhung don dang mthun pa'i rmi lam gyi ltas nam mkha'i lha las dbang bskur blang ba'i gsal snang dang bcas pa byung zhing / gdong dga' ba sku gzhon pa tshe brtan lags khong rang tsho la shin tu gces pa yin pa/ nged la'ang snying nas dad pa yod nges de ngam rings du 'das pa'i bsngo rten yang 'di skabs byung / slar yang de mtshams slob dpon rin po che'i drung du/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang la sogs pa chos 'ga' zhig zhu bar myur shad phyin/ bo dong bkra shis sgang gi thad der gdong dga' nas tshe dbang bskur ba la yong dgos tshul 'bod mi nan can dpe med rang byung na'ang da res yong mi thub/ zla ba gnyis tsam gyi khongs su yong gang thub byed byas thag bcad nas phyin/ byang chen du sleb dus paṇ+ḍi ta sdi rla nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis po'ang lha sa sogs dbus phyogs rnams 'khor ba'i nged —132—

la ched kyis 'phrad par byon/ de dag grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bar 'dug cing phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos than thun 'dra bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srungs ma ha nu ma ba'i cho 'phrul lus byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang bha ra ta'i srungs ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsung na'ang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pa ga la zhigaphyis kyi bla chen mang po'i 'dod bya chen po zhig de dus rang rtsol med du 'grub la khad byung na'ang rnal 'byor ba bdag gis ci dgar bor ba lags so/ /zhag bcu tsam nyid dang mtshan du gleng slang byung / de rjes bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa dang dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur ba zhus/ 'dol byung du khor tsam zhig phyin/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyang spyan drangs te/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil la sogs pa'i dbang bskur mang po zhus shing / de mtshams rgyal rtser zhag gsum tsam zhig phyin/ yar lam mar lam gnyis car —133—

tal snyogs byas/ bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi drung du slar yang lha hi pa dang / 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang de zhus/ de mtshams shangs nas 'jag pa rnams kyis 'bod mi nan can byung bar brten shangs su phyin dus gar phyin phyin du yul mi thams cad la tshe dbang dang ma ṇi'i lung tsam gyi chos 'brel byas/ rnam rgyal gling du zhag gsum tsam bsdad grwa tshang chen mor mang ja'i rgyur ja sigs gcig phul/gzhan gnang sbyin dgos na bla chen 'ber mo tsho la zhus shig bya btang la rgyu nor gyi re ma che/ yar lam zhong zhong gi gnas mjal tsam byas te/ de nub sgrub gnas chen po 'jag tu sleb/ sang nyin grwa tshang chen mo'i slob dpon pa rin po che tshul khrims pa sogs shangs kyi dgon so so nas chos zhu ba mang bar sleb pa'i gnangs nyin de ka nas shangs chos rgyas pa'i 'go btsugs te/ phyi'i chos grwar khrid kyi chos thun gnyis gnyis mgon po'i bka' rnams ma gtogs gzhung bka' nyi shu po yang chos grwa de nyid du bgyis shing lung yang phal che ba de kar song / chos kyi rnam grangs gzhan thams cad bla brang du byas shing nam langs ma thag nas srod chil gyi bar du chos kyis 'da' bar byas/ gnas der rig pa dwangs po nyin mo'i bya bas dub pa'i rnam pa med pa'i nub mo kha 'don dge sbyor shin tu smar ba dang gnyid cung zad re byung ba la yang rmi lam ya mtshan can kho nas dus 'da' bar byung / tshogs pa rnams la tshe dbang zhig byas pa la ched kyis brda' btang ba sogs med kyang mda' nas mi nag pa stong bud tsam tshogs mi tshogs che zhing dad pa'ang che bar 'dug pas byang chub kyi sa bon thebs su re ba'i tshe dbang gi sngon du sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas pa zhig byas/ grub chen khyung —134—

po rnal 'byor gyi yin thang zhal phye ba'i dus su 'ja' sprin gyi bkod pa sna tshogs las me tog gi char 'bab pa byung / de mtshams dgra 'dul nas kyang 'bod mi nan can dang / brgya tsho nas kyang cog po rtse tsam du cis kyang yod dgos shing /zhal ngo rnams kyang cog po rtser phebs gsung ba sogs byung kyang / gdong dga' nas 'phral du yong dgos pa'i 'bod mi nan ches pa dang / de skabs gdong dga' ba'i gnas gshis kyis 'dod dang ma bstun kyang ma byung ba'i stabs nas de tshor 'gro ma thub cing cog po rtse grub chen khyung po'i gnas chen yin pa la mjal yang ma thub/ spyir yang yon bdag gi ngos 'dzin 'di bar chad shin tu che bar yong gin gda'o/ khong lam du zhag gnyis bsdad shin tu 'tshub pa rang zhig byung ba khong tsho'i nad so grag shos de lo 'das/ g.yang gi chos sder sde pa chos rje'i sras po sku 'bring ba smo smo drung dang bcas pas sna len bzang po dpe med mdzad cing / chos than thun 'dra phul/ de nas o rgyan rdzong du dpon sa'i drung gi dgongs bzhed bzhin smar khrid kyi snying po bsdus pa zhig dang tshe dbang sogs phul te/ ra sa brgyud nas gdong dgar sleb/ theg bcu gsum tsam bsdad pa'i ring la kyai rdor gyi dbang sogs dbang dang dmar po skor gsum la sogs pa rjes gnang zur bka' mang po dang / yul gang du'ang mi bcu pa yar klungs su bcu'i rnam pas tshe dbang stong rtsa rang byed dgos byung / ri khrod chen po jo nang du sleb 'phral nas dus khrid sngar khyud kyi phyag len ltar btsugs/ de la'ang dus khrid 'dzugs 'phyis pas khrid gsar ba ha cang mang ba rang ni ma byung / sgrub ste rang la khrid shin tu smin pa bar du dge ba'i khrid yan chad rdzogs —135—

par byas shing nges don rgya mtsho bshad/ kun dga' dpal bzang yang 'di skabs zla bo la sleb pa yin/ skabs der 'tsher du mjal bar khor tsam phyin/gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang zur bka' zhig zhus pas rdo rje 'phreng ba'i de ka byung / slar jo nang du chos lung byang rtse'i sgrub sde pa rnams chos zhu bar byung ba nyer mkhe'i kyai rdo rje/ mi 'khrugs pa/ bde mchog nag po pa bde mchog lha lnga/ 'jigs byed rnams kyi dbang dang rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs sogs byas so/ /'dir smas pa/ tha snyad ngan g.yo'i zlos gar de yis ci/ /nges don sbrang rtsi 'thung ba 'di nyid mchog /dus ni mi brtan lang tsho yol pa dang / mi rtag don sems yang dag don la gzhol/de mtshams rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mjal bar 'dod pas bshul lam du zhugs te bde chen gdong dga' sogs brgyud nas bde skyid gling du sleb/ nyi shar du sde pa brtan pa lags yum sras gnyis car sman pas dpyad phul ba ma 'phrod pa'i stabs gcig tu gshe/gas pa nas/ sde pa rje drung kun dga' bsod nams drung gis nged la yong dgos tshul nan chags gnang ba la mi yong bar thag chod zhus na'ang / slar yang nan chags yod skabs rje drung la mnga' zhabs dang / chos sde yul log byas/ brag stod nas bla ma rin po ches/ yum sras sku gshegs pa gnyis kyi sbur bzhu byang bzhu nang skabs kyi zhabs tog dang dgongs rdzogs dang yon sogs kyang nyi shar slob dpon ba dang / mi sna 'dus pas byed pa las/ rje drung rang la rang dbang thob —136—
