pa gcig kyang med par ma zad dam 'jur che bar byas 'dug bla ma dam pa'i phyag dam na shel dkar phyogs la song na legs pa 'dug cing brag stod du rtse 'dzom tsam gnang phebs pa ltar phar lam chu tshan khar zhugs gsum tsam chu tshan cung zad bsten pas de skabs kyi de mgo srin dang chu ser la phan par byung /shel dkar du sleb dus der rdzong gzhis dang chos sde sogs phal cher gogs ༷ shing dengs pa'i rnam pa can du 'dug pa mthong ba'i rkyen gyis skyo shas drag tu skye ba byung / rtsibs ri rgod tshang mjal rje rgod kyi zhe bcad dang sgrub tshugs kyi rnam thar la 'jug par smon lam snying thag pa nas btab/ der bzhugs kyi dpon slob rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig chos 'brel du byas/ brag stod rdo rje'i pho brang du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du 'byor/ dpon slob rnams kyang de ka'i khar nyin ka phebs pa yin/ sku mthong ba'i mod la sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i rig pa rjen gyis song / mtshan zangs kyi phyi'i snang ba ban bun tsam la rig pa yer gyis thon pa bde sdug las 'das pa zhig byung / skabs 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa dang po'i 'char sgo sbyor rgyu yin/ 'di skabs bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du 'khrid tshul man ngag sgrub thabs sogs rnam grangs mang ba zhig don gnyer gyis zhus shing gnang / gsar du bsgyur ba'i dbang byin rlabs rnams dgos phebs pa ltar phul/ bka' stsal spyi bor nod de sgrub sde rnams la rtsa dbu ma'i khrid byin rlabs ngo sprod dang bcas pa dang / nag po pa'i bskyed rdzogs gyi khrid rnams zhib par bshad/ de mtshams spa lung du phyin zhag gnyis tsam bsdad/ spa lung chos rje ngag dbang pa dang lhan du lus kyi phu'i la la thon nas —137—

glang skor du sku gdung dkar ru dang dam pa'i sku 'dra mtshal zhal ma/ ko brag pa'i sku 'dra phyag gnas ma sogs rten mjal thams cad zhib par bgyis/ rten rnams la dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod pa bzang rab phul zhing / sku gdung dkar ru la mthong snang mang du byung / de nub rmi lam du grub thob bcu drug dang mkhas mchog bcu drug gi sku'i snang ba dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i ltas byung nas gsol 'debs kyang brtsams/ 'di byin rlabs sna bsdus 'jug tshul gcig yin pa 'dug rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas rang gis grub thob pho mo lnga bcu sogs mang po rang cig mjal 'dug pa de'i rten 'brel cig yin pa 'dra'o/ /zhing rings su phyin yul pa de la gdon gyi bar chad kyi 'tshub chen po 'dug rig pa 'ur nas khrom mi thams cad brdungs gshis ngan pa'i grags pas khyab/ 'on kyang yul pa de tsho rang gi chags sgo sangs par mngon/ sa skya yul chung spe leb ra chu rnams su so so'i 'dod pa ltar yig drug dang tshe dbang gtso bor gyur pa'i chos 'brel thogs par byas/ slar yang spa lung du bde mchog gi dbang dang /nai gu'i dmigs 'doms dang / rjes gnang 'ga' shas dang khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la brag stod du sleb/ sprul sku sman thang pas ngam ring du snyan 'bul la brten te dpon sa mnga' bdag drung nas bka' tho nan can chos lung gi mi sna dang bcas pa 'bod mir 'byor/ zla ba 'di'i nang du drung chen grags pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang zhig byas pa sgrub sde pa thams cad kyis kyang gsan/ bla ma dam pas dgyes pa rdo rje la brten nas dam rdzas sgrub pa'i phyag g.yog de bgyis shing / 'di skabs kyang dri bzang thag ring du —138—

tshor ba dang rdzas la sgra dang bcas te khol ba ltar gyur pa la dngos su bdud rtsi babs pa'i rnam pa ya mtshan can byung / rjes gnang byin rlabs 'dra zhu yin yod pa'i skabs su/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas/ da dung sems khrid la bskyar ma zhig byas na mi legs sam phebs byung bas de ma thag blo dang snang ba 'gyur nas lus nyams rkyen gang gis kyang mi non pa 'dra ba dang / sems la ngos gzung med pa mchi ma rang dbang med par 'byung zhing / rgod pa la sogs pa'i ngag nyams sna tshogs shar/ de nub nyid kyang med cing gnam sa gang yin yang btang med du song / ngam ring la 'gro ba'i blo yang bzlog de mtshams rang bsam sdings nas slob dpon rin po che'i phyag dam gnang ba'i nang na yang thugs dam lhas dang de min yang bslab ston zhib rgyas bcas 'byor pa'ang rang gi blo de dang mthun par byung / mtshams mu nas dge sbyor la rtsol ba gang che bcug khrid tshul gang de ba de ma yin par tshig spyi dang yig spyi la ma bltos pa'i don brgyud 'jug tshugs su ston pas gang la gang 'dul du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zhes pa de nyid mngon sum du ston par mdzad de/ res 'ga' nyi ma gcig la yang rim pa na 'phar ba'i sgom kha lta phyogs bcu bcu tsam spro ba dang res 'ga' zhag bdun brgyad du yang gcig la 'jog pa sogs mngon sum lam byed kyi bka' drin stsal/ 'di skabs zab mo'i gnad kyi go ba sngar ma rtogs pa mang po 'di cug yin pa 'dra 'di ltar yin pa 'dug snyam pa chu drag tu khol ba'i lbu ba lta bur shar/ lta ba dang grub mtha' tha dad dang brjod tshul sna tshogs pa dag la zhen pa zhig cing 'gal 'dus skyon med kyi rnam par go /de sngon dang mi 'dra ba'i yid —139—

ches kyi gdeng ya mtshan can brjod mi shes pa zhig byung / 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa gnyis pa sbyar ro/ /bla ma'i zhal nas las rlud du snang ba'i 'khrul ba ma 'gags na 'gyur med kyi gnas la reg pa med pa'i nges tshig zab mo bstsal pa ltar/ chos kyi dbyings zab mo rtogs pa yang thabs kyis rtogs pa'o zhes nges pa brnyed/ de kho na nyid mchog thob nas nyin mtshan chad pa med pa rlung shi med go med du bkag cing / phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings la mnyam par bzhag pa na/rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar 'gyur ba med pa la ye shes zla ba yar ngo bzhin 'char bar snang ngo / /'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa gsum sbyar ro/ /bar der gegs kyi rnam pa rigs mi gcig pa lnga tsam byung ba don du ni gegs ma yin te/dmigs pa'i sgyur ka bstsal gdams pa gnang ba ltar bsgoms pas de nyid yon to du gyur to/ /'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bzhi pa sbyar ro/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang gong ma dang / dgyes pa rdo rje rngog lugs kyi dbang bskur ba bstsal bas dbang pa re re las ye shes 'bar ba re re byung zhing / khyad par he badz+ra dbang gi nub 'od gsal dang rmi lam 'dres pa'i snang ba ngo mtshar can mang du byung ngo / /'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa lnga pa sbyar ro/ /de nas ston dus sa ring nus 'bod mi gzi 'bar ba gnang byung zhing / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bka' lung gi khur yang blangs te sku gzhogs nas phyir 'ongs skabs/ gdan bzhugs phul ba'i thog tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bka' drin rjes dran gyi yon dbul ba mtshone byed dang bcas zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba btang/ de nas rgyan bu shel dkar dang bde gling sogs su'ang phyin/ 'dar gyi lcang gseb —140—

der chos rje bsod nams chos 'phel ba dang 'dar ba'i zhal ngo rnams kyis rgyas pa spros pa mdzad/ mthar gyis ngam ring du 'byor/ 'di skabs zhug nyi shu rtsa gsum tsam bsdad cing / zhal ngo rnams su sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang / tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya tshar dang / lha dgu ma brgya tshar/ rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang dang / bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang bskur ba rnams byas/ 'di byang du chos 'brel thog ma rang yin/ bzhi sde'i dbus mdzad pa dang / ri bo che ba'i rje drung brtan pa sogs 'ga' shas la nai gu'i dbang khrid cha tshang tsam dang / gzhan yang so so'i 'dod chos than thun zhu mi mang rab byung / 'di skabs pha rat+na bha dra'i thugs sras gcig pu pa rje 'gyur med dang yang mjal/ chos kyi gsung sleng 'phel zhing dri ba che chung sna tshogs phebs kyi 'dug pa la blo tshod kyi lan re phul/ rje 'di pa la de gong sdom chen gyi dbang sogs chos zhu 'dod yod pa ni skabs der sangs song / slar yang 'di skabs chos lung byang rtse'i chos phyogs kyi khur 'khur dgos rnams byed dgos tshul phebs pas/ gtsang gzhung gi lam brgyud chos lung byung rtser sleb 'phral nas khong tsho'i mos bzhed mthar thug tu 'dug pas sgrub sde gang yod kyi steng du don gnyer ci rigs pas brgyan te grangs brgyad cu tsam la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bshad/ 'di skabs khrid rang gi ngo bo shin tu smin par song zhing / lung pod nag ma yongs su rdzogs pa zhig las gzhan ma song / chos lung rang gi nyer mkho la sgos kyin yod pa ltar bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang dang / dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang rnams byas/ don —141—

gnyer 'dra la 'jigs byed zhe dgu rma 'i dbang bskur zhig bgyis/ sman thang ba rang gi bzhed kyi mthar thug dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum rnams kyi byin rlabs dang khrid tshul gzhung drug gi lung sogs cha tshang bar bgyis/ rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i chos skor zab don bshad skabs/ rgyu rkyen gang yang med par rgyu ra'i dkyil 'khor dang nang mchod ka li mchod stegs nas 'phar nas sa la lhung dkyil 'khor la skyon ni ma byung mod cung zad gnyan char mngon pa byung sman thang pa rang yang rtog pa zos/ rang dang lhan cig gnas pa grags bzang sogs la ma hā mā ya'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad ngag nas spar zhing / mā ya nyid kyi rgya gzhung 'grel pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi bshad pa zhib mor byas/ sgrub sde la chos khrims sogs kyis do dam byed gyu'i khungs tsam byas/ de skabs kun jo nang nas rje drung rin po che'i nye gnas rje drung nyid ltogs rir gtong mkhan kun blo ba zer ba'i rgod bro ba kho pas dpon sa mnga' bdag drung ltag khur gyis bar skabs der sgrigs gshig pa'i rtsing spyod rang byed pa zhig byung / 'di skabs rmi lam du mkhan po bka' drin can stag lung rin po che de/ bud med rta ba gnyis kyis lam sna byas tsa ri la phebs rgyu yin gsung pa ltar las chibs rgyugs mdzad phebs song ba la stag lung bas phebs bskyil ra mda' 'dra rjes la yong gyu ba dang / ngas mgyogs par rgyugs pas zhabs rjes zin chibs bshor la nas bzhugs gdan la bzhugs su bcug pas/ 'o na da res thon tsam byed pa lags/ lar stag lung pa 'di kun la skyo ba skyes/ khyod kyis stag lung pa la phan 'dogs byung na gyis gsung ba zhig gsal po rmi ba las/ de 'phral brtan —142—

bzhugs 'bul mkhan brdzangs pas khong tshos sleb gong sku shin tu dub pa rang la brtan bzhugs phul 'phral rang sku khams yar so nas zhag bcu skor la sangs dwangs su byung bar gda'o/ /de rjes jo nang du de lo'i khrid dus ran du tshugs khrid gsar pa yang mang rab byung / sbyor drug gi rgya gzhung rnams dang chos rje yab sras bcu bzhi'i rnam thar sogs kyi lung bklags/ tshogs chos ma gtogs zur chos bzhin gyi brel ba med par sems kyi lta phyogs kyang smar bar byung / bogs 'byed spogs pa'i cho ga bla ma'i zhal lung nas 'byung ba 'ga' zhig nyams su blangs pas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams kyi rtsal gong nas gong du na 'phar zhing rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba la cung zad gdang shar ro/ /'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa drug pa sbyar ro/ khrid gtor gyi tshe mi mang po'i 'du long zang zing sna tshogs yod pa rnams rang sems snang stong gi rang ngo tsam du shar/ de la brten de yid ches kyis drangs pa'i dga' bde zhag bdun tsam rgyun mi 'chad par byung zhing / de nas bags kyis dbyings su zhi nas btang snyoms chen po zhig gi ngang du gyur to/ /chos lung du sleb tsam nas rgyal mkhar rtse dang gting skyes nas 'bod mi car sdod yod pa dang / khyad par rje btsun bla ma dam pa'ang gting skyes su phebs 'dug pas hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu skor la rim pas yar chas te lha rtse rdzong du 'tshom chen gyi logs bris la rab gnas zhig byas/'di skabs ri mo'i zhib cha rnams ni ma grub 'dug de nas kyang lam 'gor che se ba la gtir skyes su sleb/ dgon gsum gyi dge 'dun rnams lam 'bras shig dgos pa'i nan chags rang byung ba bzhin de'i gnangs nyin rang nas chos kyi —143—

'go btsugs shing / khrid smin rgyas dang lung gi skor ni bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar cha tshang zhig dang lam 'bras yig sna drug cu po rdzogs par bklags/ de min lung gi spros pa spangs go don bshad pa rnams kyang mtha' chod par byas/khrid zhu ba la zhal ngo rnams ma gtogs dge 'dun sha stag yin zhing sum brgya skor yor/ rgyu dbang la dbang cha bcu bdun tsam byung / sde pa'i dgongs bzhed ltar rgyud sde lnga'i dbang byas pa la dbang mi lnga bcu lhag tsam byung / zhang gi rigs kyi sngags pa bco lnga tsam dang sde pa yab sras don gnyer gzhan 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa dbang cha gcig la gshin rje gshed dgra nag zhang lugs kyi dbang bzhi drag po'i rjes gnang rgyas bsdus gnyis car dang bcas pa rdzogs par byas/ sngags pa kha cig la dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor gyi rjes gnang yang bgyis so/ /mchog gi bla ma dam pa la nyams dang myong ba/ gang yod shin tu zhib mor snyan du phul/ mdo rgyud man ngag rgya mtsho'i gnad 'dus pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa phebs pas tshig re res kyang mdud pa mang du khrol yangs ting gi song / khyad par rang nyid kyi blo'i 'char tshul las brtsams te/ gnas lugs kyi ye shes gcer mthong 'dzug tshugs su ngo sprod gnang bas ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i chos thams cad kyi don gyi brgyud pa thob/ 'di tsam nas gzung mkhas 'dod dbyings su yal/ sgra sogs phyi rol gyi rig gnas thams cad byis pa'i rtsed mo lta bur go /thar lam ston pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos wo po rnams la sngar las ches lhag pa'i mos gus skyes na'ang thos bsam gyi sred pa dang brel ba zhig byung / de ltar gang dang yang mnyam pa med pa'i bka' drin —144—

stsal te gcig chog rgyal po rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes bsam pa thag pa nas dang ba dang 'dun pa dang yid ches pa'i bdag nyid du gyur te/ 'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bdun pa sbyar ro/ /bla mas kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i mngon par dbang bskur bas dbang bskur te skabs 'dir zhal gyi gdams pa mang po zhig dang /rgyud 'bum gyi 'phros phal che ba'i lung yang les/sa par thob po/ /'dir smras pa/ gnas lugs gdong lngas khyab pa'i nags klung du/ /spros pa gnyis 'thung dbang po sder bcas bcom/ /dus gcig stong gsum bgrod pa yid mgyogs stobs/ /gcig car chos kun rig pa bla ma'i drin/ /'di skabs dge grong gi phyed ka 'phros ma gting skyes kyi phyag na yod pa de yang chos gzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang byung / lam 'bras kyi khrid grol nas gam pa nas rab 'byams pa legs bshad 'bod mir gnang byung ba bzhin phyin zhag bdun tsam bsdad cing nag po pa'i dbang bskur zhig dang / gzhan tshe bka' rjes gnang sogs dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ dge grong kol chu tshan kha srad tang tang gi gzhung rnams brgyud mag dge sdings mjal/ 'dol byung du zhag shas bsdad/ bsam 'grub rtser sde pa sku 'bring ba'i drung mgul shin tu bsnyil ba'i stabs nas dbang bka' sogs zhu bzhed kyi 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar bsam rtser sleb/ de gong du sku khams de la zhud kha sdang ba rang zhig yod 'dug de phyin nas ma byung zhing / zhal ngo spyi khyab tu tshe bka' ci rigs dang / sku sgos su tshe dbang brgya tshar phyag na rdo rje gtum po ras chung lugs kyi dbang sogs dang rjes gnang mang ba tsam phul/ shar steng nas sras yum du dpal —145—

kyai'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba dgongs bzhed ltar bsgrubs/ skyes rabs brgya rtsa mdzad bcu dang bcas pa'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs thog tshad ma nyi shu rtsa lnga pa cig 'dug pa la rab gnas byas/ slar yang tshong 'dus dbu rtser zhag shas bsdad/ grwa lnga'i drung dang thugs snang dag pa'i gsung gleng smra ba nyid chos kyi gtso bor byas/ da lam dbus phyogs su 'gro rgyur 'dug pa lo gcig tsam nas yar phebs pa zhig dgos de min ma mjal dogs pa yin gsung gin 'dug de nas yar lam dga' gdong pa rnams kyis 'bod mi byung ba ltar khor tsam phyin 'du khang du khri la 'khod nas dge 'dun rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig chos 'brel du byas/ dpal bsam sdings su slob dpon mchog gi zhabs drung du/'od zer dgu phrugs kyi byin rlabs dang a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang chos 'brel tu zhus shing / mi g.yo bla med kyi dbang chos 'brel du dgos phebs pa ltar phar phul/ snyen ra lo bde mchog dkar po rnam par rtsen pa'i byin rlabs de chos 'brel gyi rjes mar 'bul dgos byung zhing / gang spyi'i gnas tshul 'das ma 'ongs kyi bka' bkod thams cad kyang mthar dam pa'i chos kyi zab don dang 'brel ba kho na gnang ba dang / snga phyi'i gnas tshul zhib cha 'bul ba sogs kyis nam phyed phyed sku gzhogs su 'gor ba sha stag byung zhing / sku khams log dogs byung na'ang yang nas yang du bka' phebs la da sgos dbus phyogs 'khor ba'i myur du mjal bar smon te phal cher da mi mjal 'am bu tshe'i 'du byed gtong khar sngar mgor bzhugs pa zhig byung na dgos pa gda' ste snga phyi'i rten 'brel rnams la dpags na mi yong ba 'dug 'am bus nan chags su zhus na lo —146—

shas nye skor 'di kar bzhugs pa zhig los yong du 'dug ste/ stag lung nas bla ma'i bka' bkod kyang yin pa dang gzhan phan gyi bar chad mi byed da ras kyi res la gsung 'phros/ smar ba rang byed dgos phebs shing 'phros gtam 'bul ba la bsdad pa rang la dgyes par 'dug pas nyin mtshan thams cad sku gzhogs rang du bsdad/ sgrub sde ba rnams la nai gu zhig kyang bshad/ dpal ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi sku 'bum zhig gsos kyi zhal bkod slob dpon rin po che nyid kyis gnang bar mdzad cing / de ka'i bka' bgros zhu 'os thams cad thag chod par zhus/ bdag cag dpon slob snga mo nas rdzas gcig yin na'ang /slob dpon rin po che nyid kyi phyag rdzas dang gnas 'byi drung chen gyi rdzas kyi steng nas sku skal gang yod las phal cher de gong nyid nas dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog gtso bor gyur pa'i dkar phyogs kho na la gnang zin cing/ de rjes kyi dngos kyi rdzas gang yod dang bla ma dam pa nyid kyi phyag gi'ang gang yod rnams gcig tu bsgril de zhig gsos kyi thes su dmigs de bzhag da lta bla ma mang po nor ngom mdzo rta ngom/ g.yog mang ba rang ngom/ spyin bdag ngom/ yon mchod thams cad chibs rags ngom/ kha drag ngom par gda'/ tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab ni ngom rgyu med pa la gang ngom/ phaṭa/ 'di skabs zhag nyi shu tsam sku gzhogs su bsdad cing dam rdzas ril bu rta sgrub cig kyang mdzad pa bdud rtsi 'bab pa sogs rtags ni sgrub pa dngos las kyang che cha tsam byung / de nas kyang zhag shas sdod 'dod yod na'ang / rtse chen nas dpon sa yum drung sku tshes ma zin pa'i 'gro dgos shar zhing / der sku drin mtshungs med slob dpon —147—

rin po che de nyid kyi zhabs zung 'bral bar mi spobs bzhin du 'ongs/ kha ba chen po babs pas lam yang bcad pa bzhin du song / phyis mi mjal ba'i rten 'brel du 'dug rtse chen rang du mun sros pa la sleb/ khrus chog dbang bskur mtshan byang bzhu ba sogs gang dgos thams cad bgyis shing / sbyangs yon dbu khebs de byung ba'ang zhig gsos kyi rgyur 'dre bar song / dgongs rdzogs grol 'phral lhun grub bde chen du rje grub chen gyi sku 'bum mjal rgyal mkhar rtser phyin 'khor lo bde mchog lha hi pa dang gzhin rje gshed nag gi dbang sogs zhal ngo spyi khyab tu dgongs bzhed kyi chos mang tsam dang / zhabs drung bla ma'i drung du dgyes pa rdo rje rngog lugs kyi yab bka' dang yum bka'i dbang /rdzogs rim bsre 'pho'i khrid dang lung yongs rdzogs sogs dgongs bzhed ltar gyi chos sna mang po dang / mdo rtsa'i gzhi stod kyi byed tsam thugs 'dzug khrid kyi bshad pa zhig kyang phul/ gnas rnying nas 'bod mi nan can gnang byung ba ltar dpal gnas rnying gi chos grwa chen por phyin/ rje drung ngag dbang drung dang rje drung 'jam dbyangs drung sogs zhal ngo rnams dang mjal/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa bar chad kun sel dang yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang sogs dgongs bzhed kyi chos bka' mang rab phul zhing / gdung brgyud rin po ches kyang dbu skra gsil bar mar ba byung tsam gnang / 'di skabs 'tshub cha che ba rang 'dugaye shes mgon po'i 'phur thang gtso bor gyur pa'i phyi nang gi rten khyad par can thams cad mjal/ gser sdings pa'i grwa tshang rnams gnas rnying na chos bar la bzhugs 'dug pas gnas rnying gi 'du khang du khong rnams la chos 'brel du bla —148—

ma'i rnal 'byor zhig dang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang po'i lung bklags/ slar yang rgyal rtser dge rme'i sgang der phyi mtsham me ba byas/'ga' zhig la dza lan+ta ra'i do ha nged rang gi rnam bshad kyi steng nas tshar gcig bshad/ slar rtse chen du yong dgos tshul phebs pa ltar khor tsam phyin zhing 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma'i dbang / gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang / tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs byas/ yang rgyal rtser chos rje rin sdings pa dus 'khor shar chen pa chos rje lha'o pa gzhan grwa rigs don gnyer che ba mang rab dang bcas pa la thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhed srol ltar sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid dang / khrid yig ngo sprod sogs kyi lung / sems nyid ngal gso'i khrid rnams bgyis yum mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i nang rten rje dam pa'i sku 'dra bzang sku ngo mtshar can bsgrubs pa gnang 'dug pa/ snga gong slob dpon rin po ches rab gnas rgyas pa gnang 'dug dngos la'ang zhal ngo rnams kyis bka' phebs ltar rab gnas rgyas pa rang bgyis/ 'di skabs su lcags 'dam chos rje'i drung gis a khu ba 'das pa'i don la rong grags par yong dgos tshul gyi nan chags rang mdzad na'ang / 'phral rang ngu don gal che ba gzhan zhig kyang yong snyam pa blo yul du lam lam 'char ba zhig gi stabs nas 'gro ma thub/ de skabs dgos gal che sar phan ma thogs na'ang 'khang ra med par mos pa 'phel ba ngo mtshar che/ hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum la rtse nas thon mar lam sde pa mkhar kha ba'i sprur la khrus chog dang byang bzhu grub nas/ gnas rnying nas dpon sa'i drung shin tu sku khams bsnyel ba'i myur shad yong dgos tshul byung bas de 'phral lam —149—

bsrangs nas phyin pa sleb dus dpon sa'i drung ni sku ma 'tsho 'dug skrur la khrus chab dang dbang bskur byas/ 'pho ba'i dmigs pa dang rten 'brel 'dra bgyis pas de 'phral rang 'pho ba thebs pa'i rtags gsal ba thon/ rje zhal ngor chos kyi tshul las brtsams te thugs gso gang drag bgyis/ rje drung sku mched rnams kyang da res khyed kyis yod du bcug pa'i bka' bkod thugs thag pa nas phebs kyi 'dug zhag gsum pa'i nam phyed tsam la sprur 'od bzhu byas nyi shar la mtshan byang bzhug ste/ de man mis lam du zhugs rim pas myos/ mkha' ro'i la 'og tu mthong snang gi khyad par byung ba ni yi ge logs su bkod yod pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /mkha' ro gangs sbug tu sleb cing / yar 'brog nas ste pa a khu drung pa dpon g.yog rnams kyang gzhis len la phebs 'dug tshe dpag med kyi lha khang gsar ba der sdod sa byas/ sde pa dpon g.yog rnams ni lug mjal gyi thugs brel sogs nas de'i gnangs nyin phebs song / nged kyis gnas de nyid du zhag bcu skor tsam mtshams byas/ char zhod dang smugs zil shin tu che ba dang cham pa shin tu na ba byung na'ang / sngar mkha' ro'i la 'og gi mthong snang dang bstun pa'i sems la bde snang gi 'char sgo brjod pa las 'das pa zhig shar ba thams cad kyang dbyings shar dbyings grol gyi tshul du gyur te/ /lus kyi zug ngu yang dbyings su yal ba ltar 'gro ba ka byung ngo / /'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa brgyad pa sbyar ro/ /de nas tshes nyer gsum la yar 'brog stag lung du sleb/ sdod yul rtse'i gzhal yas khang du byas shing / zhal ngo rnams la thog mar sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang rten 'brel legs pa'i phyir phul nas/ tshe —150—

dbang brgya rtsa sogs song rjes/ da lam thugs bzhed kyi gtso bo shangs chos yongs rdzogs rang yin pa cis kyang dgos phebs pa ltar de mthun phul ba ni/dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor so sor dbang bskur ba dang gcig car bskur ba ste/ nyi ma bdun gyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rdzogs pa dang / zab lam chos drug sogs gser chos kyi khrid rnams dang / byin rlabs gzhung bka' nyi shu/rgyab rten lung yig rnying po ti gnyis tsam/ de dag tu ma 'dus pa 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gyi dbang dang khrid/ thugs rje chen po zhi drag sogs shangs chos cha tshang zhig song / mgon bka' rnams ma gtogs pa la don gnyer sha stag 'dus pa bzhi bcu zhe bgrangs yod cing / khrid dmigs skyor dgos pa sogs nan tan yang dag byas/ zhal ngo rnams la sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid dang / lcam sring gnyis su sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa/ sde pa ma'i drung la nai gu'i lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor rnams kyang dgos phebs pa ltar phul/gzhan don gnyer mang dag zhig la gsang 'dus rim lnga mar 'gos gnyis 'dus kyi lugs bu ston rin po che'i khrid yig steng nas khrid zhib pa zhig dang rgya gzhung rnams dang 'gos kyi gtong thun chen mo'i lung bshad cig kyang bgyis/zhal ngo rnams su dmar po skor gsum sog sa gzhan yang chos mang dag song /rje lcags nang ba dbon slob thams cad dang mjal chos 'brel yang phul/ khong dpon slob tshos nged la brtan bzhugs kyang mdzad/ 'di skabs sde pa khu dpon gyi gsung las da lo lha sa la skor chen zhig 'dzugs rgyu yin pas de ga'i mgo byed dgos gsung ba byung na'ang mi byed par thag bcad/ 'dir rdo rje'i gnas —151—

pa dgu pa sbyar ro/ /de rjes zhal ngo so so nas chos yon yang bzab ma dang /sde pa rgyal bu'i drung gis brgya 'bul zhig mdzad skabs/ 'tshom chen gyi steng 'og khengs pa tsam gyi chos zhu mi la/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas pa'i sgo nas sems bskyed phog cing / de rjes sna dkar rtser chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i sku 'dra sme ba can la snam sbyar bzang ba zhig phul/ de nas rim pas chas de skyes yul tu sleb/ ri ltas la phyin pas yul gyi bkod pa sna tshogs mthong ba la brten pa'i yid kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs pa rang bzhin dag ba'i ngo bor rang ngor mnyam pa'i/ dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang / khrel la tsho ni ni ji bzhin du/ /zhes pa la nges pa rnyed par byung / de skabs sna dkar rtse'i bde yangs su wa brgyal ba sogs ltas 'tshub pa byung bas ji ltar bya gsung ba'i lon gnang byung ba de sku la gnod pa cang med yul chags chen po zhig yod pa 'dra zhus/ ston dus 'gol zhing rig pa dwangs ba la brten de 'chad spro bar byung nas/ rang gi lhan cig gnas pa don gnyer drug bdun la rgyud sde thams cad kyi mthar thug pa byin rlabs kyi gter chen po 'khor lo sdom pa bde mchog nyung ja'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa yongs su rdzogs par bshad cing / spyir rgyud 'di la rgya bod kyi 'grel ba'i dpe cha nag 'ded la bltos mi dgos pa'i zab mo'i nges gnas la rang dbang 'byor tsam gdog/ de yang rang blo rno ba kho nas min/ bla ma dam pa rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnam pa lnga'i thugs rje dang / rang gi bsod nams dang brtson 'grus 'dzoms pa las byung ba lags/ 'on kyang 'di skabs sngar srol dang bstun —152—

gnyan phul byung ba'i ṭīk+ka la gzhi byas te/ man ngag gi bshad sgros gzhan rnams dang / lwab pa'i 'grel ba nas ci rigs par kha skang ste/ snga gro nyi ma shar lho de tsam nas kha zas gdan gcig po ngan gyi bar dang / zas kyi bya ba grol 'phral nas nyi ma nub kyi bar bshad cing / sngags btu' byin rlabs gong 'og sogs skabs de dang der dgos pa'i byin rlabs rnams kyang tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba dang 'brel par bsgrubs shing / dbu zhabs bar gsum gyi rgyud mchod kyi tshogs 'khor dang thun re bzhin tu thog mar bsrung 'khor gtor chog maṇ+ḍal gsol btab sogs dang 'jug tu yi rang brjod pa sogs phyag len go rim ma 'khrul bar bgyis/ 'on kyang chos thun snga phyi'i lag len spros pa 'di lag len rnying pa rang yin min mi shes pa 'dug 'phral rnam pa gsal gsal bo cig snang / bshad thun ches bas nyan pa bo rnams kyi blo la 'jag pa rang ma byung na'ang / rang nyid kyi blo ngo la dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje btsun mos rgyud byin gyis rlob kyin yod snyam pa'i yin dga' spro dang bcas pa rtag tu byung / rmi lam du bud med kyi gzugs can 'ga' res rgyud kyi tshig 'khru'i bshad pa la dag ma dag gi dpyad pa byed pa yang lan mang du byung bas/ phyis 'byung dang deng sang shes rab che ru re ba rnams dpe lung tsam re'am spyi bshad tsam re brgyud pa'i khungs su byas nas/ rang gi dpe lta 'dra byas pa'i yid dbyod la zab don yin par lung 'gog 'thag pa/ mkhas pas mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje'i tshig 'chad pa/ zhes pa'i lung gis zin pa'i bshes gnyen chen po/ rtog ge pa la rdo rje slob dpon gyi khral bkal ba rnams kyi nyan bshad dang mi 'dra ba'i byin —153—

rlabs gyi rtags mtshan can du gda'/ pha jo'i drung la mnal lam ma yin pa'i gsal snang ci rigs 'char ba zhig yod pas/ rgyud kyi gung tsam la sleb skabs kyi tho rangs shig bud med cig gis pu rangs lo chung chos 'chad pa la byon zer ba'i skad gsal po thengs gsum gsan pa byung 'dug cing / bshad pa de nyid grol mtshams bsnyen pa 'dra'i kha gso bgyis/ de grol mtshams sam bu ṭa dang rnal 'byor ma kun sbyod kyi lung bshad 'doms/ sdom 'byung gi lung rnams byas/'di skabs rgya ma'i grwa tshang gi slob dpon pa chos mdzad rgyan yang nged la 'bod pa la byon byung / de nas lhun rab tu 6ga bdun tsam bsdad/ 'dod chos 'dra byas/ rgya ma slob dpon pa dang rang gi lhan cig gnas pa 'ga' zhig la/ skyes bu gsum gyi khrid lam rim rgyas pa'i 'go tshugs shing / rgyab rten du gam la shi la'i sgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum gyi lung bshad kyi 'go yang tshugs/ rin spungs nas zhabs drung zla bzang pa'i drung yang skyed tshal 'og na bzhugs 'dug pas/ khro phu rgya rdza'i lung zhig dgos phebs pa de skabs stod cha tsam song /slob dpon grub thob pa'i drung yang chos 'brel zhu ba la byon byung / yol ri gong du rang byon mgon po'i zhal khyim mjal bar phyin/ bar skabs su mgon khang la dmag thebs pa'i cung zad chag grugs byung zer/ sngon dus ltar gyi byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan med dam snyam pa tsam byung na'ang / zhal ras mthong ba tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur ba sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan sngon dus kyi de kho na bzhin du ཿga de nub rang byon mgon po nyid kyi drung du mchod gtor bskang gso bzab mar byas/ mgon po'i sku drung de nyin du nyal nas bsdad pas/ rmi —154—

lam du bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pas rjes su bzung ba'i rtags snang cung zad byung / nang par yang snga rab langs te smon lam mang du btab/ rang byon mgon po nyid dang gnyan ston gyi nang rten thub pa'i sku 'dra la snyan dar dri bzang gi mchod pa rin po che dang bsres pa mang du phul/ mgon khang du spyan gzigs dang lha gzhan rnams la yang snyan dar bla bre 'phan sogs mchod rdzas than thun 'bul rgyu byung / mar lam khu spe grwa tshang du chos 'brel 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang dang gang blo ma'i byin rlabs byas/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku 'dra phyag gnas ma dang / gser gdung la phyag mchod phul/ snga nas 'bod mi nan can yod pa bzhin/ de nub sa sribs la gong dkar du sleb/ 'di the ba'i thog ma lan gsum ka sa sros pa la sleb pa rkyang byung ba bkra legs rgyu rang mi snang ste/ rten 'brel gzhan cung zad legs pas re shig gzhan las grag pa byung / gang ltar de skabs sdod yul mgon po me thub ma bzhugs pa'i steng der byung / zhabs drung mi dbang drung du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang tshe dbang grub brgyal ma brgya rtsa lha dgu ma brgya rtsa sogs phul zhing /bdag mo'i drung gi phyag phyir don gnyer nyi shu tsam dang bcas pa la dzam+bha la dkar po dang sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang / khyad par bde mchog lha lnga'i smin byed kyis sgo phye ste/ phyag rgya wo po ga'u ma'i khrid tshul shin tu smin pa dang /zhabs drung gdung brgyud du tshe dbang sogs sku che'i rten 'brel gyi dbang bka' rjes gnang ci rigs pa phul/ sngar gyi 'phros la bka' gdams lam rim gyi 'khrid tshul rgyab rten gyi bshad pa rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ sgom rim gyi lung —155—

bshad rgyas pa dang / de skabs ba'i sde dbu mdzad pa phyis tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan thog tu phebs pa rin po che rta ra ba'i drung la mtshan brjod kyi 'grel chen sngags don rnam gzigs kyi lung bshad cig dgos gsung ba ltar rngog pa'i ngag sgros dang sgrel nas bshad pa zhib rab byas/ de dus chu bo ri'i lcags zam chad yar 'brogs pa'i skor chen gyi mi mang po shi skabs yin/ sngar gyi bde mchog gi rgyud bshad nyan pa po rnams la yang mngon brjod bla ma'i lung bshad rdzogs pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lung gnad 'doms kyi bshad pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par byas/ dkon gnyer nyi rnam pa sogs don gnyer 'ga' zhig la ni gu chos drug byin rlabs dang bcas pa zhig dang / zhal ngo rnams dang drung 'khor drag bsdus dang / jo gdan bzhi ste/ yol mkhan chen sogs dge bshes mang dag dang bcas pa phyed nyis brgya tsam la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba dang / gzhan yang bde mchog nag po pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang / bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang / rim lnga'i byin rlabs/ dril bu rim lnga'i khrid bshad pa mtha' chod dang bcas pa/ jo gdan 'ga' zhig la skyid sdug lam khyer gyi khrid sogs mdor na 'di skabs zla gcig zhag po nyi shu skor la chos shin tu 'phel ba byung / hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la drang srong srin pa rir sleb tsam byas/ de nub lha khang der nyal bas gnyid kyi 'od gsal mtshan zang thal gyis zin/ gnas der rten 'brel gyi sgo bzang po cig 'grig la khad la yal song / nang par 'jun du khor tsam phyin tshe dbang sogs bzhed —156—

pa ltar byas/ sras mo chung chung zhig gi skra phud blangs/ de nub sdod dgos tshul nan chags rang byed kyin 'dug na'ang ltas ngan pa zhig 'dug pas ma bsdad/sang 'u shang rdo'i gnas mjal byas te/ de nas rgya sde dkar chung gi rdo rings kyi bka' tshigs yi ge de ched btang mjal bar phyin/ de nas zhabs drung bkras stobs pa'i phyag g.yog mdo sngags gling pa'i sku skye bsu bar byung / de nub ra sa 'phrul snang du zhabs drung bkras stobs drung dang mjal ba/ sngar ma mjal nas shin tu yun ring bar song bas phan tshun yid kyi ngal stegs su gyur/ 'di skabs lha sar zhag bzhi bsdad cing phyag mchod smon lam gang 'grub byas/nub mo shin tu 'tshub pa'i cho 'phrul dang 'od gsal gyi snang cha re mos rang du 'char ba zhig byung / 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad kyi ya rgyal bar khang gi gyang ris sgrol ma'i sku brnyan la byang dar sngon po bzang ba zhig phul ba bzhes pa'i rnam pa byung ba rdzun med thams cad kyis mthong de ka yin/ zhabs drung bkras stobs drung du phag dkar shes rab gsal khyed paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa'i nye brgyud de'i byin rlabs shig phul/ yar lam yer bar zhag gsum bsdad/ dpon sa yum drung nas nged kyis rta lo yongs pa'i dus nas gzung yer par rab lo gsum tsam/ de min yang lo mtshams tsam zhig byed dgos rtag tu phebs pa zhig yod na yang / de skabs 'gyur 'dug pas lo gsum ma zhag gsum la bsdus/ spyir bskal dus rnyings pa'i slob ma phal cher dang / khyad par sde dpon phra rags phal cher zhig mthu bzlog sogs rkyen sel lam 'jig rten gyi phan bya 'di las 'di e grag snyam pa dang / 'ga' zhig thob rgya 'dra —157—

'dod pa dang zas ngo nor ngo sogs la su byung byung bla mar 'khur chos gang thob byed/ de rjes dam tshig la ye mi rtsi ba zhig yong bar gnang / don du ni de 'dra de dmyal ba'i sgrub thabs chen por gda'/ 'brom chen po'i gsung las/ kho bos tsham tshom du bla ma bsten ma myong / bsten nas yal bar 'dor ma myong gsung ba gnad kyi dam par snang ngo / /spos kha'i dgon pa na rje btsun ma la yer ba ba'i sku 'dra 'gro mgon skye med zhang gis bzhengs pa byin rlabs can de mjal/ ri bo dge ldan mjal 'dod che ba rang yod na yang de skabs stabs ma 'grig rgya ma rin chen sgang du skye bo grangs med pa tshogs pa la nyin re bzhin du rgyu 'bras kyi chos kyis rgyud bskul ba sngon du 'gro bas khrom chos re 'chag med du bshad/ khyad par kyai rdo rje'i dbang cha drug tsam dang / gzhan yang gang la gang 'tsham gyi chos kyang 'phel rab byung zhing / nyin re bzhin tshogs 'khor rgyas pa 'dren mkhan bzhi lnga re ma chag pa byung / nub mo khyi zhig rgyun du zug gin 'dug pa la skad kyi gdangs la yig drug gi sgra gsal bo rang lhang lhang ba ja sbyor gcig tsam gyi bar du byung / nye skor gyi yul pa thams cad 'tshogs pa'i mi tshogs shin tu che ba zhig la ma ṇi'i lung dang khrom dbang zhig byas/ snga gong lha sa'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa smin pa zhig 'dir skyen gyis sad pas/ phyi'i snang ba thams cad sgyu ma cam dang / nang rig pa nam mkha' lta bu dbyer med khyab brdal lhongs su gyur/ phyi snang cha ji tsam mang gin bogs che ba/ lus la 'pho med kyi bde ba 'char ba/ rlung yang mnyam rgyur 'gro ba dang nang gi sgra'i gsang ba la brten te ngag thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur te/ legs —158—

nyes mtho dman gyi tshig thams cad mnyam nyid du shar/ da lta'i dus na sgom chen pa kha cig rang phyogs kyi skyon shi gsang ro gsang dang 'char ka byung dogs kyi dogs pa ri tsam khong du bcug nas chos brgyad rang ngom zhing / lkog tu lus ngag yid gsum shin tu ma dag pas dus 'da' ba dag la snying rje khong nas skyes/snga sor mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig gi sel cung zad cig gi ltas yang yang byung bas/'dir mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor ma shin tu tshad che ba rgya che dpangs mtho rang bshams nas gtor ma lan brgya tshar bsngo ba sogs rang gis kyang bgyis shing /dam tshig gtsang ba rnams bsngor 'jug pa lan mang du bstud nas byas pas sel dag cing mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rtags rnams tshang bar byung ngo / /'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bcu pa sbyar ro/ /'dir smras pa/ gang zhig srid pa gsum du sno 9 chas kyi gtam/ /lan brgyar bsgrags pa'i de yang rmad du byung / /de dag las kyang dngas kun rgyal srid la/ /rang sems gcig car 'kho7ra 'di ches cher mtshar /de nas bye ri stag rtser zhag sbrel zhig bsdad/ dpon sa zhol nas gyi sras mo chung chung zhig gi skra bcad/ sa der smon mkhar sde pa'i gzhis sa cha thams cad rje drung zhwa dmar bar phul ba'i phyi nang gi skad cha zhib par tshor bas kho rang tsho'i 'dod pa skyabs zhwa dmar can la zhus/ dbang rigs khong rang tshor yong la re nas zhus 'dug pa la gzigs stangs 'dzol nas sa gzhis thams cad rje zhwa dmar bas phyag tu bzhes pas phyis 'gyod/ de yin ni ka bzhi ras chen shor ba'i phyag rjes yin/ spyin pa rgya che yang bsam pa ma dag pas 'bras —159—

bu chung ba/ bzhas gnyen dam pas ma zin pa mtshar snyam pa yang yang shar/ de nas dga' mor chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku 'dra 'bul thob ma la snyan dar phyag mchod sogs phul/ rje btsun mar pa lo tsā ba'i thugs dam rten yin nges bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil thang rgya gar ma zhig bzhugs kyin 'dug pas/de sngas 'gor spyan drangs te tshogs mchod phul zhing nub mo bzlas pa mang rab byas nas nyal bas/ rmi lam du slob dpon mtsho skyes dang / lwa ba pa gnyis kyi phug yin zer ba brag phug shin tu nyams dga' ba kha sprod cig 'dug gcig na bud med sngo sangs gcig dang gcig na dmar mo gcig 'dug lhan cig skyes las gang skyes pa/ /lhan cig skyes par de brjod bya/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /de yi don 'di yin zhesargyas par gsung ba dang / rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dag /ces pa nas mchog tu dga' ba'i rigs las byung ba rnams/ zhes pa'i bar rkang bro dang bcas nas glur blangs/ bum pa zhig dang / thod pa zhig dang / ong pu gru gsum gyi dbus na sdong bu la me 'bar bzhin pa zhig snod chus gang ba zhig me tog 'dab ma bdun pa zhig nor bu yin zer ba'i rdo sngon po zhig rnams lag tu gto byung ba/ dbang bzhi sogs zab mo'i brda' don du go /lar nged la mar rngog lugs 'di kun la bag chags sad rgyu cig 'dug de nas chos sdings su zhag gsum tsam bsdad cing / grwa rigs grang dpon so so'i nang du 'bod mi rnam grangs mang ba rang gis brel bar byung / mgon po lha brgyad dang lha bcu gnyis ma/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang / pu ṭa'i zur bka' sogs —160—

bzhes don gyi chos 'ga' re byas/ zur ru ba tshang dang yu nga sdings pa tshang la nyin 'khor zhig phyin/ sdings pa'i de na na la zla'i ra ba smad pa rnams chos bar la bzhugs 'dug khong rnams kyis kyang nged la chos 'brel zhig zhus song / sgro rong du gnas bcu'i gser thang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas bsdus pa zhig byas/ lhun grub rdzong gi klu sdings su stag lung nas sde pa'i drung dang mjal/'di nyin rang gdung rgyud gcig sku bltams pa de da lta'i stag lung rin po che 'di ka rang yin rten 'brel legs/ tshes bco lnga'i nyi phyed tsam la rnam rgyal rab brtan du sleb ba'i sa gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rje btsun stag lung ba chen po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs pad mchog gi drung du 'byor zhing zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong bas dga' bde dpag tu med pa thob/ 'di skabs su mkhas pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon rin po che jo nang du phebs pa'i dus khrid sogs gnang dgos tshul snyan du phul ba bzhin phyag thog tu yang khel 'dug nged kyis zla gcig skor rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dpal stag lung ba chen po'i zhabs drung du/'gro mgon phag mo grub pa'i bka' 'bum gyi 'phros sngar ma thob pa rnams dang /rje ri bo che ba'i bka' 'bum phal che ba zhig gi lung rnams zhus shing / rnam rgyal rab brtan du sleb pa'i gnangs nyin yang dgon du sprul pa'i sku yang mjal/ de mthun grog khar yang mjal shangs lugs kyi rgyud sde lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa khyad par du 'phags pa zhig sgrub brgyud 'di nyid kyi zhabs tog tu dmigs nas sbyar/ rje 'bab rong pa chen po'i dngul sku rin po che sogs —161—

'bab rong pa'i rten rnams stag lung gling na phebs 'dus pa'ang mjal/mgur 'bum gyi dpe mthong bas bag chags sad rgyu bsha' ma zhig 'dug shweng dpon sa skyong dang g.yul rgyal gnyis dang phrad tshe dbang gcig byas/ stong pa'i dpon a chos kyang byon 'dug stag lung ba'i sku tsha yin kyang mchod gnas ngan pas sbos 'dug phrad ma byung / de mtshams nas rje bla ma'i gzims khang de nyid du mtshams bcad/ nyi phyed tsam nas gung thun la rtsom pa'i thun che ba re byas/srod thor snga dgongs rnams bzlas brjod dang mnyam gzhag kyang 'phel bar byung / bka' babs bdun ldan gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang / khyad par lhan cig tu gnas pa'i don gnyer mang pos rab tu bskul ba la brten nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi bstod chen dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi 'grel chen de brtsams pas/ thog ma dka' 'grel tsam byed par bsams te/ phyag 'tshal gyi skor rnams la de kha bzhin byas pa yin na'ang / de man chad la 'bru bshad dgag sgrub dgos pa sogs la rab 'byams pa rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyis bshad pa dpyis phyin pa rang dgos tshul gyis 'phral 'phral bskul ba la brten bshags pa nas brtsams te/ rgyas 'brel rang du song hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la 'go brtsams te chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcu la rdzogs par grub/ 'di rang re'i rtsom pa snga rtsom gyi gtso bo yin/ legs so thob pa'i mtshan ma tsam dang khyad par rim gnyis spyi'i bshad pa song mtshams kyi nub gcig rmi lam du rnam rgyal rab brtan gyi shar gyi ri de'i ngos shin tu 'jam zhing snyoms pa ma/thing shog bkrams pa lta bu la mtshal yig bzab chung gi rnam par zhig gis ri'i ngos go —162—

mtshams med par song 'dug pa/ bud med kyi khrom chen po zhig kyang ri de'i rtsa ba na 'dug de'i gtso mo de mi'i lus la mig gsum dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pas 'di ni zhing gi rnal 'byor ma zhig go snyam ste g.yon phyogs nas lan gsum bskor te/ rgyud nas bshad pa ltar brda'i phyag dang yid kyis dri ba byed kyin 'dug pas gtso mo de na re/ ri sa hā dzā/ zhes lan gsum gsung / ri logs kyi yi ge 'di rnams ci yin klog tu wo ngam dris pas/ 'di mngon brjod 'bum pa chen po le'u 'bum yod pa de yin/ de yang shes rab rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs pa ni 'di tsam zhig 'tshogs pa yin pa las thabs su gyur pa ni khyed gcig pu ste/ des na 'khor lo'i mchod pa 'di thog mar gyis la phyis klogs shig ces gsung zhing / tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod par snang ba mang po zhig las mthar tshogs kyi bya ba zin pa na/ de rnams bklags pas ri logs chen po yi ge phra mos khyab pa de yud tsam gyis klog zin pa dang don rnams kyang blo la ram ram yod pa snyam byed/ gnyid sad pa'i tshe yang sngar ma go ba'i don nyi shu tsam zhig gsal le 'dug yang lan cig rmi lam du khang pa'i ngos la sdig pa rwa can shin tu che ba zhig btags 'dug pa rlung gis bdas de gdong la lan gsum phog byung ba rmi lam ma zin par 'jigs skrags chen po byung / de 'phral rmi lam zin byung na'ang / da res rmi lam ma zin da ste nam zhig bar do'ang mi zin pa 'dra snyam sems skyo shas chen po byung / de 'od gsal du gyur de mtha' dbus med par song / dpal ldan 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon rtogs chen mo 'di yang snga ma'i rjes thogs la brtsams pa yin te nyi ma bzhi la grub —163—

par byas/ dbyar gyi ring rje btsun stag lung pa chab tshan sogs kyi stabs nas byang rgyab la phebs pa gnang song / slar phebs mtshams nged kyis 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gnas chen mjal bar dmigs phar lam phod mdor zhag gcig bsdad/ sde pa rin po ches yar gsum bar skyel mar yang phebs/der mi dmangs rnams la ma ṇi'i lung dang sems bskyed cig byas pa/ sde pa'i zhabs drung gis kyang gsan te chos 'brel gyi thog ma yin no/ /de nyin rwa bsgreng du sleb pa'i jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs rten rnams la gser chab sogs kyang zhus snga phyir dkar me snyan dar sogs rgyas pa 'bul thub cing / bar skor la brten pa'i gnas mjal yang shin tu zhib par byas/ tshogs su'ang chos 'brel dang gnas so so thams cad du yang chos kyi rnam grangs re bshad/ khyad par brag seng ge'i zhol rje btsun tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas chos 'brel zhig dgos zer ba la/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i gnad 'doms pa lam rim bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa zhig bshad/ rgya dpe me thub ma rnams kyi rten mjal byas pas/ shwan ti bas mdzad pa'i brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa sogs rgya dpe mang po'i gsham na/ bha ṅga la paṇ+ḍi ta dhik+ṣi dī pa ka ra shī rnyon su bu sta ka/ zhes pa 'dug pas jo bo rje nyid kyi phyag dper nges pa'i mos gus chen pos mchi ma 'khrug cing na bza' dang dri bzang la rin po che bsres pa sogs phul zhing smon lam mang du btab/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi rgyud kyi rgya dpe nas shog bu gnyis tsam rgya skad nyid du mgyogs par klogs shing / de rjes so sor phral nas bod skad bsgyur gyin bshad pas/ rwa bsgreng pa thams —164—

cad sngar mi che dgu thams cad la rten mjal phul zhing / sgra ba dang lo tsā bar btags pa mang po zhig rang byung na'ang / 'khru re 'khru gnyis klog pa tsam las mi 'dug pa ngo mtshar che zhes ngo bstod mang po byed kyin 'dug tshur lam lha chu rgyas pa nas lcags la thon te phu mdor bcag mal zhig bsdad/ sde pa yab yum drung du tshe bka' sogs dgongs bzhed bzhin phul/ sgrub gnas ser le ru zhag gsum tsam bsdad/ rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyi sku 'dra gsung byon ma la mchod pa bzang du bshams shing smon lam btab/ de na smon mkhar nas dpon sa'i drung sras yum bzhugs 'dug pa la'ang dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'brel 'dra phul/ slar rnam rgyal rab brtan nyid du sleb/ 'di skor gyi skabs shig tho rangs gnyid min dngos min la/ shes pa gsal zhing dwangs pa zhig gi ngang nas sa dang bar snang la lus dbyibs sna tshogs pa yod pa'i skye bo grangs med pa zhig 'gro ba zhig 'dug de dag dang lhan cig tu song bas lung ba gru gsum kha dog dmar po zhig gi dbus na/ shel gyi ri blos mi 'khyud pa zhig 'dug de nyid mchod rten bzo 'bras shin tu mtshar ba che chung ma nges pas go mtshams med par gtams pa zhig 'dug pa/ mchod rten re re la yang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku dpag tu med pa dang de thams cad kyang zhu ba zhu lan sogs chos kyi sgra di ri ri 'dug nam mkha' nas me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang po dang / phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa'i sems can grangs med pa mang po mchod pa byas kyin 'dug pas thams cad kyang mgrin gcig tu/e yig la ni wa gnas te/ /rgyal ba kun gyi pho brang la/ /sangs rgyas grangs —165—

med bdun bcu gnyis/ /'khor ni bye ba bye bas bskor/ /bde chen 'od dpag med pa'i zhing / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang po zhig 'don gyin 'dug pa/tshig gi 'phro rnams brjed nas thal/ ri 'di ci yin dris pas mchod rten dpal yon can yin zer/ 'di skabs dpal jo nang du bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis lhag bsam rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas rgyu gang yod bsgril nas/ sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo la zhig gsos bgyis pa grub tu nye ba'i skabs yin pa 'dug pas de la lta ba yin nam sems/ bka' drin mnyam med mkhan rin po che de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs su nang rten bzhengs pa'i tshe/gser mang tsam zhes 'bul rgyu byung zhing / de min rten bzhengs pa sogs ma grub pas de nyid la dmigs pa yin/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gcig kyang bzhengs/ mchod rten zhig gsos kyang grub shin tu che ba byung / nam gung mi rnams gnyid du song ba'i skabs/ rgyang nas shing gzhog pa dang zangs brdung ba dang sbud pa'i sgra sogs di ri ri yod pa lan mang du byung ba dang / rab gnas mdzad 'dug pa'i skabs su'ang 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i ya mtshan che ba rang byung 'dug de rjes slob dpon rin po che'i phyag dam thams cad du nga ni rang res zhig gsos kyi bya ba grub pa yin pas da sgos myur du 'gro ba yin gsung ba 'byor byung ba phyi mtha' ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i gsung du byung / 'di skabs dpal stag lung rin po cher blo sbyong gi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa zhig dgos phebs pa ltar ngag thog nas don bdun ma'i khrid kyi steng du gzhan rnams tshang bar byas/ yig rnying rnam —166—

grangs shin tu mang ba'i lung rnams kyang phul/ dngos kyis kyang sku rags ma'i skor gyi lung yongs su rdzogs pa dang / nyams len khrid tshul gyi snying po rnams zhus/ de mtshams gling gi gzims spyil du bskyas shing / sprul pa'i sku rin po cher thang pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi 'phros dang nye bar mkho ba'i lung chos kyang mang du zhus shing / gtso bor stag lung bka' brgyud nyid kyi rang bzhed nā ro chos drug shin tu smin pa sogs stag lung bka' brgyud rang dang 'brel ba'i dbang rjes gnad mang bar zhus shing snga phyir dam pa mchog 'di la lung bka' chos mang ba thob/ gtso bor dgongs bzhed ltar bde mchog lwa ba bcu gsum ma/ sdom 'byung rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po don zhags gzungs grwa lnga rnams kyi dbang sogs dang / mar rngog yab sras kyi bzhed pa las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang 'brel ba'i chos rnam grangs shin tu mang ba la/ rngog lugs dgyes pa rdo rje'i bsre 'pho'i skor dang / gur gyi srog shing / 'grel pa bka' yang / gur ṭīka gzer chen/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ rgyud khyi ka mgar gyis mdzad pa/ gdan bzhi'i rgya gzhung rnams dang / rgyud 'grel rngog ston thogs med grags pas mdzad pa rnams kyi lung dang / mā ya dang gdan bzhi'i 'khrid tshul man ngag gi yi ge rnams kyi lung sogs dang ras chung snyan brgyud rnying pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gsang 'dus rim lnga mar lugs kyi 'khrid tshul rgyas pa dang / bu ston rin po che'i khrid yig dang / gdams ngag nag khrid kyi dpe bum yongs rdzogs dang / rim lnga spyod bsdus sogs 'phags skor gyi rgya gzhung rnams dang / 'grel chen sgron gsal —167—

gyi lung / dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs dang gzhung drug sogs lung gi skor yongs su rdzogs pa sogs rnam grangs mang ba rang phul zhing /bka' las gsang 'dus rim lnga la khrid yig mang po 'dug na'ang / tshig don gnyis ka mar lugs gtsang sang nge ba mi snang bas brda' don gnyis ka mar lugs kho na yin pa gsal la cha tshang ba zhig rtsoms shig ces/ bka' gnang phebs pa la brten te/ rim lnga smar khrid gdan rdzogs kyi khrid yig rnying rnams la 'thor thabs su gnas shing 'ga' zhig gab pa dang mi gsal ba'i tshul du yod pa de gsal zhing ma 'khrugs par bsgrigs pa 'di brtsams pa/ phyis byung mar ba'i rjes 'brang du khas len pa mang po zhig gi sa na ham pa spyi brtol kho na la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bzang bar rtsi ba 'dug pa rnams ltar na/ kho bo'i 'di tsam yang bstan pa la cung zad bya ba byas pa yin par sems/ de ltar zla ba gnyis kyi bar du snga gro nyi shar la yang dgon gzims khang du sleb par byas gzims khang de nyid kyi nyi ma ma bzhud kyi bar sku gzhogs de nyid du bka' chos zhu 'bul rnams bgyis shing / de mtshams gzims spyil du tshogs chen la nyin re bzhin rjes gnang re ma chag pa dang / snying po don gsum gyi khrid dang / bde mchog lha lnga'i smin byed kyis sgo phye ste/ shangs chos yongs su rdzogs pa gzhung bka' so so dang 'brel bar bsgrubs/ de grol mtshams su so so'i 'dod chos la chos thun gnyis gsum re 'chag med du byung zhing / don gnyer 'ga' shas la brtag gnyis kyi zhib bshad rtsa ba tshig gcig kyang ma lus pa rdzogs par bshad/ grog khar yang grub pa'i dbang phyug gi zhabs drung du pad+ma bhe ra ba dang —168—

dmar po mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i rjes gnang sogs dang rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor sogs rnam grangs mang ba thob/ dngos kyis kyang chos than thun dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ de nas slar yang rnam rgyal rab brtan du bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du zla gcig skor bsdad cing / rje ri bo che ba'i bka' 'bum dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba dang / gu ru drag dmar nyang lugs kyi dbang dang lung bka' yongs rdzogs thob/ dngos kyis kyang sku che'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang brgya rtsa zhig phul zhing / khams pa dge slong gnyis kyis nan chags kyis bskul ba la brten te/ dbang mi bdun tsam la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhig byas/ dus slob ma sta gon gyi gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi skabs de rang du/ srin lag g.yon nas khrag rang brdol du byung / 'di ltar bu yang phyis 'tshub pa'i ltas su ka byung / sog po'i rgyal brgyud dpon po kha dan bag dur yang / bla ma bzang dgu la nor lha'i rjes gnang rang ched kyis zhu yin 'dug pa/ nged la yang dzam+bha la ser po'i rjes gnang zhig dgos zer ba bzhin byas/ khong dang lhan du hor stong pa'i rgyal bus kyang rjes gnang de zhus song / dpon po kha dan gyi rgyal mo rgan pa na ba yin pas khong gi ru khrod du yong dgos tshul nan chags byed kyin 'dug na'ang ye ma phyin/ kho rang yang dpal de bzhin gshegs pa stag lung pa 'di/ nged gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal po dkar po a ba dan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ nged sog po rnams la sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba yin pa/ de'i yang bla ma khyed nyid yin 'dug pas thugs dam skyabs 'og tu 'jug dgos zer gus pa chen po byed kyin 'dug—169—

hor zla dgu pa'i nyi shu gsum la rje btsun dpal stag lung pa chen po brtan bzhugs dang bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i yon rnams phul/ sems can gyi mgon skyabs la dgongs te zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba btab/ lo shas de ka byed dgos gsung zhal gyis bzhes/ nang par nyi shu bzhi la dar la brgyud nas ku run sleb/ brag nag gi ri khrod du 'bod mi byung ba ltar phyin theg gsum bsdad/ de mtshams nyan por yang phyin/ nye skor gyi yul chung thams cad du sgo skor la phyin pas yig drug gi 'gro don che bar byung / khyad par nyan po'i gtsug lag khang du ma ṇi'i lung byas pa dang / shar pa 'bum pa mjal ba'i tshe mi tshogs shin tu che bar byung zhing / de dag tu me tog gi char yang bsnyon med du babs/ lhun grub rdzong du zhag gsum bsdad cing / zhal ngo rnams la dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'dra phul/ sum 'phrang du phyin dus ra lung pa'i cog grwa ba dpon slob rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig chos 'brel du byas/ dpal glang ri thang du mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pas 'bod mi nan can yod pa bzhin sleb/glang thang rang du zhag nyi shu skor bsdad cing gtsug lag khang du snga dro rjes gnang re dang / gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun la paṇa chen gser mdog can pa nas brgyud pa'i skor gyi shangs chos yongs rdzogs dang / dgongs mo skya btsun tshogs r+ṣa pa la theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong dang smar khrid sogs bshad cing / bla brang du so so'i 'dod chos zhu ba shin tu mang bar byung / bar bar du nye sde bor gyi dpon chung 'dra dang grong tsho thams cad la phyin/ khyad par khrom chen po la sems bskyed bsdus pa dang ma ṇi'i lung dang khrom dbang rnams byas pa'i skabs/ khrom —170—

mi tshogs shin tu che bas ma ṇi bskul mkhan gcig gis ma 'khul bar tsho bzhir bgos te/ ma ṇi bskul mkhan bzhi byed dgos par byung / sems bskyed kyi skabs me tog gi char bsnyon med du babs pa'i me tog che ba rnams ni phug ron tsam thams cad gyis mthun snang du grub pa mthong / 'di skabs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub yig na yod pa bzhin bud med 'ga' zhig gi dpral ba dang 'khur tshos kyi steng na g.yu drung ris dmar ser g.yon du drag tu 'khor ba'i rnam pa nam yang mthong / tho rangs shig paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po shākya mchog ldan gyi ye shes kyi sku'i snang cha zhu lan dang bcas pa gsal ba zhig byung ste/'di'i lo rgyus zhu lan gyi rdo rje'i tshig 'grel pa man ngag sogs logs su bkod yod pas der shes par bya'o/ /grub rgyal nas 'bod mi nan can byung ba bzhin phyin/ chos rje don grub pa'i drung dang nang so zhal ngo rnams la brda don gsal ba'i khrid/ tshe dbang rjes gnang sogs rnam grangs mang ba dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs shig kyang bgyis shing / dgon pa'i gtsang khang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas shig kyang byas/ rdzong mdun gyi mthil der khrom dbang zhig byas pa 'phan yul stod kyi mi phal cher tshogs shing thams cad kyang dad pa che bar 'dug pas nges 'byung la bskul ba dang las 'bras kyi chos bshad pa'i tshe mchi ma 'byin pa dang / yid 'gyur ba'i sdig pa sna re spong ba dang / dge ba sna re sgrub pa'i dam bca' byed mi mang bar byung / de nas glang thang du sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhin rje gshed kyi gzhung glo ka stong gi tshad tsam pa/ rong zom chen po chos bzang gis bsgyur ba'i dpe lag tu 'byor/—171—

mthong ba tsam gyis snga gong yun ring sbyong myong ba ltar brjed gsos pa 'dra ba zhig la yid dga' bas khyab pa zhig byung / de nas skyor mo lung nas 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar lam du zhugs/ gro sar rwa lo'i thugs dam ga rnyo la sogs gro sa'i rten rnying pa rnams mjal/ gro sa'i la la 'thon yab tu sleb/ de nas snga bar langs te ra tsag mjal bar phyin/ rten thams cad la yang snyan dar phul zhing / khyad par rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la kha yig 'byar ba'i snyan dar shin tu mang ba phul/ dri bzang dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi me tog gtor gsol ba mang du btab/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags cung zad byung / skyor mo lung du grub thob brgyad cu'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas bgyis/phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid dang tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang sogs dgongs bzhed kyi chos rnams phul rjes/ ra sa 'phrul snang du khor tsam phyin ma ṇi ba dung dkar 'brug sgras/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sku brnyan gser zangs las bsgrubs pa dang / bka' 'gyur yang byed tsam bzhengs grub 'dug pa de rnams la rab gnas dgos zer ba ltar rab gnas 'bring po zhig byas/ jo bo shākya mu ni'i sku mdun gyi khyams khra der bka' 'gyur gyi zhus dag la byon pa'i dge ba'i bzhas gnyen gnyis tsam zhig dang gzhan yang dkon gnyer ba sogs kun bsgril nyis brgya tsam la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dmigs pa rnams bsdus pa'i lugs ltar dang lam gyi spyi chings zhib mor bshad pas mi dmangs rnams la dad pa'i gsos 'debs tsam byas/ de na yod pa'i dge bshes rnams nged cag rtag tu lam rim gyi bshad pa byed pa yin yang —172—

sngar mtha' ma chod pa'i blo bskyed ji snyed cig byung zhes gzengs bstod mang po byed/ po ṭa la'i 'jam dpal gshin rje gdong drug gi li ma chos rgyal mes ag tshoms kyi thugs dam rten ngo mtshar can de nyid la snyan dar bcu tsam phul zhing gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ hiXsgyi yi ge nyer gsum pa'i sgra lhang lhang ba lan gsum tsam rna bar tshor bar chad 'ga' zhig bzlog pa'i ltas kyang shar/'di gzhin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i sku 'dra yin/ skyid shod nas sde pa g.yul rgyal drung lan gcig mos gus che rab yod pa'i khungs kyang mdzad/bar skabs 'dir dad pa log ge ba dang zhal mdzes mtshon yod tsam la zhe sun ne ba dang co 'dri se ba kho na mdzad/ ngas kyang co 'dri'i lan che ba re byas/ yer pa nas kyang zem me ba kho na mdzad/ skyid shod dga' ldan pa rang la rten 'brel gal che 'dra sgrig rgyu yod na'ang / de ka'i stabs nas ye ma 'grig stag lung pa tsho na re/ gzi 'bring rgyud la pho skyes dpa' bo mo skyes mkha' 'gro zer ba la/ngas pho skyes de 'dra mo yin/ mo skyes rang de ci 'dra byas pa'i bzhad gad kyang yod/ yer ba nas dpon sa'i drung rang de chos phyogs srid phyogs gnyis ka 'brel med phyin ci log kun gyis gzigs pa de yin/ pha ming la mi phan pa la khyim sa brlag pa chos mdzad nas kyang blo gtong sa nor ba/ rang gi zhal ngo skyes bu dam pa tsho la mi dad pa/ gdol thabs tsho la mos zhen skyes pa de ka lags mod/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sgugs la sdod ga na yod pa/ de nas tshur lam shun du zhabs drung gdung brgyud dang mjal/ tshe dbang dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ tshas snar zhag gcig gi sar rgyang nas bla chen rin po che snye thang chos rdzong —173—

nas ched kyis 'phrad par phebs byung / dpon slob rnams la dgongs bzhed ltar lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi yig lung rnams rdzogs par phul/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad la gzhis ka gong dkar du sleb/ tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin slob dpon rin po che chos kyi dbyings su sku thim pa'i gnas tshul skyel mi sleb/ de 'phral thos mchod du ra ba smad pa'i grwa tshang dang / gong dkar chos sde/khu spe/ skyed tshal 'og sogs nye skor gyi dgon sde rnams su mang ja 'byed bcas dang / dgongs rdzogs thugs dam bskul ba bgyis shing ra ba smad dang chos sder snga phyir mang ja 'gyed bcas grangs mang bar bgyis/ de 'phral nas stod phyogs myur shad 'gro rtsis yod na'ang / 'gro ba'i bsam pa btang ba nas rlung ltas log cing rmi lam du'ang da res ma phyin pa legs pa'i ltas byung ba nas/yid kyis bsams pas kyang rang gi chas rang gis zos pa tsam gyis dgongs rdzogs su 'gro rgyu cang mi 'dug pas rdzas gang yod dge 'dun gyi sde so sor mchod pa la song na legs par yang shes mod/ phyis kyi sa skya'i gdung brgyud la 'das grongs byung tsa na/ shul mchod mkhan zhal ngo des rang gis rang la 'bul ba rgya chen rang rgyag pa'i srol ni 'dug gzhan ni de 'dra ga la srid/ nged kyis de mtshams gang ci thams cad du a khu'i drung dang kun dga' chos dbyings par zhib 'then bslab ston byas shing / dgongs rdzogs kyi tshogs dbu la gtso bor brag stod nas rje btsun bla ma rin po che spyan gang 'drongs dang / gal srid spyan ma 'drongs na/ rje dam pa'i bu r+ṣa du yang ni 'dug slob dpon rin po che de nyid kyis kyang chos 'brel cung zad gsan 'dug pa/ bstan 'dzin rin po che —174—

spyan 'dren zhus na legs pa dang / da lta 'phral du gang yod rnams slob dpon rin po che de nyid rang gi mkhyen pa dang thugs rje las phyung ba yin pas thams cad gtong dgos tshul zhib rgyas su glengs nas myur shad du khong rnams brdzangs/'di skabs dgongs rdzogs kyi dngos gzhi ri khrod tshen po jo mo nang du chos lung bsam sdings byang chen so so'i dgon lag dang bcas pa rnams tshogs pa'i so sos kyang dkyil 'khor tha dad pa zhal phye zhing thugs dam bskul/ tshogs dbur rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa spyan 'dren zhus kyang phebs ma thub pas gral dbu la bsngo ba gnang bar bstan 'dzin rin po che zhag gcig spyan 'dren zhus 'dugabasngo brten gtso bor brag stong du bla ma dam pa'i drung du phul zhing / dgon lag dang bcas par mang ja 'gyed bcas kyi sku skal phud rnams phul/ grwa tshang chen mo bya rgod gshongs sa skya ngam ring bzang ldan rnams su mang ja 'gyed sogs kyi sku skal jo nang nas bgyis/ ngor snar thang gangs can bkra shis lhun po zha lu gnas dgon rnams su byang chen dang snar thang na yod pa rnams gyi steng nas lhag ma ma lus par btang / gser mdog can du gser mdog can rang na yod pa rnams kyi steng nas lugs mthun du bsgrubs shing / dpal 'khor chos sde rtse chen chos sde dga' ba gdong gnas rnying sogs nyang gi chos sde dgon gnas che phra rnams su bsam sdings na yod pa rnams kyi steng nas song ba kun bsgril stod smad thams cad du bsdoms pas nas 'gyed la khal khri tsho phyed gnyis tsam song /gzhan rnams des mtsho ni/ rim pas dbus ya ra 'brog gi dgon gnas rnams su yang rang re la bltos pa'i gang grag bgyis shing / dge sbyor thams cad kyang —175—

thugs yid dbyer med du bsre ba'i ngang nas bgyis pa'i khungs byas/ gtso bor bdag nyid bla na med pa ye shes mchog dam pa thob pa de'i tshe bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su gang bar bya yi/ gzhan du dam pa'i chos tshig gcig gi drin lan yang bskal par lon par ga la 'gyur/'dir smras pa/ 'di na tshogs gnyis gser gyi ri bo'i spor/ /nam yang chags pa'i 'dab chags rgyal po rol/ /mi mkhas chen po'i las la chung ja'i 'bras/ /shes ldan thabs la mkhas pas rgya cher spel/ /de nas zla ba de nyid kyi nang du zhal ngo so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos rnam grangs mang ba tsam phul/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la tshogs dge 'dun sgang ba'i mkhan chen rin po che shākya rin dbang gis gtso bor nan tan du mdzad pa'i don dang / gzhan yang gsol ba bdebs pa mang po'i ngor gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras tshugs par byas/ 'di skabs chos zhu ba rab smad pa shas che ba'i dge 'dun rang mang ba dang / bla ma dge ba'i bzhas gnyen mang rab dang bcas pa byung zhing / khrid dmigs bshad pa mtha' chod dang bcas pa rgyas nges pa byas/ snang gsum skabs bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang / rgyud gsum gyi skabs yig sna drug cu/ po ti dmar chung sogs kyi lung bklags shing / dgun nyi ma thung ba'i stabs lung rgya chen po rang ma song / rgyu dbang la dbang cha sum cu tsam byung zhing / yab bka' yum bka' gnyis ka'ang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor cho ga rgyas pas bzhengs thub/ dam tshig gi chos skor song mtshams rgyud gsum gyi dmigs pa ma tshugs gong der/ zhabs drung bkra shis —176—

stobs rgyas nas bka' bkod nan chags kyis/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po'i rgyal sras dang / mkhyen brtse lags gnyis car bstud mar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i tshogs dbu la yongs na ma yongs yin gsung byung bas tshes dgu'i snga chos grol nas lcags zam rtser phyin/ bkra shis stobs kyi sras che ba rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po ma ༅ / rgyal bu sku bgres pa bla ma'i drung dang yang mjal zhing dgongs rdzogs kyi sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs/ dril bu'i tshangs mgo bral ba zhig byung bas dmigs pa'i bar chad du song yid mi bde ba zhig dang rtog pa'ang za ba zhig byung ste/ phyis zhabs drung stobs drung rang myur du zhabs pad mi brtan pa'i rten 'brel du go /dgongs rdzogs grol 'phral myur shad yongs pas tshes bcu'i dgongs chos ma chag tsam thub/ 'di skabs lam 'bras kyi cha lag dbang byin rlabs thams cad rdzogs par song / ra ba smad nas drung chen 'phrin las dpal 'byor ba'i dgongs bzhed ltar sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa byas shing / zhu mkhan zhabs drung zhal ngo rnams kyis gtso mdzad pa'i 'phyong rtse dkar phibs su shong mi shong tsam byung / snga phyir bde mchog ྅ hi pa bde mchog bong zhal can bde mchog sdom 'byung / bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gsum ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs dang / bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid tshul shin tu smin pa/ gzhung bka' nyi shu dang 'brel ba'i shangs chos rnams cha tshangs ba dang / rgyud sde lnga gcig tu bsgril ba'i dbang bskur rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i steng nas/ gong ma zhal ngo rnams gtso bor —177—

phebs pa'i dbang zhu mi brgya tsam la legs par bsgrubs pa mchod gtor bsham lugs bum pa 'jog lugs tshun chod dang dab pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs shangs lugs rang gi phyag len gtsang mar byas/lam 'bras grol mtshams su de nyid bcu'i pha rol tu son pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug dge slong ye shes dbang po spyan drangs te/ chos 'brel gyi thog mar gu ru zlum po bzhi'i dbang zhus/ ye shes phab pa'i dus su sems la bde nyams chen po zhig shar/ de nub rmi lam du'ang sgrub yig nas bshad pa'i ltas rnams byung / sngar rten 'brel log pa de cung zad sor chud par snang / de nas rdo rje phur pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs nas dbang bskur stsal ba'i sta gon gyi nub rmi lam du skas ring po zhig la 'dzeg gin 'dug pas skas gdang re re la rdog pa 'jog pa dang dga' ba gcig dga' ba gnyis zhes pa nas dga' ba nyi shu tham pa'o zhes pa dang skas mgor sleb/ de na rdo rje gnod sbyin yin zer ba zhig 'dug pa la byin rlabs zhus pa zhig rmis/ drag po sgrol dbang zhus pa'i nub brag rdzong shin tu btsan pa zhig na 'dug pa'i rmi ltas shig byung / mthu btang sogs sbyor ba ngan pa byir bzlog pa'i ltas su go /gsang ba 'dus pa 'gos lugs rnying ma sa skya pa'i rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum yang brgyud pa la bzhugs pa'i chos shin tu dkon pa deng sang sa zhen che che mo kun gyis kyang rtsad ma chod pa de yang bzhugs kyin 'dug pas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor steng nas dbang rdzogs bar zhus/ lha ngo ston pa mdzad skabs dmigs pa shin tu gsal bas gzhal yas khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mngon sum —178—

du mthong ba snyam byed pa byung / phur bsrungs kyi rjes gnang sogs chos tshan thor bu 'ga' shas kyang thob/ dpon slob rnams la sa lugs kyi bde mchog lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang zhig dgos phebs pa ltar phul/ de nas zhal ngo rnams dang rin po che lha rtse ba sogs kyang karma pa mjal bar phebs song ba/ de bar zhag bcu skor zhig shin tu 'gol zhing kha 'don 'phel ba skyid par byung / 'di skabs ra ba smad pa rnams la gnas bstan bcu drug gi rjes gnang dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug bla ma rin po che ye shes dbang po dang / dge slong rdor grags/ gser gling nas bka' bcu pa ye rgyal ba sogs chos sde ba mang dag zhig la bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang / bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang / mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi bka' gtad/ lho nub mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs phul/ /'di nyid dge slong rin po che'i drung du/ bka' gdams glegs bam sbus gtsang ba zhig 'bul mkhan byung ba sogs rten 'brel legs par byung 'dug skyed tshal 'og nas chos rje grub thob pa bde mchog pū hi pa'i dbang dang lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi lung zhu bar byon byung bzhed don ltar bgyis/ yar rgyab nas de gong yang 'bod mi 'thangs len lan kha yar nan ci che che rang byung ba dang / 'di skabs skyid ru nas bgres pa 'bod mir gnang ba ltar/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bdun la skyid shongs su sleb tsam byas/ zhal ngo rnams la dgongs bzhed ltar tshe bka' dang / mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang / ras chung lugs kyi tshe khrid mgyogs khrid rnams byas/ de'i sang chos brgyad la lhun grub lha rtser 'byor/ sdod sa phun tshogs bkod kyi steng der —179—

byas/ sleb 'phral nas tshe bka' sogs kyi zhal ngo'i dgongs bzhed than thun dang / zhag shas nas grwa thang nas bla chen rin po che dpon slob rnams kyang phebs shing / rim pas 'dod chos zhu mkhan phyogs nas kyang rnam grangs mang ba rang 'dus/ gdung bu dang chos rdzong sogs nye skor de nyid la bzhugs pa'i chos zhu ba yang mang ba dang so so nas chos 'brel 'dod pa sogs kyang shin tu mang bar byung / gang ltar 'di skabs sleb nas zla gcig tsam gyi bar chos thun bzhi lnga ma chag pa dang / de mtshams nas zla ba bzhi'i bar du nyin re bzhin chos thun bcu gnyis re ma chag pa dang / mang dus su chos thun bco lnga bcu drug re yod pa'ang mang du byung zhing / bla chen rin po che'i bzhed chos kyi gtso bo shangs chos yongs rdzogs dang / ngor chen nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas yin pa 'dug pa bzhin gtso bor bsgrubs pa yin la/ gzhan so so'i don gnyer rnams la chos bshad pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ lam 'bras dang 'brel bar brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed/ slob ma rjes bzung /kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi rgyu dbang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i rgyu dbang yab/bka' lus dkyil gyi dbang dang / yum bka' lus dkyil gyi byin rlabs/sangs rgyas spyan ma/ yi ge brgya pa/ aṣ+ṭa rnams kyi bzlas lung / lam zab phyi nang / bir srung phyi nang / dbang bzhi ngo sprod/ brda don gsal ba/ sgrub pa lung byin sogs dang / snang gsum gyi skabs zab mo mdo lnga'i lung / rgyud gsum nas bzung ste/ lam 'bras glegs bam dang / thun mong ba'i yig sna bdun te yig sna drug cu/ po ti dmar chung / pod nag ma yongs rdzogs/ po ti —180—

dmar chung du ma 'dus pa yig rnying phra mo bzhi bcu tsam/ gzhung bshad smar ma rnams kyi lung / bsam mi khyab dang / phyag chen yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs/lam skor phyi ma rnams kyi lung khrid/ nai gu chos drug dang phyag chen ga'u ma tshar gnyis/ lam 'khyer gyi khrid/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyi khrid zhal shes ma/'chi med kyi khrid/ gzer gsum gyi khrid/ bdag med ma'i nang khrid/ su kha chos drug de dag dang 'brel bar bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang rgyas pa sogs/cho se drug bka' bcu/ phyag chen bka' lnga/ mkha' spyod bka' lnga/ mgon po bka' lnga/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gyi byin rlabs/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs/ mgon po'i skor ma gtogs pa'i shangs chos kyi po ti wo po gnyis tsam gyi lung / bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang / gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs/ gshed mar lha lnga/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor/ ma hā mā ya rngog lugs/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma/ mi 'khrugs pa jo bo lugs kyi dbang la sogs pa dang / snying po don gsum/ ras chung lugs kyi tshe khrid/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ nag po rim bzhi/ lha hi pa'i khrid bsdu ba gsum ldan/ 'jigs byed kyi khrid rwa rtse sems 'dzin dang / rnal 'byor bzhi pa/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i hū khrid bzhi/ ma hā mā ya'i khrid/ gshed dmar rnal 'byor bzhi rim dang / spros med kyi khrid/ rje btsun rin po che kun dga' grol mchog gi bka' 'bum po ti bzhi yongs rdzogs dang / nged rang gis brtsams chos po ti bzhi/ku ru kul+le dang rnal 'byor ma'i skor gyi po ti gcig /ri chos skor gsum sogs —181—

yang dgon pa'i gsung po ti gnyis/ zhang tshal pa'i gsung po ti gcig skyes rabs brgya rtsa rgyan gyi me tog byams chos sde lnga rnams kyi lung / mdo sde rgyan dang rgyud bla ma'i gnad 'doms kyi bshad pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bdun/ 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung bdun/ 'grel chen sgron gsal/ 'gos lo tsā ba'i stong thun chen mo dang shog ril gsum/ rim lnga mar lugs nag khrid kyi yig sna nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi lung / brtag gnyis dang bde mchog rtsa rgyud la sogs pa rgyud 'ga' yar gyi lung / de dag gi bshad 'doms don mthong ba dang bcas pa lan kha yar/ ྅ hi smad lnga/ dril bu gzhung gsum/nag po gzhung drug phag mo gzhung drug mi dbang chos gsum/ mi tri mkha' spyod kyi rgyud gzhung gsum/ ma hā mā ya la ku ku ri ba'i chos bdun/ 'gar gyi ḍi ka dang rngog pa'i bshad tshoms chen mo'i steng du rgya 'grel gyi legs bshad bsnan pa'i bshad bgros rgyas pa dang / de'i man ngag gi yi ge bcu gcig ma gcig gi gcod khrid/ birlu ba'i gshed dmar gyi gzhung brgyad/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i gshed dmar gyi yig cha phal che ba'i lung / mtshal min pa'i dge 'dun thams cad dus 'khor jo lugs kyi dbang zhu bar byon byung ba gzhan yang don gnyer shin tu mang ba dang bcas bzhi brgya tsam la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang / g.yin yang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid dam po'i phyag len dang bcas pa shin tu smin pa dang / dus zhabs snyan brgyud/ sha wa ri ba'i gzhung chung / sbyor drug brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ kun spangs chen po dang /chos rje phyogs pas mdzad pa'i sbyor drug gi yig cha phal che ba dang / gzhan yang —182—

dus 'khor bsdus rgyud/ dbang mdor bstan/ rgyud phyi ma/ don dam bsnyen pa/'jam dpal gyi lta ba 'dod mdor bstan/ 'grel chen dri med 'od/ rdo rje snying 'grel la sogs pa'i lung / sa lugs kyi mkha' spyod ma skor gsum dang /dpyal lugs phag mo skor gsum gyi byin rlabs/ thun mong gi gdams pa drug dang / khyad par gyi gdams pa bcu gcig gi khrid/ dmar po skor gsum/rnam rgyal 'joms/ pu ṭa sogs rjes gnang zur bka' mang po dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho la sgrub thabs nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe drug ste so rbe'i rjes gnang du rgya gzhung yongs rdzogs kyi lung / bsam gtan sgang gi chos rje rang gis kyang chos mang du zhus shing / khong gi grwa btsun yod bdag pho mo sogs brgya bud skor zhig la bde mchog 'khrul sbong gi dbang bskur zhig byas/ 'di dag gi bar skabs su rdze btsun dpal stag lung ba chen po'i rnam thar dang / grub chen bzhi nā tha'i rnam thar/ gsang 'dus rim lnga 'gos lugs kyi khrid yig sgrol ma 'gyung ba'i dkyil chog bla chen rin po ches bskul ba ltar dril bu rim lnga'i khrid yig sogs kyang brtsams/ yul tsho so so nas yig drug gi bzlas lung dang /sems bskyed zhu ba sogs kyang shin tu mang bar byung / de yang nged ma sleb gong du rten bzhengs kyi 'tshub cha dge skyon cher byung song ba dang / khyad par bzo bo bal bo 'ga' shas shi zhing na mkhan gsum gsum bzhi bzhi rgyun mi 'chad pa byung 'dug pa/ nged sleb nas zhag gsum tsam nas bzo 'phro rnams la bgegs skrad dang bsrung ba bzab ma zhig byas de 'phral brgya sgo'i 'gag tu mdzo gcig shi 'dug bzo bo na ba sogs 'tshub cha thams cad de nas zhi/ rdo rje gdan pas —183—

mdzad zer ba'i bstod pa'i go rim ltar bzhed pa mdzad 'dug pas/ nged sleb mtshams na slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i sku bzhengs dang 'grig 'phran bu bsgyur bkod dgos pa rnams kyi kha ta'ang zhib par bgyis/ dbyar nyi ldog gong du gtso bo la rab gnas thub tu re ba tsam byung na'ang / gtso bo'i sku rgyan la gser zho phyed nyis brgya tsam song zer ba'i bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa dang / dbu rgyan gyi rgyal ba rigs lnga g.yu byang la brko ba sogs bzo gnas zhib grags pas de bzhin ni ma grub/ de bar du chos kyi 'gro phan shin tu che bar byung /lam 'bras grol nas mi ring bar gzungs bzhugs kyi gzungs sgril ba sogs kyi bkod pa byas shing zla phyed tsam la grub/ rten bzhengs gtos ches bas de nas kyang gzungs bzhugs 'bul ran gyi bar la rgyang tsam 'dug pa dang / ston smad du song bas 'gol bar byung bas bde mchog dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa kha gso 'dra byed kyin bdun phrag gsum mtshams dam par byas/ 'di dus sngags chos rnam par dag pa 'phel ba'i dga' ston du grub thob mi dra ā na sde'i gsang yum yin snyam pa mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis dngos su a ru ra'i 'bras bu chen po snyim pa kha sbyor du cung mi shong ba zhig dang gzhan 'ga' yang byin byung ba/ sngon rje grol mchog la mkha' 'gros stsal ba de dang 'dra bar byung /de'i khu bcud mang du 'thungs pas rkang pa shin tu na ba'i rgyun de 'phral dragagazhan yang gzhi nad mang du byang / de nas kun dga' dpal bzang la bstan/de min yun ring du su la yang ma bstan no/ /de skabs yon bdag gi sar yang rgyal po'i 'tshub che ba 'dug pa dang / nged rang la'ang gzhan gyis byad ltas che —184—

ba zhig byung ba nas de la dmigs te rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drag po'i spyin bsreg cig byas/ byi lo lo dus kyi thad du rtags kyang gsal bar byung / de mtshams nas rim pas gzungs sogs kyang phul zhing / zhag po bcu bzhi la gzungs bzhugs kyang legs par grub/ zhal gser 'bul ba sogs la yang rgyun ring du thogs pa dang / de nas zla gcig tsam 'gor ba 'dug pa nas/ thog mar bgegs mi 'jug pa'i bgegs skrod rab gnas byed dgos 'dug pa/ nub gcig thog mar rab gnas la yongs dus lha rten gyi gseb de thams cad mi'i gzugs can sna tshogs pas gang ba'i gtam 'bug 'bug byed kyin 'dug rang re'i sems la da ci nas rab gnas byed pa gsang rgyur 'dug pa la ma gsang ba de ma legs da ji ltar yong ngam bsam pa zhig byung / bgegs skrod dkyus ma zhig byas pas ye rang 'gro ma nyan der tshig pa zos mi thams cad phyi la bton/yang stong pa'i gdeng dang yi dam gyi nga rgyal bskyed nas yungs kar gtor bas gzhan rnams yal/ birnya pa'i sku'i thang der 'od dkar po phub nyis 'gyur tsam zhig sgor re 'khyil ba dang / sku de yang 'phar ba'i snang ba dang 'di skad byed na khyod la zhag bdun gyi tshe las med de nas sde pa'ang 'chi khang pa 'di yang rlag par byas gtong zer ba 'od de'i dkyil nas sgra lhang lhang ba byung / rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi snyems pa'i ngang nas zhags pas bcings shing mtshon cha'i cher 'bebs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'od de'i dkyil du rdo rje 'phangs pas 'od de sil zhig pa dang da 'dir yong ri shi zer zhing nyen skad ci ring ba zhig rna bar byung / birlu pa'i sku 'dra'i dpung bar rdo rje'i shul te ma skyong gis sod/ slar —185—

bsrung ba dang rab gnas byas/ de phyin shin tu 'jam pa rang gi legs lam gyi sgo che bar byung / phyin go rten 'di ngos nas bkra shis po yong bar thag chod pa nged kyis khas longs tshul sde pa rang la'ang zhus shing de phyin chad mngon gsal du phebs lo bcu lhag gi bar la gong 'phel du song ba de yin/ skabs 'dir dang chung ngu nan chags yong dgos tshul byung ba nas khor tsam phyin pa'i zhag po bzhi song / rje lo tsā bsod rgyam pa'i dgon pa bsam gtan gling mjal/ khong rang so so'i 'dod chos tshe dbang rjes gnang dang spyan ras gzigs kyi smar khrid sogs blo dang mthun par byas de 'khor mtshams chos rje shākya bstan 'dzin rgyal rtse nas ched gtad 'bod mir gnang byung zhing / rab gnas sogs kyi stabs zhag shas sgug dgos byung bas/ de bar du mgon pod me 'bar ma'i lung dang zhal gyi gdams ngag cha tshang / khyad par bde mchog nag po pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag rgyas pa sngags rim man ngag gi gnad bcu gnyis kyi khungs chod pa la brten dgos tshul nan chags mdzad kyin 'dug pas bka' rgya'i dus kyang grol/ bshad du rung tsam gyi mtshan ma'ang byung bas chos rje'i drung dang /gzhan gnyis de gsum la man ngag de dag rim gyis bshad/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la gtso bo rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan gzims khang phun tshogs bkod du spyan 'dren mdzad pa'i rab gnas dang / de rjes su lha gzhan rnams kyang rim pas spyan drangs te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i sa chog tshes gnyis dang sta gon gyi cho ga tshes gsum la byas/ de nyin gyi 'phros dang bzhi la dkyil 'khor khru bcu gnyis —186—

pa'i tshad du bzhengs/ bzhi'i nub bdag mdun tsam gyi sgrub mchod byas shing /rgyab chog tu tshogs pa dge 'dun sgang ba dpon slob thams cad phebs pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga mdzad/ dngos cag rnams kyis tshes lnga'i tho rangs snga ba nas sgrub mchod btsugs pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga mtha' rgyas rang du bsgrubs shing / dga' ston tshogs dang bcas pas srod yol gyi bar 'gor/ slar yang nang bar dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bsdus pa dang rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga lag len mtha' rgyas kyis lha rnams mnyes par byas/ de mtshams dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i cho ga yang byas/ zhag mang por skye bo che phra'i 'du 'tshogs mang pas shin tu g.yeng che bar byung zhing / tshogs dge 'dun sgang ba dpon slob thams cad la bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs shig byas/ lha sa mjal du 'gro rgyu'i dwags po skor mi shin tu mang ba rang zhig rten gsar bzhengs rnams kyang mjal bar byung zhing / bde yangs su khong rnams la ma ṇi'i lung sogs byas/ 'di skabs khri khang nas sde pa ma chen grwa lnga'i drung gshegs pa'i gnas tshul skyel mkhan yang byung / snga sor 'khor rang gsung pa bde'ang bden pa 'dugade skabs rab gnas kyi brel ba'ang chod cing yar klungs nas 'bod mi rnams kyang dus thog tu ma byung bas/ rgyal rtsi'i 'bod mi sogs dang stabs bstun pa'i gtsang phyogs la 'phral du 'gro ba'i rtsis byas pa yin na'ang / tshes bcu bzhi la yon mchod lhan du rnam rgyal du phebs zhag gsum tsam bsdad cing /'obs gsar 'dru gnang ba la rab gnas shig kyang byas/ don gnyer 'ga' la mi g.yo bla med kyi dbang bskur zhig kyang bsgrubs/ slar yang yar lung nas —187—
