'bod mi nyin re bzhin yang gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bstud nas byung / bar 'dir chos rje bsod nams rab rgyas pa la rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ bla ma rin 'byung don yod grub pa'i tshar gsum khug pa rnams thugs 'dod ltar bgyis/ de nas lam du chas de grwa phyi rdzong du zhag gcig bsdad/yar lung kyi gzhi bdag tsho'i bsu ba'i bkod pa mang du byung / mon mkhar rnam sras gling gi skyed tshal du nang so zhal ngo rnams la sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang phyag len 'bring po'i steng nas byas/ nang par snga bar dpon khang nas yar tsam na gzhis ka zhig 'dug pa der phyin/ sras mo chung chung gnyis kyi skra bcad/ tshe dbang zhig kyang byas/ phyug po dgon pa'i bla ma sa dmar ba chos zhu'i don du nged cag dang lhan cig yar lung phyogs su byon/ chos mang du gsan/ khong rang la snga mo lung bstan zhig yod pa dang yang mthun par byung gsung gin 'dug /gtsang chung gling khar bkra shis rtse nas sde pa bsu bar phebs/ tshe chu 'bum par gnas gsar nas rje drung yang phebs/ bkra shis rtse'i chos sder bsu ba'i bkod pa gzab rgyas dang bcas sleb/ zhal ngo rnams su tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang / btsun gsar bla med gyi dbang ma thob pa rnams la thogs mar bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang zhig byas/ gzhan ྅ hi pa'i dbang cha bzhi/ dril bu pa'i dbang cha bzhi/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor steng nas nag po pa dbang cha brgyad de de rnams bgyis shing nyin gung so so'i 'dod pa'i khrid chos sna tshogs dang / spyi chos su theg pa chen po blo sbyong yongs rdzogs dang / shangs chos byin rlabs dang 'brel ba yongs rdzogs/ dril bu rim lnga'i khrid bshad pa —188—

dang bcas pa/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i lung ci rigs pa dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ dgyes rdor rgyud gsum/ sdom gsum rab dbye sogs kyi lung dang /dgongs phyogs rags bsdus rnams la nag po rim bzhi dang / kū hi pa'i khrid dang / don gnyer 'ga' la sngags rim man ngag gi gnad chen bcu gnyis snyan brgyud ma rnams byas shing / nyi ma nub nas srod kyi cha la don gnyer mang dag la sgrol ma'i chos skor rgya gar nas gsar du bsgyur pa rnams bgyis pa 'di'i rim pa la/ slob ma rjes bzung / rig pa gtad pa/ slob ma sta gon/ dngosagazhi thun mong gi dbang / thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang /gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bzhi par bcas pa rnams la zhag re re byed pa dbang bskur nub bdun ma dang / he ru ka lha dgu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang sogs byin rlabs dang / rjes gnang mang po dang / rgyud kyi gzhung shing las 'byung ba rnal 'byor bzhi'i rdzogs rim rgyas pa dang / zur bkol man ngag shin tu zab pa rnams dang / rtsa rgyud rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i lung tsam bgyis/ yum bu bla mkhar mjal bar yang khor tsam phyin/ ltag gi ri sgang der skye bo 'du tshogs che ba la yig drug gi lung dang / tshur lam sa paṇa gyi chos khri'i steng nas/ gang blo ma'i byin rlabs de byas/ de nyin skyes pa gzhon nu dkar po gcig pha tshad nas chos nyan gyin 'dug mi rtsa khams dwangs pa gzhan 'ga' res kyang mthong / de yar lha dngos su gda'/ tshogs pa thams cad la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba rgyas par bsgrubs/ rje lcags nang pa dpon slob tsho'ang nged 'phrad par phebs pa/ nai gu'i skyu lus dbang mo che byed pa dang 'dzom —189—

nas nga zhu ba mdzad song / bar 'dir chos lung rab brtan nas chos mdzad byams rin pas yong dgos tshul nan chags mdzad pa ltar phyin/ khong dang thugs yid 'dre zhing skyid par byung bas zhag bzhi bsdad/ btsun gsar dang btsun gsar ma byed mkhan yang 'ga' yar byung / khong rang dpon slob dang yon bdag drag bsdus 'dra la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang dngos sta sbrel ma dang / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ tshe dbang / mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang sogasabyas/ sgrub chu'i chu mig gsar pa zhig 'dug pa la rab gnas shig la phyin/dgun grang sgang de nyid la nas rnams la ljang ba dang snye ma thon 'khru chags pa tsam byung 'dug zhag bzhi song ba'i snga dro mi dmangs la tshe dbang zhig kyang byas/yang bkra shis rtse'i chos sder rje drung gnas gsar pa'i drung dge bshes 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa la/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang phyag len rgyas pa dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ thob thang min kyang 'jig rten ngo srung gi dbang las sde pa yab sras kyang de la yod/ chos sde'i bde yangs chen mo der khrom dbang zhig dang / bsam yas pa'i rab 'byams pa ston pa grags pa sogs mang dag la thugs rje chen po'i smrar khrid sogs bshad/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la mkhar thog tu phebs sgo ltar phyin/ theg bdun tsam bsdad cing tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ bde mchog gi dbang / dgongs bzhed kyi rjes gnang mang dag dang / thugs rje chen po'i smyung gnas/ sgrol dkar kyi tshe khrid sogs phul zhing / mchod gnas gnas brtan pa 'ga' shas la snying po don gsum gyi khrid cig byas/ mi dmangs rnams la yig drug sogs chos 'ga' re —190—

bshad cing / dpon g.yog sku 'khor sogs shin tu mang ba la thugs rje chen po'i smrar khrid cig kyang byas/ tshes bcu la g.yo ru khra 'khrug mjal bar phyin/de 'phral phyogs bzhi nas 'dus pa'i mi 'tshogs shin tu che ba rang byung ba nas nges 'byung gis rgyud bskul ba'i gtam las drangs te ma ṇi'i lung zhig bgyis/de nyin pho brang sne'u gdong rtser sleb pa zhabs drung gdung brgyud dang mjal/de'i sang nyin nas chos 'bul ba'i 'go tshugs shin tu thugs snang dag pa rang gnang / thog mar tshe dbang brgya tshar dang rjes gnang mang dag phul/ tshes bcu drug la rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ thog mar zhabs drung sras yum la dbang yongs su rdzogs pa zhig dang / de rjes dbang cha gnyis pan zhig byas / de dag grol mtshams nas gzims khang po ṭa la zer ba'i 'tshom der zhal ngo rnams gtso bor phebs shing / g.yin yang don gnyer mang dag dang bcas pa'i dbang mi drug cu bdun cu la dpal rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum ste dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe lnga po'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / 'jigs byed rwa lugs/bde mchog nag po pa/ bde mchog lha lnga rnams kyi dbang dang / phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid shin tu smin pa dang / nai gu'i khrid sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang yongs rdzogs/ mgon po zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi drug dam can chos kyi rgyal po rnams kyi rjes gnang / zhabs drung gdung brgyud sku rkyang du phyag bzhi pa'i gsang khrid lugs tha dad sna tshogs dang bcas pa sogs chos bka' rnam grangs mang bar phul/ tshogs chen pa'i tshogs pa rnams kyang 'phrad par phebs —191—

thams cad kyi chos 'brel zhus song / tshogs pa'i nang nas sa lugs pa gtso che ba rnams la sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang byas/ de skabs lo gsar gyi skabs dang 'dzoms pas gral dbur yang shog phebs pa ltar phyin/ bar skabs shig do sngon du 'bod mi nan che bar byung ba ltar zhag shas sdod rtsis kyi 'gro 'dod tsam na yod skabs/ byang stag lung du zhabs drung grog kha pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gtso bo la yong dgos tshul gyi 'bod mir dbon po skyabs grol 'byor pas/ do sngon du zhag gcig las sdod skabs ma byung / sleb pa'i nyin mo nyid dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dbang dang / tshe rta sbrags ma sogs zhal ngo rnams su bzhed kyi chos dang / rtse thang gi dge 'dun phal cher zhig 'dus pa la sman bla'i rjes gnang sogs dang / gzhan yang phyag g.yog rags bsdus la tshe dbang dang / so so'i 'dod chos zhu ba shin tu mang zhing /rab gnas zhu mi mang ba dang / ja 'dren dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa sogs byung / thub pa gser gling ma spyan drangs phyag mchod smon lam rgyas pa phul/sang nyin yang skya ser gyi skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus pa la ma ṇi'i lung dang so sor dbang bka' rjes gnang mang dag dang bcas pa bsgrubs nas/ slar yang sne gdong rtser chos bka' 'phros 'phran bu yod pa rnams phul zhing / tshogs chen mo ba'i sa lugs pa rnams la bzhed pa ltar kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang cha gnyis pa zhig byas/ de nas tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin skyel ma'i tshogs shin tu mang pos gling kha'i bar du skyel ma mdzad/ de nub kyang rnam sras gling gi skyed tshal der bsdad 'dod chos than thun bshad cing / btsun gsar ma byed mi —192—

shin tu mang ba byung / sang nyin me long gdan sa pa rang 'bod par byung ba'i bzhin me long dgon par byin/ tshe dbang sogs chos than thun dang / grwa rigs thams cad la 'du khang der bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig chos 'brel du byas/ grwa thang gi thang du bla chen rin po che'i drung yang 'phrad par phebs byung zhing / gzhan yang mi tshogs che ba rang 'dug pas chos 'brel zhig byas/ de nub lhun grub lha rtser sleb/ chos rje sked srong pa la dpyal lugs kyi phag mo skor gsum dang phag mo gzhung drug gi lung byas gzhan yang chos than thun bshad/ dol mda'i gru thon nas lam bsrangs te lho ngos su dpon sa'i drung dang mjal/ glang thang gzims khang du yud tsam phyin/ lhun grub rdzong du stag lung nas sde pa'i drung dar yang mjal bslab ston than thun 'dra yang zhus/ sang nyin stag lung thang du sleb pa'i gzims spyil du bsdad cing / de'i gnangs nyin skyabs mchog dam pa rje btsun dpal stag lung pa chen po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung du mjal bar phyin/de gong bar skabs su mgur cham 'khrugs pa glo tshad kyi rnam par song ba'i sku khams dub pa rang zhig byung 'dug pa sku rim sogs gnang ba'i sku khams bde mus kyi skabs na 'dug cing / de skabs kyang sku mtsham me ba 'dug pas nyin re bzhin nyung bsdus kyis zhal mjal zhus/ grog khar sku gdung sku gzhogs su dngos cag nyi shu skor gyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub mchod re bto / rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa/ lha dgu ma brgya rtsa 'chi blu'i cho ga dang bcas pa sku rim du bsgrubs shing / tshes bcu drug gi —193—

nyin dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi byung / 'di skabs chos khri thang du stag lung rang gi dgon pa bu cha lag dang bcas pa tshogs shing nyan po dang rin chen brag gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa yongs bsgril tshogs pa nyis stong tsam tshogs shing /dngos kyis sa khri dmar po'i steng du bsdad/ stag lung rang gi tshogs kyi bca' ba bcu gsum gyi rim pa dang 'brel bar mdzad/ dgongs rdzogs kyi dngos po gzhal bar dka' ba byung / dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i mchod bsngo rgyas par phul/ rtse nas sprul pa'i skur rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang dang / mi g.yo rnal 'byor bla med sogs dgongs bzhed ltar phul zhing / dngos kyis kyang lha lnga'i dbang sogs chos bka' mang dag zhus/ 'di skabs bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyas sku mi brtan pa'i ltas kyang gsal bar shes nas zla bo rnams la ma gsang par bshad/ slar yang rnam rgya'/ rab brtan tu zhabs drung rin po che cung zad sku khams zi ba'i stabs nas sku gzhogs su phyin/ sku shin tu dub pa'i rnam pa 'dug pas de nyin rang brtan bzhugs phul ba de 'phral rang nas sku khams bde ba'i rnam pa mngon par byang zhing / dge 'dun dam tshig gtsang ba rnams kyis bskang gso tshe gzungs sogs sku rim rgya cher sgrub pa'i bkod pa'ang bgyis/ sku che'i rten 'brel gyi dbang rjes gnang kyang nyin re bzhin phul/ 'di skabs mtshams bcad ma thub na'ang zhag shas bsnyen pa kha gso'i tshul du byas/de mtshams bla mas bka' phebs pa bzhin sku rim du dmigs pa'i drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog sgrub pa'i sngags thun gsung mi 'chag dang bcas pa blos longs par bgyis shing / gtor ma 'phangs pa'i tshe dmigs pa gsal zhing phyi rlung —194—

ltas la sogs pa yang legs par byung / de nub pha rol gyi dmag sde bcom pa sogs rmi lam gyi ltas kyang bzang / nang bar bka' phebs la mdang gtor ma mar khyer song ba tsam la sku khams kyang yang chod chod 'gro ba'i rnam pa gsal khyad thon pa byung zhing / nub mo gnyid kyang shin tu bde ba rang byung / da khams dga' mo yong ba 'dug phebs kyi 'dug pa bzhin thog tu khel/ de nas kyang zhag shas kyi bar du dbang chos 'dra phul/ spyir sku gzhogs su rgyang tsam bsdad na dgongs pa'ang 'dug cing / dngos kyang bla ma'i sku drung rang du sdod pa la yid dang spro bar yod na'ang / sne gdong rtser sdod dus ngam ring nas 'bod mir gser khang pa tshe ring 'byor pa 'di skabs kyang rkang btsugs su bsdad yod pas/kho bas dgos med kyi skul cag spro thung rang byed pas de kha'i stabs nas bka' phebs la yang da lam gang myur 'gro ba las 'os med phebs shing / de mthun gyi hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu dgu la sku gzhogs nas thon pa'i lhag par yang bla ma kho na yid la byed bzhin pas nyin dang mtshan du 'da' bar gyur to/ /'dir smras pa/ da lta'i smra dbang 'bum phrag brgya dag kyang / /gang gis mdun sar mi smra'i brtul zhugs can/ /rang la ma chags tshig gi bdud grol ba/ /brjod bral lam du 'jug 'di ngo mtshar rma do/ /de nas de nyin dog sar 'phos glang thang du zhag gsum pa zhig bsdad/ kyai rdor gyi dbang zhig kyang byas/ slar 'phan yul gyi gzhung bskor te glang rar zhag gcig dang / de nas lto ngos su phyin tshe dbang sogs chos than thun phul/bdag po bkras stobs drung sku 'das pa'i gtam yang 'dir khyer byung / nang —195—

par ra sa 'phrul snang du sleb/ zhag shas phyag mchod sogs 'phel bar byung /zhal gser zhig kyang phul/ bar skor la dkon gnyer dpon gyis zhig gsos byed kyin 'dug pa rta gsum sogs zang zong mang dag zhig gsos kyi thes la btang / lha sa nas snga bar yongs te sbu ba gdong du skyid shod nas sde pa'i drung dang mjal tsam byas/ rim pas gzhis ka gong dkar du 'byor ba'i 'di skabs zhag nyi shu rtsa gsum bsdad cing / zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po ches de gong bla med kyi dbang ma gsan pas da lam dbang bskur mang tsam zhig kyang dgos pa 'dug cing / khyad par dkon cing byin rlabs che bar 'dug pas rje btsun mar pa'i bzhed pa las 'byung ba ltar gyi dbang bskur rnams dgos phebs ba ltar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje rtsa rgyud kyi yab bka' lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang / yum bka' bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur nas 'gyung ba rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor/ dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lnga/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' lha dgu bcu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor/ drug po de rnams mar rngog gi phyag bzhes gtsang ma phyag len shin tu dag pa dang dbang bshad chun yang gzhan dang ma 'dres par bgyis/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang bskur ba rgya gzhung nyid kyi rjes su 'brang de bsgrubs/ skyid shongs nas rab gnas la yong dgos tshul nan chags byung ba ltar phyin zhing / sleb pa'i nyin mo nyid rab gnas nyin gcig ma'i cho ga bgyis/ sang nyin so sor dgongs bzhed kyi chos rnam grangs mang tsam phul zhing / sras mo zhig gis rab byung yang sgrub par mdzad/ slar —196—

yang gzhis kar chos kyi 'phro rnams phul/ lhun rab pa'i zhal ngo rnams btsan mdo'i mdun der 'phrad par phebs shing gang ci'i gzhis len sogs bzab ma rang mdzad/ dza la dmar po sogs rjes gnang 'ga' shas dang tshe dbang sogs byas/ 'brang phu dgon par sleb nas mi ngo rnams la yang tshe dbang sogs 'ga' zhig byas/ rang gi lhan cig gnas pa 'ga' la sgrol ma 'dus pa don dam pa'i rgyud rdzogs par bshad cing / chos rje grub thob pa yang skyed tshal 'og gi mkhan por phebs pa'i nged la 'phrad pa dang chos 'dra zhu ba la byon byung / lhun rab nas sde pa bla ma'i thugs 'dod ltar bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang dang / snying po don gsum gyi khrid sogs bzhed chos rnams byas/ de rjes su yol ba mkhan chen yang chos zhu bar ched kyis phebs byung ba/ bzhed don gyi gtso bo lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid yin 'dug pa bzhin/ phyag rgya chen po mchod rten drung thob kyi khrid de 'phral nas btsugs shing / sa 'dir zab pa'i tshul dgu lhan cig skyes grub/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yi ge med pa rnams grub cing / lhag ma rnams 'brog stag lung du byas pa yin/ yol mkhan chen dang nged rang gi lhan cig gnas pa dge bshes 'ga' shas la ma hā mā ya'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u gsum pa'i rgyud bshad zhib pa zhig kyang byas/ 'di skabs zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bsdad cing / de mtshams nas yar sris/ sna dkar rtse rnams brgyud nas yar 'brog stag lung du hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco lnga la sleb/ tshe dbang rjes gnang sogs sleb 'phral nas dbu tshugs shing / sde pa khu dbon rang la tshes bco brgyad nas lam 'bras zhig kyang 'go tshugs/ 'di skabs khu dbon gnyis —197—

ma gtogs gzhan la mi byed pa'i rgyun mtshan yang myur du rdzogs par byed dgos byung ba'i dgag dgos kyi dbang las yin zhing / hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la grol zla gcig zhag nyi shu tsam song / lam 'bras glegs bam man ngag phra mo po ti yongs rdzogs/ lam skor phyi ma dang bcas pa rnams song /man ngag lugs kyi rgyud dbang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten de dbang cha gnyis tsam zhig kyang bgyis/ khu dbon drung rang du lus dkyil yab bka' yum bka' gnyis/ lam zab phyi nang gnyis/ bir bsrung phyi nang la sogs pa lam 'bras kyi byin rlabs rnams kyang cha tshang bar phul/ zhal ngo rtse rgyas dang /gzhan yang gzhi byes kyi don gnyer so so dang bcas pa la man ngag lugs kyi bdag med ma/ kyai rdor ḍom+bi lugs/ mtsho skyes lugs/ nag po lugs la he ru ka bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbang ste bka' babs lhag ma de rnams ras bris kyi dkyil snyen ra la brten te bgyis/ zhal ngo thams cad dang don gnyer mang dag la phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid shin tu smin pa zla chos shig bgyis shing / zhal ngo mna' rnyid sogs la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhig byas pas/ sta gon gyi skabs su srin lag nas khrag dang brdol ting chung zhig khengs pa tsam byung / dbang mi drug cu tsam la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs shig kyang bgyis/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rdul rdzo gyi dkyil 'khor tshen po bzhengs te/ zhal ngo bzhi sogs dbang mi dgu tsam la dbang nyin bdun ma'i phyag len rdzogs pa dang rgyud kyi lung yang bgyis/ zhal ngo rnams la rnam rgyal lha mang / gza' yum nor rgyun ma ste dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor —198—

gsum gyi dbang yang phul/ gnas bcu'i zhal thang chen mo gsar bzhengs la rab gnas byas pas gnas brtan lam phran brtan dang / rgyal chen mig mi bzang gis me tog bzhes/ gzhan yang rang re'i gra slob 'ga' shas la dza lan+ta ra'i do he'i man ngag rgyas pa tshar gnyis dang / mig g.yo bla na med kyi khrid sogs dang / snga sor hor zla gnyis pa'i 'go rang nas bka' babs bdun ldan gyi man ngag bshad pa'i 'go brtsams pa skabs 'dir mthar phyin pa tsam byung / de nas re zhig de phyogs kyi brel ba chod pa'i lugs su byas te/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gcig la lam du zhugs/ gnam grur sleb skabs rgya gar kyi kla kle'i chos lugs 'dzin pa dar bhe sha gcig dang 'phrad sems ma dga' se ba zhig byung / phugs rgyal rtser mi legs pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug rim pas brgyud de rgyal rtser 'byor/ thog mar rkyen sel gyi dbang chos 'dra phul zhing so so'i bzhed ltar bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang / 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor/ mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dbang / bdag po rgyal ba'i drung dang smar khrid dang phyag chen ga'u ma/zhal ngo spyi khyab tu spros med kyi khrid sogs chos kyi rim pa rnams 'phel bar byung zhing / bar skabs der 'brong rtse brgyud nas 'dol byung la phyin pa/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po dang gshin rje gshed gdong drug gi dbang bskur/ gzhan yang dgongs bzhed kyi chos sna mang du bgyis/ lha sdings su sngar yang yang 'gro ba bzhin 'di res kyang phyin/ dbon chen lhun grub bzang po rang gis mo la btang / da thod pa nam 'bogs cha mi 'dug pas shi ba byung na —199—

dgon chung 'di la'ang thugs rjes gzigs zer/ mnga' bdag rgyas mo'i sku gdung zhugs 'bul byed dgos stabs slar rgyal rtser phyin/ gam pa nas bdag po'i drung yang phebs 'dug pa tshe dbang brgya tshar dang / bde mchog nag po ba'i dbang zhig kyang phul/ tshes bdun gyi dgongs mo rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i spyin sreg gi cho ga la brten te gdung 'od bzhu byas zhugs 'bul shin tu legs shing dbu thog ril por byon pa'i rnam pa byung / dpon sa yid lags drung dpon g.yog bcu skor la nai gu'i mgyogs khrid sgyu lus dbang mo che dang bcas pa dgongs bzhes ltar phul/ de nas rtse chen du phyin theg shas 'gor/ dgongs bzhed kyi chos 'dra phul/ rang res stag lo chos sde'i khur bzhag pa de phyin chad chos sder ci yang ma phyin pas 'di skabs 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i dngul gdung la byin rlabs zhu bar phyin/ rang gnas bsam gtan sdings su sleb/ sgrub sde ba rnams la nai gu 'bring po zhig bshad cing / 'jag nas rin po che sprul sku dpon slob rnams dang sman thang blo bzang pa yang 'phrad par byon byung / thugs dgongs ltar gyi chos 'dra byas/ gser mdog can nas shangs ba slob dpon pa chos khrims dang bcas pa nged yong dgos tshul la phebs byung zhing ma hā mā ya'i dbang bskur zhig kyang bzhed pa ltar byas/ skabs 'dir bsam sdings su zla phyed tsam song / hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gsum la spa mnam rdzong du 'ongs/ nang par rje grub thob karma pa dgu pa yang phebs pa'i sku gzhogs mjal bar phyin zhag bzhi'i bar du nyin re bzhin mjal ba'i chos 'brel gyi thog mar sku gsum ngo sprod chos thun gcig la 'dus pa zhig —200—

gnang zhing / sngon grub thob pa gshis kyang o rgyan pa la chos thams cad kyi don brgyud gtad pa'i chos 'brel dngos su stsal ba ni 'di kho na yin 'di gsan pas karma kam tshang gi chos thams cad don gyis gsan pa yin no gsung /gzhan yang lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid thun gcig la tshang ba zhig dang / sgrub thabs zab pa 'ga' shas dang / tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub/rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang / ber nag can gyi gtor dbang bla ma'i rnal 'byor thugs la shar ba gcig sogs dgyes bzhin du stsal/ snga phyir thugs su byon pa'i bka' lung bag phebs par gnang / de mtshams tshong 'dus su phyin pa'i zhag bdun bsdad cing / 'di skabs rje karma pa dbang phyug rdo rjes dngos la bstod pa brtan bzhugs spron lam blo ka gsum pa zhig ched gtad skyel bar gnang byung / dge bshes nor bu dpal bzang pa la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs pad ma dra ba'i dbang bskur zhig kyang byas/ so so'i 'dod pa dang bstun pa'i chos gzhan yang mang du bgyis/ de nas dkar po la la brgyud nas chos grwa chen po gser mdog can du phyogs/ la rtsa nas mkhan slob rnams kyang bsu ba la phebs/ dge 'dun rnams kyi ser bsgrengs bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te 'byor/ bkra shis brtsegs pa mkhan slob sogs rags bsdus la 'khor lo bde mchog sdom 'byung lha bcu gsum ma dang / sgrol ma bla med ma'i dbang zhig byas/ shangs pa grwa tshang du yang mkhan slob sogs drag bsdus la 'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dbang / rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dbang /rjes gnang 'ga' zhig rnams bgyis/ tshogs chen la rjes gnang zur bka' nyi —201—

shu tsam dang / gsang 'dus rim lnga 'gos lugs kyi khrid/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar zhib mo rnam dag gi chos 'khor yan chad tsam gyi lung sogs dang / mkhan slob rnams la rim lnga mar lugs kyi khrid yongs rdzogs dang /spyod bsdus sgron me'i lung sogs phul/ 'di skabs rtse chen nas dpon sa'i drung shin tu bsnyung ba'i 'phral sleb dgos tshul phebs byung na'ang / sku khams skyon mi yong ba'i khag theg da lam mi yong zhuganas ma phyin/ 'bod mi yid ma tshes byed kyin 'dug na'ang phyis de ka ltar byung / de nas bsam grub rtser sde pa sku gzhon pa'i drung dang / sras yum rnams su dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang bskur ba dang / dkyil 'khor de nyid la brten te zhal thang 'ga' zhig la rab gnas kyang bgyis shing dga' ston tshogs 'khor kyang dpe med byung / 'di skabs rab gnas kyi seng bar la dkar me zhig dar yol la mched/rnam pa gcig tsam tshig rtog pa za bar byung / yon bdag tshor thugs rtog byung dogs dar de ka 'dra bas spos pas sus kyang ma rig gzhan yang tshe bka' sogs dgongs bzhed ltar phul nas/ dpal snar thang du zhag lnga tsam bsdad pa'i yab yum so sor chos than thun dang / sde pa'i drung du slob dpon sa byā na tha nas brgyud pa'i he ru ka'i byin rlabs shig kyang dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ chos kyi gsung gleng 'phel bar byung / chu mig gi sgrol ma dang byams pa sogs rten rnams la phyag mchod rgyas par byas/ byang chen du 'byor pa'i dgon pa byang du khrom dbang zhig byas pa mi tshogs kyang che/ sgrub sde rnams la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang smar khrid zhig bzhad/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang / mi —202—

'khrugs pa jo bo lugs kyi dbang bskur zhig kyang byas shing / de gnyis kyi cho ga 'dzugs pa'i bkod pa'ang de dus byas pas myur stabs tshugs/ de nas rim pas lam bsrangs stag la'i la thog nas thal rlung chen po rang gcig byung / re shig stod phyogs ma 'gro zer ba'i brdar 'dug ri khrod chen po jo mo nang du 'byor ma thag dpon sa rgyal drung gis ja 'dren bzab ma zhig byung / gzhan ni gang yang med byang gi spyan 'dren pa ni ldog de'i sang nyin rang nas dus khrid zhig kyang btsugs/ 'di skabs gtam gsar pa'i snga ltas shig dang rmi lam gyi 'char sgo gsal ba 'dra byung bas/ rgyun sdod kyi zla bo thams cad la gtam gsan chen po zhig yong ba 'dug smras pa ltar/ de 'phral rje dbang phyug rdo rje zhing rjes song / sngon 'gro'i ring la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang byas/khrid 'dzugs pa 'phyis pa'i stabs khrid gsar pa mi nag pa'i rigs mang po ma byung na'ang / khrid gsar pa grwa pa byis pa 'dra dang btsun gsar ma rang lnga bcu tsam yang byung zhing / gzhan yang las dang po rnams dang bcas pas dam po 'debs mkhan mang rab byung / sngar khyud kyi phyag len ltar dus chos shin tu smin par byas/ sngon 'gro'i skabs shig rmi lam du slob dpon pad+ma yin zer ba'i sku'i rnam pa shin tu gsal ba zhig dang / de la gus pas bstod pa zhig kyang byas pa sad nas ma brjed par yi ger bris/ de nyin gu dra'i sku 'dra zhig kyang ster mkhan byung / yang rgyal ba mi phams pa babs pa yin zer nas chos ci yang zhig bshad kyin 'dug gnyid sad tsa na gzhan mi dran sher snying dngos po brgyad dang sbyar nas zugad pa de blo la ram me 'dug phyir mi ldog pa 'khor —203—

lo'i gtam la snying thag pa nas nges shes lhang nger shar/ kun mkhyen rton pa bzhi ldan chen po'i byin rlabs kyi 'jug sgo yin par mngon/ khrid grol nas zla phyed tsam mtshams dam par bcad/ de mtshams bsam 'grub rtse nas dpon sa'i drung chab tshan gyi zhor la mtshed du mjal ba dang / de mthun jo nang du yang phebs pa'i rten mjal sogs zhib mor gnang / sgrub sder nas khal lnga brgya gnang / de rjes su yang zla gcig tsam mtshams dam par byas/ de yang de gong phag byi glang gsum gyi lo la nyams kyi rtsal chu ltar 'khrug pa thun mong gi yon to mang po skye skye 'dra ba yod/ stag lo yang de'i rgyud phyogs 'dra tsam byung /yos lo 'di nas de yang rim pas yal zhun mar rtseg chod pa na khol mi yong ba dang 'dra ba nyams sangs nas rtogs pa nyag gcig mnyam nyid du song snyam pa'i dga' dga' 'dra mo zhig snang na'ang phugs ni lo gong ma gsum bzhi de la 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis dbang du song nyams kyi rtsal phyogs med du sbyong ba ma byung bas dus la bab pa'i rten 'brel las yol dge sbyor la bogs ma thon pa kho na'i skyon du snang / 'dis rang don dang gas don gnyis ka la skyon chen po zhugs te/ re shig brjod pa'i gnas med do/ /de skabs gting skyes nas sde pa ma chen drung sku khams kyang ltems yun ring ba dang / sku zhud sogs sku dog gi rnam pa che ba 'dug pas 'phral sleb dgos tshul byung ba/ de mtshams chos lung byang rtser khor tsam phyin chu ser gyis pus mo na ba la phan du re ba'i chu tshan zhag lnga tsam bsten/ sgrub sde rnams la rtsa dbu ma'i khrid cig bshad cing dbang rjes gnang 'ga' bsgrubs/ nged dbus na yod dus ngam ring nas mi sna gnang —204—

ba'i rten sgam zhal 'byed lan gnyis tsam mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu gcig kyang ma lus 'dug grwa pa rnams kyang rten mjal ma myong ba sha stag yin pas rten sgam zhal 'byed byas pas sngar gyi sa na med pa gnyis gsum zhig snang / nged rang dol du mtshams bcad skabs mkha' 'gros stsal ba'i sman mchog dbang po'i 'bras bu de yang / snga phyi'i rten 'brel 'ga' la rten sgam du bzhugs su gsol/ de nas gtsang mgo gnyis mar tshe dbang rjes gnang gang 'os dang /gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang zhig dang khrom dbang zhig kyang byas shing / nyin gcig bde mchog rtser phyin pa'i bka' brgyad lha khang la rab gnas dang tshogs khang du bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig kyang byas/ de nas yar lam dgon pa 'bras sbungs kyi mdun der/ 'bras sbungs gdan sa pa shāka mchog pa'i drung dang dge 'dun rnams dngos la 'phrad par phebs byung / de nub khyung dkar zhol du sleb/ sang zhogs lha rtse rdzong dbon gnyis rang la tshe dbang zhig dgos zer ba byas dus nyi ma gza' 'dzin byung ba'i mun shin tu nag par song ba phyis dam sel chen por 'gro ba'i rten 'brel du snang / de nas bde gling du sleb/ gnas pa bcu'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas byas/ rim pas mkhar chen du 'byor zhing /sde pa rin po che'i drung yang sku khams yar sor byung 'dug mo lon sogs cung zad rtsub ba la brten pa'i dgongs bzhed ltar sde pa ma chen sku rkyang du tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya tshar gnyis dang / dze ta ri'i lugs brgya tshar/ dpal mgon po'i rjes gnang tshar lnga bcas/ sleb nas mi ring bar mchod yon lhan rgyas kyi khul nas brag stod du rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa spyan 'dren du btang / zhang 'brug —205—

sgra'i sgrub gnas gdong khra blta bar phyin/ de na dgra nag gi dkyil thang rgya gar ma yin nges ri mo legs nyes 'bring tsam la chud zos shin tu che bas mngon mi mngon tsam du song ba zhig 'dug de la bltas dus la li ta'i gshin rje gshed 'byung ba'i dgongs pa zhang lugs pa rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i rnam gzhag la nges shes skye bar byung / bar 'dir rngam pa shin tu na bas zhag gnyis tsam chos mtshams byas/ de nas don gnyer so sor bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang / 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang dang / rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi khrid dang / nai gu'i khrid rkyang zhig dang / mi g.yo bla med kyi dbang / zhal ngo rnams la gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang /drag po'i rjes gnang mang dag dang bcas pa so so sgos kyi 'dod chos thang thung rnam grangs sna tshogs dang / khrom dbang sems bskyed dang bcas pa zhig kyang bgyis/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'ang spyan 'dren zhus pa ltar hor zla bzhi pa'i nyer lnga la mkhar chen du zhabs zung 'god pa gnang / yid kyi gdung ba thams cad dbyings su thim thugs yid dbyer med brjod bral mkha' mnyam khyab bdag chen po'i rang zhal lta ba ni nam yang yong mod kyi mdor na sku rnam pa thams cad pa ye shes kyi rang snang rgyal ba kun gyi sku'i rdo rje dang / gsung gzhom med sgra skad thams cad pa sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi rang bzhin mig dang rna ba'i bdud rtsir gyur pa nyid kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub gzhan la gus pa dbyings su yal te 'di nyid kho na bdag dang 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i gtan gyi nyer 'tsho'o/ /zhes pa 'di 'ba' zhig yid la —206—

byed pa dang nyin dang mtshan du nang gi dga' ba dang bde bas khyab par gyur to/ /skabs 'dir gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa'i rim pa ni/ gling gi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs bdag nyid kyis myur bar bklags te 'phar lung du zhus/ ro snyoms chen mo yongs su rdzogs pa'ang thob/ gtso bor bdag nyid kyis ji ltar mngon du bgyis pa las brtsams te/ nyin re bzhin du yang yang du zhus pa de dang de'i 'phrang sgrol ba dang gong nas gong du khyad par du bogs dbyung ba'i bka' drin stsal ba ni bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig yod do/ /'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bcu gcig pa sbyar ro/ /de nas dngos la bla ma dam pas rten 'brel gyi gnad yod ces phebs nas brtan bzhugs shig kyang gnang / tshe dbang brgya tshar gyi bka' drin yang stsal zhing / da lam chos thams cad kyi don gyi dbang bskur thob pa'i dbang dgongs pas bcad pa zhig gnang dgos zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpal 'khore lo bde mchog slob dpon spyod pa pa'i bzhed srol ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang /de nyid kyi mthar bdag phyogs kyi gos can phyag rgya drug la sogs pa'i he ru ka'i chas rnam par bkod de/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi rjes su gnang ba shin tu rgyas par stsal/ rigs kyi bdag po nyid kyis bdag la rab gnas kyi me tog kyang mthor bar gnang / bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang gi don yang 'di la 'doms par 'dug ga ṇa tsa kra'i dga' ston yang nyams su myong ste/ e ma ho/ da ni khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen pos ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa lta bu'i rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyang ci'i phyir spyod par —207—

mi nus zhes dbugs phyung / rnam pa brgya phrag du mas mngon par mtho ba'i gzings bstod par yang gyur to/ /'dir rdo rje'i gnas pa bcu gnyis pa sbyor ro/ /bcu gnyis po 'di dag bod sgom rnams kyi gsung ltar na nyams yin kyang 'dra/ rtogs pa yin kyang 'dra/ gang yin kyang khyad med/ 'char sgo de dang de 'dra gcig ni byung ba lags so/ /smras pa/ sngar ma shes rnams ci yang go /go ba tsam yin na'ang yin du chug /myong yang myong bya dang myong byed stor/ /'di ma shar bya ba gag kyang med/ /nyams yin zhes gsung na'ang gsung bar zhu /rang bzhin la 'gyur ba med par rtogs/ /rtogs pa la yid du re ba med/ /yin zer na'ang 'gal ba mi 'dug go /sa bcu gnyas dag pa'i gnas pa 'di/ /nga sgyu ma'i skyes busathob par 'dod/ /don thob bya thob byed dbyings su yal/ /tshig smra brjod bral ba a la la/ /'jig rten 'di ni spros pa'i rjes su 'jug /gzhan dag spros bral tshig gis mtshone par 'dod/ /spros dang spros med ro mnyam gyur pa dag /don dam gnas na ci bder gnas zhes thos/ /de nas dpal ldan bla ma dam par dka' drin rjes su dran pa'i yon mtshon byed tsam phul te/ brtan bzhugs rgyas pa'i sgo nas zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba btab bo/ /snga sor stag lo'i nang du sku khams bsnyel ba'i tshul bstan pa de 'di'i bar du 'phro lus pa'i rnam pa phyag yul cung zad mi bde ba dang sku khams kyang bying pa'i rnam pa 'dug phebs pa zhig yod na'ang / brtan bzhugs phul ba 'di las brtsams te sku khams shin tu dwangs shing sku gzugs —208—

shin tu bzang ba rang du gyur pa 'dis kyang mos pa'i dge ba rnam par dag pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa brtan pa yin no/ /'di skabs bzang ldan chos sde nas slob dpon bkra shis dbang phyug pa dang byang nas mi sna bde gling nang so gzi 'bar ba byung / bzang ldan du tshes bzhi la lam 'bras tshugs nges dgos tshul du 'dug cing / de ni don la'ang dgos par yod mod kyi/ thams cad dus thug cing dog sar 'dzom pa'i 'gag thug sar brla bsgrad pa'i dpe/ de'i sngon du ngam ring du khor tsam ma 'byor na gto mi rung ba'i nan chags dang / gdong 'ga' nas kyang 'bor mi car sdod zhag shas sdod dgos kyi nan chags sogs zhe sun po rang cig byung bas/ 'di gong gam pa la 'gro ba'i khas len yod kyang bsgo tshel/ bla ma dam pa'i sku mtshams 'og tu nyin re bzhin zhal dkyil mjal bar phyin cing / sde pa zhal ngo rnams su rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs shig dgos phebs byung na'ang / da lam 'jug gi rten 'brel yin pas phag dkar shes rab gsal byed zhig 'gyur rnying pa'i lugs byed byas de phul/ tshes bcu dgu la chas de nub chu babs su sgrogs mkhan pa tshang gi der bsdad/ de nyin lam gyi ngal dub shin tu che ba zhig byung ste phyin na mi legs zer rgyur 'dug de nub kyi tho rangs snga zur tsam la gting skyes nas 'dren dpon tshe ring sleb pa'i sde pa ma chen drung kha sang dgongs phyogs nas sku bsnyel ba'i sku khams thu bar byung bas 'phral du ldog yong dgos tshul du 'dug pa/ rlung ltas sogs 'phral gyi ltas la brtags pas nyes skyon gcig kyang mi 'dug pas/ de phyin bzang ldan gyi chos 'di yang phyis 'grub dka' zhing dge 'dun gyi bya ba bshol du mi rung bar 'dug —209—

snyam pas da lam skyon mi yong ba khag theg pas yong mi dgos par 'dug byas zhu lan yang de 'phral phul/ rim pas gdong dgar sleb/ theg bdun sdod dgos byung zhing / skyes rabs so bzhi mdzad bcu gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi zhal thang gsar bzhengs rnams la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol te/ rab gnas nyin gsum pa'i cho gas bgyis pa dang stabs bstun du dbang bskur zhig kyang byas/ gzhan yang tshe dbang brgya tshar dang / 'jam dpal smra seng dang / zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang sogs brjed chos 'ga' shas dang / gdong dga' slob dpon pa dang rags rdzong slob dpon pa gnyis la nag po rim bzhi'i khrid zhig kyang bshad/gnas rnying rje drung ye shes rgya mtsho pa yang chos zhu ba la 'di skabs nas phebs byung zhing rim pas ngam ring du sleb/ de nyid dpal ldan sdings su zhabs drung lcam sring phebs 'dug bsam 'grub dga' ldan pa dang / rtser bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams gyis ser bsgrengs dang bcas bsu ba gzab ma gnang / 'di skabs zhag gsum bsdad pa la zhal ngo spyir tshe dbang brgya tshar dang drag po'i rjes gnang 'ga' zhig phul/ gzhan so sor 'dod chos thang thung 'dra bshad/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin ngam ring nas snga bar chas te/ dpal bzang ldan gyi lung pa'i phu'i mtsho kha der/ che bgres slob dpon rnams kyang bsu ba la phebs shing / dge 'dun rnams kyi ser bsgrengs kyi bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas bzang ldan chos sde chen por sleb/ de nyin 'jam dbyangs chos khri'i steng nas dge 'dun rnams la byin rlabs tsam zhig byas/ de'i sang nyin —210—

bod spyi'i 'dod pa la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi dus chen yin zer ba la/gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gi byung khungs sogs bshad dbu tshugs par byas/ /tshes lnga nas brtsams te snga chos dgongs chos kyi chos thun gnyis gnyis thun shin tu che bar bshad cing / snang gsum skabs tshogs pa ngos ma stong rwa can tsam dang / zhor nyan pa nyis brgya skor byung ching / rgyu dbang dbang cha bzhi bcu rgal nges pa dang / rgyud gsum man chad sna tshogs pa ngos ma drug brgya mi chad pa/ lam dbang dbang cha nyer lnga tsam byung zhing snang gsum gyi skabs khrid dmigs gang nges dang bshad pa'ang mtha' chod par bgyis/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba dang / rje btsun grol mchog gi rnam thar rgyas pa'i lung tsam zhig song / tshes lnga de nyid nas brtsams te gnas rnying rje drung sogs la gung seng la shangs chos skor rnams bgyis shing /zla ba de nyid kyi tshes bcu gcig nas brtsams te/ snga chos dgongs chos kyi bar dang dbang gi seng sogs kyi nyin gung la tshogs pa rags bsdus brgya skor la lam skor phyi ma rnams bshad cing / snga gro re bzhin tshogs pa gang yod kyi steng du nye skor gyi yon bdag 'dra dang bcas pa la rjes gnang zur bka' gnyis tsam re 'chags med du bgyis/ 'dir de ltar chos bshad pa'i rim pa mdo tsam ni gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag smin rgyas/ lta ba bskyed rdzogs rnams mdo rgyud spyi sgos kyi bshad pa mtha' chod pa dang / lam 'bras rang rkang gi chos skad thun mong ma yin pa rnams zhib mo 'thems nan dang / dmigs pa rnams la bskyar chos kyi sgo nas shin tu nges —211—

par byas/ iṇ+ḍa bh+ya ti'i lam skor ma gtogs/ lam skor phyi ma rnams kyi dmigs khrid nges can dang / so so'i go babs kyi bshad pa rnams kyang gcig la gcig rgyas 'gebs kyi rang bzor ma song ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rang skad kho na'i sgo nas mtha' chod cing sgom don la 'dro lo bar byas/ sems bskyed kyi skabs mchod pa'i bkod pa yang shin tu rgyas pa dang / zhu mkhan yang stong phrag gnyis lhag nges pa byung / bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang dang / rje btsun bdag med ma'i lus dkyil byin rlabs rgyas pa lam zab phyi nang / bir bsrungs phyi nang / sangs rgyas spyan ma'i bzlas lung / a spyi'i bzlas lung /yig brgya'i bzlas lung / bla ma rin 'byung / bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar gsum khug pa/ bla ma don grub kyi tshar gsum khug pa/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod/ brda' don gsal ba/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ sgrub pa lung 'byin gyi bar du byin rlabs kyi rim pa yang mtha' rgyas dang / de bzhin du bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs/ phyag chen yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs/ rags bsdus la nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs cha drug /mai tri mkha' spyod dang in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs tshar re/ dmar po skor gsum gyi rje gnang / bde mchog nag po pa dang / 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor dbang cha re re/ shangs chos pa rnams la sgyu lus dbang mo che/ ga'u ma'i bka' che chung gnyis mkha' spyod bka' lnga/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gyi byin rlabs sogs dang / gser chos lnga'i khrid/ 'chi med 'khrul 'khor gyi lag len/ lung chos skor po ti gnyis song / tshogs chen du byin rlabs dang rjes gnang gi rim pa/—212—

bde mchog lhan skyes dang kyai rdor lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs/ bka' gdams lha bzhi so so'i rjes gnang / rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro/ rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa/ mi g.yo ba zhabs bzhi pa/ mi g.yo spre'u brgyad ma/ o rgyan sgrol ma/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu sogs zur bka' brgyad cu lhag pa dang / de dag la brten pa'i yig lung ci rigs pa dang bcas pa/ don gnyer 'ga' zhig la bya ba spyi rgyud gsum dang / gsang 'dus kyi rgyud gzhung 'ga' shas dang / khyad par gsang 'dus rim lnga la 'khru bshad mtha' gcod rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang dge 'dun nyis brgya tsam la ras chung lugs kyi tshe khrid sogs mdor na nyin mtshan du chos bshad kyis dus 'da' bar song / gong du chos tshugs ston rang la gshin don gyi mang ja zhig byung ba la rtog pa cung zad za ba zhig byung ba ltar rgyud gsum gyi 'go tshugs tsam na/ sprang bo mang po nad kyis shi ba'i rkyen gyis grwa ba gsum bzhi la nad des gos/ de mtshams ri khrod ma'i rjes gnang sogs bgyis pas de phyin chad dgon khong du mched pa gcig kyang ma byung / 'di skabs phyogs mtha' thams cad na nad zla mang ba rang 'dug na'ang / bzang ldan rang du chos shin tu 'phel ba'i ngos nas/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la lam 'bras kyang grol/ de skabs ngam ring nas gsung phebs de na nad rims yod 'dug pas zhag bcu skor de khar sdod pa dang / de nas bags bsang ba sogs la shug khrod du nges par 'gro dgos tshul dang / de mtshams ngam ring du yong dgos phebs byung bas de skabs zer tshad nyan pa'i spre'u'i khung rang byas/—213—

bzang ldan rang du mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig dang / de grol nas shugs khrod du zhag brgyad bsdad cing / sgrub sde rnams la bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang zhig byas/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la ngam rings su sleb/ de'i sang nyin rang nas chos kyi rim pa rnams tshugs shing / hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i bar du/ gtso bor zhabs drung nyid dang / ga tsā yang gang 'os kyi don gnyer so so dang bcas pa rnams la so sor/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ma hā mā ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ salugs ro langs brgyad bskor/ zhe dgu ma/ skyo lugs drag po'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ bde mchog nag po pa/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ mi ga yo bla med de bla med kyi dkyil chen bcu dang / gzungs grwa lnga dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu ste bya rgyud kyi gnyis/ gri gug lha lnga/ gur lha bcu gnyis ma/ gyi ljang lha bcu bdun ma ste mgon po'i dbang bskur gsum/ yongs bsgril dbang bskur bco lnga byas/ dpon sa yum drung gis kyang 'di dag gi nang nas drug tsam zhu ba mdzad/ lu phu gdan sa pa dang lhun sdings gdan sa pa sogs kyis kyang so so'i 'dod pa dang bstun pa'i de dag ci rigs pa zhus/ de bzhin du ma hā mā ya'i khrid/ 'jigs byed rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi khrid sogs khrid lung rjes gnang rnam grangs mang po rang song / zhal ngo tsho shaṃ so sor bcad pas tshe dbang / brgya rtsa lan bzhi dgos pa byung / rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma dang / bde mchog la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs thub/ gzhan rnams ras bris kyi steng nas bsgrubs/ gseng zhig la skya bo khag thang du sa skya pa chen po'i sku 'bum —214—

mjal bar phyin/ sku 'bum la gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad skabs shig me tog gi char chen po mngon sum du babs pa thams cad kyis mig lam du phebs/zhor la byams chen yang mjal/ nged kyis snga gong bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang la bka' yangs pa rang byed kyin yod cing / bar skabs shig bka' dog po byas na legs pa'i ltas shig byung nas phal cher bka' dog par byas na'ang / bar skabs de dang der mang du byed dgos byung bas gsal snang dang bde stong gi nyams la gnod par byung / de bas na rdo rje theg pa'i chos zab mo ci rung rung la spyin pa ni rang gzhan gyi don gang yang ma yin la/ skal ba dang ldan pa la dam du spel ba nyid rang dang gzhan gyi don snga na med par 'gyur ba'i gnad dam par snang ngo / /zhabs drung gis dbu rgyan se'u ma legs pa zhig yon du gnang nas/ ma hā mā ya'i khrid yig cig rtsom dgos phebs pa 'phral du brtsams/ zhabs drung chos skad la dgyes shing sgo yangs pas zhal gdams 'ga' yang yi ger bris nas phul/ de ltar na zla ba phyed dang gnyis kyi bar la rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan can mdo rgyud kyi don mkhyen par mngon pa'i nga rgyal can 'gas lo sbrel nas kyang bshad par mi nus pa tsam 'grub/ lar ni skal med la chos bshad byed pa la bag chags 'jog thub pa'i phan yon gcig kyang 'dog dbang bskur mang po dang dam nyams mang po'i dpe nyes dmigs gcig kyang gda' ste/ chos lar mi 'chad pa las 'chad pa de ka los grag rang re'i las skal du'ang 'dug go /dam tshig nyams pa tsho re shig dmyal bar skye ste/phyis 'khor ba mtha' can yin mtha' can gzhan las kyang nye'o/ /de skabs —215—

zhabs drung bdag pos rgya dril rwa log ma sbus gtsang ba zhig yon du gnang nas/kun dga' dpal bzang brgyud nas phebs sgor/ dngos cag gi rnam thar zhib mo zhig rtsom dgos phebs pa'i bka' nan ma chogs pa dang / gzhan yang snga phyir bskul ba po mang po'ang yod pas/ de nas mi ring ba rang lo nyer dgu nas sum cur 'phos pa'i mtshams rgyal gyi zla ba'i nang du 'di yan chad bris pa lags so// // phyis tshig sna cung zad bsrings pa ni yod/ bkra shis/shu bha/ /—216—

༄༅/ /o snyu sti/ da ni sngar gyi 'phros las bshad na/ 'di skabs rje 'gyur med dang lan kha yar mjal byung / shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul du mdzad/ rang re'i rtsom pa la yang thugs dad gus 'khrungs tshul gnang gin 'dug de nas re zhig phyogs der 'gro don yang 'phran skabs su bab pa de tsam gyis chog shes par byas/ phugs kyi dbyings dang rtag brling khel ba ni gang byas kyang dka' bar tshogad 'a/ jo nang gi phyogs su chas te 'ongs pa'i tshe/ zhabs drung lcam sring gis dpal ldan sdings su skyel thung tsam mdzad/ de nub seng ge lung du sleb/lha rtser theg po gnyis bsdad/ de kun tu ltas kyang 'tshus par byung/ /jo nang tu sleb 'phral nas lo dus kyi 'khrid btsugs/ de skabs zab don gyi bstan pa dar bar 'gyur pa la lhongs kyi rnam pa dang / yon bdag la'ang sku dog dar ba'i rnam 'gyur la zir bun byung ba ni/ snga sor snga mo nas bu legs pa zer ba kho pas/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pa'i sku thog nas gzung / 'di bar du jo nang pa la gnod pa 'ba' zhig byed cing / kha bkod bcug pa'i dgon 'khris rang du ri dwags rngon pa dang / grwa rigs rnams kyi rgyags zhing 'phrog pa dang / lam du rdung ba dang / mchod thes kyi mchod gzhis rnams la gnod pa kho na byed pa rgyun mi chad byung 'dug res 'ga' zla gcig gi nang du lan gnyis gsum gyi zos mi bde yang byung / jo nang pa'i phyogs khas zhan pas sdug sna dgu btang ba'i nad ma theg pa dang / rkyen chos gzhis kyi zhing 'ga' zhig btsan phrogs byas/ slar sprod dgos kyi don la/ sde srid kyi phyag dam mi sna zhus shing gnang ba yin kyang byang pa'i g.yog po la la dpon po la rtsi mi dgos/ ma —217—

brtsis pa de la ka dpon po rang yang dga' 'gro ba'i srol cig kyang yod/ kho pas lha rtse rdzong dpon ltag khur gyis phyag dam dang mi sna la kha skyengs btang /de'i kham mchu'i lab la chad gzi ba phan tshun tshig rkyen ma theg pa'i 'thab mo byung / kho pa thal song la shor/ de 'phral ngam ring du dgongs sangs zhu bar btang 'dug na'ang / mnga' bdag drung gi dgongs sangs yang ma bzhes/ lha rtse rdzong pas jo nang gi chos gzhis them pa bcu lhag cig la gtsang gzhung gi dmag chen bsdus/ dang po nas byang pa'i dmag skya 'thor la jag pa byung ba'i gtam dpe gcig la/ nag mo dpon to la dang zhus nas dmag cig 'ong gi zer ba de dngos su lag len la bkal/ me rgyag shing bshu byas/ de rjes rtses len dang mchod gzhis grong pa rnams la/ jo nang pa dang kha lab mi byed pa'i mna' bkag thel tshe bsdus pa yang rting la bskyas tshang gtib pa sogs dran tshad lag tu bkal/ 'di dus kyi lha rtse rdzong dpon e bdag po dang / nor rgyas pa tshe ba sprel ma'i skabs yin/ de lo zir bun gyi sgang yin kyang jo nang du khrid gsar ba mang zhing btsun gsar byed mkhan yang mang / dam po 'debs pa dang khrid gtor gyi bar thams cad bar chad kyi dbang du ma btang bar sngar las kyang rgyas pa tsam du byung / jo nang sgrub sde rang la'ang / dmag sang yong gnangs yong gi sdigs sdigs byed skabs/ /nged rang sku 'bum gyi rdo rje gdan na sdod skabs yin zhing / dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa la zhugs/ de'i bya ba rnams 'dzol med du byed cing ngag ni sgrub pa'i bzlas pa la brtson par yod nyin gcig sems ni skyo shas shin tu che/ da dgon gnas 'di bzung yang —218—

bstan pa spyi sgos gang la yang mi phan par 'dug de bas zar zir 'di la chod 'doms shig byung ma thag dgon gnas 'di dag gzhan 'dzin skyong byed pa thams cad kyang bor te mi med lung stong 'grim zhing chos brgyad dang ma 'dres pa'i sgrub pa kho na byed snyam pa lhang lhang ba yod pa'i skabs/ tho rang gi cha gcig thog ma rdo rje gdan nyid na bzhugs pa'i kun mkhyen chen po'i sku 'dra de ka yin snyam pa la/ sku dngos su gyur nas zhal ras skya me re ba zhal tshom dkar po cung zad yod snyam pa spyan lta stangs can dbu zhwa na bza' bzhugs gdan sogs spyi mthun 'di ka shin tu gsal ba de mthong ma thag tu/ sngar gyi dge sbyor gyi shugs ni je che la mnyam nyid du gyur/ 'phral snang cha blo mi bde ba de yang rtsa ba nas sangs nas dga' yal yal ba bde cham cham pa cig byung zhing / de'i zhal nas nga'i bstan pa la phan thogs yod du nye bar sleb na mi byed dam/ /da nas je bzang du 'gyur bas spro ba bskyed gsung ba cig byung / de nas kyang lo shas ni cang ma byung ste phyis rim pas yong ba la dgongs par 'dug yang de'i phyi nub kun mkhyen chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags yin snyam pa mdo bkod dang mthun pa'i rnam pa lha'i sku can zhig byon te/ rnam par bzhag bya 'jon byed dang/ rnam gzhag thams cad rdzun pa yin/ /blo la snang ba 'khrul pa ste/ /bden pa'i don la gos pa med/ /gsung pa zhig byung bas/ de tsam kho nas kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed pa gzhan stong gi grub mtha'i gting sleb/ the tshom dang gol sa thams cad chod/ chos sgo mtha' dag 'byed pa'i lde mig chen po lag tu 'ongs bar gyur to/ /yang bdag gi sems —219—

la/ brgyud pa'i bka' babs 'di la/ byin rlabs don gyi brgyud pa kun mkhyen chen po la dngos su thob kho bo brgyud thag re nye snyam pa yang yang byung bas/rmi lam du brgyud pa la nye ring med/ sems sems nyid la thim pa yin mod zer ba zhig byung bas sngar gyi 'dzin pa rlom sems de yang dbyings su yal/'di skabs kyang zhag bdun song nas dam rdzas la sgra chen po btud mar byung ba dang bdud rtsi 'babs pa sogs byung / mtshams grol nas de'i rtogs brjod kyi tshul tu gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan gyi tshigs bcad dang / de'i lung sbyor yi ger bkod/ de skabs byang gtsang sku nye sbrel skabs yin/ ltas rten 'brel legs po ye mi 'dug de la phan thabs bcos byed rgyu phran bu 'dug ste gnyis thad nas bcol gtogs mi 'dug pas kha rog bsdad/ 'di skabs dpon sa rin mo ches/ gdong dga' ba la yon mchod bar gyi legs lam gyi thabs kyis gsungs 'dug na'ang khong pas ma mdzad/ de mthun nged la gleng bar chos rje dkon blo ba ched bsdad byung / de nas dpon sa rin mo che rang du dgongs pa zhus/ jo nang ba dang bu legs pa tshang gi rtsod gzhi kham mchu de byang gtsang gi mi sna gnyis 'dzom gyi steng nas gcod rgya byas/ skabs 'di dag tu 'dom pa'i thad du gtsang bo la dar chags/ rang re la nye ba ltar snang ba'i 'brel can mang pos 'dom pa'i dar 'di sngar gyi jo nang mkhan po rnams sku 'das skabs kyang chags de min gzhan ma byung ba dang / da res khyed mchod yon bzlos pa 'di yang /yon bdag snang che zhing / sku rim dge 'dun dang mthu mkhan dang mthu bzlog mkhan sogs 'gangs can rnam grangs mang ba nas rim gro sogs gang ci nas —220—

bzab dgos zer/ 'phral snying gtam yin yin skad blo phugs dkrugs sdebs dang sdigs ri gtong ba'i gzhi mthun par snang zhing gzhan 'dris med dang chags sdang can gyi phyogs nas spyir mi min du bgrong ba sogs rang re la grags pa dang 'gro don cung zad byung ba la phrag dog langs pa'i skyon brjod dang ngan smras sna tshogs byed pa gzhir bcas shing / rgyu mtshan de dang de dag la brten nas nged la dog cha che 'phral du 'chi ba yod skad kyi mthu skad dang sdigs ri sna tshogs byed pa byung na'ang sems la ni g.yo mgul dang snyems 'khrig rdul phran tsam yang ma byung ngo / /lar bla ma'am sde dpon sogs mi phal cher la sdigs ri 'di 'gro kyin 'dug nga la yang de tsho dang 'dra snyam mthong chung gi sdigs ri byed par 'dugagazhan yang de 'dra'i rigs tshod bgam pa'i khungs byed pa sogs mang po zhig yong gin 'dug ste nga gdod nas grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa tā ra nā tha yin/ bla rul dri thug ching ching tsho dang nam du yang 'dra mi yong lags/ sdug rgan la song yang gzhan zer kho na'i rjes su 'brang ba tsho rang bsam mno thong / nged rang ni byis pa nas gzung gdeng chung 'dra gdog lags/ rin po che ka bzhi nas ni de tshor phan 'dogs la zhes kyang phebs dgos pa 'dug gsung pa'i tshur ston gnad byung ba la/ spyan 'dren la btang dus phebs ni ma byung / sde pa kun spangs drung gis snga byin shin tu bkyon par mdzad/ rang re la 'gro don 'phran bu byung ba la/ zhwa dmar nag la 'gran pa yin no zhes pa la rkangs bcol/'phral zar zir de la bsnyad pa'i gsung ra thon lug thon du byon/ sku nye'i gsar 'grogs kyi rgyab skyor khungs dang / stag lo pa snam nas yongs dus —221—

bzang ldan pa dang gser mdog can pa dang gdong dga'i 'bod mi sogs rta ba bco lnga byung ba tshun la ko long mdzad/ 'on kyang kho bo'i sems la ni da lta sna tshogs pa'i brjod pa smra ba po rnams rang 'bras dang rang mdog myur du ston par 'dug snying re rje snyam pa ma gtogs gnod sems ye ma skyes/ bstan 'dzin rin po cher rje grol mchog nas brgyud pa'i sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang gi snyan 'debs zhu bar dge steng slob dpon pa yang yang btang ba/ dpe gsar 'dzin byed dgos pa la khag bskur mdzad nas re zhig mi yong gsung gin 'dugade ma gnang ba la phyis khyeg 'dra byung yin/ gzhan yang bka' bkod sna tshogs nges med du 'byon cing phyag g.yog rnams kyi 'gro 'tshams la brten pa'i byed lugs dang brjod sgo sna tshogs byas/ de nas nye skor g.yas g.yon nas 'bod mi byung dogs dang de la brten nas ngam ring du 'gro dgos byung dogs jo nang nas tho rangs shig bteg sngar nas lung nag shel dkar la yong dgos tshul nan chags yod na'ang ltas mi legs pa kho nas shes dkar gyi thad la yang gsang ste phyin/ de nub khro phur byams chen la phyag mchod smon lam sogs byas/byang chen du zla ba phyed gnyis tsam phyi mtshams me bal nang du dge sbyor 'phel bar byung / rkang pa cung zad na ba yang nad 'don gyi dmigs pa brtad pa kho nas sel/ byang phyogs drag ma zhes bya ba'i yul nas 'ongs pa'i 'phreng gi zhes bya ba'i mi rigs kyi tshong pa zhig bal por sleb pa de'i bram ze zhig la zong bskur/ bram ze des kyang ngam ring nas nged kyi zla la 'ongs jo nang du 'chi la khad byung / nad g.yog sman sngags sogs gang grag byas/ nad phan cing 'di —222—

skabs tshong pa kho rang yang sleb/ sngar ma thos pa'i byang phyogs kyi yul gyi gtam mang po dang / bzo bkod ngo mtshar can sngon med mang po mthong / byang chen pa rnams la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi 'khrid dang bshad pa/ bka' gdams kyi man ngag thor bu mang po dang bcas pa bshad/ gser mdog can du lam 'bras sogs chos rgya che rab dgos tshul gyi nan chags snga mo nas yang yang yod pa dang / de skabs dus la bab pa'i stabs gser mdog can du 'gro ba'i mar lam/ bsam rtser shog gsung ba ltar phyin/ sleb pa'i sang nyin kun spangs drung la tshe dbang 'dra dgos gsung ba ltar byas/ de yang kun spangs drung sku snyel nas zla ba gnyis lhag song skabs yin/ snyung gzhi'i rkyen yang gdon gyi gnod pas byas 'dug skabs der bsrung 'khor la rin po che ka bzhi nas gzims chung mdo phug tsam mdzad nas bcar bzhugs dang / klu sdings na rje zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku dang / drung pa rin po che yang bzhugs bzhin pa la/ bla ma rnam gnyis kyi dbang byin rlabs gnang ba la phebs res kyi/ sde pa la zhud kha grag po lung med re byung bas/ bla ma rnam gnyis kyang phebs pa'i rgyun chad/ ka bzhi nas kyang mdzad thes zad pa la/ sde pa gnang ches pas mi bzhugs ka med kyi gang grag ci grag gi skabs der snang / de skabs kun spangs drung la thog mar bgegs skrod drag po zhig byas pa/ sde pa rang la zil chen po dang 'jigs snang gi dran med du 'gro tshad pa dang drag tu rdul ba sogs re zhig bgegs 'thon pa'i rtags gsal bor byung / de 'phral rang nas bzung sku khams de je grag la song / kun spangs drung ni kha sang nas zla ba gnyis kyi khongs su zhal —223—

nas gang bton tsho ni brjed/ sngar bka' bkyon bkyon ka mdzad mkhan de dang rgyud mi gcig pa 'dra ba cig byas/ rgyang tsam sdod dgos tshul nan chags rang gsung gin 'dug de gong gdon gyis sbas pa'i rnam pas 'tsho byed rnams kyis kyang nad ngos ma zin pa la/ de mtshams nas nad ngo zin cing sman gyi bcos byas te sku khams bde ba'i lugs byas/ theg bcu gcig bar bsdad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la gser mdog can du phyin/ bco lnga nas bzung chos btsugs te snga thun la sa skya bka' 'bum lung gang 'gro re dang grol ba'i thig le'i 'khrid/ gung thun la lam 'bras kyi 'khrid tshugs/ zhag brgyad song mtshams rin po che ka bzhi nas klu sdings su sgar pa mjal ba la byon dgongs mo rtse la phebs dus gdon gyi phyi 'brangs byas/ kun spangs drung la zhung shin tu thu ba brgyab te 'grongs la khad byung / de'i rkyen gyis snyung gzhi log yang 'bod mi nan can 'phral du byung bas bsam grub rtser 'gro dgos shar/ chos kyi stobs 'phral du gser mdog can la log 'gro rtsis yin na'ang zhal ngo thams cad kyis nan chags gnang bas/ sku khams bde bskyed thon gyi bar sdod dgos byung ba zla gcig zhag nyi shu tsam song / de bar la nyin re bzhin gtor dbang re re dang / tshe dbang gang 'gab re kun spangs drung rang la phul/ zhal ngo gzhan rnams la dgongs bzhed ltar/ tshe dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang tsam dang /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang / bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang / chos rje dkon mchog legs 'dzin pa la mi g.yo bla med kyi dbang / rnam sras rigs chen brgyad/ gzhan yang 'dod chos ci rigs bshad/ zhwa dmar ba'i sgar nas blo ma —224—

gling pa 'dod chos kyi snying po gal che ba yin zer nas/ khong sogs dbang cha gcig la gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang dang / 'khrid brgya tshang ba zhig bshad/ nged sleb 'phral ka bzhi nas ni gnod sbyin dom gyi dbang po'i dpe 'am btson thar ba bzhin du log phebs song / de rjes lan cig 'cham pas re na cig byung skabs/ nyi ma dgong kha cig gnyid byung dogs zur 'phyong gi dpyangs kha na bsdad yod pas/ bud med dmar mo dre'u la zhon pa snang gsal gyi rdzong ri las che che tsam zhig nas/ las ka don chen mang po deng sang 'phral du 'grub pa yod pa yin te/ khyed 'dir sdod dgos 'dir re zhig 'a rgyangs song zer nas lcags kyi mda' phyogs la yal gyi song ngo / /sku dog phan tshun du 'gyur ba'i sde ba karma bstan srung dang / srang stod nas kyang sku snyel ba la bgegs sprod dbang sogs byas pa tsam gyis sku khams sangs dwangs pa rkyang ba byung / sgar pa rnams pa snam du phebs khar sgar ston la rtse la phebs dus kun spangs drung rang gis kyang zhud byung dogs kyi bsrung 'khor dmigs pa nan can dgos tshul 'phral 'phral gsung de dus zhud kha'i rnam pa byung yang ma byung de rjes mi ring bar sku khams sangs grag lta bur song / hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu la slar yang gser mdog can du sleb/ lung chos kyi rim pa sngar bzhin btsugs nas/ snga chos la lung shog bu gdong thon brgya bud re bklags/'khrid kyi chos thun ci rigs pa re byas/ dgong chos la lam 'bras kyi 'khrid btang/ theg nyi shu tshun la lam 'bras kyi snang gsum rdzogs shing / 'khrid gzhan gshed dmar spros med/ nai gu sogs shangs pa'i gser chos bzhi/ rwa —225—

rtse sems 'dzin/ snying po don gsum sogs rnam grangs mang du song zhing /sems bskyed kyi dus kyang skye bo 'du 'tshogs che/ rgyu dbang la dbang cha lnga bcu nga bgrangs byung rung brtsol ba bskyed de myur du grub par byas/ /rgyu dbang skabs shar steng nas dpon sa rin mo ches kyang phebs shing / gzhi byes tshang ma la mang ja/ nas 'gyed/ skam 'gyed/ 'khrid ston tshogs 'khor bzab rgyas dpe med rang mdzad/ rgyud gsum gyi 'khrid kyi skabs/ snga dro 'khrid gzhan gyi thun re bshad pa la/ bsam mi khyab sogs lam skor chung ba brgyad po rnams la/ in+d+ra bhu ti'i skor ma gtogs bdun po rnams kyi 'khrid dmigs gang zhib byas/ so so'i lung yang tshang bar rdzogs/ snga sor bsam 'grub rtse nas yongs dus/ kun spangs drung la da lo bsam rtse rang du/ bzhugs thugs dam bzhin yang gnang thub na rab/ de min yang sku rim gang grag gnang 'phral spyod thugs rtog gang zhib gnang pas lo gsar nas sku dog las grol 'gro shas che ba 'dug zhus pa yin na'ang / 'di dus lam 'bras grol du nye ba'i skabs shigakun spangs drung pa snam du glo bur du thegs song zer bas/ mthar thon mi yong bsam zhing gzhi byes gzhan thams cad la yang smras/ lam 'bras grol 'phral u rgyan rdzong nas dpon sa'i drung sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi mgo la 'gro dgos byung zhing gdung chog rim pa zhe dgu ma grol bar du smin por byung /de skabs 'phur mo'i 'bri g.yag rnams dpon sa de nyid rang gi zhal chems ltar dge rgyun la sbyor ba mdzad/ sa 'dir myang ston pa sogs don gnyer 'ga' la rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs 'phreng ba skor gsum dang dpung bzang gi rgyud kyi —226—

bshad pa yul le ba re byas/ kun spangs drung ni khong ra'i dgongs bzhed dang phyag g.yog phyogs 'dzin can rnams kyis bskul pa snam chu bzang ba dang bla ma rnam gnyis kyi bka' bkod la yang brten sku khams sangs te grag 'gro ba gzhir bzhag pa la grag pa'i ngo so gzhan la mi 'chor ba'i phyir rang du phebs par gnang zhing / ka bzhi nas ni mchod yon lhan du chab tshan la phebs pa'i rtsis kyi rin po ches kyang pa snam du phebs/ sngar bros pa yin yang de dus tshur 'khor/ de'i thog zhag shas nas sde pa sku khams 'phral du log pa'i je lod kyi ngang nas mthar yang zhud khas bsdus gda'/ nged tsho o rgyan rdzong du sleb nas zhag po dgu tsam song ba na/ bsngo rten gyis sleb byung / sngar de 'dra'i sku khams gyong ba la gzhug tu su las kyang dbyings chung ba de 'dra cig yong ba ang /'dir ma zad gyang gyong shang shing rdzas rdzas dbang 'dra yod gyu'i khungs la man ne mun ne/ ngan shed khyer/ bsam ngan khog bzung ba snga phyi ngad lta'i bar ji snyed cig gda' ste lang pa cig dang khum pa cig ka sngar yang byung / da dung yong ba 'di lar mi go bar 'dug lags/ de rjes u rgyan rdzong du dgongs rdzogs grol nas/ 'jags su rab gnas la 'gro dgos stabs chu byang ka rgyud nas phyin/grwa tshang chen mor rin po che tshul khrims pas gsung nan can byon nas khor tsam phyin/ tshogs pa rnams la chos 'brel sogs legs lam char byung / de nas 'jags su phyin/ de skabs zhag po dgu bsdad/ khyung po'i yin thang zhal phyi nas gsol ba btab pas me tog gi char lag pas bzung du btub pa tsam snyon med du byung / lan cig stag lung rin po che sku bag tsam snyel ba zhig rmi lam du —227—

byung bas blo cung ma bde/ 'di skabs sku snyel ba'i 'go tsam yin tshod du gda'/tshogs pa rnams la rgyu sde lnga'i dbang chen mo dang gseng chos chung ba rnams bshad/ nyung bsdus 'ga' cig la su kha'i chos skor rnams kyang byas/ rin po che 'phrin las bkra shis pa'i nang rten thub pa'i gser sku la rab gnas byas pa'i dngos gzhi'i nyin mo sgo bsgrigs nas rlung chen po zhig byung ste/ lcog rtse mgul nas 'thung dkar dang chung 'chag med sde pa kar bstan drung gi phyag nas byung 'phral zhig yod pa de zhal ba'i dkyil du 'phar de chag de 'phral stag sna nas zhabs drung dre bo sprul pa'i skus/ stag snar khor tsam yong dgos gsung ba'i 'bod mi zhig gnang byung / de nyin ka nyug nas kyang 'bod mi byung / de'i snga nub rmi lam du kha che paṇa chen yin zer ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta rgya gar gyi dge slong rgan po'i rnam pa zhig byung ba'ang rgya 'dre'i cho 'phrul du shes nas sprul bsgyur gyi 'dul dgos snyam pa la long ma byung bar gnyid sad/ rmi lam de dang dkar yol chag pa la rtog dpyad cung zad byung bas de skabs gnyis ka la ma phyin/stag sna nas tshur ja 'dren zhig gnang byung / 'on kyang ltas de 'jags pa sprul pa'i sku dang / zhabs drung de pho gnyis ka ring por mi bzhugs pa la lta bar 'dug mgon khang gi rdo sku'i drung du nub cig gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad pas/ mgon g.yag rnams thag ring po na 'khyams shing yod 'phro la nub mo de ka la thams cad 'dus nas gling gseb nyul zhing ngar sgra 'byin pa byung / yong khar chos cig bshad pa/ dpon chung sogs chos khri'i ltag tu bsdad song /bar skabs tsho gnyis su 'gro ba'i ltas su go nas zla bo tsho la'ang 'thab dgos —228—

byung / tshur lam chums su chos rje skal bzang ba dang gsung gleng 'phel bar byas/ gser mdog can du bla phyed sgor bsdad/ sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung gi 'phro dang rjes gnang sna tshogs pa dang chos than thun rnam grangs mang bar byas/yar lam bsam 'grub rtser zhag bcu bdun skor bsdad zhal ngo so sor chos bka' mang rab dang / rang gi zla la sdod pa'i don gnyer 'ga' zhig la/ rgyud bla ma thogs med 'grel chen dag bcas pa'i zab bshad byas/ de nas khri khang du rin po che ka bzhi nas kyang phebs bde mchog sogs dgongs bzhed kyi chos bka' yang mang du phul sngar las lhag par gus pa ltar mdzad kyin 'dug yar lam pa snam du khor tsam phyin nas/ bsam sdings su sleb 'phral mtshams bsdams/ rgyal rtser 'gro dgos byung dogs pa'i snang ba cig shar ba nas/ pasnam du sde ba kar bstan drung dang yang gleng slang byung / de yang rgyal rtse nas bdag po rgyal ba'i drung 'brug pa'i bu chen rje lha rtse ba la thugs mos chug cing bka' chos gsan/ rtogs ldan rnams dang lhan du rlung khrid skyong bar mdzad/de skabs gzims chung 'od kyis khyab pa dag dbu la me 'bar ba'i nyams snang byung gsung / nged gser mdog can na yod dus sman dpon pa brgyud nas ji ltar yin 'dri bar gnang byung ba la/ ngas ni bden pa rang la rgyal 'gong gi cho 'phrul yin las che zhus na'ang / shin tu ma dgyes/ rin po che lha rtse nas phyag rdor gtum po'i bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags yin par lung bstan dbus dbyung mdzad gda'/ rtags de tsho byung nas zla ba lnga drug gcig song ba'i 'di skabs nged mtshams bsdams nas zhag bdun song skabs/ bdag po sku 'das nas —229—

dgongs rdzogs la 'bod mi sleb/ zhag shas nas dus tshod tshes grangs dang bstun rgyal rtser phyin/ byang bzhu sogs bya bar 'os pa rnams 'bad de bgyis/bdag po de snga mo nas thugs dam 'phel shing thugs rang bzhin bzang ba dge phyogs la dkar ba zhig yod na'ang / phyis rting thugs su bar chad zhugs pa'i rnam pas 'os bab med pa la khrims gcod tshan can sogs sna tshogs mdzad/da de rang sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs byung gsung gin sdig pa la ye mi mdzem pa zhig byung zhing / 'di skabs kyang bsre 'pho'i rlung sgom pa yin gsung nas khrung bag med gsol sku 'khyams byung bas rkyen byas par gda'/ sku gshegs nas dgongs rdzogs kyang hrab hreb las ma byung song der yun ring yang ma bsdad/nged dang byang ba'i yum chen mkhon sel du song ba'i khungs la/ gnyen tshan gra bsgrigs su rlom pa'i rgyang rtse rtse chen gnyis ka ma mgu ba'i nag log ko log la song / sdong po khog rul gyi bla ma dang chos rdzus pho mo tsho ngom ngom 'dra byed kyin 'dug ste/ gang yang ma 'gor bar ci 'dra cig byung kun gyis ltos shig /o badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hu/ slar yang dgun thog de bsam sding du dge sbyor gang yod dang / nyin mo lta rtog phran bu sogs brtsol pa ha cang che ba ma yin pa zhig la lus/ rmi lam gzung bas yul snang gi bkod pa sham+bha la dang po ṭa la sogs ngo mtshar che bar byung / dus gtor gyi bskang gso byas pa cig la/ gtor ma'i dbus nas btso 'thon pa dang / zil chen po bzod par dka' ba byung / de rjes zhi ba'i spyin sreg kyang mang du byas/ 'di skabs don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ stag lung rin po che rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis zhing brjes pa'i —230—

gtam skyel ba dang / thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten skyel ba dang / zhus 'bul dang rten bzhengs sogs gang cir snga khyad che ba'i gal che yod tshul gyi nan chags 'bod mi la gzims dpon nam mkha' gnang ba ltar mi ring bar chas/ 'dol byung du zhag gsum pa zhig bsdad/ de min lam du 'gor ba med par zhugs/ snang kar rtser zhag lnga pa zhig dang / 'brang phur yang theg shas bsdad/ lhun rab tu phyin/ skyed tshal 'og gi mkhan slob rnams kyis dgon par shog gsung ba ltar gyi chos khri'i steng nas tshogs pa rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig byas/ yol ri gong du mgon po la bskang gso dang spyan gzigs 'ga' phul gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan yang cung zad byung /phar lam gyi re lha khang du lha rin po che'i phyag gi 'phel gdung spyan drangs phyag mchod phul mgon khang yang mjal tsam byas/ shin tu zhag po gnyis bsdad tshe dbang sogs dgongs ba ched ltar bgyis/ lha sar yang phyin/ 'di skabs rme ru ba'i slob dpon gyi las byed byas/ sde pa dga' ldan pa'i dmag mal gro gong mkhar la bteg grub tsam gyi skabs su 'dug snga sor lha sar sdod skabs dga' ldan khang gsar nas rtswa shing gi mthun rkyen phran bu yong kun yod na'ang 'di skabs ye ma byung / lho ngos brgyud nas glang thang du phyin rgyal rtse nas bla ma'i zhabs drung gis de'i gong tsam du 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku dpon slob spyan 'dren mdzad 'dug cing da rung myur stabs 'brug pa dpon slob kyi phyag phyi la phebs rgyu yin par 'dug zer bas/ re zhig rgyal rtse la yang thegs pa mi dga' zhing /'brug pa'i sgar sogs gzhan la yal yul yang ye mi legs/ 'di phyogs su —231—

yang 'dul ba yul lugs dang bstun pa'i gnang sgo dang / chos spyod bskang gso sogs kyang phyi ltar du sde 'di kha dang mthun pa mdzad/ dpon slob nyung bsdus kyi ngang nas ma mtha' yang lo gsum glang thang rang du bzhugs pa 'thad tshul zhus te phyag g.yog gi stabs su song ba yin nam/ de rjes zla gcig tsam nas 'khrugs pa'i sgar la thegs gda'/ de rjes rgyal rtser phebs/ de la brten nas lo brgyad tsam gyi bar du gtam ngan la mdzad dka' ba byung song / /de nas nged kyi lhun grub rdzong brgyud stag lung pa'i sngar 'khyud kyi sgrigs bkod dang bcas stag lung du sleb/ de'i gnangs nyin mchog gi sprul pa zhabs drung rin po che dang mjal/ de skabs rten bzhengs kyi rgyu tshogs la 'dre ba'i don du snga phyir gser zho lnga bcu tsam dang / gzhan yang rang re la ltos pa'i gang yod dkrugs pa'i tshul du phul/ zla ba gnyis tsam dbang lung 'khrid sogs chos kyi rnam grangs mang po rang dgos phebs pa ltar snga dro nyi ma shar tsam nas nyi ma phyed yol gyi bar la ci nus ci lcogs su phul/ zhabs drung du'ang / bla ma gsang 'dus dang thugs sgrub dang drag dmar pad+ma gling pa'i lugs sogs chos mang rab zhus/ nyin phyed man bka' chos 'bul ba rdzogs nas/ don gnyer 'dra la chos than thun 'dra yang byas shing / phal cher ni zhabs drung gong ma de mi bzhugs pas bag grang ba'i rnam pa dang / sde de dang rang re'i lag g.yog sogs gang la'ang yid 'dre ba yang mi 'dug nas/ g.yas g.yon gyi spang ri brag 'og ne gsing dur khrod sogs 'og la sa rnams su phyin nas mnyam gzhag gtso bor byas/ rin po che gong ma'i gdung ni lo de nang du zhu 'bul mi gnang —232—

bar thag chod song / rab gnas ni snga sor stag lung na dbu bla res mdzad pa ka mang ba 'dug ste zhabs drung 'di nyid kyis rten bzhengs gnang ba thams cad la zhal ngo ma gtogs bla ma gzhan gyis rab gnas mi mdzad pa cig 'dug pa de da lta'i zhabs drung 'di rang gi dgongs brtad yin snang ba/ don ni ri bo che ba la dpe 'dra gnang ba yin par 'dug de phyin phyag g.yog byed rgyu yang mi 'dug pas myur du 'gro ba'i dgongs grol yang yang zhus kyang / kar dge'i dus 'khrug 'di ci 'gyur mi shes pas sdod dgos tshul gyi bka' nan ma chogs/bdag jo bo yab sras rnams la shin tu mos gus che bas/ snga gong phyogs 'dir yong res kyis rwa bsgreng mjal ba dang zhabs tog gang grag re byed kyin yod/khong tsho yang dga' tshor chen po byed kyin yod na'ang rwa bsgreng dgon mi dmangs la stag lung nas kyang skyod dar yag po ma byung gda'/ khong tshos kyang stag lung la blo log byas sog po la 'jus 'dug pas rwa bsgreng ba la sngar lugs ltar byas na bla ma'i dam tshig la gnod par 'dug pas 'di skabs btang snyoms su ba theg ser gler mtshams bdun phrag gnyis pa zhig byas/ der dge sbyor 'phel zhing nyams bzang ba zhig byung / mtshams grol nas dpon sa gang skyid dang rje btsun drung phebs/ nai gu sogs dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i chos 'ga' re byas/ nyin gcig dbu khang la ri ltas byed du phyin rdo la 'khar ba'i rjes shig byung zer/ nyams 'ur re ba cig gis yin min dga' mi dga'i rtog dpyod ni gang yang ma byung de'i grags pa yam me ba zhig gis khyab/ de rjes phu mdor phyin/ sde pa'i drung la dbang bskur sogs 'ga' shas phul/ rmi lam du —233—

rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sngo ljang gi sku shin tu gsal ba zhig byung / nang par dgon pa ba chen po'i thugs dam rten yin zer ba bris sku rnying pa zhig lag tu 'byor pas dga' ba chen po skyes/ gnyan thog tu khor tsam phyin/ rje btsun ma'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can dang / rga lo'i thugs dam 'bum cha sogs la phyag mchod smon lam btab/ gnyan thog rdzong gi rnam sras lha khang sogs kyang mjal/ slar stag lung du sleb skabs ngam ring nas dpon sa mnga' bdag drung sku 'das pa'i bsngo rten skyel ba'i mi sna sbrel ma 'byor/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi grol nas/ bla ma dge bshes bzang dgu la thugs dam 'dogs 'bul bar gnang bar gda'/ mnga' bdag drung de phyag 'tshal khar mgo bog pa'i rnam pas khong rang gshegs khar dam tshig nyams pa yin kyang smon lam yang dag pa btab/ mi snas yul dus gzhan du sna tshogs shig glengs 'dug na'ang de la grub 'bras rang ni cang ma byung ba 'dra'o/ /rje btsun ma'i thang ka rnying pa de la gong gsham sogs gsar pa gsol/ rab gnas skyar ma byas pas me tog mang po sku la chags pa dang / rmi lam thabs su yi ge bcu pa'i sgra shin tu gsal bar grag pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang po byung / dmag byung dus rgyal khams 'jig pa las skyob thub pa'i rten 'brel yang nges 'grig gda'/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam du chos zhu 'bul tho re ba byung / de mtshams gtsang pa'i dmag 'phan yul du sleb/ 'bri khung go gnyis ni dmag 'bod mkhan dngos su ka gnang / gzhan thams cad kyis kyang mi sna bstun phyogs snga mo nas sleb yod 'dug kyang rgyal du dmag ma sleb par stag lung nas mi sna gnang ba yang ma byung /—234—

sde pa dga' ldan pa dang thugs 'brel ches pas phyi ltar na phyogs su lhung ba ltar yang song nas shin tu thugs 'tshab che bas 'phan yul na yod pa'i mnga' zhabs tsho srung skyob la bdag mi 'gro kha med kyi bka' nan gnang / yul tsho so so dang lcang lung chos sdings pa sogs dbu tsugs kyi 'bod mi nan can mang po byung /de mthun 'gro dgos shar bas thog ma nyan por phyin zhag bzhi tsam bsdad/ de rjes lcang lung chos sdings su phyin/ yul tsho so sor nged re'i grwa pa re re tsam bsdad pas kyang srung skyob thub cing phan 'dogs che ba rang byung / yongs bsgril dmag gi 'gros dang bstun zla gcig lhag tsam 'phan yul du 'gor/ dga' mor sde pa kar bstan drung dang mjal dus da lo'i dmag 'di kun yang phugs sde pa rang la phan chung / da dung kar dge'i 'khrug pa yong shas 'dug na'ang da ni slar dmag mi gnang ba rang legs/ gnang na sku tshe la shin tu rang gnod thag chod zhus te/ sde pa'i dgongs pa la kar lugs la ko long byed par 'dug snyam pa'i go ba log pa shar song na'ang / rang re'i drang po rang yin pa phyis rang rtags bstan pa der gda'/ gzhan yang 'phan yul spyi la zhwa dmar ba'i rdzong la dgos rgyu'i shing gcod kyang zhu ngo byas pas de skabs ni rtsa ba nas chogs/ ja pa dang dgon gnas so sor ja 'don mdzad pa kun la'ang zhu ngo phal cher 'grub pa sogs 'di skabs rang res skye bo mang po la phan thogs par byung zhing / de min na khyad par stag lung pa la mnga' zhabs la gong shor chen po yong nges par 'dug kyang rang res zhabs tog re 'grub byung bsam pa yod/ dang po khyi lo'i skabs kyi rmi lam de yang thog tu khel bar gda'/ 'on kyang snyigs dus kyi mi —235

rnams ngo mtshar che ste/ dmag ma log par la skyi sdug thams cad khyed la rag las zer lan cig ma yin par sgrog pa la/ dmag phyir log 'jigs pa dang bral ba na 'phral du rang 'gyur te ngo shes byed pa yang dka' zhing tshig gi gtang rag re yang mi gtong ste/ stag lung pa chos skyong bzang ba la 'jigs pa yin no zhes bya ba dang sog po la 'dzems pa yin no zhes dril sgrog par byed do/ /dus 'khrugs 'di dus rtse la sgang pa'i mkhan po sogs kong po kar srid kyi dge 'dun ser dmag rnams kyi rme ru bla ma'i dgon pa bzhig de'i gser chos mang po sdebs la bzhu nas/ dpon slob yon bdag dang bcas sgo bsha' byed pa sogs chos 'gal gyi spyod pa ha las ko las rnams la yin skyo shas che zhing /cis kyang dgos med kyi blo dang dge sbyor la bskul ma cher byung / de nas stag lung du khor tsam phyin/ gling gi grwa pa phal cher zhig da res khyed kyis pho byas pa yin zer dga' tshor chen po byed du byung / zhabs drung rin po che thugs zab pa'i rang bzhin du snang yang / dpon ni zhabs tog sgrubs pa la legs so'i tshig tsam yang mi mdzad kyi steng du gnas skabs gzhan la bsnyad nas bka' bkyon par mdzad do/ /de lta na yang bla ma'i zhabs tog yin bsam blos longs par byas/ nged lta bu la byang chub sems dpa'i re ba ci/ 'on kyang / gang la bdag gis phan btags pa'i/ /re ba che ba 'ga' zhig gis/ tshen tu mi rigasaganod byed na'ang / /bshes gnyen dam par lta bar shog ྅sa pa'i don yang de skabs snying thag pa nas skyes/ stag lung nas phyir 'ongs dus lhun grub rdzong du zhag gsum bsdad sde pa'i drung gis dges dges su mdzad cing / me sde'i —236—

khog gi ja pa sogs phal che bas kyang phan gdags kyi drin gzo 'phran tshegs dang tha na tshig gi gtang rag tshun chod nas 'os su 'gro ba tsam byed kyin snang bas bsam pa la chos pa'i sa las 'jig rten pa'i sa mi gzhi legs shing byed pa bzang ba 'di ni ya re cha bsam pa yang yang shar/ de nas lcang rgyab/glang thang / shing grong sogs su 'bod mi byung ba ltar phyin dus/ khong rnams ni stag lung pa dang nged rnams mos gus ni nged rnams che che tsam yin pa la/ stag lung kho na la phyogs su lhungs pa'i phan 'di tsam 'dogs pa snyam pa'i mthong ltas re byed kyi 'dug ste stag lung lha sde ni de 'dra khyed kyis ma go 'dug pa/ 'jig rten sgyu ma'i gar mkhan 'khrul snang gang shar gyi nyams skyong ba bden med la bden zhen can tu gda'/ rang res la sa cha 'di tshor chags sdang gi bcol gnyer med snyam zhe la 'dzin pa yang ma byas sel sbyangs dang / dag tshangs dang bshad sbyangs yang ma byas/ gang dga' gyis phaṭa snyam nas yongs/ sgo la'i nang khugs su shun nas rab gnas la 'bod mi gnang ba dang 'phrad dus/ sa cha de kha nas dung chung legs po zhig rnyed/ rten 'brel legs sam snyam pa shar/cung zad legs par yang 'dug lho ngos su dpon sa'i drung gis stag lung pa la phan 'dogs che 'dug ces dgyes dgyes dpe med mdzad/ de res thugs steng shod kyi stabs ci yin pa 'dug dga' ldan khang gsar du'ang yong dgos tshul nan chags gsung ba ltar phyin/ zhal ngo rnams la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang sogs 'dod chos 'dra phul/ ltas brtag pa 'dra gyis gsung ba la/ da lo'i gnas tshul 'di yang ma legs pa che ste da dung lo shas 'jam gang chags dang —237—

brling cha gang che ma mdzad na skyon che ba rang gda' zhus/ sne gdong rtse nas lcam drung gis kyang de mthun gyi gsung phebs dang / sbu ba gdong gi khur gzhes mdzad na ji ltar gsung ba la yang gzhan ni mi shes skyong dang gang gnang gi ring la g.yog rigs la byams po gnang dgos zhus/ lha sar jo bo'i sku gzhogs su nged dang khong dpon g.yog rnams smon lam lhan cig mdzad rgyu'i khungs la rig pa 'ur smon lam byed 'phrol bzhug nas gnas tshang du log de rjes shun du sleb nas zla gcig tsam bsdad/ thub pa gnas bcu'i gser sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba rnams la rab gnas rgyas par byas/ rab gnas grub man las la rten gzi byin rgyas pa dang bag dro ba'i rnam 'gyur der 'dus thams cad la gsal bar snang ba sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan byung / shun nas zhabs drung du rgyu sde lnga'i dbang sogs shangs chos cha tshang zhig dgos gnang ba ltar phul zhing / de nas snye thang du gser khang pa'i sar zhag gcig bsdad khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ sang nyin yul tsho tha dad pa'i rtsed sna sna tshogs kyi bsu ba dang bcas bla chen drung gis 'bod mi gnang ba ltar bde ba can du phyin der yang tshe dbang dang ma ṇi'i lung sogs dang bla brang du yang chos than thun sogs phul/nang par mkhar rnga bas nan chags byas pa ltar khor tsam phyin nas/ chu lho'i nor bu dge 'phel gyi rdzong du sleb tsam byas/ skyi ru ba sde pa kun rgyal gyis mthun rkyen phun sum tsho gis pa sbyar/ khrom dbang zhig byas/ dpal ldan gsang phur phyin rje btsun sgrol ma rtsod rgyal ma jo bo gdung rten jo bo'i thugs dam rnam rgyal mchod rten lo tsā ba chen po'i sku thang phyag gnas ma dang / slob dpon rin —238—

po che 'khon bsod nams rtse mos bzhengs pa phywa ba chen po'i bris sku sogs rten ngo mtshar can mang po de rnams la spos mar me snyan dar sogs bzang du phul smon lam mang du btab/ de nas rim pas brgyud de 'ongs nas drang srong srin po rir rten gsum rnams la phyag mchod phul/ bsam rtser sde pa srang stod nas sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten yang 'dir sleb nang par gong dkar du phyin/ zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bsdad/ zhabs drung khu dbon sogs dang bla ma slob dpon dge bzhas ci rigs dang / don gnyer sna tshogs 'dus pa gzhi bcu skor la/'phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum dang bcas pa'i dbang / phyag len mtha' rgyas rdzogs pa dang /g.ya' bzang spyan mnga' dang / ra ba smad pa'i grwa tshang rnams la/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig nyi ma sbas pa lugs kyi rjes gnang dang / gzhan yang so sor gang la gang 'dod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs mang du byas/ rgyal rtse nas khyim chung ba tshang nged la sngar nas mi dad pa rang yin na'ang / gtsang nas bka' bkyon byung ba dang nged la zhu ngo dgos tshul nan chags byed pa zhig byung / khyim chung ba dbang lags zer ba khong ras nged kyi zla la zla ba gnyis lhag bsdad/ rim pas ngo chen zhu rgyu'i khungs la/ 'brug pa yon mchod kyi ngo chen yong rgyu yin zer 'brang phu nas glo bur du log song bas ngo chen ma dgos pas snying sangs pa cig byung na'ang / kho pa tsho la don ma mthong ba'i ngang nas mi ring bar bka' bkyon gnas tshul de ltar shar song / dbang lags zer ba khong rang bar skabs sa skya khri chen la blo brtad zhus 'dug phyis sa skya bdag po a mis drung gis gzims —239—
