chung sgo rtsar khrims gcod lag thal la btang / de mtshams skyid bshag gnyis kyis 'bod mi nan can yod pa ltar/ skyi gshongs su zhug dgu bsdad/ zhal ngo sogs don gnyer mang dag la/ bde mchog dang 'jigs byed kyi dbang / ni gu'i mgyogs 'khrid/ sgyu lus dbang mo che zlum po bzhi'i dbang sogs chos bka' mang du byas/ de rjes gzhung rnam rgyal rab brtan du bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya che ba dang bcas nas sleb/ 'dir yang nai gu chos drug so so'i bka' dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang 'dod chos rnam grangs mang rab byas/ theg bcu gsum bsdad/ khong tsho'i phyag na las stod lho pa bdag po'i phyag gi byin rlabs rten mang du 'dug pa rnams la rten mjal byas/ nyin gcig rngog pa'i gdan sa spre zhing mjal du phyin/ spre zhing na bzhugs pa'i rje mar pa'i gdung khang de la/sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang nor bus bcos dang nang bzhugs la gzigs rtog mdzad rigs su 'dug na'ang / da rung rje btsun mar pa'i gdung rus bzhugs bden yin 'dug pas gus pa chen pos mchod pa phul gsol ba btab/gdung brgyud pa dang gsung gleng 'dra byas na'ang khong pa dbu gug gug kyog kyog tsam ma gtogs chos kyi phyogs la smra bcad dam por 'dug mi la phug dang dben gnas sogs kyang mjal te/ rje btsun chos sku rdo rje'i sku 'dra zhig 'dug pa sku bzhugs dus kyi phyag gnas ma yin zer yang min pa 'dug lung chung gi dpal lha mo byin rlabs can de yang mjal/ nyin gcig chos 'khor gling la phyin dus/ dgon pa'i slob dpon rngog lugs kyi chos mkhas po yin zer ba zhig dang 'phrad byung bas gsung gleng 'dra byas dus/ 'brug pa gsar —240—

pa'i chos skad gdol thabs kyi cal col las rngog lugs rang gi phyogs 'go things pa tsam yang mi 'dug 'di skor la yar lung bkra shis rtse pa gsar 'grogs ni sangs/ khong rang tsho'i bla ma 'dra'i bslab ston la brten ldem 'gyang log ge ba zhig dang / yar rgyab nas sde pas ni gsung 'gros 'bug bcag yi ge sogs 'brel thag thams cad bcad/ yig 'brel sogs cung zad byas na rgyal 'gong bzhin zhud byang dogs thugs la shar ba yin te 'ong gang na'ang ngo mi shes mig gis ma mthong rna bas ma thos pa lta bur mdzad do/ /chos rje sked srongs pa 'phrad du byon/ khong dang gzhan 'ga' shas la/ bslab bsdus chen mo'i bklags lung gzhus rtsa ba rnams la 'bru bshad dang bcas pa byas/ yar lam yang gong dkar du 'ongs/ sa 'dir 'di skabs sogs snga phyir 'brug pa gsar pa'i yig cha mang du mthong byung ste mthong ba kun la 'us bsam pa las ni ma shar/ de nas rim pas myos te/ ka brgyad mar lhun rab pa'i zhal ngo rnams kyis mthun rkyen sbyar/ snga sor dpyid ka skyid tshal 'og tu phyin skabs/ slob dpon grub thob pa dang rang stong gzhan stong las brtsams pa'i chos skad brgal brtag mang du byung / khong gi de nas rje go ram pa dang / rtse thang sangs lhun dang / dngos grub dpal 'bar bas mdzad pa sogs gzhan stong 'gog byed kyi dpe mang po la lta rtog mdzad/ 'di skabs khong byon nas/ dogs gcod kyi 'bel gtam la nyin rtser zhig song / phyis khong rang yang grub mtha'i babs la dad pa rnyed tsam byung ba'i khungs mdzad kyin gda'/ sang nyin gtsub mo'i brag phug mjal du 'gro ba'i nub te/ cho 'phrul yang shin tu che bar byung zhing nang —241—

bar mjal dus/ phug na legs ldan nag po rib rib yod pa snyam byed/ rten rdo gru gsum sku 'ol byi yod tsam yod pa cig kyang rnyed byung ngo / /snga sor nas chos brgyud tha dad pa'i ko long khog tu bcug phrag dog gis nged la ngan smras lhur byed pa mi che chung dbus kyi lho kha stod smad 'di kun nas mang po byung ba yos 'brug gnyis la phal cher dengs tshar gda'/ snga sor byi glang stag gsum dang 'di skabs sbrul lo 'di kun la dbus kyi yul so so dang sde rigs so sor rten 'brel legs phyogs sgrig rgyu mang po 'dug ste gegs phyi nang gsang gsum ka yong ba gcig gis phal cher lag tu mi longs/ cung zad bsgrigs pa tsho'ang 'gal rkyen gyis mchugs 'gro ba cig rang yong gin 'dug lar sems can spyi mthun gyi las dang sgos su'ang myong bar nges pa la 'phags mchog rnams kyis kyang mdzad thabs bral tsa na/ rang re phal pas ci byar yang med mod/ 'phral ma nges pa bsgyur du rung ba 'di tsho la mang po zhig la so sor rten 'brel 'grig na phan thogs nges pa ji snyed yod de 'dod pa gegs su song / lar rten 'brel legs bya ba bya byed rtsom pa gcig po de legs par yong / rten 'brel yang 'dus byas yin pas rtag pa gnas yin/ legs pa'i rgyun de ma mchugs pa'i ring la dga' bar yong / phyis 'gal rkyen gyis rten 'brel log mchugs byung na thog ma lan cig 'grig pa cig pos mi chog pa 'di kun gyis go dgos pa'i gal po che rang yin no/ /de nas rim pas 'brang phu dgon par sleb/ nang mi rnams zi nge ba zhig 'dug nas khang pa'i nang du blo ma chags/ nyin mo phal cher phyi la bsdad/ ri phug gang phug ri rtse sogs gang dben dben du mnyam gzhag —242—

'dra dang khang rgyab kyi zhing steng der chos ra tsho gnyis gsum re 'chag med byas/skya ser sna tshogs 'dus pa la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang sems bskyed rab 'byams pa kong phrug dang spyin pa sogs don gnyer kha shas la/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa 'dzin chos su bto / rdo rje gur gyi rgyud la dpe bkram nas rgyas par bshad/ 'di skabs zla gcig zhag po nyi shu tsam bsdad/de rjes sna dkar rtser zla phyed tsam bsdad pa'i skabs/ zhal ngo rnams su phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs/ gshin rje gshed nag po zhung lugs dang gdong drug ra lugs kyi dbang / zlum po bzhi sogs dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang tsam phul/ rang dang lhan cig rgyu ba'i slob ma 'ga' shas la/ dpung bzangs kyi pond pa dang / kyai rdor gyi 'dzin chos kyi 'phro rnams bto / hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la lcam phun tshogs drung gi skra bcad dang / chos kyi dga' ston sogs rgyas pa mdzad/ snga sor rgyal rtse nas 'bod mi rim can du byung ba'i 'di skabs kyang de phyogs su 'gro ba gzhir bzhag lta bur yod na yang /dus thog tu 'bod mkhan yang ma sleb rmi ltas kyang 'gyur rin sbungs nas 'bod mkhan byung ba ltar rong phyogs su 'gro bar mas/ sang nyin 'gro rgyu'i de ring rang de rgyal rtse nas 'bod mkhan sleb kyang de skor la 'gro ma thub rong chen brgyud nas phyin/ grags par theg mal zhig bsdad/ chos rje 'od mchog pa de na bzhugs kyi 'dug pa'ang nged la 'phrad par phebs byung / de nas byams chen du sde pa 'jam grags drung bsu pa la phebs 'dug cing / byams sku chen mo la phyag mchod smon lam ci rigs pa btab/ slob dpon 'ga' la chos 'brel —243—

tsam byas te/ rin sbungs su zhag brgyad bsdad/ tshe dbang rjes gnang 'ga' shas kyis thog drangs/ ni gu'i mgyogs 'khrid dang / sde pa 'jam grags drung sku sger du gshed dmar gyi dbang bskur zhig dgos phebs pa ltar phul/ ngur smrig gi sgrol ma dang / tsan dan sgrol ma rang byon dang / gnas brtan bcu drug gi bris thang yer pa ra ba la sogs rten byin rlabs can rnams mjal/ phyag mchod smon lam rgyas par byas/ de nas rim pas 'ongs te bsam 'grub rtser sleb/ chos bka' ci rigs pa dang rkyen sel gtso bor phul/ shar steng nas jo nang du tshogs la mang ja thon pa'i khro sprus gtsang ba gcig gnang byung / lcam a mdzes drung byang phyogs su gnyen 'phrang la thegs nas/ rgyal bu 'khrungs sgo yang seng ge lung du byung zhing a mdzes drung rang sa der sku ma 'tsho ba zhig byung 'dugargyal bu sku na phra grag pas lam du nyer 'tshe byung dogs zhal ngo rnams thugs mi bde ba la/ 'dre gdon rnams la nged kyis bar chad ma byed zhig pa'i yi ge zhig kyang byas/ nyes zho med par bsam rtser myur du phebs thub/ zhal ngo rnams la rgyu sde lnga'i dbang dang / ni gu chos drug so so'i byin rlabs dang bcas pa cig kyang byas dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ snar thang dang byang chen du yang khor tsam phyin/ slar yang bsam rtser rgyal bu sku na phra ba la bar chad mi 'byung zhing rten 'brel dge mtshan du/ tshe dbang dang gtor dbang 'ga' re phul nas/ khri khang gi klu sdings su rin po che ka bzhi nas phebs 'dug pa dang yang mjal zhing /dgongs bzhed ltar khri khang pa'i zhal ngo rnams phyag phyir dkris pa dang bcas pa la/ 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma dang / bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang zhig —244—

byas/ 'di skabs dad gus chen po dpe med mdzad thugs nang gtsang ba'i gsung phebs pa sogs mdzad kyin 'dug ba snam lhun grub rtser sde pa kar bstan drung yang phebs shing / gsung phebs ltar zhag gsum bsdad/ nyin gcig dbyar dus kyi chu shin tu ches pas zam pa dang zhing la gnod che bar dogs pa chung la rang res sngags bzlas pa'i nas gtor bas de 'phral rang cung zad bri de nas je chung ngu song sang nyin nas gzung chu'i gnod pa ma byung / rdzong gi khang pa shin tu grum pa'i zhig nyen che bar 'dug pa la khrus chu gtor bas 'phral 'phral sa brugs yod pa yang rgyun chad/ phyis kyang lo mang du bcos ma byas kyang rdib choms sogs nyes skyon ma byung / bsam sdings su theg bcu bdun tsam bsdad cing / shangs chos than thun dang / snying po don gsum sogs chos than thun 'dra bshad/ mdol byung du yang dbang chos sna tshogs pa 'phel bar byung zhing / bsam rtse nas 'di bar yan la/ yol pa mkhan chen dang bka' bcu rab 'byams sogs mang dag la/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan gyi gzhung bshad pas byang chub kyi le'u rdzogs kyi bar la zhib bshad mtha' chod par byas/ nyan pa po rnams blo gros 'dzings se 'dug pas de man chad la bshad tsho me dang lung tsam byas nas re zhig ba theg bsam 'grub rtse dang / pasnam dang mdol byung rnams su rgyal rtse nas 'bod mi nan can byung yang 'gro ma 'dod pas khas ma blangs/ de rjes rgyal mkhar dbang ldan du phyin/ gting skyes la 'bod mi nan can yod pa'i don gyi rim gyis 'dos 'drar sleb cing / sde pa zhal ngo rnams dag mjal tsam byas/ gam pa nas nan chags mdzad pa ltar/—245—

thog mar gam par 'gro dgos byung zhing zla phyed skor la rkyen sel 'dra phul/ kyai rdor gyi dbang zhig kyang byas/ slar gting skyes su 'byor te zla ba gsum tsam sdod dgos byung ba/ zhal ngo rnams dang chos rje stag sna ba/ dgon gsum gyi grwa rigs drag bsdus dang bcas pa rnams la/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag dbang byin rlabs 'khrid dmigs go don zugad pa yig lung dang bcas pa mtha' rgyas dang / dus 'khor gyi dbang zhig kyang sgrubs/ 'di skabs rgyal rtser nang zhig byung gda'/ brag dkar gyi mgon po'i spyan lam du gri che chung 'dres pa shin tu mang bar phul nas mnga' gsol byas skabs/ brag phug la rlung gseng sogs gang yang med cing phyi na'ang yul shin tu 'jam pa rang yin pa la/ lcam bral gyi lder bzo'i bar nas rlung 'tshub shugs chen po zhig byung /snyan dar dang dkar me rnams g.yos kun dga' chos dbyings pas zhun mar khur yod pa mnal ba dang / phyi ru khyi sob kyi sna nas khrag zags/ dgyes pa dang 'tshub 'gyur spel ma'i nyams su gda'/ de yang nga la dgyes gzhan la ma dgyes pa yin/ yang zhag shas nas dkar lar phyin mgon khang du theg gcig gsol ba btab/ cho 'phrul chen po dpe med rang dang byang phyogs kyi bla rus 'ga' zhig 'gyel 'gro ba'i lhas gsal bar shar/ de nas zhag 'ga' song nas brag dkar du rgya nag gi ska rags sbugs thags ma zhig la/ bka' bsgo dang 'dod gsol bris/ dam rdzas yo byad 'ga' re dang bcas nas kun dga' dpal bzang 'bul du btang bas nyams chags bskang ba'i rtags gsal por byung / de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mjal bar bsam ste/ brag stod phyogs su —246—

chas/ pha drug gi tsha nas snga dro langs nas yongs pa'i nyin bde ba can gyi gdod thad der/ bsam gling mkhan chen sngags grwa pa bsu bar sleb byung / khong la rgyal 'gong rjes su 'brang pa'i cho 'phrul du ma 'dug nas de la gzir gyin phyin/khong yang mdog ro sor zhus zhus pa byas song / de nas bla ma mchog gi sku drung du sleb/ da res 'phrad pa 'di dga' zhes shin tu dgyes pa rang gnang gin 'dug zla gcig lhag tsam sku drung du bsten rgyu byung / gtso bor sngar gyi nyamasamyong rnams la bogs 'don pa dang / gegs bsal ba lam du gtong tshul kho na'i bka' stsal pa rnams bka' drin du thob cing / gdams pa'i gnad kyi chos ci rigs pa yang stsal/ rang res ma thob pa'i chos zhu rgyu 'ga' re yod kyang /thob rgyu dang thos rgyas chog pa yod snyam pa kho na snying la bzhag ste zhu ba ma byung /de skabs bka' las/ 'u cag yang nam 'chi cha mi gda' grwa rigs lag g.yog grul btub tsam yod pa tsho yang phal cher shi da lta ni 'di tsho na sna tshogs las mi 'dug pas 'u cag shi ba byung na'ang shul 'di la khyod kyis blta dgos zhes yang yang gsung / lan cig 'di na mno bsam tha dad pa 'ga' re yod pas dgon gnas 'di mi 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel du chos skyong gi rtag gtor zhig tshugs phebs pa ltar bsgrubs yar rgyab nas zhing skyong zer ba'i dpon rigs shig 'das pa'i bsngo zhus 'phran bu skyel ba la/ sde pa'i drung rang gi phyag dam zhig kyang gnang byung / yar rgyab sde pas bar skabs der 'brel bcad/ de nas 'brel 'thud pa'i thog ma de mi shi'i sde sbyor de mdzad/ rten 'brel de 'dras yong / lan cig mgon po'i gtor chen brag steng du bskyal bas/ lcam dral —247—

lam me ba zhig gi gsal snang mthong / bskang gso'i thun gtor skyel khan la yang mthong snang mang po byung gda'/ chos rje sngags grwa pas gzhi byas rnams la ji tshogs 'khor zhig btang / tshogs rdzas kham re bsten pa la bla ma dam pa dang nged dang kun dga' dpal bzang dang gzhan yang 'ga' re la yang byung / lhag par nged rang grib shin tu na bas 'khrid brgya sogs 'chad 'phro tsho yang 'jog dgos la khad byung / bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas/ kha sang kho ba'i tsho gis 'khor de ma dag pa'i grib tu 'dug tshogs kyi grib tshogs kyis sel bya ba yin gsung nas phyag nas tshogs 'khor zhig gnang bas/ tshogs kyi phyed tsam zas zin cing ma dan zhal gang bsten pa'i mod la sangs te grag song / 'di skabs 'jags pa sprul pa'i sku glo bur du sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten dang gnas tshul skyes mkhan 'byor/ khong gshegs rkyen 'jags rang gi chos skyong ma dgyes pas bsrung skyob bral ba'i rnam par byung ba 'dra/ 'phral rkyen rnam gling chos sde par gtogs pa'i bla ma gcig gis 'jags pa'i dgon gzhis 'phran bu de pa mig 'og tu bcug pa la lo re lo gnyis tsam yang rang gis ma thub par dug spyor byas 'dug pas yid skyo shas che ba cig kyang byung / spa lung du chos rje ngag dbang pa'i sku skye yang spyan drangs/ nged la 'bod mi byung ba ltar khor tsam zhig phyin/ sgom chen sems rgyud ma thul ba rnams zings shig kho nas dus 'da' ba de gshis su 'dug pas zir zir ba zhig las ni mi gda'/ slang yang brag stod du 'ongs te tshe dbang zhig rten 'brel du zhus/ phyir 'ongs dus brtan bzhugs shig phul zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab dus cang mi gsung / spyir rje btsun 'di —248—

nged kyi lo bzhi lon pa'i dus su mjal ba nas lo nyer lnga lon pa'i gting skyes su mjal ba'i bar de la/ snga phyir sku la bgres su 'gro ba'i rnam pa 'gyur ba ye med/ de dus phag lo yin/ de rjes kyi yos lo de la gting skyes su mjal dus/cung zad bgres pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi tshul bstan 'dug de nas rta lo'i skabs kyi bar 'di la bgres tshabs che ba'i tshul bstan 'dug ste sku dbyings su bsdu ba'i dgongs pa brtad pa der gda'/ 'di skabs sku gzhogs nas tshur 'ongs dus chos rje sngags grwa ba blo bzo'i rig rig gras kyi byed pa phugs kyi rten 'brel du 'grol re nas/ nged la skyel ma yang bla brang gi sgo'i them pa'i mtshams su byed pa sogs snying rje zhing gad mo'i rgyu mang po byed/ snga sor rgyang nas thos tshod la khong pa brag stod du yang yang yong zhing bla ma dam pa la mos gus dang zhabs tog che phyag g.yog 'grub po yod zer ba'i grags pa cig kyang 'dug pas blo sems dkar bar yod kyang / 'di skabs khong gi mtshan nyid rtogs 'phral bla ma'i phyag nas gnang sbyin zhu ba dang kho pa mi rta mang po la lto chas dgos pa'i phyir du chos zhu ba la khag dkris nas sku gzhogs yang yang yongs par 'dug cing /gnang spyin lkog tu zhus nas mtshan mo rtsibs ri la skyel/ 'bul ba gang yod khrom bsags nas byed/ gang sdod kyi ring la yang skyug bro la sngon slu ba'i spyod ngan kho na byed/ phugs kyi 'dod pa grwa rigs rnams rim pas slad nas kho rang la 'du bar byas/ bla ma la 'chi dgugs dang shul la rngams pa kho nar 'dugasnga sor phyag g.yog cung go chod pa'i khungs 'ga' shas yod pa rnams kyang lo gcig gi khongs su na lugs cig par byung nas thams cad 'das gda' ba yang —249—

dogs pa'i gzhir gda'/ spyir khong par ma zad 'di ba'i sde 'di tsho phal cher bsam sbyor shin tu rtsog pa 'di'i rigs kho na yong gin 'dug 'on kyang / gang phyir 'jig rten skyon la dga'/ /skyon yang yon tan ltar mthong nas/ /zhes pa ltar/ skye dman rlung khyer ma tshos sna drangs pa'i mi nag pa phal dang btsun pa glad med tsho dad pa mi skye dgu skye ci byed las zad la 'gro ba gcig ni gda' lags/ de nas dgon pa bde ba can du sleb cing / ya byang mtsho sgo nyi shar rnams brgyud de yongs/ brag stod nas yongs pa gnas brtsams nyin re bzhin rlung chen pos rjes bcad pa bzhin du byung ste/ rang gi sems nyid chos skur ngo sprod pa'i bla ma de dang tshe 'di la phyis mi mjal ba'i rtags su gda'/ mtsho sgor shin tu 'tshub cing rlung nag spyi dang mi 'dra ba byung ba'ang khong rang rnams la 'phral du blta bar 'dug phug dmar gyi la la mi rta 'khyer ba'i rlud tsam byung /ngas dam nyams kyis khengs pa'i lung ba pha gi tsho la 'gro dgos 'dis yin byas pas chos rje dkon blo sogs 'bod mi tsho lce nar byed kyin 'dug gdong dga' bde gling sogs brgyud/ grom pa lha rtse'i rdzong dpon 'phos 'phral gyi drang srong ba dang gro lung pa 'dug pas thab 'dzin bteg hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la ri khrod chen po jo nang du sleb/ de nyid nas ka 'khrid kyang btsugs snga sor nags phug mi dpon la brten pa'i kham mchu'i skabs/ nged myur du 'chi ba'i lung bstan dang bsdigs ri byed mkhan rnams la phal cher khong rang tsho 'dus byas kyi gnas tshul bstan grub/ byang rang gi dbu bla'i khungs gyag gyog de 'dra bzhi lnga zhig bshud btud la lud tshar 'dug ang yig pa sangs ma rgyas nye —250—

gnas sangs rgyas pa'i dper song / mang po zhig ni kha skyengs se ba gzhan las 'dzums gab gcig 'dug kha gcig ni nged la dbang dang drag po'i las mtha' byed do/ /snyam rang ngam rang phyogs rnams mi shes dgu shes mi dran dgu dran lag tu mi 'gel dgu 'gel byed pa'i rigs 'gres gzhan la yang dogs pa byed cing 'phral khyed byin rlabs can yin zhes tshig gi mos mos ltar byed/nged rang tshang gi mdog smon 'gro ba sogs ni bar skabs der grub mtha' chos brgyud sogs kyang gzhan la ngo log gi khungs dang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas sna tshogs su smod cing bzlog pa dang ngan byed shes zer ba thams cad gsog par yang 'dug ste thams cad snying re rje snying re rje phaṭa kho bo nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i las tshogs ta thams cad la mkhas kyang / las mtha' sgrub pa'i don du rdzas sna cig kyang gsog ma myong / /'khor lo sbar mthil tsam 'bri ma myong / ngan sngags 'phreng skor cig bzla ma myong / sgrub mtshams gcig sdom ma myong / dmyal rgyu skad cig kyang gsog ma myong / kho bos bltas na ni sems can rnams skal ba dman pas nga yi 'dod don ma 'grub pa kho nar song snyam gyin gda'/ gzhan gyi blor snang la khyod la dbang drag rgyas pa sogs byas pa'i zhad re mang gda' 'dod don yang 'grub kyin 'dug pa re mtshar snyam na/ rnam par mi rtog pa snying rje'i rang bzhin du shar bas/ ye shes smra ba po rnams la/ /ye shes gcig bus las kun byed/ces pa de yin te 'ong /smras pa/ dbang bsdud mkhan dang drag sngags mkhan/ /bsam ngan po —251—

rnams bla tshugs 'dzin/ /rang 'dod dbang gis las tshogs bsgrubs/ /dmyal ba'i sgo che ma lags sam/ snying la nor sgrub sna tshogs bcangs/ /yong ni yi dwags khyu cig yong / /nyin mtshan dbang bsdud bsgrubs pa la/ /dbang thang gzhan la shor ba mang / /mthu chen 'dod pa'i drag las mkhan/ /dgra rnams tshe ring phyug la btsan/ /rang gi phyogs la god kha mang / /bzlog pa byas kyin 'dre gdon gnod/ /dge bshes bla ma shes ldan rnams/ /grong sngags nag po'i ring lugs spong / /dad pa brtan pos dge phyogs spel/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa lags/ /bla chen mang tshad 'di 'dra gda'/ /chas kyi lag len lta ci smos/ kha skad tsam yang ye med pa/ /'jig rten khengs grags kho nas 'da'/ /bden med la bden par 'khrul pa snying re rje/ /bden pa la dogs pa skye ba snying re rje/ /mgo skor la sha tshar nor ba snying re rje/ /drang po la rdzun du 'dzin pa snying re rje/ /a tsa ma a tsa ma snying re rje/ /lud gong gi le'u ma lags sam/ /da ni kyus la 'jug par bya ste/ de lo 'khrid gsar ba mang rab dang /'khrid lo 'bring tsam byung / chos rje kun blo ba dang / grwa tshangs chen mo'i slob dpon rin po che bla ma ba dang / yol pa mkhan chen sogs mang rab la/ sbyor drug brgyud pa mi 'dra ba gzhan yang 'ga' re bshad/ sde ba ljang pa chos rje la srog gegs byung ba la gegs sel cig bstan/ sgom pa'i lugs byas kyang bcas bcos gzhan byed mkhan mang ba'i skyon gyis 'das/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu nas kun dga' chos dbyings pa'ang lhag par na ba la/ rim gro sman —252—

dpyad sogs gang yod byas na'ang nad 'or du lhung ba'i slar phyir lod la hor zla gsum pa'i nyer gnyis la khams ma 'tsho/ rjes sgrub gang grag rang btang bzang thag chod pa byung yang byung ba de gang yin/ nad gzhi ni spyi babs chang skyon gyi snga sor nas lus zom zhing yang yang na 'ong ba cig gda'/ de skabs kyang smug po byer ba 'dra ba cig 'dug 'tsho byed spe bzang pa rdor gyis brtag dpyad byas pa zas ngan du ngos 'dzin byed kyin gda'/ dogs gzhi yang cung zad byung /gtso bor ni phan pa'i ngag la mi nyan par 'brel med byung rgyal du bskyangs pas lan song / rin po che ka bzhi nas/ 'di skabs kyi snga phyi rnams la/ dgon grwa rigs dang bcas pa thams cad da dgos khyod la blo gtong dgos 'dug nged tsho'i cha nas chos nas bshad pa'i bla ma bsten tshul rnam dag zhig dgos rgyur 'dug na'ang khyed la sngar de bzhin la ma grub pa la 'thol bshags 'bul/ skye ba phyi ma bla ma'i dgongs pa sgrub par smon lam 'debs/ grwa pa kun la'ang de mthun gleng ba yod ces snga ma sku snyel ba tsam nas ma gshegs par la bshud mar byung / hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la sku ma 'tsho bar gda'/ de mthun gyi chos lung byang rtse'i phag mo dur khrod du sbur bzhu dang / nged la yang bsngo rten gnas tshul skyel ba la grwa rigs rnams byon zhing / 'on kyang grwa rigs kyi mgo mi dang dgon pa'i khur len nged kyis byed ma dgos yang / 'di skabs su 'jags kyi phyogs su tsho gnyis su song ba'i phyogs gcig sngar lugs bzhin gyi rgyud la gnas na sems pa dang / bla brang rnying pa pa'i mi ngo shul ma rnams sku skye'i dbon po la brten gzhan phyogs la lhag par mos pa'i zi re ba byung zhing /—253—

gnyis thad nas yi ge dang zer lugs mi 'dra ba gsor thag 'then yong ba zhig gda'/ bsam mno la 'phral dar rgyas che chung dang kha drag zhan ji ltar byung yang chos lugs rkangs ma 'chugs tsam byung ba shangs lugs kyi chos kyi bstan pa la phan pa yin bsam pa dang / chos kyi rkang 'a rtsags na/ dar rgyas che yang shangs pa bka' brgyud dar bar mi 'gro dgos don stong 'dug bsam pas so so'i dbang du ma btang bar bsam rtser sde pa la yang zhus/ rnam gling chos sde dang dga' gdong sogs kyis snga mo nas sde pa la yang yang zhus gda' na yang / dang po'i zhal ngo de tsho shes ldan 'dug cing gzhan/ 'ba' zhig la gros 'dri mi dgos par rang thag chod pa zhig yod pas zhal bzhes ma mdzad gda'/ de kas da lta'i bar du tshugs ma stor tsam byung / zhabs drung tre bos kyang 'jags dgon pa phyag tu dgos tshul phebs byung na'ang / lan 'debs la spyir gyi 'bul mi 'dod pa min yang 'di kun zhal 'dzin gnang yang khong tsho la yang phan mi thogs shing phyag tu yang phan pa dka' bas da res mi legs zhus/ de ka lung bstan bzhin du song gda'/ de nas lo ma 'gor bar zhabs drung ngang sku 'das/'di skabs lhun grub spe'u nas bkod pa mdzad/ rtsad skor glang lung rdzong mdun khram mda' rnams la grwa khral grwa pa gsar ba drug cu lhag tsam byung ba lo bdun lon pa yan chad rab byung bsgrubs/ bsnyen rdzogs pa gnyis byung / jo nang gi chos grwar rab byung bsgrubs byas 'phral gyi rten 'brel yang legs/ khong tsho la mi 'khrugs pa sogs chos sna kha yar bsgrubs/ de nas sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes lnga la chos lung byang rtser phyin/ de lpin lam bkra yang legs/ zhug 'ga' shas —254—

chos than thun dang / lus la phan du re ba'i chu tshan 'dra bsten gyi yong skabs ngam ring nas 'bod mig gnang ba'i nged lhun sdings tsam du sleb dgos pa'i 'phrad 'dod yin nan chags phebs byung na'ang / phyogs der 'gro ba ltas la ma chug zer ba byas de don la ltag tshugs bzung ba'ang yin/ ci ste nges par mjal ba'i dgongs bzhed yin na chos lung nyid du phebs pa las thabs gzhan ma mchis shing / 'di skor la sku dog bar chad ye med tshul 'bul bar kun dga' dpal bzang pa sku zhogs brdzangs dus rje 'gyur med tsam ma gtogs phebs pa la bshol 'debs byed mkhan kho na byung 'dug na'ang / de res skabs nged kyi tshig 'a/ thugs bkal nas de 'phral bskyod pa bde bar chos lung nyid du phebs bzhud gnang byung zhing / de res nyes skyon cang ma byung ba de kar gda'/ gzhi byas thams cad la dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i skyes dang /rnam dkar gyi phun tshogs rgya chen po dang bcas par gyur cing / bzhed dgongs ltar dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ rkyen sel gyi rjes gnang mang rab dang bcas pa phul/ lo de nang du sku dog ltar yod phebs pa la'ang / hor zla bdun pa la 'dzer bag che ba tsam du snang / de min nyes skyon med tshul 'char sgo ltar zhus/ byang nas zhabs drung nyid kyi 'phral gyi bar chad 'ga' re sel ba dang / skye bo mang po la phan pa'i ltas kyang gsal bar shar/chu chen po gcig nas srog chags kyi phung po lung phung tsam skam sar bton pa dang / gser gyi gru gcig las skye bo mang po sgrol snyam na 'jug mkhan mang po ni mi snang / las mthun ngo shes pa lnga drug tsam chu'i pha khar bsgral ba sogs rmi/—255—

de rjes sgrub sde rnams la rtsa dbu ma sogs 'khrid chos 'ga' re byas/ 'di skabs theg nyer bdun bsdad/ bsam rtser shar stengs nas dpon sa rin mo che sku khams ma 'tsho ba'i byang chog byed dgos byung ba gshegs rkyen rgyal po'i gnod pa la brten par 'dug pas gshed 'brel bgegs skrod bungs bskyed pas bltas kyang bzang ba tsam shar/ nged 'brug sbrul rta lo'i stod rnams las smad phyogs la song ba'i bar la smon 'gro ba dang chos lung gi grwa pa kha re khog 'brel/ dpon po kun rdor ba yang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rje rdo rings ba la dad pa log ngag bzang pa'i che brjod kyis dus gda'/ dgon khongs dang lung pa'i phu rnams bya bral ming can skya min ser min byi po chom po tshos gang pa gcig byas/ jo nang du'ang smon 'gro ba'i khang par stong rdzus tsho'i 'du 'tshog sogs 'gro 'chams bltas rgyu'i khungs dang blo phyir 'chus mang po rang byung 'jug nga yi bsam pa la de ka rang 'dra mo rang bsam pa gcig byung ba slar nga'i bsam pa der song / de nas mar lam jo nang brgyud nas byang chen du phyin/ sleb 'phral nas mtshams bsdams zla ba phyed gsum tsam du dge sbyor 'phel bar byung /khyad par rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa dkyil 'khor la brten pa cung zad byas skabs kyang / spyir yang ltas bzang bar byung zhing / khyad par hor zla drug pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor las dngos grub blangs pa'i skabs me tog gi char 'bab pa rdzun med mngon sum du byung zhing / sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang mchod kyang zhag mang po lo na'ang gsar pa lta bu la dpe gzhan gyi mtshon du med pa'i dri ro bzang po che zhing gsal ba byung ba yang —256—

sbyangs pa dang rtogs pa'i cha shas tsam du go /'di dag kun tu snga phyir yul dus kun gyi 'gyur ba la brten nas rang shugs kyi skyo shas che bar byung / hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la 'tshub dang cho 'phrul gyi rnam pas bla ma yi dam gyi gtor ma la/ o dkar bas gnod pa byed pa dang sdig pa rwa can shin tu che ba shig nam mkha' nas rang gi pang du lhung ba sogs sna tshogs pa byung ba rnams kyang dbyings su bskyal/ 'jags kyi gdan sa 'god dgos byung nas/ rnam gling chos sde pa dang / pa snam dga' gdong ba sogs 'jags la su thob ling nge ba la khong tsho'i ham pa rang rtsis su ma song bar/ khu spe bka' bcu ba kun dga' legs grub thugs dam grag pa'i khungs kyis bsko bzhag byas na'ang phyi ni sngar gyi rten 'brel de khar gda' bas nye gnas kyi skyon gyis zi re ba cig ka byung /snga sor rang re'i ltas dang mthun par/ 'di skabs ngam ring du sde srid rang sku khams stems par byung ba la sku rim rgya che ba gnang ba dang rje bla ma dam pas bka' dbang gnang ba sogs kyis sku khams bde bar byung yang / bla ma dam pa 'phral du sku khams mi bde bar byung nas zla ba de nyid kyi nyer bdun la byang ngam ring gi pho brang nyid du gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan tshod du gda'/ nyer lnga'i rmi lam du bla ma dam pa byon/ 'u cag kha sang nas na yin yod zer ba'i skad cha yod par 'dug na'ang de 'dra ye mi bden/ sngar yang na ma myong da dung na ba mi chi srid ces thugs 'u re yod pa zhig gsal por byung / de dag kyang phugs nges pa'i don la dgongs shing / gnas skabs su zhig pa la slar 'jig tu med pa'i don sku 'da' ba'i ltas su gda'/ nyer 'dun gyi nyin —257

thog mar spyan gyis mi gzigs pa ltar mdzad pa la slar sku gzhon nu'i rnam pa shin tu mtshar ba mu tig gi rgyan dra phyed khral khrol du gsol ba na bza' spangs pa'i rnam pa can zhig phyogs gzhan zhig la thegs tshul yod pa zhig byung /gnam gang gi nyin gnas tshul skyel mi sleb/ don du ni mthong thos dran reg gi gdul bya tha ma 'dul ba la dgongs pa dang snga sor bka' yang yang phebs pa ltar gyi dgon gnas kyi shul rnams bdag la gtod par bzhed pa ste/ de yang rje nyid rang nyid kyi gdan sar sku thim na/ bla brang gi nang ma nang g.yog dang grwa rigs sgom chen gyi ming can blun po rnams dang yon bdag gi khungs rnams 'phral zas gos dang phugs chos rdzu'i zoms la brten te sngags grwa ba rgyam pad rang gis mgo skor zhing bslad zin pas rje sku 'das ma thag par khong gis bdag byed pa zhig yong par 'dug de ltar na ni chos brgyud lag len nyams len yo 'chugs te bla ma dam pa de'i dgongs bzhed kyi log phyogs 'gal zla kho na la 'gyur 'gro ba der gda'/ 'di skabs kyang sku thim pa'i gtam thos ma thagakhong pas brag stod du phyin grwa ba rnams la'ang yi ge the'u tshe len pa dang bla brang gi sku chas nas ja sbob rtse nyis sbrel sogs mang dag zhig rgyan bu'i rdzong dpon la rngan par bstabs na bza' bzhugs gdan sogs sku chas mang dag cig mtshan mo bskyed pa sogs zar zir mang po byas gda'/ 'on kyang 'gal rkyen mang pos lo shas bar du dka' se ba'i ngos nas snga srol bla ma nyid kyi dgongs pa la ji ltar yod pa rnams phyogs mthun tsam 'grub par byung ba ni rje nyid yul gzhan du sku thim pa'i rten 'brel las byung bas/ skye bo 'ga' zhig sde dpon gyi —258—

rdzong du sku 'das snyam ma dad pa byed kyi 'dug kyang / spyir phyogs de kun yang gnas bzang bar rgya gar paṇa chen nags rin sogs kyi rnam thar las shes shing khyad par rgyu mtshan gong du smos pa ltar dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad pa kho nar nges shes skyes so/ /de skabs gdung chog ngam ring du gnang 'dug na'ang sku gdung rin po che sgrub gnas su spyan 'dren pa dang dgongs rdzogs kyi dngos bzhi sgrub par dngos kyis kyang mtshams bkrol te hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer gsum la byang chen nas chas/ yar lam rtsad skor gyi gnas 'di/ ngas pa'i sa gzhi la bgegs skrod tsam byas nas hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gsum la sgrub gnas chen po brag stod du slob/ tshes bcu'i nyin par/ nged rang gi mi sna grwa rigs dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang sku gdung spyan drangs nas 'byor zhing / de'i nyin nas dgon lag grwa rigs dang bcas pa/ thams cad 'dzom pa'i tshogs grwa btsugs/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin par grol ba yin zhing / rje bya bral du gyur pas sku chas rgya che ba ni lar nas med cing cung zad yod pa rnams ni chags med du gzhan la stsol bar mdzad/ lhag ma cung zad yod pa rnams kyang bar skabs der zegs 'thor du song bas nas cha phran tshegs ma gtogs thams cad nged rang gi lag nas btang / rten bzhengs 'phran bu yan chad grub pas de'i byin rlabs la brten nas phyis 'byor pa dang nga/ge ba'i bya ba yang gong 'phel du 'grub pa cig byung / 'di skabs kyang sngags grwa rgyam pad pa yang dgongs rdzogs kyi skal ba len par byon yod cing nged kyis kyang khong la rnam gzhag sogs bzang du btang / khong pa rang gis ni sgrub sde la thug pa gcig kyang —259—

drangs pa med/ gdung la zhal zas gcig kyang ma phul/ dbus pa'i mi ngan khrel por ngo tsha med ltogs la can 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar zangs ma de ka bskyangs nas dgongs rdzogs grol ba'i nang par phyi la dengs song / de rjes su sgrub sde rnams la shangs chos dbang byin rlabs dang bcas pa cha tshang ba zhig dang / skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim cha tshang zhig bshad/ ngo sprod zhu mkhan mang du byung bas/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams 'khrid mang du btab/ hor zla dgu pa'i nyer dgu la rin rdzong pa'i lag nas ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i sku dang / gting skyes brag dkar nas bdud mgon chen po lcam dral gyi sku phebs pa/ dus gcig tu 'dzom/ mgon khang gsar du btsugs pas gnyan par byung / nub gcig bla ma la gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba btab pas rmi lam thabs su grub thob brgyad shin tu gsal bar byung de dang mthun pa'i bstod pa yang byas/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam song rjes su cung zad ltas 'tshub pa zhig byung nas mtshams dam por bsdams/ ngam ring la 'phral du 'gro ba'i chad so yod pa la'ang 'gyang cha zhus/ mtshams bsdams nas zhag gsum song dus/ bsam rtse nas sde pa sku 'bring pa'i drung mthu stobs rnam rgyal ba sku khams snyel ba'i stabs kyi 'bod mir stag tsho ba gnang ba'i zhal ngo thams cad kyis shin tu bka' nan che bar byung na'ang / sku khams da lam 'di la brten pa'i skyon che ba rang med snyam/ de bas nged rang gzab dgos yin pas dgongs grol rang zhu byas ltas dang bstun nas 'gro ma thub/ phyis sde pa mthu stobs drung rang de la thugs brnyas ma 'khrungs na'ang / sde pa kar bstan drung dngos mi dges tsam byung 'dug—260—

mtshams zla gcig lhag tsam song ltas kyang 'jam par byung nas ngam ring du chas skabs/ gtsang gi dmag dbus la bteg zer ba'i skad cha byung / gzhan la g.yar po mdzad pa'i dus 'khrug de spyir shin tu ma legs/ khyad par sde ba kar bstan drung rang thugs dgongs la rtog rtsing gang byas kyang karma pa yab sras kyi byin rlabs kyis 'byobs yong snyam pa yod de rang gi las ngan la gzhan gyis skyob thub pa med/ da ni sde ba'i sku tshe yang lhus things snyam pa byung / 'di skabs brag stod kyi dgon lag mtsho dbus dgon par chos bros pa mi phal cig byung ba dang brag stod rang du btsun gsar ma gcig rang byung ba la rgyan bu rdzong dpon gyis rtsod pa gtong ba sogs sngar gyi ja spob rtse'i 'bras bu rnams mgo tho re ba smin gda'/ nged kyis gur chung la brgyud de ngam ring du sleb/ nam mkha' legs pa sogs bkra yang legs par byung / bde mchog bong zhal can/ sgrol ma bla med kyi dbang / bsam mi khyab kyi 'khrid sogs bzhed dgongs kyi chos bka' yang mang rab phul/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la 'gro rgyu yin na'ang / nyer gsum gyi nyin nas zhabs drung rang sku khams bsnyel ba rang zhig byung / sman dpyad pa rnams kyang 'tshab cha che bar byed kyin 'dug pa la/ spyir sku dog cung zad yod pa rkyen sel gyi dbang byin rlabs sogs kyis lhongs par snang bas da res sku la nyes skyon du mi 'gyur ba thag chod ces khas blangs/ kho tsho la khog gnod 'dra gcig kyang 'dug la la yid ches byed/ phal cher the tshom se byed do/ /sku rim sgyur kha 'dra phul ba ltar chos sde tshogs pa dang yang dus mtshungs te 'phral du bsgrubs zhag lnga'i bar shin tu bsnyel bar byung yang —261—

nyer brgyad nas gzung sku dwangs skyed che ba'i tshes gcig nas sangs dwangs 'phral rkyen sel gyis dbang phul ba kun yang phan thogs byin rlabs che bar mngon pa byung / phrag dog dang ngan smras la dga' ba rnams kyis snyil ba'i skabs sku mtshams dam po mdzad pa la sku ma bzhugs pa yin yong bsams nas col sgrogs sna tshogs kyis mdog gzhung khengs/ de rjes sku mtshams 'phral du bsangs pas de tsho la snying tshim pa'i mthar thugs pa gcig byung rje 'gyur med kyang phebs pa dang mjal byung zhing tshes bzhi'i dgong mo stod pa'i tshong pa rnams dang 'phrad khong rnams kyis gser sogs mang rab byin pa rnams phyis brag stod kyi rten bzhengs kho na la song / tshes lnga'i snga bar btegs mar lam jo bo rjes bzhengs pa'i mchod rten yang mjal/ tshes bdun gyi nyin mo chos lung du sleb/bar skabs su dgon pa nyis 'dzin gyi tshul gyi sde srid rang gi phyag na yod pa de de skabs slar yang dngos la gtsang mar rtsis spros gnang / sngar bstan 'dzin rin po ches btsan phrogs mdzad pa'i mchod gzhis rnams 'di skabs rtsis sprod gnang ma thub gzhan mtha' dag ma tshang ba med pa byung / de skabs zhag shas bsdad nas zla ba de'i nyin shu lnga la sngar 'byud ltar gyi jo nang gi 'khrid btsugs/lo 'di la 'khrid lo 'bring tsam dang / btsun gsar byed mi drag zhan sna tshogs nas shin tu mang bar byung / 'khrid grol nas zla gcig tu nye ba la/ gsang 'dus/ gshin rje gshed/ rgyu sde lnga sogs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i yi ge 'ga' re brtsams/ jo mo nang gi sku 'bum chen mo'i lha khang ci rigs pa la dgon pa ba tshos mdzod byed pa cig bar skabs shig tu byung / rje grol mchog gi —262—

sku thog la de rnams 'don pa gnang 'dug na'ang / yos lo byang sku mched kyi nang gzings byung dus rje drung gong ma dpon slob rnams kyis dgongs bzhed mdzad nas/ bang rim gnyis pa'i gdod chen bzhi ma gtogs pa lha khang thams cad grong pa'i bskyas mdzod du song / de rnams spo bar 'dod pa cig snga mo nas yod kyang stabs ma bde ba la/ 'di skabs nye ring med par thams cad la skad btang ste zhag grangs 'di tshun chod la thon pa byed dgos tshul bsgrags par nged skyi phug tu mtshams shig byas/ 'di skabs shangs rdo sngon pa mi ngo gnyis 'brum pas 'das byang gcog sogs byed dgos byung / yin ni 'jags kyi chos skyong gi 'tshub tu mngon/ lha khang gi mdzod rnams dus thog tu bton cing / 'phral du gang byas pa'i dus nyin mo gsum btud mar nyin zangs kyi 'ja' 'od dang nyi thog dang 'ja' sprin gzugs brnyan shin tu ngo mtshar ba dang me tog gi char 'bab pa thams cad kyis mthong bar snyon med du byung zhing rol mo'i sgra snyan po dang dri bzang gi yul phyogs thams cad khyab pa'i rnam pa zhag mang por shin tu gsal ba zhig nged rang la byung na'ang / gzhan gyis tshor ba ni cher mi snang /'khrul snang yin las che mod/ mtshams grol nas tshogs khro'i khro lugs cig kyang byas/ rgyud gyi rgyal po ma hā mā ya la khyi ka chen don lhag par rgyas shing / de la bltos te tshig shin tu nyung ba zhig kyang ma brtsams/ chos lung du yang khor tsam phyin/ de rjes gsa' la brgal/ gtsang gzhung la yul tsho so so'i phu'i dgon pa ba rnams kyis lung pa'i mdar bsu ba ser 'phreng re mdzad/ grong tsho so sor bu skyes 'phral spyi pa las mang ba'i ming 'dogs dgos shin tu mang ba —263—

zhig byung / phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi ltas shin tu go /rim pas mang mkhar brgyud nas gting skyes su phyin/ dge 'dun mang po la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim rgyas par bshad cing / byang sa'i lugs kyi sems bskyed phog bar 'dir gam pa la yang khor tsam phyin cing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur sogs chos bka' mang rab dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ slar yang gting skyes su sleb nas/ rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi cho ga las brtsams/ dbang mtha' dag rdzogs par don gnyer mang po la byas/ 'di skabs snga phyi rnams la/ rang res bsgrigs pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas kyi mgon po'i skor rnams ma gtogs pa'i gzhan mtha' dag zhal ngo rnams dang don gnyer rnams la byas/dam rdzas kyi sgrub pa cig byas pa shin tu legs te/ dri bzang gis lung pa khyab pa dang / ltas rnams sngar bzhin shar/ de rjes ston ser kha ru yang song shing /brag stod kyi rten bzhengs snga sor hor zla gsum pa'i nang du 'go btsugs/'di skabs phal cher zin pas brag stod du 'gro ba'i yar lam la smad kyi phyogs la byas/ skyed kyi ri khrod der yang khor tsam phyin/ byang phug tu jo bo la mchod pa dang gsol btab mang du byas/ skye bo mang pos blun dad la brten pa'i mi'i rgyan cha dri ma can ngan ngon mang po sku la spron pas mi mdzes par song ba de rnams la rin po che'i dra phyed byed tshul gyi bkod pa yon bdag la zhus shing / sku la khrus gsol ba sogs kyang bgyi/ sku ngo bo me thub tu byon kyang / phyag g.yas kyi gru mo'i mtshams nas bral ba sogs cha shas la gnod pa mang du byung 'dug pas/de dag gso bar 'dod pa tsam byung yang / mi gnod 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam pa —264—

'dug pas spros pa bskyungs/ nged kyis ni lhag bsams gang dag byas pa'i khungs yin kyang / so so skye bo'i skyon gyis sems ngan pa'i mdud kha byung ba yin te 'ong / de skabs bsrung ma rnams 'tshub che ba'i rnam par byung zhing / de rjes zhag nyi shu tsam nas kho tsho'i mi ngo drag shos de sogs glo bur du shi/ zar dang stag sna'i mi dmangs rnams snga gong 'brel chags shin tu chung ba yin na'ang /'di skabs phal cher dad pa skyes gyur pa'i tshul du byed pa cig byung / de nas rim gyis drang song rdzong sogs brgyud nas brag stod du 'byor/ sleb 'phral nas rten bzhengs kyi gzungs bzhugs sogs rim pas bgyis/ gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs yin pa dang / der rten bzhugs dgos pa nas/ rab gnas kyis cho ga kyang gza' tshes dang bstun snga bar byas/ sa chog gi spyin sreg kyang zhi drag gnyis kar bgyis shing / hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin mo rab gnas dngos gzhi byung la/ de nyin zhi rgyas gnyis kyi sbyin sreg dang / bcu bzhi'i snga dro rjes kyi bya ba dga' ston dang bcas pa song / de nyin ka dbang dang zhi ba'i spyin sreg mtha' rten dang bcas pa sgrubs/ de bar du phyi rten byang chub mchod rten zhig brtsigs pa'i phyed tsam yang grub/ de rjes mi ring bar grub nas rab gnas kyang bgyis/ 'di skabs kyi rten dngul gdung dpangs su rtse khru drug pa/ bzo khyad phun sum tshogs shing lhun chags pa/ dbyibs kyang rgya gar dang mthun par bzhengs/ phra rgyan sogs kyang phun sum tshogs pa rang byung zhing /rje btsun byams pa'i sku brnyan rgya mtho gsum pa shin tu mtshar ba zhig dang /gser tog chung ngu gcig rnams bcos pa la/ yongs bsgril gser rkyang zho —265—

brgya dang drug cu song / de mthun dngul shas che ba dang / zangs sogs rgyu la sbags de yon rdzongs de las lhag dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas nas gser srang bzhis sna drangs te/ gos dar sbus gtsang ba la lhus blangs pa'i gser zho nyis brgya'i rin thang gi tshad phul/ de skabs lag na yod pa'i yo byad thams cad dkrugs/ shul na gser se ba gang yang med/ spyir yang 'di yan chad du kho bo yon bdag grwa rigs mi bzang ngan/ 'byor pa che chung dad pa brtan mi brtan gang gi sar yang / chos phar gcod dgos pa'i bla ma'i rigs de yin/ tshur la 'bul ba bza' zos pa'i bla ma de 'dra min/ phar la mkhas 'jug gi ster sbyin dang ngo bstod yang byed ma myong / chos 'tshong mkhan min/ chos ster mkhan yin/bla ma rlud zhags pa min/ bla ma rlud sgom mkhan yin/ bla ma bskyed rim pa min/ bla ma rdzogs rim pa yin/ bla ma rang don pa min/ bla ma gzhan phan pa yin/ bla ma las mtha' pa min/ bla ma las dag pa yin/ dge bshes sdig po che de min/ bya bral thos rgya chen po gcig yin/ 'phags pa dmyal ba'i gting rdo de min/ so skyes thar lam gsal byed gcig yin/ zang zing nor la brje bo byas/ /dam pa'i chos ni brdal por btang / /ha ha 'di yang lugs gcig yin/ khre mthas ko mthas byed ri shi /'di skabs bla ma'i don du rten bzhengasapa'i rten 'brel gyis mi ring bar longs spyod mnga' thang je 'phel du song /'ga' zhig bla ma'i phyir du rten sogs la 'bad kyang / mthong chos kyi phan yon 'phral du mi yong ba de/ phal cher bsam pa ma dag pa'i skyon du snang zhing / kha cig ni bla ma rang gi yang skyon no snyam mo 'di'i skabs su tshes bcu gsum gyi —266—

nub mo bla ma chen po'i sku gdung dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por bsgrubs te/ thabs kyi dbus su zhugs me sgron pa'i tshe/ snga dro me tog gi char dang 'ja' sprin ngo mtshar che ba dang / dgong ja tsam nas shar phyogs su dbyar dus kyi 'ja' tshon legs po de kho na 'dra ba gsal bar zug pa yun ring du gnas pa byung / dus skabs hor zla dgu pa yin zhing char zim la sogs pa gang gis kyang rkyen med pas/ ya mtshan che bar mngon/ skrur khang phye ba'i tshe gdung rus snyim pa gsum tsam las mi snang zhing / phal cher cung zi'am zhu dkar gyi rdo 'dra ba'i rnam par 'dug bskal dus rnyings pa 'di la gdung skal khyab ches pa la'ang dgos pa mi 'dug pas dad can gal che ba 'ga' re la gdung skal gyi dmigs cung zad ma gtogs/ thams cad za ma tog gi nang du 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i sku brnyan dang lhan du mchod rten gyi bum par bzhugs su gsol/ deng sang 'di skad ces gdung rus nang rten du bzhugs pa dang gdung dngos su bcug pa ni lha khang dur khrod du 'gyur bas mi shes shing yul de la yang gnod do zhes zer zhing / rus pa'i rang mtshan med par thal bar sbyangs te tsha tshar bsgrubs pa bzhugs par 'dod la/ rgyu mtshan 'phags pa yin na rus bu bzhugs pa mchog yin kyang / bla ma rnams so so skye bo yin pa'i phyir ro zhes deng sang gi dpyod ldan du re ba phal che ba 'dod kyin 'dug ste/ gsang sngags pa'i bla ma de dkon mchog gi gra nas phud pa kha phyi zod zad kyi gtam yin mkhas pa 'di tsho rang kha nang gi lpags pa 'thug grags pas dga' mo yod gin yod 'dug 'u cag ni rtsa ba'i bla ma so so skye bo yin zer ba kha shin tu rang —267—

mo'i ma sems/ mi mkhas pa phal cher ni/ blun dad nyid kyi sgo nas gdung rus nang rten du byed pa la dga' bar yang byed do/ /de nas slob mas bla ma la so so skye bo yin zhes kha gdangs nas ngo mthon du brjod par mi spobs la/ 'on kyang the tshom za na tsha tshar bsgrubs te bzhugs pa sogs los kyang 'thad/ gang zag de nyid la phan gnod ni sangs rgyas kyis dngos su gsal bar ma gsungs pas rig gras kyis lung bstan byed dka' la gnod par nges na ni ba so dang rus pa la lha sku brkos pa la yang sems can de la gnod par thal bar ni 'gyur/dur khrod skyon du 'gyur na ni/ 'phags pa yin yang skyon de yod par mngon/'phags pa'i sprur skyel sa de yang dur khrod ka yin mod/ dur khrod du gyur kyang gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la ni bkra mi shis pa yang ma yin/ der ma zad 'dul ba las kyang grang khang du dur khrod 'bri bar gsungs pa kun la yang skyon 'dogs sam ci/ 'dir ni dam pa la 'di phal pa'i sa las 'das pa'i nges shes brtan po yod cing gdung rus rin po che dang mtshungs par gyur pa de/ slar yang phye mar bgyid pa'i blo ngan ci zhig byed/ de rjes su gzhung chu la gtor ma btang bas chu mig zhig kyang gsar du brdol/ 'tshams thung tsam byas pas ltas kyang bzang bar byung / gtsang nas sde pa kar bstan drung la shin tu mdzer pa'i rtags gsal po yang yang byung yang de lo thugs 'gyur re 'dug pas sku rim sogs snyan 'bul ma byas/ bal po bzo bo rnams slar ngam ring la 'gro skabs brgyan bu gnyer pa bshes gnyen pas ci lod lod byas shing / spyor brtod kyi yi ge rten bcas mi len par ma zad sa la rdebs pa sogs shin tu 'ur bar 'dug —268—

na'ang / zla gcig tsam nas khong rang bteg rgyu tshang ba las 'bras bu yong ba chos nyid du gad spa lung la'ang mi 'dod bzhin du khor tsam phyin/ de rjes cig nyo'i nang brgyud nas ding ri nas lung dang dgon pa rgya lung sogs su khor tsam phyin chos 'brel mang rab byas/ ding ri phyogs su nas ster mkhan byung ba 'dra la cha rkyen byas/ rgya lung du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod gtsugs/ 'di dgon chung yin yang bar chad byed mkhan med pas btsun gsar byed mkhan yang mang du byung / brag stod phyogs su ni spyi babs snga gong yul phyogs de kun na lo nyes sogs bar skabs su mi 'dod pa du ma yod kyang / rten bzhengs rnams bkra shis pa'i de nas da lta'i bar shin tu bde bar byung ba 'di yin na'ang / rgyan bu rdzong dpon chos dgon pa la snyen bkur byed mi yang 'gegs shing btsun gsar byed sa med pa dang / tha na gnas skor rten mjal sogs kyang byed sa med pa'i nag yig 'grems shing sgrog par byed do/ /de stabs nas 'di skabs btsun gsar byed mi ni ma byung / 'on kyang da ni dgon pa stangs zhan du ni mi 'gro las che snyam ste da dung rim pas rtags mngon du 'gyur ro/ /brag stod du tshogs chos kyang ci rigs bshad/ lcags zam pa sger pa chos rje ngag dbang pa la shangs chos gang zhib cig byas/ slar 'du khang bzheng rgyu'i shing bzo gal che ba rnams kyang grub/ bya lo'i nang du 'du khang bzheng rgyu'i bkod pa sogs kyang bgyis/ snga sor lug lo'i dgun chos kyi skabs/ ngam ring sde srid du mu tig chen mo mang rab dang / g.yu gos dar sogs zhu rten bzang ba rang phul/ bla ma dam pa de nyid ched kyis spyan 'dren gnang ba dang / gnas skabs —269—

su rkyen des sku 'das pa'ang yin/ sku 'da' sa tshun thams cad nas thugs khur bzhes pa'i bka' babs 'dug bsam bstan pa'i rgyun la dgongs pa'i chos gzhis tsam zhus pa yin na'ang gnang ma thub/ nyin gcig zhabar lung yong gsung na'ang / de'i sang rang 'gyur nas mi yong gsung / de kha'i dod du spyi dang bla brang yongs sdoms la nas khal stong phrag gcig spyi sa'i rnams bstan pa nam gnas par dang / bla brang gi rnams nged rang gis 'dzin bdag byed rin gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod pa ltar gyi 'di lo'i yong sgo rnams rtsis blangs/ sde srid nas dngul gdung la dkar me khor yug gcig kyang 'dzugs pa gnang / 'di skabs ngam ring du yong dgos tshul nan chags phebs na'ang dus 'khrid chag dogs nas ma phyin zhing / ya byang sogs lam zhor la yong dgos zer ba rnams la khyag khyog ma byas par lam bsrangs te jo nang du dus chos la sleb par byas/'di lo 'khrid gsar ba shin tu mang zhing 'khrid lo yang legs/ bla brang gi mkhar las dang rten bzhengs sogs 'di ltar byed dgos pa 'dug snyam pa glo bur du blo la shar/ hor zla dang po'i d+ku ba༅ sto/ dngos gzhi'i dam po'i mtshams kyi sgang zhig la/ bsam rtse nas nged la 'bod mi gro mo che ba byung 'ar 'ur 'dra byed kyin 'dug khong yang dus sde pa kar bstan drung snyel ba rang med pa 'dug na'ang / khong pa 'dir de ring sleb rgyu'i mdang nub de snyel yod par gda'/ ltas kyang 'tshub pa nas khong la re zhig khas ma blangs/ yang sku ltem pa yin zer nas mgron gnyer 'jam dbyangs sogs tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin mo sleb/ snga sor dbus dmag rting ma mdzad pas sku tshe la gnod cing snga phyir ltas —270—

kyang shin tu ngan pas sku khams mthar thon mi yong nges snyam/ mtshams 'og tu khong tsho la ngag 'phrad tsam byas/ nam yong nges can ni khas ma blangs byin rlabs rten dang dung rdzas sogs bskur de 'byor pa'i nyin mo sku khams bde tsam byung 'dug na'ang tshes bcu drug gi nyin mo sku ma 'tsho/ mgyogs bstso'i rten yang 'phral du sleb/ de mthun gang myur 'gro dgos shar te/ 'khrid 'phro mgyogs po byas/ nyer gsum gyi nyin mo thon pa'i snga dro yong khar bla brang gsar rgyag gi sa chog rnams byas shing der yang lam bkra yang bzang tsam dang / lcags kha bkra shis rtse'i gdong der gnas brtan bcu drug dang / rnam thos sras kyi sku la rab gnas zhu mkhan zhig kyang byung ba'ang shin tu bzang / ri klungs thams cad kha ba babs pa'i skya lam me 'dug pas yid spro ba zhig kyang shar/ spyi de skabs kyi kha ba de khro phu'i dgon pa gsar 'debs la sde pa gser ma nas rang la 'tshub kyi rnam pa yin par 'dug na'ang / nged la rten 'brel legs pa cig byung / rting sor jo nang bla brang gsar 'debs kyi 'gram 'dings pa'i nyin/gtsang sa nas nged la 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i li sku legs pa cig gnang byung ba 'grig pa sogs ltas bzang po yang rim pas byung / de skabs rtse ru sleb nas re shig gsang sgo'i tshul dang bstun pa'i phyi ltar du dbang 'bul gyin yod pa'i tshul byas nas/ mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga re btang / mtshan brjod pa sogs dge 'dun mang po la 'tshom chen du tshogs bdag dkar po sogs chos 'brel 'dra byas/ sleb nas zla phyed skor nas gsangs/ brdol/ chog grwa che ba 'dzugs pa mdzad/ zhal ngo snga ma 'das grongs byung ba rnams la kar lugs kyi ser —271—

gsogs las gzhan pa'i chog grwa rgya che ba yang ma byung zhing / cung zad yod pa yang phyogs ris can kho na yin 'dug na'ang / 'di skabs grub mtha' phyogs med kyi chog grwa 'dzugs par mdzad/ mthar sbung bzhu sogs thams cad rjes gtsang bar bsgrubs/ dgongs rdzogs rgya khyon che ba sdig dang ma 'dres par byung / de yang sku 'bring pa'i drung dang zhabs drung rgyal bu yab sras gnyis kar la ngas chog grwa 'di phyogs med ris med rgya che ba rang gnang dgos zhus pas de 'phral zhal bkod gnang song / sngar srol med pa'i ngor zha lu sogs 'di nas gzung nas chug pa yin/ kho rang tshos pho skyes nas byung ba ye med/ 'di skabs skyed ru ba sde pa rgyal las brgyud yar rgyab nas 'phral du yong dgos tshul nan can rang gsung gin 'dug lo 'di'i nang du 'bod mi yang yang dang gtsang sa'i ngo spron sogs byung na'ang ltas bzang po lar mi 'dug pas blo thag bcad/ der sku tshigs zhe dgu grol nas nged kyis shangs phyogs su phyin/ sgrub gnas 'jug tu shangs chos than thun mang du bshad/ don gnyer 'ga' la gcod khrid sogs nyer mkho 'ga' yang byas/ stag sna'i dgon par 'bod mi byung ba bzhin phyin/pha rin po che tre bo sprul pa'i sku'i dngul gdung la rab gnas dang / tshogs pa rnams la chos 'brel tsam zugad/ mi shangs chos 'khor gling du khor tsam phyin de mi dmangs la khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ slar yang 'jag tu khor tsam 'ongs nas grwa tshang chen mo sogs lam du yang 'gro don ci rigs pa dang bcas te/nyug rgyal khang du phyin zhag gsum bsdad/ nang so zhal ngo sogs so so la don gnyer gyi chos than thun bsgrubs shing / de rjes gser mdog can du zhag —272—

brgyad tsam gyi ring la tshogs pa thams cad la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyas pa dang / sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang sogs tshogs spyi dang / sgos so sor dbang byin rlabs sogs sngags chos mang ba dang / bla brang dang shangs pa grwa tshang gnyis su bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa yang thin tu mang bar byung / mkhan chen 'jam mgon lhun grub kyis rten bzhengs mdzad pa'i thub pa jo tshad ma de la/dus 'khor gyi cho ga'i steng nas rab gnas kyang byas/ brag dkar chos rje drung dang yang de dus thog mar 'phrad pa yin/ sgrub gnas bsam gtan sdings su yang zla phyed tsam la gzhir bzhugs pa rnams la chos thang thung ci rigs pa dang /shangs pa slob dpon pa sogs 'ga' shas la phag mo lha so bdun ma'i dbang dang sgrub dkyil gyi gzhung sogs bshad cing / de nas 'dol byung du zla phyed tsam bsdad pa la yang zhal ngo rnams la dbang chos ci rigs pa dang / chos zhu ba rnams la rdo rje gtum po'i dbang dang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa dang rang re'i brtsams chos mang dag sogs chos bshad rem par byas/yar lam 'brong rtse brgyud nas rtse chen du 'byor zhing / snga sor rtsa chen chos sde'i gdan sa mkhan chen rab mdzes pa sku gshegs 'phral nas/ slar yang nged la byed dgos tshul gyi gsung bris rim can du yod pa dang / 'di skabs kyang byed dgos tshul nan chags che che skad yang yang mdzad kyi 'dug kyang zhal kho na las snying nas min par yang 'dug chos sde pa phal cher blo 'dun par yang 'dug mod/ phyogs de kun sngar las rnam par 'gyur ba'i bun ne pa zhig las mi 'dug pas byed 'dod kyang ye ma skyes/ dbu mdzad mkhar thog pa la he ru ka'i —273—

'du shes rang mdzad kyin 'dug pa la bzang rabs dma' 'bebs rang byed pa'i skabs de yin/ 'dir yang chos zhu ba rnams la chos sna ma nges pa than thun sna tshogs dang / zhal ngo sogs la yang bzhed pa dang mthun pa'i dbang chos ci rigs bshad/ gsung rab dang rten gsar bzhengs rnams la rab gnas kyang bgyis/ zhal ngo rnam dag mang mkhar gnas pa'i chos mdzad da lta mkhas pa sangs rdor bar grags pa 'di sogs la zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid cig dgos gsung ba ltar rgyud ci 'khul gyi khungs su bshad pas/ chos mdzad khong res bya bral gyi khungs byas kyi rting la/ lhun rtser zhu log phul khong rang tshang gi grwa pa mang po khrims la sbyar ba sogs rang gi bya byed kyi mnong la phogs ste chos zhu 'phro la sleb ma byung bas ngo mtshar wo rgod bro bar byung / rgyal rtser yang phyin cing sdod sa zil gnon gyi gzims khang gsar pa der byas/ zhal ngo rnams su tshe bka' sogs rkyen sel mang dag dang / dbang cha gcig la bde mchog pū hi pa'i dbang / sa dge zha lu ba sogs sna tshogs 'dres pa'i bla ma slob dpon dge bzhas mang dag la/ dpal gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid mar 'gos gnyis kyi lugs cha tshang ba dmigs pa rnams sbungs kyin bshad/ yang mar lam rtse chen klu sdings su zhag gcig bsdad/ 'di dus rtse chen du snga phyi gnyis car la chos bdag bzang ra babs nas/ chos sde'i 'dzin bdag byed dgos tshul nan chags byed/ phyis kyi rten 'brel 'ga' la bsams khong rang gi mngon du cung zad cam khas blangs/ de rjes skye mkhar gyi chu tshan zhag shas bsten pas lus la yang 'phrod rab byung / 'dol byung du sleb dus 'brang phu nas a ma lags —274—

dpon g.yog kyang phebs byung / snga sor rtse chen du sleb dus nas 'byor rgyas pa 'bod mi la gnang ba ltar rim pas bsam 'grub rtser sleb/ yab sras rnams su phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid dang / dbang rjes gnang mang dag phul/ 'di skabs khro phur rdib bcom byung 'u lag pa sum cu skor shi pa'i skabs de yin/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig la slar yang khri khang du sleb bzhed dgongs dang mthun pa'i chos than thun phul/ mgon khang gsar pa la rab gnas dang rten gtor 'dzugs pa sogs byas de khang pa kha phyir bltas bag ma phebs po cig 'dugachos rje gnas gsar pa yang 'phrad du phebs byung / tshe dbang zhig dgos gsung ba ltar byas/ gnas gsar nas sde pa'i phyag nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil thang rgya gar ma dus zhabs pa chung ngu'i thugs dam rten yin zer ba/sngon jo nang pa rang gi yin nam zer/ gang ltar rje sgo dras pas rin po che mkhyen brtse ba la gnang ba de/ rta chas gser chas shig byung na nged la cis kyang ster ba yin zer gyin 'dug pas/ sde pa kar bstan drung gi dgongs rdzogs skabs byung ba'i gser chas sga 'khor tshang ma dang ral gri mgo shubs legs pa dang bcas pa gzhan yang ja gos dar sogs bslu yon gyis thugs tshim par byas de thang ka blangs/ khong rang yang lhag par mgu zhal bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi bris thang zhig kyang rting nas bskur byung / de nas snar thar gyi phun tshogs gling du yum sras rnams kyi gsung nan can byung ba ltar zhag bdun tsam bsdad/ byang chen du zhag nyi shu skor bsdad cing mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig grol nas/ sngar ma thob pa 'ga' shas la mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ spyi khyab —275—

tu thig le bcu drug gi dbang sogs chos bka' ci rigs byas/ 'di skabs gnas srin po ri nas drung yig bal du ba gnang ba'i yar lam gnas dang khro phur yang rab gnas dgos tshul sogs phebs sgo byung ba la/ gnas su ni dgongs bzhed ltar yong ba gzhir bcas/ khro phur 'brug pa'i grwa tshang gsar 'debs gnang ba la/ nged kyi rab gnas de rang mtshal rang la byas btsag mi'i dper yang 'gro las che zheng / khong bla ma tsho yang ma dgyes pa cig yong /rab gnas legs pa'i yon mchod rnams bkra shis pa ji tsam byung rung /'brug pa'i thugs rje yin zer ba cig las mi yong / de las ma byung kyang khyad mi 'dug ste/ ci ste sku dog dang byur chags thug pa 'dra byung na/ thog ma rab gnas byed mkhan des nyes zer ba cig yong bas/ khro phu'i rab gnas la cis kyang dgongs grol dgos zhes kha gsal nas zhus/ de mthun gnas su khor tsam 'byor skabs gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dbang sogs dgongs bzhed kyi chos rnams phul/ nub re bzhin ser bas sna drangs pa'i drag char yun ring ba 'bab cing / nub gcig rdzong gi 'khris su thog babs pa sogs phyi nang gi ltas thams cad rtsub tsam byung / de rjes jo nang du sgrub sde rnams bsod snyoms lam gyis tsam la sleb/ theg nyi shu skor zhig bsdad pa babs nas don med sog dal du las se ba cig byung na'ang / ston dus bzang zhig rig pa dwangs la skyid par byung / bla brang dam chos gling gsar du bto pa'i 'og thog thams cad khel ba dang / bar thog kyang ci rigs khel ba la rab gnas kyang mdor bsdus shig byas/ las ka grub che zhing phyi nang du 'tshub dang nyes skyon gyi rnam pa —276—

ye ma byung ba'i gtang rag gi tshul du gzhong stod kyi dur khrod du gtor ma rgya che ba zhig btang / grub thob 'dar phyar gyi sgrub phug steng 'og gnyis kyi 'og ma bdag med ma dang bde mchog sogs zhal gzigs sa dang / steng ma slob dpon pad+ma dang mjal sa yin par snang zhing / 'og mar phyin dus brag gi phug nas chu dri bzang che ba zhig gsar du brdol ba sogs ltas mtshar ba cung zad byung / jo nang sku 'bum nang gi sman sku chag grugs byung ba la zhig gsos byas pa phal cher 'di skabs grub/ rnam sras kyi 'cham sku gcig kyang bzhengs/ snga sor lo 'di'i dpyid gsos ngam ring du 'gro rtsis kyi khongs yin na'ang / gtsang la 'gro dgos stabs nas ma thub pas/ bsam sdings su yod dus nas gzung 'jad nas khang pa 'bod mi car sdod gnang ba ltar/ 'di skabs ngam ring du chas pa'i lam rtsad skor du dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi sa chog dang phyogs gtor sogs rgyas par byas/ phyogs gtor tsho skyel sa nor ba'i zing nge ba gcig byung / phyis yon bdag 'pho ba'i ltas su gda'/ rim pa'i ngam ring du 'byor/ sngon ma rgyang tsam sdod rtsis yod na'ang gting skyes la 'gro dgos stabs nas zla gcig las sdod long ma byung / de bar du gtso bor sde srid kyi bzhed dgongs dang / gzhan bla ma slob dpon sogs chos thob don gnyer dang bcas pa la chos ni 'phel bar byung / sa grang zhing dgun nyi ma thung ba'i dus yin na'ang chos thob rtsi ba'i rigs la chos 'gro yang che rab byung / de yang sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rang res bsgrigs pa'i go rim ji lta ba bzhin du nor lha'i skor yan chad yongs su rdzogs pa la rjes gnang gi ngo bo nyis —277—

brgya tsam yod pa phal cher dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen mo dang /phur bu sa lugs kyi dbang drag po sgrol dbang dang bcas pa/ ras chung lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha mang / gzhan yang phyag rdor sogs dbang dang khrid kyang mang du byas/ chags sdang sna tshogs la brten pa'i rtsub zing nge ba zur rong nge ba yang dgos par byung / gting skyes la mgyogs po 'gro dgos yin na'ang / a ma drung rten mjal sogs gnang dgos kyi khyad nas/ chos lung du yong dgos byung ba'i rten mjal zhi brgyas 'bul ba dang / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel gyi dbang yang mang du 'bul dgos stabs chos lung du zhag bdun bsdad dgos byung / snga sor bstan 'dzin rin po ches bzhes spyod mdzad pa'i mi sde grong rnams phal cher skabs 'dir sde srid lcam sring so so nas chos lung du sbyor 'jags kyi rtsis sprod gnang / grong pa kha shas smon 'gro nas kha snga bang mgyogs kyis zhus grub nas gnang ma thub/ mdog smon 'gro ba 'di dang po rje btsun grol mchog chos lung du thog ma phebs dus/ mdze po thar pa dang mjal ba'i rten 'brel las chos lung du dam sel chen po yod par lung bstan mdzad pa rnam thar na yang thebs pa'i dam sel chen po'i mtshan gzhi de smon 'gro ba kho nar gda'/ dang po rang rje dam pa'i sku skye mang por nye gnas su gyur pa/ dge slong dpal 'byor la dpon drung 'phan ne rang gis dug sbyor byas bden mi mang po'i rgyas yod dbang po can dang yin 'dug rje bla mas dgon pa'i khur bzhes gnang dgos rgyu la yang / 'phan gyi dus chos gsung rgyu yod tsam ma gtogs lar ma phul/ khong 'das rjes lo lnga khur bzhengs mdzad pa la —278—

rtse ba rnams rbud pa'i dam 'gal mngon gyur dang byas/ snga mo khong tshos gang cir mi rigs pa byas pa la grangs med par 'dug phyis kyang nged tshor gzhob rdog gnon rang gang shes byas pa dang bla ma rin po che byams pa'i drung sku gshegs pa la dar 'phyar byed pa sogs ji snyed cig yod/ sngon rje grol mchog gi rten bzhengs skabs/ phyogs kyi dad 'bul la tshad bzung du med skabs dngul sde yangs gang dang gser g.yu dre'u rgyab mang po smon 'gro rang gis zos zer ba'i kha skad grags chen yod pa yang don la bab nges yin/ rjes su'ang snyan dar mchod rdzas dgon pa'i yongs 'bab za kham lung med rgyun du byas pas/ dang bo kho rang tsho dga' tshad yod pa yin kyang dkor zug nas phyis kha lag mthil la thug pa yin/ dgon pa'i sgrigs bshig pa'i yang gtso bo rang de khong tsho lags na'ang / nged kyi cha nas 'khon bsangs ba cig ka byung na legs bsam pa dang / chos lung sgrub pa ba 'ga' res nan chags res byas pa la brten lug lo dpon sa la bshags pa blangs/ rim pas dpon drung la yang len rtsis yin kyang bshags pa byed zer ba kha tsam tshig tsam kho na yin pa'i rtags lo gcig tsam yang ngang sring mi thub par kha dang don thams cad nas mi rigs pa kho na byung ba dang / spyir khong tsho mna' dam bzhag dam tshig thams cad spangs dug sbyor ngan byed slus mgo g.yogs sogs dran tshad lag tu 'gel mkhan du gda' bas 'di skabs nas slar yang 'brel ba spangs/ de snga'i bya byed la brten rje byams pa'i mtshan can sogs bla ma gong ma'i dam tshig bsrung ba la yang de dngos legs par byung / de nas rim gyis chas de lam 'gor gang —279—

yang ma byas par gting skyes su 'byor/ khong tsho la dpon mo phebs pa'i bgegs skrod dang / thog mar chos bka' than thun ci rigs phul/ gam bar yang zhag bcu skor zhig song / gsang 'dus dang kyai rdor gyi dbang dang rkyen sel mang rab phul/ slar yang gting skyes la rgyang tsam bsdad/ gsang ri ru sdod gnas kyi mkhar las byas pa la lta bar phyin khang bkod blo dang mthun pa ni ye ma byung 'dug theg gsum bsdad skabs dus 'khor thugs dkyil ras bris la brten nas khang ba rab gnas dang / rang gi g.yog rnams la chos sna mi gcig pa bcu gsum gyi 'go btsugs/ nyi ma rting ma la gting skyes nas sde pa yab sras kyang phebs/ tshe mdo'i bshad pa yongs rdzogs shig kyang byas/ gting skyes su snga phyir ma hā mā ya dang / sam pu zhi'i dbang dang rang re'i bde mchog gi bstod pa'i 'grel chen dang / ma gcig gi gcod khrid tshar gcig sogs chos 'phel rab yang byung / de nas jo nang gi dus chos kyang ran pa las 'phyis pa tsam du song bas/ gting skyes nas yongs ba'i nyin rlung 'tshub che se ba gcig la de dgongs gangs babs pas sang nyin lung pa thams cad skya lam me ba byung /byams gling dgon par khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ dpal rtse nas sngar sku drung sdig po che rang yod dus 'brel chags dga' rab yod rung / khong pa 'das nas ngor mkhan drung gi bslab ston la brten de nas 'di'i bar la 'brel rgyun bcad/ thag thug chang chung yang yong ba cig ka byung song na'ang / 'di skabs nan chags kyis 'bod mi byung nas/ dpal ldan rtser bcags mal zhig bsdad/ gdong dgar yang zhug po bzhi pa zhig sdod dgos byung / jo nang du hor —280—

zla dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi la sleb/ bco lnga nas dus 'khrid kyang 'go btsugs/'dzam thang pa'i grwa ba sog po'i bla ma byed mkhan sangs rgyas dpal zer ba khong dpon slob rnams sleb/ khong pa la sog po'i rgyal po zhig gis rnying pa tsho bzhi'i bla ma so so la 'bul ba bskur ba ni mang dag yod par 'dug gzhan khong rang rnams kyi blo gtad jo nang rang la gtso bor dad mos kyis zhabs tog byed par yong ba yin 'dug kyang / dbus gtsang du sleb nas mar phyogs na 'brel cung zad yod pa'i nā len+d+ra/ rtse gdong / ngor/ rta nag rnam rgyal sogs khams dgon rnams su tshogs gsog gi rnyed bkur zhu ru phyin dus thams cad mgrin gcig tu chos zhus dang / zhabs tog byed sa nged kyi 'di kho na yin/ jo nang ni sngon gyi skad cha tsam min/ pa da lta stong pa bzhin song sku 'bum gcig yod kyang zhabs tog med/ chos 'chad mkhan yang med/ btsun ma nyung shas shig sdod mkhan yod pa de kun yang lto mi 'byor bar dka' thub la snyad pa'i kar gong za ba las med zer/ khong tsho'i rgyu nor 'phran bu rnams la hams pa'i kha bslus 'ba' zhig brjod 'dug cing / khong tsho yang de bzhin bden pa yin 'ong snyam khams phyogs na jo nang pa dang 'brel med kyis nges med mang po la rnyed bkur byas/ nor phal cher zad pa na gnas tshul cung zad rtsad chod de jo nang du sleb/bsnyen bkur rgya cher med na'ang mang ja skol ba sogs mchog tu dga' bas bsgrubs/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dgos zer ba ltar gzhi byes sngar dus 'khor gyi dbang ma thob pa rnams dang lhan cig dbang bskur rgyas par bsgrubs/mgon po che chung gi rjes gnang yang byas/ dbus gtsang gi grwa sa mang po zhig —281—

rdzun dang ltogs la che ba la nges shes rnyed do/ /'di skabs gangs chen po rang babs/ byang nas lhun grub spel ba kun dga' gnang nas gtsang pa 'di la byus ci 'dra yong / zhabs drung rang so bdun pa'i skeg la dog gam mi dog gsung ba la/ gtsang gi srid 'di ni da dung gong 'phel 'gro shas ka 'dugazhabs drung rang so bdun gyi skeg la cung grag de las so brgyad pa dog de bas kyang so dgu pa ches dog de las thar na re shig yangs te de ni skyon che/ bzlog thabs dge ba rgya che tsam 'di lta bu dgos zer ba zhus te/ thugs ma ches shing bzlog thabs ma mdzad song / de rjes hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin chos grol te/ bla brang gong du phyi mtshams me byas nas de khog nas skyid phug tu phyin mtshams dam par bsdams/ dge sbyor 'phel zhing skyid par byung / dgon gnas yas mar so so la brten pa'i kham mchu sad sud mang po dus gcig tu langs pa lta bu zhig byung kyang blo la g.yo mgul sbu tsam yang med/ ngam ring nas drang srong ba lha ri rtse ba/ chu 'og pa ste mi sna gsum sbrel byon/ cha rgyus che che mo dang gar gar mo dang tshod che che mo dang 'jigs 'jigs mo sogs nges med sna tshogs zer ba la rtsis gdab byed mkhan ni ye ma byung ngo / /spyir ni sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las/ de yang dgon gnas dang bshad sgrub kyi sde 'phel ba la rag las zer ba 'di byis pa mdang skyes tshun chad kyi kha nas ta yongs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar gyur cig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang mtho bar gyur cig zer ba'i kha tsam tshig tsam gyi smon lam dang /chos skyong la 'phrin bcol 'di skya ser mkhas rmongs dge ba la dkar mi dkar —282—

thams cad byed par gda'/ lag yod du ni blo dang ldan pa dang mkhas su re ba kun yang bstan pa dar bar mi 'dod de/ btsun pa byed mkhan mang ba bas dmag khral rgyug mkhan mang ba la dga'/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang mtho bar mi 'dod de chos pa dbang thang che ba mi 'dod/ mi nag pa rang shugs che ba 'dod/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang mtho ba ga la zer ram rtsad gcod dgos/dge bshes kyi ming can phal che ba zhig la yang 'di ka gda'/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas la zhen byas pas chog pa'i dod yul dpon re la mdzad/ thos bsam sgom gsum la zhen byas pas chog pa'i dod bsam ngan dang sbyor rtsub dang kha ngan rnams la mdzad/ dge 'dun la zhen mdzad pas chog pa'i dod nye du'am 'brel chags can mi nag pho mo rnams la mdzad par 'dug go /sngon rgyal po mya ngan med kyis rgyal srid dge 'dun la phul ba dang / rgyal po khri ral pa can gyis bla sgo dang po dge 'dun la phul gnyis pa ni rgyal po gsum pa ni blon po zhes gsung ba yang mi rgan smyo ba rang min te mchi/ dkon mchog gi mnga' thang nas bcad de skye bo phal pa'i lto gos dang bu smad kyi don du bsgyur ba la sems can la phan btags pa'i ming yang med de/ mkhas rmongs thams cad kyis mi go bar gda'/ bod shes ldan tsho sems can gyi don gyi ngos 'dzin mthar gtugs na grong pa'i lung gsog la ngos 'dzin mdzad pa 'di rang de e mi yin he he/ bla ma 'phags pas khri skor bcu gsum las la bkol nas gtsugs lag khang bzhengs dus las mi thams cad kyis skur pa zhus 'chi smon btab ste/ khong pa'i de sdig pa'i las ye min/ ma 'os pa yang min las che/ chen po byang chub —283—

rgyal mtshan gyi yul mi kha log dogs 'jig rten pa'i shing ra la shing gcod ma byas par gtsug lag khang rnying pa thams cad shus nas rdzong la bkab pa la ma 'os zer nas kha btang mkhan ma byung / 'jig rten mi dmangs rnams smon po byung ste khong pa'i de chos ye min/ rgyal khams thams cad dmyal bar btang ba yin/ da lta dper na dge las kyi phyir du grong pa re la nas bre re bsdus kyang blos mi longs sdug skad 'don te/ de bas lhag pa'i longs spyod thams cad bsdus nas dge ba la sbyar na yang sdig pa med kyi steng du phan yon ches 'phel ba lags/ glegs bam gser ma bzhu nas gser byas/ gser sku rdzogs nas zangs su byas/ dngul sku rtib nas ja nyos/ gser kong bshig nas spyi khab 'tsho/ de tsho grong pa'i skye bo blun po rnams la byin nam tha na 'tshong du phyin kyang 'dzum mu le dga' nas yong ste/ de la dge ba ye med kyi steng du rang gzhan tshang ma dmyal rgyu zangs ma'i sdig pa la sbyar bar mi gda' 'am/ 'on kyang kho bo cag tshe 'di pa yin pas de 'dra blor mi chud snyam na/ blun po blun nag tsho cis kyang bden mod mkhas pa dang dpyod ldan gyi nga rgyal ma byed cig lar btsun pa 'di tsho yang / khog de 'dra byed mkhan tsho la dga' ba la/ 'phral nyams snang med pa 'dra ba cig 'dug kho bo ni sngon rang nyid zhi bde don gnyer dang 'dzin dzos spangs pa'i bya bral la smon/ gzhan gyi sdig rkyen du song dogs 'dzem bag lhur byed pa zhig yin na'ang / rang nyid gcig pu phar skyong dgos med/ tshur 'khur dgos med na de bzhin rang legs par gda' yang / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la brten te bstan pa'i khur 'khur dgos phyin 'os pa dang / mi 'os pa rang gi —284—

rig pas dpyad nas 'os pa'i las la tsham tshom med par 'jug pa las gzhan ma dga'i dogs pa'am kha zer du dogs pa'i rtsis btab ma byas/ ji skad du/sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan dang / phan dang bde ba rnams bya ste/ /bde yang mi phan mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar theg chen gyi lam gnad nas ni mi 'chugagazhan ngor rtsub zeng nge 'jug pa 'di 'gro don byed lugs kyi 'jug sgo gcig tu gda'/ rgyud rnams las kyang / mchod phyir mi yi bdag po dang / phyug po rnams kyi nor 'phrog go /zhes pa dang / rdo rje gsang ba 'di lta bus/ semasacan thams cad bsad na ni/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas zhing dag tu/ /rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs mi gda' 'am phaṭa/ de tsam stong shob la lags te/ thugs la mi 'thad na bzod pa bzhes par zhu/ bzod pa mdzad na mdzad mkhan rang la dga'/ nged la ni bzod pa byas ma byas la khyad med do/ /hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la lung gshong sogs rten bzhengs byed ma'i bal po rnams kyang 'byor/ mi ring bar bzo grwa tshugs/ mkhar las kyang thams cad la bar thog khel zhing / lha khang gi thog kyang khel ba'i skabs sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la snga dro mtshams sengs te/ bgegs mi 'jug pa'i byin rlabs tsam byas/ de nub nas ka bla brang gong du mtshams bsdangs/ zla gcig tsam song skabs rgyal khams gyi 'gyur zlog chen po cig 'phral du yong ba'i ltas byung nas/ chos dang dge ba la mi 'khod pa mnyam po la rang re la ni rgyal khams lha spyin gyi kha la bstab pa dang / mchod spyin gyi kha la bstab pa la khyad med zhe sun pa dang mgo na ba gang nas yong mi shes pas mtshams shin tu dam pa —285—

zhig byed dgos snyam/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la shug pa gnam 'phyang du mtshams dam por bsdams/ de kha'i tshes bcu drug la lhun po rtse pa'i 'gyur zlog de byung bar gda'/ snga lo khro phu'i rdig bcom gyi lo dus yin/ de nas 'gyur zlog chen po tsho mu la byung ba de lags/ de nas kyang mtshams dam por bsdams pas dge sbyor 'phel bar byung / gsal snang gi rim pa yang ches cher mched pa'i re 'ga' rgya che rab byung na'ang 'dir mi 'bri/ ra sa'i skos ru rnams skyabs 'tshol ba'i phyir jo nang gi phu ru sleb/ de la ja sbyo re la yang snga phyi yod pa tsam du lha rtse gnyer khang nas gtser rtsod byed pa dang / 'brog pa rnams song bstun gser ma nas rang gi 'bri g.yag rnams spyi mchod du bros pa'i dgos par 'dug pas khong pa rang gi phyag tu thebs na bsam nas jo nang du bsdad pa la yang bskor rgyag tsab tsob mang po byung ste/ phyis gser ma nas rang gi phyag tu 'phrod pa byas/ de skabs bcu pa ba rnams bar skabs 'di la jo nang pas dar 'dzugs byas pa'i tshes gzhis su rtsis len par shog zer ba lan mang du byung na'ang / gnas skabs 'di rigs kyis chas dgos pa ni yang med snyam thag bcad pas rang re brling po byung / de skor la dar 'dzugs pa bzhi lnga byung gda' na'ang thog tu khel ba gcig kyang ma byung / 'di dag tu snga phyir byang nas bde srid kyis nas khal stong phrag gcig rten bzhengs kyi cha rkyen tu gnang / de rjes rgyang tsam song ba na bsam 'grub rtse nas nan chags 'bod mi gnang ba'i sde pa mthu stobs drung sku stem nas yun ring rab song ba phyir lod du gyur pa zhig 'dug pas/ slar sku 'tsho mi 'tsho ji ltar byung yang gal che skabs rang du 'dug —286—

pas yong dgos zhes yab sras gnyis car gyis nan chags gnang byung bas/hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la jo nang nas bteg srad bkod du bsdad pa'i nub nam gshis 'tshub pa sogs phyi nang gi ltas rtsub pa tsam byung / rtse ru sleb dus mthu stobs drung sku shin tu ltem pa rang 'dug dbang rjes gnang sogs phul bas/ bar skabs zhag shas shig thugs rig dwangs pa tsam byung na'ang / sku zungs ni nyin re bzhin bri 'gro ba de khar gda'/ nyer lnga nas gzung lhag par yang 'byung ba sdud pa'i tshul 'dug cing / gnam gang gi thor 'go ltas pa tsam la sku ma 'tsho song / 'di skabs sgrub grwa chen po 'jag tu chos rje sdings kha sku skye gdan sar bsko bzhag byas/ yol thang legs pa gcig dang tshogs khro dga' ba gcig spyi rdzas su phul/ 'di nas gzung legs lam yang gong 'phel du shar ro/ /sde pa mthu stobs rnam rgyal de nyid bzhugs dus kyang sku sgrib sbyang ba'i thabs dbang byin rlabs dang gshegs skabs kyang 'pho ba dmigs gtad sogs dang de rjes kyang sku tshigs grol gyi bar nyin re bzhin mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga tshar re bzlas pa mang rab dang bcas pa re dang mtshan byang bzhu ba sogs thams cad byed dgos byung zhing bdun tshigs kyi mtshams su rmi lam lta bu'i gsal snang du nges par yong zhing / bsnyung gzhi sogs rim pas dwangs pa dang na bza' chos gos sogs kyang rje bzang je bzang du 'gro ba sogs rang res gshin don gyi cho ga byed dgos gcig la 'di rang ltas bzang bar byung / snga gong ni yon mchod kyi 'brel pa dang thugs mos kyang dkyus 'gro tsam ka yin na/rting la mos gus kyi lhag bsam cung zad dag tu dag tu 'gro ba tsam ni byung / de —287—

min gzhan rang med na'ang 'grongs kha'i mtshams spyor dang sngon gyi las 'brel zhig kyang yin pa 'dra'o/ /'di skabs kyang bstan pa ris med kyi chog grwa mdzad cing kar bstan drung gi dgongs rdzogs las kyang 'di rgya che zhing dmigs su 'gro ba dang / rting gi mtshams gcod tshun 'phral gyi rten 'brel kyang legs par byung / bstan pa sgo thams cad nas mchod pas myong srid gong 'phel du rgyas pa'i rgyur song / dgongs rdzogs 'di skabs ngor mkhan drung shar r+ṣa kun bkras pa byon pa'i nub gcig rkang dung rang yang bzhi tsam sdebs la 'bud bskang gso rol mo 'ur ding rang btang ba la nang zan rnams kyi kha btang bas sang dgongs nas bzhag dbus gtsang khams gsum gshegs pa yin zer de gdags pa ma chags pa rang 'dug go /'di'i ring la gtsang sa'i sde srid zhabs drung ni bla ma la chos zhu ba la rtog dpyad mi dgos pa 'dug phebs pa ltar snga phyir bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil zangs gri can lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang sogs dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang bar 'bul dgos byung / jo nang gi rten bzhengs la gser zho nyis brgya skor gnang / phar ched kyis zhus pa min pa la dgongs pas dpyad pa'i dbus kyi sbu sde lha rgyal gling yong sgo dang g.yog ris sogs thams cad rtsis sprod gnang / zhe dgu'i tshogs pa rnams kyis nas dgongs phyogs rtse nas thon nas snar thang gi thad nas mun sros rin chen gling du srod la sleb tsam byung / sang snga bar byang chen du phyin zhag gsum bsdad/ snar thang nas dpon sa yum sras gsum kyang phebs chos bka' sad sud 'dra phul/ slar yang 'gor med du ri khrod chen por sleb/ bal po rnams —288—

kyi bzo yang thams cad grub mtshams yin zhing / sleb pa'i gnangs nyin nas gzungs bzhugs sogs kyi 'go brtsams/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel nas gnod spyin 'khor lo'i bar gzugs ril byin rlabs rten sku gsung thugs kyi rten byin rlabs can dang bcas pa rnams ma 'khrugs par bzhugs su gsol/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes lnga gza' skar bzang ba la rab gnas kyi sta gon byas/ de rjes rim pa bzhin snga dro cho ga snga ma'i dngos gzhi re dang / dgongs mo nang par dang 'brel pa'i sta gon re byas nas 'khor lo chen po gzhin rje gshed gsang 'dus kyai rdor bde mchog dus 'khor thugs dkyil rnams la brten nas/ rab gnas rgyas pa tshar drug de skabs byas shing / sa rgyan gnam rgyan mchod rdzas sogs kyang rgyas par gra 'grig dngos gzhi chen mo de tshes bcu gcig gza' skar dge bya'i snga gro'i cha la shis brjod yan chad tshang bar byas/ jo nang gzhir bzhugs dang dgon lag so so rnams kyi chog grwa yang che rab mdzad cing / so sor 'jam mang ja tshar bur ston phye mar 'gyed pa/ skam 'gyed nas 'gyeng/ sogs gang bzang gi lugs su bsgrubs/ dge 'dun so so rnams dang chos gzhis sogs mi skya 'dus pa rnams kyang legs par tshim/ yul chos dang mthun pa'i byang zhabs drung gi bka' bkod dang bstun lha rtse nas dpal po btsugs/ rab gnas grol mtshams kyi nyin mo dga' ston rgya chen po'i dus/byang nas sde srid nyid kyang phebs/ sku 'bum thang du bzo bo sogs gzhi byes kun 'dus kyi bzhugs gral thog tu bzo bo rnams la yon rdzongs/ kha ti dang jus 'dres pa yug sgril ma bcu/ ja mngar hang dang dpe yag sa nag rtse 'dres —289—

pa sigs bcu/ gser srang bzhi sogs yongs bsgril nor sna mang rab yod/byams pa'i sku la gser zho lnga brgya lhag gcig song ba/ de bas gser srang bzhi lnga tsam gyi rin thang lhag pa'i rtsis su bcad/ bzo ras dang gos bzas cha tshang sogs la rtsis btab med/ spyi rgyal ba'i sku bzhengs pa'i yon la tshad med kyang / yul dang dus dang skye bo rnams kyi longs spyod che chung dang mig ltos sogs dang bstun pas chos nas bshad pa bzhin 'grub dka' ba gda' na'ang /deng sang la bltos pa'i legs rab grub pas kho tsho yang mgu bar gyur/ dga' ston grub mtshams sde pa'i dpal po de 'gyed pa'i skabs / rlung 'dzub shin tu che ba glo bur du langs cung zad 'tshub pa'i rnam pa byung / bsam grub rtse mdol byung gting skyes sogs 'brel can che phra phal cher gyis kyang dga' ston che 'byor chung 'byor mang du byung zhing / sde srid dpon g.yog gis kyang zhag drug bzhugs/ 'di dus brda' gtong sogs tsab tsob ye ma byas kyang skye bo mang po dus gcig tu 'dus pa sogs phyi rtags kyang rten 'brel legs par byung / de nas sde srid dang dge bzhes 'ga' la gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dbang sogs chos bka' yang 'ga' shas byas/ nges don gyi bstan pa la phan pa'i chos gzhis mchod thes shig gnang ba'i zhal bzhes kyang gnang / de rjes sgrub sde rnams la sku 'bum thang gi chos khri nas/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs kyi nying khu theg mchog lam rim rgyas pa bshad/ byang sa chen mo'i lung zhig kyang byas/ byams pa'i sku gzugs lha khang dang bcas pa la snga sor rab gnas lan drug hor zla bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes bzang ba zhig la slar yang rab gnas —290—

gcig ste kun dril rab gnas lan bdun byas pa la/ slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi gzhung bzhin du tshar lnga/ don gsal gyi lugs gcigadus 'khor lugs gcig rnams byas/ yar lung nas slob bu dam tshig can chos rje byams rin pa gshegs pa'i bsngo rten skyel ba dang / byang stag lung nas dpon sku rdzi 'das pa'i mang ja bsngo rten skyel mkhan yang byung / de rjes dus chos kyi khrid kyang sngar lugs bzhin du bsgrubs/ gting skyes nas lcam chos 'bum lags kyang 'di skabs dam po mdzad/ bya lo dang khyi lo'i khrid lan gnyis po 'di la 'brid gsar ba mang rab byung na'ang / 'khrid lo ha cang legs rgyu ma byung / 'khrid grol nas jo nang chos lung gnyis kyi chos gzhis kyi bu tsha dbang po cung dwangs pa rnams la grwa khral bskul/ btsun gsar bdun cu lhag tsam gyi skra phud bcad/ klog sogs phra mo slob pa'i 'go btsugs/ de rjes bla brang dam chos gling du mtshams bsdams/ zla gcig tsam song skabs 'dol byung nas sde pa'i drung sku tshe'i 'phen pa btang ba zhig byung 'dug pas 'bod mi byung / 'gro ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i skabs dbus nas lha bris pa rnams sleb cing / de mthun gyi bkod pa cung zad byas/ sgrub sder tshogs la mang ja ja 'gyed bkra shis khra ring gsar du bcos pa gnyis/ ras nam thang brgya bud la bcos pa'i char khebs sku 'bum gyi chos 'khor bcu gsum yongs rdzogs khebs pa gcig dang / sngags thang bcu gsum dang rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil thang phal cher tshang ba gcig gnas bcu'i yol thang legs pa gcigazangs sbug che ba gcig rnams spyi thes su phul/ hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer dgu la —291—
