lam du zhugs/ gsum pa'i tshes gnyis la 'dol byung du sleb/ dgongs rdzogs kyi cho ga'i rim pa rnams dang khrus chog byang bu bzhu ba sogs mtha' dag bsgrubs/ sde pa de thun mong ma yin pa'i yon bdag dad zhen can yin pas snying thag pa nas blos longs par byas/ gtsang sa nas dbus dmag gi sgar gra bsgrigs pa'i dpon g.yog rnams nor khyung du byon skabs yin pas 'bod mi gnang byung ba bzhin khor tsam phyin/ zhag gcig klu sdings lho ma der sdod yul byas/ sde srid zhabs drung rang du tshe dbang dang rkyen sel gyi rjes gnang mang rab dang / dpon rigs so sos kyang tshe dbang dang rjes gnang tsam re zhu ba mang du byung / dpon g.yog rnams kyi bar chad sel ba sogs rten 'brel legs pa'i dge mtshan yang shar/ gzhan gyis bskul ba dang bcol gnyer med kyang rgyal khams dang chos kyi bstan pa la ma gnod pa zhig byung na sems/ dmag dbus la dngos su 'jug dgos pa mi yong ba'i thabs cig rang gnang dgos tshul nan chags dang / thabs g.yin med par dmag rang mdzad dgos shar na'ang /dgon gnas che phra thams cad la gnod pa ye med pa gcig mi gnang ba'i thabs med cing / yar rgyab dpon g.yog thams cad kyi sar yang thugs rje gang che gnang dgos tshul nan chags rang zhus pas dgon gnas rnams la de skabs kyi dmag res la gnod pa ye ma byung / de rjes 'dol byung gi sku rjes grol nas lha sdings su phyin zhag gnyis bsdad/ gnod spyin zha 'on kyi rjes gnang dang khrom dbang sogs than thun bgyi shing / rin po che ka bzhi nas kyi sku skye'i brtag zhus pa sleb kyang 'di skabs gsal ni ma thub/ slar yang 'dol —292—

byung du zhal bzhugs rnams la sku khrus tshe dbang 'bul bar zhag lnga tsam bsdad/de mtshams bsam sdings su sleb pa'i zhag bcu gcig tsam phyi mtsham me ba byas/'dol byung dang lha sdings sogs su 'cham pa byung ba 'khrugs pa'i rnam pas khams kyang bde mo min pa cig byung / hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la bsam sdings nas chas te gong 'dzin gyi la la 'gro rgyu yin na'ang / lha 'phreng gi rnam pas de nub rang gangs babs nas sad la la ma thar bar gzhung la phyin pas lhun grub brtse'i gdong der gtam snyan yod zer dar 'phyar byed pa dang 'griganged rang dgon pa nas dgon par 'gro ba la rten 'brel legs shing / yon bdag la'ang legs snyam pa byung / rkang bzhi dang dge sdings su bar zhag re byas/ de nas nam zi la chas gangs chen po babs pas yul phyogs 'gyur ba'i snang ba 'gyur re ba'i ngang nas nyi ma snga phyed la jo nang du sleb/ gzhir sdod rnams nged nam sleb yong snyam pa tsam yang med pa la sgo drung du thob rgyag 'byor/ri mo ba rnams kyis gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo'i skya ris 'go tshugs tsam dang sangs rgyas rab byung gnyis la tshon gyi 'go tshugs tsam bde dgyes gnyis la skya ris tshugs tsam g.yin gang yang ma grub par 'dug de rjes zhag shas mtshams byas/ de grol nas sa ga'i nya la sgrub sde rnams kyis tsha tsha 'debs pa'i bkod pa byas shing / dang thog snga mo dge tsha zhig yod 'dug na'ang rje drung gong mas gcog par mdzad gda'/ slar de gsar du btsugs pa'i rten 'brel yin nam de'i nyin mo nam mkha' dwangs pa la nyi ma thog phub dang / sna cha gnyis rim dang khyad par rta sga gong dang chu byang gi dga' po'i thad tsam dang nags rgyal gyi rtse'i —293—

thad gsum du 'ja' sprin ma yin pa'i dbyar dus kyi 'ja' tshon gug po de ka 'dra ba yun ring du sdod pa sogs phyi ltas legs shing / sku 'bum thang nas tshogs pa rnams kyis yan lag bdun pa byed pa'i tshe/ ston pa sangs rgyas mngon sum du 'di na bzhugs yod pa 'dug snyam pa tsam gyi yid 'khrul ba yang byung / de nub nas phyi mtshams tsam byas/ nyi shu lnga la skyid phug tu phyin mtshams dam par bsdams/ cung zad 'tshub cha che zhing dge sbyor yang 'phel bar byung /sngar bca' lung gi chu de shin tu lod par grags shing chu mig de yang ja skol mi nyan pa lta bu yin na'ang gtor ma btang bas chu skye rtsal yang che ru song chu'i ngo bo shin tu bzang bar song / hor zla lnga pa'i tshe bco lnga la nyin gung gnyid yur ba zhig gi dus sham bha la sogs rmi lam gyi yul snang ngo mtshar can mang du byung /hor zla drug pa'i tshes gsum nas bzung tshes bcu gcig gi bar nub re bzhin phyi ltas nam mkha' rgod pa'i rnam pas ser ba cung zad 'bab cing thog kyang 'bab tshad pa dang / nang ltas su yang mtshan ma rtsub tsam re nub re bzhin rtag par byung nas tho rangs cho 'phrul de zhi 'gro ba'i rnam pa yang rtag par yod/khyad par tshes bcu gcig gi srod khyer la thog 'brug drag po re dang bstun glog 'od mi bzad pas nang khengs yod pa gdong tsha tshub tshub pa dang rwa gzhob thul le yong ba de lan sum cu so grangs zhig byung ba dang / nang ltas su yang sems nyams dang cho 'phrul skyi g.ya' sogs mang du byung / 'on kyang dbyings su bzhag pa'i tshes snyems 'khrigs rdul tsam med pas cho 'phrul zhi nas nam phyed phan la mnyam gzhag la shin tu bogs che bar byung / cho 'phrul de tsho yang gzhan gyi byad —294—

kha gnyis gsum 'dzom pa'i ltas su 'dug sngar sor bya lo'i nang du snga phyir nged rang la gtad dang mnan pa dang zor kha sogs byad kha rbod gtong rigs mi gcig pa dgu tsam 'dzom pa'i ltas dang / gcig tsam rang gi slob ma'i khungs gcig gis byas pa dang / gzhan gcig nus pa yang dga' rab yod pa'i ltas byung / de skabs dang 'di skabs kun tu stong nyid snying rje las gzhan pa'i bsrung bzlog spangs te de kas don 'grub par gda'/ de ka'i tshes bco lnga la khang pa'i byang zur nas rdo 'ga' re 'dzags shing / bcom rdib yong la khad kyi rtsig pa 'phral du gas byung bas thog mar de 'phral gnas spo'am snyam pa la rang re rkyen thog tu bzlog sgom byed par la gnas spos pas ga na 'ong / zhig 'os nam zhig zhig gang du yang mi 'gro snyam ste de nub bsdad pas thor mgo zin tsam la sgra chen po dang bcas te byang skya de thams cad 'ur song 'gyel 'gro ba'i dus na mtshan mo char mun 'thibs pa dang ber langs pa'i rnam pas phyogs gang nas 'jig cha med cing sdod sa rang gi thad kyang rdib 'gro ba lta bu'i ber ba byung kyang gces 'dzin gyi snyems ye ma byung / sdod sa rang yang g.yabs kyi byang ngos 'gyel 'gro sa de dang nye bar byed kyin yod pa ma sbos par de rang du bsdad/ de rjes sang nyin ltas dus 'gyel 'os tshang ma 'grel grub/ gzhan rnams mi 'gyel bar 'dug pas de khar bsdad kyang yod bar 'dug na'ang / char zhod chen po la brag thigs ches pas sun par 'dug nas shug pa gnam 'phyang du spos/ 'di skabs ngam ring nas sde srid kyis lhun grub spre'u ba kun dga' lags gnang ba'i phug gsum gyi lung pa phu mda' chos gzhis su sbyor 'jags —295—

gnang rgyu'i rtsis sprod la cher gtad byon/ slar yang phyag dam gsar du phebs pa'i zhag shas 'gyangs/ sgrub sde dbyar mtshams kyi sgang yin pas mang ja zhig gnang byung ba tshes bco lnga'i nyin mo dug skyel byas/ de nub khang pa 'gyel ba yin de dang stabs bstun chos lung du zhon rta zhig kyang glo bur du shi/ dam sel gyi ltas 'tshub bo zhig kyang byung bas/ de dus mang ja de la the tshom za ba cig byung na'ang / phyis brtags dus chos lung gi mgon khang du sgo'i sna lcags kyi zung bcus nas dam sel can gyi gtor yan dang snyan dar dang yo byad 'ga' re phul 'dug pas de'i cho 'phrul du gda'/ 'di skabs dam chos gling du gser sku lha khang bsgrigs pa yin/ /hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin mo phug gsum rtsis len byed skabs gnyid kyis ma bslad pa'i rdzun med mngon sum gyi snang ba la gnas bdag ma'i cho 'phrul mang po zhig byung / nags rgyal gyi rtse na phug gsum du 'ja' dkar zug pa sogs phyi ltas kyang bzang po byung yod pa gda'/ chos gzhis phug gsum 'brel chags pa dang khyad par jo nang gi grwa tshang la bstan pa nam gnas par sbyor 'jags gtsang spras chod pa gnang / de rjes skabs shig tu rin po che ka bzhi nas kyi sku skye brtag par chug mi chug lung bstan zhu zer/ khri lcags sogs yon mchod phyogs gtogs kun gyi mi sna byung /mtshams dam pas 'phrad ni ma thub/ de na yang kho tsho gnyis su song ba'i sku skye yin rung min rung / yin par lung bstan na gdan sa pa mkhan chen sogs phyogs gcig mi dga'/ ma yin par lung bstan na grwa rigs rnying pa zhen can sogs gcig gshe/sa mi dga' ba zhig 'dug pas lha sa'am chos lung byang rtse lta —296—

bur brtag bsgril gyis zhes nan gyis smras kyang / nged la byed dgos tshul rang zer ba ltas brtag pa byas kyang khyed rnams yid mi ches/ brtag yig la mi sna rnams kyis thel tshe rgyob la/ 'dir brtag par bsgril ba las 'os med byas nas de bzhin byas pas brtag par ni thon yod par gda'/ dbus dmag 'khor 'phral nas brtsams pas ma grub rtse nas 'bod mi phyag dam rim can du byung ba dang / de rjes mi ring ba na zhabs drung sde srid rang sku khams cung ltem par byung 'dug pas shangs pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog dpal bzang 'bod mir gnang pa'i bka' nan chags pa rang 'dug pa la brten/ sku rim snga khyad dang dpyad bshal sbyongs sogs gnang ba la gegs mi 'byung ba'i bsrung skud dang dud rdzas sogs 'phral du phul/ rang yang 'gor med chas pa'i hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer gsum la shel dkar zhol du sleb tsam byas/ nyer drug la rtse 'byor/ rdzong thog gi nam mkha' la dga' 'khyil gsum dang dpal be'u 'khor lo sogs rnam pa shin tu gsal ba'i 'ja' sprin ya mtshan byung / sku khams kyi lam pa sor chud 'dug cing / slar zhag gnyis gsum nas bde dwangs rtags thub par byung / de ka'i sang nyin nas brtsams zla gzhug de la gtor dbang 'ga' shas dang sku grib sel ba'i rim pa 'dra byas/ zla ba dkar nas tshe dbang sogs rnam grangs mang rab phul/ de nas tshes bcu skor la chos rje shangs pa sogs kyang byon/ khong la bde mchog 'khrul spong gi dbang zhig byas/ de'i rjes nas zhabs drung yab sras sogs la 'khor los bsgyur drug gur rigs bsdus sa myu ṭa rdor dbyings sogs kyi dbang dang / gcod yul gyi khrid phyag rgya —297—

bzhi'i snying po'i khrid sogs dang / rjes gnang byin rlabs sogs mang du byas/tshes nyi shu skor la dgongs grol zhus kyang / /sde pa sku 'bring ba'i drung gi lo mchod kyi tshogs dpon la sdod dgos tshul nan chags phebs kyin 'dug pa bzhin de ltar byed dgos byung / lcang ra slob dpon pa ār+ya ba la yang sum pa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud sogs dbang khrid than thun bshad/ gnam gang gi nyin nas tshes bzhi'i bar sku mchod la dor zha lu dkar po brag byang chen pa rnams tshogs pa'i chog grwa rgya che ba bsnyen bkur/ phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa mdzad/ 'di'i bar du zhabs drung sde srid rang sku phyi mtshams dam po de ka mdzad yod cing / tshes bzhi'i nyin sku mtshams grol tshogs su phebs bsngo rten dang dge 'dun rnams la yon bla lhag tu gnang / grub mtha' sna tshogs 'dus pa'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su song bas/ nged kyis kyang yas gtam bstan pa sgo mtha' dag dang 'brel ba'i tshul du byas/ yas gtam dang bsngo ba mtha' rgyas su byas pas phal cher dgyes/ ko long can mang po de tsam la yang tshig pa za bar 'dug ste g.yas chung ya cha/ de nas kyang bka' nan gnang ba la brten zhag shas bsdad/ snar thang byang chen gyi chos gzhis rin chen gling gi dmag srung cha 'chag pa dang / khyi lo dbus su gnang ba'i chos gzhis rnams la yang g.yul rgyal rdzong dang legs bshad gling pa shed po che de tshe'i 'dres yong yod pa rnams khad gtsang bar gcod pa dang / 'brang gi mdar ma de thung gis cha yod 'bab sa ri sa skor dang bcas pa rnams kyang chos gzhis su gsar du sbyor ba dang / 'brang phu dgon pa sngar khral dgon yin pa spyi mchod thar pa gling du —298—

'don pa sogs sku drin tshad med du mdzad cing / snga sor stag lo gong dkar du zhu rten phul chos gzhis gang 'os cig gnang ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad rung /lag thog tu cang ma byung ba la gtsang nas 'di kun gnang ba 'di dbus pa tsho la ngoms chog pa'i mi sdun du mgo thon pa rang byung / ri khrod jo nang du bstan pa'i rgyun la phan par dgongs nas g.yu rtse sa khongs dang bcas pa chos gzhis su spyor 'jags gnang / 'dir sdod ring la ngo chen zhu dgos rnam grangs mang po rnams la yang dgong pa mtho spron re mdzad cing / khyad par dpon sa snar thang nas la lo bstar gyi nas khal sum brgya re dang / gser ma nas la yang drung pa rin po che'i sku ngo'i steng du 'phar cha gnang / gdong dga' nas la bka' bkyon tshan chen mngon du gyur pa yin na'ang / rag rdzong skor bcas tsam byang du nang bzhes yod tsam gnang ba'i tshul bstan pa tsam las gzhan skyon med du byung ba sogs gzhan la phan 'dogs kyang dga' rab byung / gdong dga' nas rang snga sor khong ra'i cha zhabs nas 'thon pa'i stag sna ba sogs la byang gtsang du ngo chen byas na mi yong tshul dbu tshugs mdzad pa la nged kyis kyang blo dang bstun pa yin/ 'di skor la ni dbyar gung nas rang brtsams zhu ngo dgos pa'i nan chags bsam las 'das pa mdzad kyin 'dug ste rang thog dang mi thog la bsam mno gtong ba cig ni dgos rgyur 'dug lags/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu bdun la nya ri dga' tshal du yon mchod lhan cig tu phebs/ nged kyis de'i sang nyin u rgyan rdzong gi gru la thon/ drag ma dang khro ru theg mal re byas/ phug gsum du zhag gsum bsdad/ nyer gsum la jo nang du sleb/ 'di skabs gtsug lag —299—

khang gi ri mo'i bya ba phal cher zin zla ba dkar 'phral rab gnas byas pa yin sleb 'phral nas bla brang 'gag pa sogs la ni gu'i gser chos chung ba rnams bshad/ khong gis de skabs dam po byed ma nyan/ chos drug la dus chos kyang btsugs/ spyor drug gi sngon 'gro'i ring la nai gu chos drug sogs kyang btsugs shing / phug gsum pa rnam la'ang grwa khral byas/ /sngar sor mgron gnyen tshe rnam gyis sbyar zhing byang nas bka' shog gis chod pa'i chos gzhis de lo legs nyes 'bring gi dbang du byas na nas khal phyed drug brgya tsam 'bab pa cig 'dugajo nang du sngon dus chos rje yab sras rnams kyi dus mchod nges can re yod 'dug na'ang chos gzhis rnams rim pas bgor ba'i kun mkhyen chen po la yang lo dus mchod pa tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams chag nas bla rabs kyang 'ga' re song rigs su 'dug 'di skabs chos gzhis de yab sras bzhi'i dus mchod thes la sbyar/ kun mkhyen chen po la zla mchod dang gong ma yab sras gsum la lo mchod bzang bar btsugs/ phyogs pa'i thugs dam dus 'khor gyi dkyil thang rgyal po mya ngan med kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten gcig rwa lo'i phyag dril mi tri ba'i rgyan drug grub thob 'dar phyar gyi phyag phur/ slob dpon shān+ti pa dang / rgyal ba dpal ye shes dang / paṇa chen zla ba mgon po'i rgya dpe sna re sogs byin rlabs rten bzang ba rnam grangs mang tsam bstan pa nam gnas par jo nang gi spyi thes su bzhugs su gsol/ de rting 'phags pa rin po che'i phyag mkhar dang gsol lcog yin zer ba mu tig ljon shing gcig kyang lha khang du ba theg sngon byin rlabs rten bzang la mang ba rang yod par gda' na'ang / bar —300—

skabs su phal cher gyag 'dug pa'i kun bso ba tsam yin/ dam po'i bdun snga phyi gnyis la shug pa gnam 'phyang du bsdad pas dge sbyor 'phel zhing skyid par byung / bdun snga rting gi bar la sde pa gdong dga' nas kyang dril bzo mdzes lam mtsho ni byed tsam la phebs/ dus khrid 'di khrid lo shin tu legs shing phag lo'i ston nas 'di bar la btsun gsar phyed pa yang mang du byung / khrid gtor yan chad mtha' rgyas bsgrubs/ snga sor nas nags phug gi mi dpon rim can phal cher jo nang pa la dgra kho na byed/ de khas lo re re la mi dpon re re la skyon re yang bstud mar byung / 'di skabs khrom dbang byed skabs rlung po che grags pa la nags phug gnyer pa kun rin dmigs phud nas brdzangs pas yul gshis 'jam thing ba byung nas khrom dbang thub tsam byung / de nas khams pa mi nyag chos zhu ba gsar sleb dang / rang re'i lag g.yog pa 'ga' re la gcod khrid cig kyang bshad/ de rjes don gnyer 'ga' la lam 'bras dang /'dzam thang gi grwa rigs 'ga' la sbyor drug gcig gtsugs/ 'di kha'i snga phyi la sa cha yas mas kyi zlos pa rnams kyang chod/ g.yu rtse'i chos gzhis de lha khyung rdzong gnyis kyi lag g.yog la mkho ba rang yod pas sa brjes byed dgos phebs par ltar hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu byang sems rgyal ba ye shes kyi dus chen gsar du 'go btsugs pa'i nyi ma la g.yu rtse'i sa tshab tu bkra shis 'dzoms rtsis sprod byung / tshes bcu gsum la chos lung byang rtser phyin zla gcig zhag po bdun tsam bsdad cing / grwa gsar grwa tshang rnams dang gzhi byas rnams la snga phyir skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang ka ri ka lnga bcu pa'i gzhung la brten nas dge tshul —301—

gyi bslab bya zhib mo dang byang sdom gyi bslab bya dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa dang rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa dang sgom pa bsgrags bzung gi gzhung la brten nas sngags kyi bslab bya zhib mo dang bde gshegs snying po'i mdo rnams tshogs la bshad/ mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang / bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang / nag po pa'i dbang rnams chos lung rang du cho ga byed dgos dang bstun pa'i ma thob pa ci rigs ci rigs la bsgrubs/ dgon pa dang lung pa la phan pa'i phyir phyogs bzhir gtor ma chen po re yang btang / drag pa'i spyin sreg chen po gcig byas pas rang re'i 'gro don gyi bar chad mang po sangs pa'i ltas shar bkra shis 'dzom gyi grong pa tsho la'ang grwa gsar bkal ba rnams skra bcad kyang byas/ mig mdas dang dgon pa'i ltag nas rang gi rmis ltas kyis mthong ba bzhin du sa la brkos pas nged yon mchod dang dgon pa la ngan byed byas pa'i 'khor lo gsar rnying re re gnyis kyang thon/ de dag sbyin sreg gi cho gas bsregs des dgon pa la cung zad phan nam yang sems pa mngon rtags kyang byung / snga sor ngam ring la yong dgos tshul nan chags yod na'ang ltas la ma chug pas da res la mi yong bar thag chod zhus pa des/ lhar rtser mjal ba'i dgongs gtad 'dug pa ltar de kha'i rtsis kyi jo nang du phyin/ mkha' spyod bde ldan gyi las ka byed rgyu 'di zhig gsos yin na'ang / zhig nas yun ring lon pa'i stabs sa chog cig byas/ chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal la yang yab sras gsum dang 'dra bar lo dus kyi dus chen mchod pa'i thes sbyar/ hor zla gsum pa'i nyer lnga rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku kun spangs chen po kun du bzang po mtshan brjod par dka' ba thugs rje brtson —302—

'grus kyi dus chen gsar du btsugs pa'i thog bkra shis 'dzom du sleb par byas so/ /de rjes nyer bdun gyi nyin gza' skar bzang ba'i thog la sde srid nyid kyang bsu bar phebs shing gzhan yang ser bsgreng sogs 'du 'tshogs che ba dang bcas lha rtse'i pho brang du sleb/ de nyin nyi phyed yan nyi ma shin tu 'jam pa la phebs bsu'i sar nged kyis rta babs 'phral rlung yam tsam zhig langs/ gur nang du sleb 'phral rlung chen po gur stib pa tsam byung / de nas ser bsgreng sogs kyang rlung 'tshub shin tu che ba'i 'khris nas 'khris su mi mthong ba tsam la slar rdzong nang du sleb tsam na rlung de yang sangs song / zla gzhug de la drag po'i bka' ci rigs phul/ gnam gang gi nyin sa chog byas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon las bzhengs/ zhabs drung rang dag phyag g.yog dpon skya gcig gnyis tsam yod/ gzhan phal cher bla ma slob dpon bka' bcu rab 'byams sogs shas che ba la nyi shu rtsa lngar bcad pa'i dbang cha gnyis pa zhig byas/ de rjes dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rim lnga dang rjes su 'brel par bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid lam rim zhib mo dang bcas pa rgyab rten 'phags pa yab sras lnga'i gzhung rnams dang rtsa rgyud dang sgron gsal sogs kyi lung gzhan yang chos kyi rnam grangs mang rab don gnyer so so la legs par bsgrubs shing / ngam ring chos sde'i mkhan chen la rnal 'byor ma'i khrid lwa ba pa'i ngo sprod tshigs bcad gcig ma sogs sger gyi bzhed chos kyang kha re bsgrubs shing / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro he ru ka lha drug cu rtsa gnyis ma'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i steng nas/ yon mchod sogs la dbang —303—

cha gcig bgyis pa la/ chos 'khor lhun po'i mkhan po byams rdor ba dang /'jad yangs pa can pa'i mkhan slob rnams kyang byon/ sa ga'i tshes bco lnga dus tshes bzang po la rdzong gi mdun du chos khri gsar pa brtsigs pa'i steng nas gtsang gzhung gi skye bo phal cher 'dus pa la ma ṇi'i lung dang tshe dbang bsgrubs shing / de rjes su rdzong gi tshom wo du yon mchod dang dge bshes gtso bor gyur pa'i skya ser 'dres pa 'tshom chen khengs pa tsam la sems bskyed chen mor grags pa mkhas mchog sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung gi yi ge gzhir bzhag pa'i steng nas sgom don ngo gang 'phrod kyi lugs su byas/ de ltar na yul phyogs bzang por chos dang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs shing / gzhan phan rgya che ba'i skabs 'di nyid do/ /de la spyir lo rgyus 'di thog ma'i tshig tu smos pa bzhin du 'di la gzigs pa po thams cad kyi dgongs pa bzhugs pa zhu/ des na kha cig 'di snyam du khyed kyi 'di la ngo mtshar ba'i chos yi ger 'god rin chog pa ni/ gang yang mi snang /de las gzhan du phyogs ris su bcad pa dang chags sdang la sogs pa chos bzhin ma yin pa yang du ma snang la/ mtho dman 'byor rgud sna tshogs kyi gtam yang snang bas mchog tu mdzes pa ma yin pa'i gtam ci'i phyir 'bri bar byed ce na/ kho bo ni 'di 'bri ba la mchog tu spro ba yang ma yin la/ chags sdang la sogs pa'i nyes pa spangs pa yang ga la zhig ste/ bde sdug gi khyad par dang dgra dang bzhes kyi 'gyur ba sogs sna tshogs 'gyung ba ni 'khor ba'i chos nyid yin la/ 'on kyang gzhan gyis nan tan du bskul ba'i phyir na/ don chen po ma yin —304—

kyang sug ris 'di bris pa yin pa dang / sems la chags sdang drag po 'chang bzhin du tshigs 'jam pos brid nas gzhan bslu ba'i thabs kyang ngas ni mi shes la/ bde ba dang 'byor ba dang mthun pa'i gtam legs po dag bris nas/sdug bsngal ba dang rgud pa dang mi mthun pa'i gtam sbed pa la yang spro ba med do//yang bdag gang zag bzang po ma yin pa la rnam thar bzang po 'byung du re ba yang ma mdzad cig rang nyon mongs me ltar 'bar ba cig byas nas rgyud dul ba'i dul lugs dang nyes skyon nyon mongs med pa'i med lugs bshad pas ni skye bo bslu ba'i ham gtam du 'gro ba yin no/ 'on kyang ston pa de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ mkhas grub rnams kyis bsgom zhing bshad/ da lta'i bar du bka' ma chad par bzhugs pa'i chos/ rnams la zhu ba dang lta ba dang nyan pa dang gzhan la 'dri ba dang the tshom gcod pa rnams kyang byas/ de yang rang mkhas su re ba dang gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig 'dod pa'i dang ltos tsam ma yin par/ sems can 'khor ba las sgrol ba chos la rag las/de la yang tshig don ma nor zhing rgyun ma chad pa zhig dgos par shes nas/ zab cing rgya che ba la skrag cing zhus par ma byas/ khung zhing gsal ba la brnyas shing khyad du ma gsad par nan tan du bslabs te gzhan la ston par byed pa 'di ni kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste dang po yin no// //mdo sngags kyi gsung rab rgya mtsho rnams las rgyal tshab 'phags pa byams pa'i gzhung rnams dang 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub du ma'i nges don gyi gzhung rnam pa mang po dang / de bzhin du 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras dang / sangs tsho —305—

rgyas ye shes zhabs dpon slob dang / bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang / kū dril nag gsum dang / la li ta dang / dpal 'dzin dang / birlu pa dang / ku ku rī pa la sogs pa grub thob rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sngags kyi gzhung rnams dang /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'grel pa dang / khyad par du grub chen zhi ba sbas pa la sogs pa'i man ngag la rang byan chud cing dgongs pa longs par byas pas sgo phyed de/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mthong ba dang thos pa tsam gyis go zhing zab mo'i don gyi snying po len par byed pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste gnyis pa yin no// //bod du byon pa'i lo paṇa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams dang / de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba sngon byon mang po dang / bar skabs su byon pa'i mkhas grub chen po dam pa'i spyod pa can du ma byon pa rnams las phyogs ris su bcad pa'i chags sdang gi blo spangs te/ 'brog 'gos mar gsum/ rwa skyo zhang gsum/ sa rngog dpyal gsum sogs yongs su grags pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po thams cad kyi man ngag dang bshad sgros dang thugs kyi gsang ba phal cher byang chub cing / bskyed rdzogs cho ga 'phrin las kyi lag len khrigs bkod thams cad kyang blo la ma mdzings par 'char nus pa dang / byin rlabs dang nyams myong cung zad shar ba 'di yang kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste gsum pa'o// //bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi mthu las gnas lugs kyi don spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings dang / de rtogs par byed pa'i thabs mdo dang sngags las gsungs pa ji snyed pa thams cad la yid —306—

ches rnam pa gsum la brten te nges shes dang dad pa thob pas de dag ston byed kyi gsung rab rnams dang gnas lugs de gzigs shing thabs de mngon du gyur pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun la yang rkyen gzhan gyis gzhig tu med pa'i dad pa mi phyed pa thob pas/ dam pa mchog rnams kyi rnam par thar pa thos pa'am de'i dpe ris mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / ba spru ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrug pa'i dang ba skye ste/ chos dang gang zag la dad pa phun sum tshogs pa skye ba 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bzhi pa'o// //gzhan yang mkhas pa kha cig kun rdzob kyi snang ba 'di la a 'thas ko 'thas shi 'thas ro 'thas su song / blo lhan skyes kyi a 'thas dang bstun nas grub mtha' 'jog 'khrul snang tshang mar byas nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la bcad gras byed par gda' na'ang / chos 'di kun sgyu ma lta bur go myong brtan po yod cing / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang sangs rgyas kyi gsung la 'khrul ba dang 'dzol so ye med par nges nas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi mnyam gzhag dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i lung la snying thag pa nas yid brtan 'cha' bar byed pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste lnga pa'o// //mkhas pa kha cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'am skyes bu dam pa 'ga' re la phyogs 'dzin gyi zhen ngo bstod 'gas pa tsam byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las shes bya thams cad la khyab par yang ma shes/ theg pa chen po'i thabs la mkhas pa yang ma go nas/ rang nyid lta ba mchog tu 'dzin/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' gzhan rnams la dgrar lta/ mu stegs la sogs pa'i ming yang thos —307—

su mi rung pa skad byed de/ blo chung shes rab can du re ba ya re cha rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par ston pa'i phyir/ grub mtha' dang theg pa gong ma gong ma thams cad la 'og ma 'og ma rnams dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lta sgom spyod pa khyad 'phags re yod cing / skyon spang tshul dang yon tan lhag tshul re yang yod/che ba du ma dang ldan mod/ 'on kyang rgyang phan pa'i grub mtha' tshun chad ma rig pa 'joms byed kyi phyogs su gtogs shing / rtsa'i bu gar nyal ba'i srin bu phra mo'i kha zas tshun chad kyang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi smon lam gyi stobs las yin par shes nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang dam pa chos kyi sgo rnams la gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob kyang gzhan rnams la yang brnyas sems dang khong nas 'khrugs pa'i 'dam rdzab du ma byings pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste drug pa'o// //rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bcas pa las mi 'da' ba'i phyir/ sngags kyi chos bshad pa la sogs pa'i don du dkyil 'khor tha dad pa phal cher gyi grangs bsnyen re yang bgyis mod/ gtso bor lhag pa'i lha thams cad kyang ro gcigasngags thams cad kyang ro mnyam/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor tha dad pa rnams kyang rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bdun pa'o// //gzhan yang bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mang pos rjes su bzung ba snyam byed kyang dngos grub ster ba po la dga' ba dang re ba med/ bar chad byed pa po la 'jigs pa dang dogs pa yang med/ lha dang bdud ro mnyam du gyur pas bar du —308—

gcad bya gcod byed dbyings su dag byin gyis brlab bya rlob byed sems su shes/ dngos grub ster bya ster byed thams cad kyang rig pa'i rang rtsal tsam du nyams su myong ba 'di yang kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste brgyad pa'o// //btsun por rlom pa gzhan rnams mgu ba'i spyod pa bzang po med kyang /chos las ji skad bshad pa'i blang dor rnams la bden zhen dang mngon zhen drag po yang med cing / spang blang gi tshul rnams spyir btang gi gnas skabs su spyir btang dang mthun pa dang dmigs gsal dgos pa'i gnas skabs su dgag bya dgos pa bstun te blang dor ma 'khrul par byed pa la chos dang rang sems zhu dag pher tsam yod pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste dgu pa'o// //bzang por rlom pa rnams mnyes par 'gyur ba'i rgyal sras kyi rnam thar ma mchis shing / 'jig rten gyi skye bo phal cher dga' zhing 'dun pa'i thabs ma byas mod/ lag len du sems can bslu ba'i thabs ma byas mi byed par mi 'gyur la/ skye bo mang po la phyi ma'i tshe la mi gnod cing phan pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba mthong na rang gi grags 'dod dang bzang 'dod dang chos dang mthun mthun mor gzhan gyis ma mthong yang khyad med snyam pa'i blo brtan pos spyod pa gzhung lam drang por bsrangs te 'gro ba 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bcu'o// //grub par mngon par rlom pa dag mgu bar 'gyur ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma med kyang sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang las tshogs rab 'byams rnams dang /thun mong kyi dngos grub thams cad kyang sgyu ma'i rnam rol tsam du go bas sred pa —309—

log cing / /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub zhes pa'i sgra bo che de yang don dam de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po las logs su mi 'dug pas/ spyir thob 'dod drag po yod kyang gzha don du yin mod kyi/ rang gi ngo bo la thob bya thob byed thams cad dang bral bas thob 'dod kyi sred pa phal cher zad pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste bcu gcig pa'o// //lta ba dang grub mtha' tha dad pa rnams las nor pa rnams kyi 'tshang rig gnas gzhan phal cher gyi blo la ma shar ba'i sun 'byin dang thal 'gyur gyi rig pa gsar pa mang po dang / grub mtha' ma nor ba rnams la nges pa'i gtan tshigs la zhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dag pa mang po zhig gzhan phal cher gyis ma shes pa gsar du rtogs kyang rang shugs la rlom sems mi skye la/ sgra dang snyan ngag dang rtog ge rnams la mkhas 'dod kyi sred pa las grol zhing / don la mi sbyor na mkhas pa'i khur chen pos brjid pa las kyang tshigs bcad gcig kho na 'dzin pas dad pa 'ba' zhig gis chos don dang mthun pa'i lag len sna re byed pa la yang gding mthong che ba zhig sems la 'chang bar gda'/ 'di yang ston pa'i bka' dang mthun pa'i chos kyi go tshul cig yin nam sems te/ deng sang phal cher gzhan rnams dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar pa ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //gzhan yang 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin la re dogs byed don med de/ tshe ring bar smon pa yang med/ thung gi dogs pa yang med/ 'chi ba la 'jigs pa yang med/ nyi ma de ring nyid 'chi bdag gi rgyal po 'ongs kyang rang —310—

sems skad cig gi don 'chi rgyu 'chi bar byed pa po ji ltar 'chi ba'i tshul gang yang grub pa med cing / 'chi ba'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de yang bde chen lhan cig skyes pa nges par rnyed la/ de las gzhan shul ma'ang grwa rigs sam gzhan don nam bya ba byed 'phro 'di lta bu'o zhes lhag ma la yongs su chags pa'am rjes su 'di lta bu zhig dgos par 'dug ces blo la bcags pa yang med la/ ci ste lus sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor ma zhig pa de srid du rang gzhan la phan pa mang du sgrub nus pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bcu gsum pa'o// 'khor ba yin phyin chad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas bdag la na rgas 'chi rgud 'pho 'gyur mi yong ba ma yin kyang / gang zhig thog tu bab pa de ka chos nyid yin pa'i yi chad dang blos ma longs pa dang sems sdug yong ba'i gnas mi 'dug cing / de thams cad glo bur ba tsam du shes pas spang blang la rtsal 'don yang mi byed la/ chos kyi don dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir khro chags kyi rnam 'gyur du ma 'gyung ba yang grib ma'i skyes bu'am chu nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du 'khrul pa'i rang 'tshang rdib pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //yang khyed cag 'di na ngas 'jig rten gyi phan 'dogs 'dra yod du re ba'i ngos 'dzin gyis chos zhu ba dang yon mchod kyi 'brel byed pa 'dra 'dug ste/ nga ni mkhos mi shes par ma zad snying shin tu ring bas de 'dra'i re ba ma che zhig lkog rngan blangs pa'i ngo yang ngas mi yong nyin mtshan shad pa'i 'grul yang nges mi pher/ gson gshin gyi rnyed bkur la hor rgyug rgyug kyang ngas mi lcogs/ zhi —311—

drag thabs skyog sna tshogs kyis dgra 'dul ni nga mi byed/ snying ring ba 'di yin pa skyon yin te slob ma brtag pa zhor la yong / yon bdag gi dad pa brtan mi brtan brtag pa la yang 'di dgos/ rang dge sbyor rang cig byed na rang dgos par 'dug snying thag nye nye mo'i sred pas dge sbyor rlung la bskur/ de'i rgyu mtshan da lta 'gro ba'i don ni cung zad tsam yin gyi/ rgyu mos pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs pa 'di las brtsams nas rnam par mi rtog pa lhun gyis grub pa'i spyod yul nam mkhas gar khyab gyi yul rnams su/ 'khor ba ji srid pa'i dus thams cad la don med du 'gyur ba nam yang mi srid par gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro ba'i don sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji bzhin du 'jug par 'gyur ba srid zhi thams cad kyi snang brnyan can de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgya mtshor 'jug par 'gyur te/ mos pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bco lnga pa'o// //bco lnga po 'di nga rang la yod nges pa'i rnam thar rang de yin pa dgongs zhu/gzhan yang rnam par thar pa mang po yod pa rnams 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /sde tshan bar pa 'di rang lo so brgyad pa'i steng du bris pa yin/ phyis cung zad bsnan pa yod/ bkra shis/ / / /—312—

o khyu sti/ yang sngar gyi 'phros las brtsams te/ rang gi gnas tshul cung zad brjod na grom pa lha rtse'i phyogs de nyid du/ sngar gyi chos 4nad pa'i 'phros de las/ dbang rjes gnang lung bka' than thun mang rab dang / khyad par byang zhabs drung rang gi dgongs brtad dang bstun/ zhabs drung rang dang / /ngam ring mkhan chen tshu9/ khrims pa dang / gzhan dge bar/sa brgyad dgu tsam/ ser chags 'ga' re dang bcas pa la/ dbu ma gzhan stong gi bshad 'doms rags pa dang / rang res brtsams pa'i gzhan stong gi gzhung than thun dang bcas pa yang bshad/ slob dpon byams bkras pa sogs grub mtha' de la phyogs zhen bag tsam gda' na'ang / nges po ni ma byung ba 'dra/ gzhan dge bshes kyi khungs rnams nged ci 'dra zhig smra'am bsam tshod bgam pa'i phyir/ bdag cag kyang grub mtha' 'di la mos pa yin pas/ chos grwa 'di la zhugs pas chog pa dgos zer yang yang nan bcags byas de yongs mod kyang / sngar gyi bag chags rnying pa blo la zhen pa de kha ma gtogs chos la go nas dad pa skye ba lta ci smos/ go ba rang sngon ma nas mi skye ba 'dug sngar gyi go ba ro thed ngan pa rab ri ba des bsgrubs nas/ rang res zhib po bshad kyang go ba gtsang sang nge ba 'char thub mkhan mi gcig kyang mi 'dug rang nyid gang mos pa'i rtsa ba'i grub mtha' de/ phyogs cen gyi sgo nas 'dzin pa dam po byed pa ni/ deng sang phal cher gyi lugs su gda' na'ang / gzhung lugs shes gyu'i khungs kyis chos nyan phyin/ so so'i 'dod tshul tha dad pa'i go babs kyis mtshams byed pa tsam mam/nged kyis bshad pa de phyogs snga yin du bcug na'ang / phyogs snga go ba cig ka —313—

yong thang ba la/ man ne mun ne cig min pa 'di yin med pa'i steng nas/ rgyu mtshan ma yin pa la rgyu mtshan du 'dzin/ rgyu mtshan rang de ye mi go gnad don ma yin pa la gnad du 'dzin/ gnad rang de mtha' la yal/ rgo chog sa nas mi go ma go chog sa nas go ba sha stag yong gin 'dug pas/ rgod kyang bro la yi yang mug par byung / phal cher ma go zhing cung zad go ba la yang blo ma song bas shes par 'dod pa'i dogs gcod byed pa yang med/ mi 'thad pa go ba'i rgal brtag 'bel gtam byed pa gang yang med par/ kha skyengs bsu ba byed la khyed la mdo phyogs kyi bslab shes 'di tsam yod snyam pa sngar ma byung / 'di ltar yod phyin/ mdo lugs kyi bshad grwa zhig bskyangs na bstan pa la phan pa 'dug zer ba'i ngo bstod gcam bu de mi re ngo res gtong du gyur/ dge bshes 'di rnams kyis mi go ba'i rgyu yang 'dir 'dug ste/ gzhan stong 'di sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i lugs yin no zhes zer ba dang / g.yin stong pa rnams ni byams chos bar pa gsum gyi dgongs pa/ rang lugs kyi dbu mar 'dod pa yin zer ba'i gtam tsam zhig rna ba lhungs pa des/ rang rang gi grwa sa na rnam 'grel gyi sems tsam rnam rdzun gyi skabs dang / byams chos bar pa gsum gyi don yin gyu ba sems tsam du 'dod pa'i grub mtha'i khul zhig 'dug pa de/dbu ma gzhan stong du ming bsgyur ba ma gtogs/ de kha rang yin yong snyam nas/gzhan stong dang sems tsam gyi khyad par shin tu che ba rnams ye mi go bar/ khyad chos de dag khong rang tsho'i 'dod tshul rnying pa'i sems tsam gyi lugs de la ka yod pa e mi yin nam/ sngar gyi de dang ni 'dra la 'dra min zhig byung snyam pa'i —314—

mgo bo spos pa de khar 'dug go /'di skabs sa ga'i tshes bco lnga la/ rang yul du pha sku mdun rnam rgyal phun tshogs de sku gshegs pa 'dug dgongs rdzogs dngos kyi skor la ni mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan pa spyan drangs gda'/skabs 'dir gnas tshul skyes mi byung bas/ dgon stod smad thams cad du mang ja nas 'gyed sogs dgongs pa rdzogs thabs gang grag bgyis pa yin/ cung zad skyo shas che ba cig kyang byung / byis pa'i dus su rtse mo'i rnam pas/ ku re kyal ka'i sgo nas/ pha la ma gus pa'i rnam 'gyur byas pa'i mthong chos kyi 'bras bu la/ da ltar yang rlung khams kyis rtag tu gtses pa'i khams mi bde ba yong bar 'dug des na phra zhing phra ba la spang blang byed pa gal che bar gda'/ de skabs zhig zhabs drung dang byams bkras pa gnyis kyis/ shin tu nan bcags ches pa'i ngo ma chogs par/ khong dpon g.yog gnyis la grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs nas brgyud pa'i sbyor drug gsar ma de bshad dgos par byung / sor sdud la mun khrid kyi rnam pa tsam gcig kyang mdzad/ 'di'i dbang man ngag bshad pa rnams tshar gcig tshar bar byas/ de skabs bka' cung zad ltas 'tshub par byung na'ang skyon tsam med dam snyam cher cher ma byas/ yig brgya bshags pa tshogs mchod sogs byed pa yang ma byung / 'di skabs rtsis gnas gsar ba'i rje drung khong mdar nas yar lung phyogs la thogs pa'i zhor lam du/khong pa'i dpon sras chos rje chung chung de dang bcas nged yon mchod rnams mjal bar byung / brag sna stod dang po zhig brag sna chos rje pas bdag po kun rin pa la dgongs pa zhus nas chos lung byang rtser phul bar 'dug de la 'phan —315—

ne bas mgo skor gyi rnam pa byas 'dug kyang / phyis brag sna chos rje spyon pa la khas chad yod pa'i dgos cha rnams ma byung ba yun ring pas snga sor cig nged la byin pa yin kyang / gzings gzhi la dgos pa mi 'dug snyam lo mang dag cig bzhag pa yin/ 'di skabs chos lung dgon par ngan byed btsun pa kun yang /smon 'gro ba rang rtogs ldan dang bcas pas btsud pa yin nges su 'dug pa dang / chos rje smyon pas kyang nan gyis phul ba 'dzom nas/ rang res kyang khams gshis langs te khas blangs pas/ 'di skabs brag sna stod lag tu byung ba yin/ smon 'gro ba gtan zhal gyis sdigs ris lung pa bkang yang / rjes la 'di yin rang ni cang ma byung / de nas hor zla lnga pa tshes 'phral la yar chas te/ sde pa dpon g.yog gis skyal ma cung zad mdzad/ rags rdzong gzhol gyi gdong der gdong dga' bas sna len byung / mdar rdzong gsar gyi mdun du sde pa dgra 'dul ba dang mjal/ de yang dgra 'dul ba la rgyal po'i gnod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i nad gdon gnyis 'dzom zhig gis yun ring bsnyung / thabs rten 'brel gyi rigs la ma mdzad pa'i sna med par 'dug gnas gsar rje drung gis rngas bsrungs rgyang tsam mdzad/ dbang bskur rim gro dpag med mdzad zer/khong pa'i gsang chab kyang chu 'jo 'jo mchod gda' na'ang / phan skyed ni cher ma byung bar 'dug mos zhen ni de phyogs rang la che mod/ nad gdon phan du re nas nged la'ang de skabs/ dngos brgyud du ma nas nan bcags mdzad pa'i stabs/ 'dre la srung yig dang byin rlabs sogs nged kyis kyang byas/ phan thogs che rab kyang byung ni byung / nam phan pa nas gsung thugs brjed ngas kyi —316—

dbang du song yod pa ni gzhir bcas/ de nas nges cag lus la 'phrod du re pas/ mang mkhar phu'i chu tshan cung zad bsten/ nyi ma snga ma gnyis la/ byang zhabs drung gi gsung nan chags chen po yod pa ltar/ sbyor drug nye brgyud kyi 'khrid dmigs yi ger bkod nas phul/ zhag gnyis song ba'i nyin mo be snabs 'dres pa'i khrag sla nga do gsum tsam skyugs/ de thog ma chu tshan gyis bad khrag pa phan pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig yin nam snyam pa byung yang / chos rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag 'phags yul grub pa'i thugs bcud de nyid skabs su ma bab pa la bshad cing yi ger bkod pa'i gnyan cha rang gtso che ba'i rigs su 'dug de ma thag ma nas gnyid shin tu che/ khams nyog lus shin tu ma bde ba zhig byung ba'i ngang nas/ rgya tsho la dang / che la sogs brgyud nas rim pas/bla ma'i bzhugs gnas ri khrod chen po brag stod du 'byor/ gtsang khang / 'du khang / logs bris dang bcas pa sogs ri khrod nyid la bltos pa'i rgya dpangs mi chung tsam rang res snga sor du rgyang nas bkod pa byas pa yang / de skabs mthar phyin pa'i skabs yin pas/ slebs 'phral nas khams ma bde bzhin du de rnams la rab gnas rgyas par byas/ dngos gzhi tshes bco lnga la yin/ de rjes tshes bcu bdun bco brgyad gnyis la/ ya phyang ba drung chen brtan pa mi ngo sogs la kyai rdor gyi dbang zhig kyang byas pa dngos gzhi la dbang rdzas 'grim pa mi lcogs la khad la thub tsam byung / de bar du khams shin tu mi bde ba de je lod du song nas/ de'i nang par nas gang yang ma lcogs par sdod dgos byung /de yang nyin mtshan kun tu khams nyog cing gnyid la 'gro ba/ mgo lus rus —317—

tshigs thams cad mi na ba'i sa gcig kyang med pa la/ lus zungs chung zhing kha yang 'gag pa/ rtag tu mgo 'khor ba'i rnam pa yod pa/ mig dang rna ba dbang po'i sgo rnams kyang 'grib pa sogs shin tu nad tshabs che ba dos drag par byung na'ang / 'tsho byed sman pa sogs gang la'ang ma bstan/ nang la thog 'gel dang / blos btang gi lam khyer cung zad re bsgom/ lar bla ma'i sku drin yin/ 'chi ba la 'tsher ba de sangs nas ni/ de gong nas lo mang po zhig kyang thal/ gal te dus la bab pa yin na/ spyir 'chi ba'i sa cha la khyad mi 'dug kyang / bla ma'i gdan sar sleb pa 'di shin tu stabs legs 'dug snyam pa tsam ni byung / de ka la zhag mang rab cig song / de skabs su nyer mkho'i kha zas dang yo byad 'ga' zhig dkon par byung nas/ blo bcos ma ma yin par rang gis rang la snying tshim mang po bgrong bar byung ste/ khyod dgos cha gang 'dod yod pa'i skabs/ dkon mchog la mi mchod/ dge ba mi byed par rang gis yog zas dang yog 'thung kho na byas/ da rang la dgos dus med thabs med pa'i yo byad rnams mi 'dzom pa 'di/ dkon mchog gi sku yogs 'go ma rnams kyi brda gtong yin/ snying re tshim/ da dung 'di bas kyang tshes che ba'i na tsha sdug bsngal thams cad sbungs shig snyam pa kho na yang yang rang zhugs la byung / de nas snga dro zhig me tog char pa spos chu dang 'dres 'bab pa yis/ dmyal ba'i me mdag chil chil gsod pa mthong gyur nas/ /glo bur bde bas tshim pa 'di ci bsams pa dang / gems dmyal rnams kyi phyag na pad+ma mthong bar shog khres pa spyod 'jug gi tshig 'di yang yang dran pas rkyen byas nas/ 'phags pa spyan —318—

ras gzigs 'ba' zhig yid la dran zhing / mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po mchi ma rang dbang med par 'chor ba de ka zhag po gnyis gsum zhig shugs 'byung la byung / de ka'i ngang la nyin gcig gnyid chogs te/ gnyid du 'phri tsam song ba na/ 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso 'dra rung ba'i sku'i rnam pa gsal po zhig khra lam gyis byung / gnyid sad pa na/ de 'phral rang du khams cung zad bder song 'dug de nas zhag po gnyis gsum na nad rags pa de grag sngar rab gnas kyi skabs nas/ rang gi grwa rigs su gtogs pa dgon tha dad nas 'dus pa/ chos thob 'dod can mang po yod pa la/ sgom chen bya bral snyom chung gi rigs 'di dad pa che bas 'tsho ba rang rgyags la brten zhing / chos kyi dgug sdod byed mkhan kho nas mtha' 'khor nas yod pas/ khams tsho zin tsam nas gzung / grwa rigs pho mo kho na lnga brgya tsam dang / yon bdag skye bo ci rigs pa dang bcas mang po la tshogs chos su dbang bskur rjes gnang grangs mang ba dang / ni gu chos drug gis sna drangs shangs chos cha tshang sogs 'khrid sna mang du byas/ snying po don rgyud rang sems ngo sprod pa yin pas/ 'khrid gsar pa'i rigs ngo sprod zhu 'dod shin tu mang ba 'dug pa rnams la'ang / so sor ngo sprod 'thems rgyas su byas pa rnams/ 'khrid thebs tshu nya/ yang legs rab byung / grwa rigs yon bdag so sos rang la gang yod che 'byor chung 'byor du byin pa'i rnam grangs kyang shin tu mang / lar bka' brgyud pa'i sgom chen 'di rnams la/sngon gyi spyan ltos bzang po'i rgyun 'di kha ngo mtshar che bar gda'/ lus longs spyod bla ma'i phyogs su btang nas/ ngas byas dang drin bgrang bar mi byed/ bla —319—

ma'i dkor la shin tu 'dzem zhing rang la lan gyi re ba mi byed pas/ so sor yang rten 'brel cung zad re 'grig nas/ rang rang la yang mdun ma tha shal rang min tsam re dang / sde de la'ang dge mtshan 'phran bu re dang / dus dang dbang po la bltos pa'i dge sbyor skye tshul 'phran du re yang 'phral du yod kyin 'dugasngon sger sgom zhig pos/ bla ma ka ba can pa'i rtsar byon pa'i dpe bzhin yin/chos phar bshad dgos/ zhabs tog phar byed dgos/ phyag phar la stob dgos/ drin tshur la 'ded du 'ong / nga la ni btsun pa'i slob mas dgos pa med zer nas/ yun ring du mjal kha ma btang skad/ cha cig nas de yang bden por gda'o/ /de skabs bo dong dang sher dkar gyi mkhan po rje 'phags chen pa gshegs pas gshegs rdzong gi gral dbu la blon po dgon par yong dgos tshul gyi nan chags la/ chos rje nam mkha' rdo rje ba rang phebs byung na'ang / khams mi bde ba'i 'phros kyang yod/ yun ring sdod long yang med nas 'gro ba ma thub pas skal ba tshur skyel bar mdzad/ rgya lung du'ang 'du khang gi logs bris gsar bzhengs kyi rab gnas la 'gro dgos yin yang 'gro ma thub/de skabs phyogs de kun tu'ang phyi nang gi rten 'brel sgrig rgyu 'ga' re 'dug pa nas/ g.yas g.yon stod smad kyi ri rnams la gtor ma mang po btang / rten 'brel phyogs re tsam nas 'grig pa yar byung / rgyan bu rdzong dpon gnyis dang phrad pa'i tshe/ dam tshig shin tu mi gtsang zhing / khog nang sol ba ltar byas pa la phan tshun gnyis thad nas kha mdzes mdzes ltar byed dgos pa de don shin tu chung zhing / khyad par phyogs de na rtsub 'gyur mang du mthong / kho tshos phar lam —320—

gzhi len byed pa'i rtsis kyang byas/ brag stod du mi mtho sogs 'dug kyang / de thams cad kyis rig tshor med par thog rgyag tu bteg nas phyin/ rgyan bu'i gdong thad rang la phyin kyang su yang gis rig tshor ma byung / de nub sngo ma lung du bsdad de cung zad 'tshub pa zhig ka byung / nang par rgyan bu rdzong dpon tshe legs pa/ byang phyogs la 'gro rgyu yin 'dug pas/ la de la 'phrang yod dam zer mkhan 'dug kyang 'phrad ma byung / khong de nas zla gcig lhag tsam nas ngam ring du thog phog pa'i rkyen gyis shi 'dug de nas mtsho sgo'i thad kyi chu byang kha der mtsho sgo grwa tshang gi slob dpon ar ba chen po yin zer ba'i srad pa de sogs mtsho sgo'i skya ser rags rim rnams 'phrad par byung / khong de lo kham mchu rgyal ba yin zer nas pho bzo che ba'i skabs su 'dug nged rnams de la brten pa'i phyogs las rgyal gyi tha snyad byed pa sogs bzhad gad che bar byung ba de ka rten 'brel shin tu mi legs pa'i rnam par 'dug go /skabs der dgra thangs nas bla chen chos rje de sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten skyel mkhan sleb/ khong bstan pa la phan pa'i dge bshes cig yod pas shin tu phangs pa byung / de nas sngar gyi 'bod mi nan chags kyi rgyun yod pa ltar rim pas gting skyes su sleb/ zla gcig lhag pa zhig bsdad/ zhal ngo rnams la dgongs bzhed ltar dbang chos sngar khyud ltar phul/ khyad par dge bzhes 'ga' re dang bcas pa la/ sngags kyi lam rim tshigs bcad bcu pa'i bshad pa chos thun bdun la rdzogs pa cig bshad/ de bzhin du dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyi bshad pa zhib pa zhig byas pa phyed lhag tsam song / 'di rnams thog khar rab 'byams pa bkra shis phun —321—

tshogs kyis kyang nges por nyan/ mang rab zhig la gcod kyi 'khrid dang lung bka' zhib cig kyang byas/ brag dkar mgon khang mjal ba dang / gsang sngags ri bor yang khor tsam byin/ brag dkar ltag ri dang / gsang ri'i ltag ri gnyis kar du gtor ma rgya che tsam re yang btang / phyogs der yon bdag gi bar chad rags rim sel ba'i ltas kyang byung / rgyal bu dbang gi rgyal po ba chos la thugs 'dun che bar yod pa ltar/ phyag thog tu longs pa'i dbu skra bsil/ mtshan kun dga' ye shes rgya mtshor btags/ dge mtshan khyad par can sbyar bas legs po byung / dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ sde ba ma chen gyis kyang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa len par mdzad/ sngar yod res kyis byed pa ltar mi 'tshogs 'dus che ba la khrom dbang yang byas shing / dbyar kha de rang shugs kyis 'khru sbyongs yang yang byung bas sngar na ba'i nad kyi gzhug de yangs sangs te grag nas re zhig lus rnal du gnas par byung / gam pa nas bdag po dgra 'dul drung snga sor nas spyi spyi nang gi sgos sgos thugs nyer ba'i khungs rang yin zhing / jo nang dang brag stod sogs thams cad du mi yang yang gnang ba zhig yod kyang / bla ma'i tshul can mi nag pa 'ga' zhig gi thugs bsgyur ba yin nam/ dus gzengs gra sgrig gis yin snyam pa'i rtog ngan ni shar/gang ltar yang thugs 'gyur ba'i 'di skabs yig 'brel tsam yang ma byung / de nas tshur lam gzhong rma bya rdzong du zhag gcig bsdad cing / snga sor byang nas gsung bkod yod pa ltar/ rma bya'i chos sde 'di rdo rings kun spangs chos rje dang / bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa de kun gyis zhal bdag mdzad pa'i rgyun yin —322—

pa bzhin/ nged rang gis kyang 'dzin skyong gi khul du byas pas da lta'i bar du legs par yang byung / tshur lam 'bod mi nan chags ltar gdong dga' phyogs su chas/ rdzong la ni 'di res ye ma phyin/ klu sdings der zhag gnyis bsdad/dril bu pa'i dbang zhig byas/ ltas kyang bzang rgyu med tsam byung / 'dam la la 'ongs nas rtsad skor du sleb/ de nyin lam la 'brog pa 'dra byin rlabs zhu bar byung / skad cha dris pas nged tsho rgya rgan nang so'i g.yog yin gyin 'dug khrol le ma'i gdong der lo chen dbon po mkhas btsun bsu ba la byung ba 'dred thag byung nas 'gyel/ phyis dgon pa nged la yong ba'i rten 'brel du 'dug de nas rtsad skor rang gi rdzong dang dgon pa gnyis kar na su yang ma bsdad pa'i stong seng seng ba cig dang / sang zhogs de rdzong dpon yang sleb nas/ phyir 'ongs dus skyel thag shin tu ring ba dang / gzhan yang tshig bkra sogs nas 'pho 'jug yod pa'i rten 'brel rnams shar/ jo nang du sleb nas mkha' spyod bde ldan gyi khang pa la/ zhal dro'i phyir du zhag gcig bsdad/ khang bkod rnams bkod pa bzhin ma byung ba'i blo khengs pa rang ma byung na'ang / re zhig de khas chog pa'i lugs su byas/ gzhong stod du gtor ma rgya che ba zhig btang / de nas 'bring bu phyogs su myur du sleb dgos yod pas mgyogs po 'gro grabs yin pa la/ ngam ring nas lhun grub spe'u ba kun dga' dang / byams bkras pa sogs mi sna snga phyi mang po bstud mar gnang ba'i dgun tsam gyi bar 'gro ba bshol 'then nan bcags rang mdzad/ de tsam 'then mi thub pa rang zhus pas/'phral du 'phral dgos pa yin pas rgyang tsam 'then dgos tshul gyi nan bcags —323—

lung med mdzad pas zla gcig tsam 'gyangs/ de'i dgug stod stabs mtshams thung tsam gcig kyang byas/ de grol nas shangs chos kyi dbang byin rlabs gal che ba 'dra byed tshul gsal bar bkod pa gcig kyang brtsams/ de rjes mi ring bar byang zhabs drung rang lha dbang rtser phebs zhor la/ mar lam jo nang du phebs dus kyang nam mkha' dngas po yod 'phro la/ 'phral rang du dus min gyi rlung chen po langs pa dang / mdzod pa sogs phebs bsu byed rgyu'i khungs la rta rnams smyo ba sogs dang / gzhan yang 'tshub cha che ba rang byung zhag gcig bzhugs/ zhung gro sgrub sde pa rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zhig zhur byung ba la yang byas/ lha dbang rtse 'gro rgyu'i dus thog snga ma de la glo bur du khams ma bde ba zhig byung nas cung zad cig 'gyangs/ de rjes lha dbang rtser byin dus kyang / zla rgyab kyi bsu ba'i sar yang cung zad 'tshub pa'i rnam pa rang byung zhing / rdzong rtser sleb pa dang nyi ma bzhud pa dus mnyam pa 'dra ba'i rten 'brel la yang rtog dpyod shar/ sngar lha rtser yongs skabs dang / 'di res gnyis kar du dpon g.yog drung skor gzigs chung ba sogs thams cad/'brug pa'i bu chen rje mog pa lha rtse ba ngag dbang bzang po slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i bsngags brjod kho na'i 'phyar rgyag dang / bem po lcags nag po 'gro 'ong 'du 'tshog mgur ma dbyangs rta rkang dung gi brda skad nyin re bzhin khor mor yong ba zhig ka 'dug pa/ 'jig rten phyogs kyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgo thams cad ni bzhad gad kyi rgyu kho nar 'dug rten 'brel ni mi legs pa rang yin par snang na'ang / drung skor nang gzan tsho ni nged tsho'i rtsar yang ngom —324—

ngom byed kyin 'dug nga yi bsam pa la ni g.ya' g.ya' dang / pha pha'i dang /tha'i tha'i/ 'us 'us ste bzhi po de kho na byung / spyir chos su bzang ta cha gcig nas mi shes te/ skabs su bab pa gcig byed dgos/ bya byed gang dga' ta mi shes te/ dus dang bstun pa cig byed dgos/ tshad pa'i sman la ga bur las bzang ba med kyang / tshad pa ma smin pa la dug tu 'gro'o/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ rgyal khams gzhan gyi gling brjod re zhig bzhag bod yul 'di na nged grub mtha' tha dad yin/ lta ba tha dad yin zer nas ko long mgo gas gas dang / ske 'phreng wa ba ras ras byed kyin 'dug ste/ spyir nang pa yin/ sgos su theg chen pa/ yang sgos su dbu ma par khas blangs byin/ grub mtha' tha dad yong don ni mi spog yod rang yod na ni so so tha dad nas su bzang su ngan yang / nang 'thab dme 'khrug shor ba'i mi ngan grib can rkyang par 'gro nyen yod lar bod 'dir sngon chos kyi bka' srol rkang 'dzin so so du ma zhig byung 'dug kyang dge 'dun shas cher rigs su ma chad spyi la bzhugs/ da lta chos kyi bka' srol mang po zhig ni nub/ ma nub pa tsho la'ang gzhan rnams la rkang 'dzin cher mi gda'/ dge 'dun ni spyi la bzhugs mkhan su yang med/ thams cad a ma kha zhags la song / sa dge bka' gsum dang rnying ma bar grags pa ste bzhi po 'di sgra che bar gda'/ de dag tu ma gtogs ci rigs pa deng sang yang yod mod zhen 'then mkhan skya ser nyung / bar skabs lan cig dge ldan pa'i lugs dar rgyas che grags pa snying du ma sdug nas sa bka' rnying gsum grub mtha' gcig zer gyin dpung pa phyogs su gzhibs/ mdun ma gcig tu sgril —325—

rgyu'i khungs byas/ dge ldan pa la phyir 'bud kyi 'char ka brjod 'dogs yid la dran tshad kha nas bton/ de'i lan du khong tshos kyang tshur la khyed rnams thams cad la thar pa thob pa'i chos yod ri shi byas pas/ bod yul gyi bstan pa'i thed ro cung zad yod pa de'ang rnam pa du mar gyes/ phan tshun thams cad bya rog dang lug pa'i tshul du song ba der gda'/ sa bka' rnying gsum ni grub mtha' gcig rung mi gcig rung gcig go zhes khas blangs pa de yin/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pos mdo sngags thams cad du chos skad sngar gyi bod rnying pa dang mi 'dra tsam ci rigs pa mdzad pa ni bden te/ 'on kyang khong gi bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi nang nas/ kha cig gis sum cha tsam la las phyed tsam/ 'ga' zhig gis sum gnyis tsam/ g.yin rags thams cad byas te grub mtha' rnying par 'dod pa phal cher yang de'i grub mtha' khas len par 'dug der ma zad sgom pa la khyad yod srid/ go yul gyi lta ba rang la tshig tsam min pa khyad che rang he he/ de'i lugs de nag po yin rang yin na/ g.yin phal cher yang nag khra ru ka yong nye gda'/ des na ming btags so sor 'dzin pa tsam ma gtogs/ grub mtha' gsar rnying gi dbye ba rang cig yod yod mi 'dra/phyis deng sang bka' rgyud du grags pa'i rkang 'dzin gyi gtso bo gnam dbrol ba de/ kar 'brug gnyis su gda' na'ang / de'i nang tshan rje btsun mi la'i lugs yin zer ba'i dbu ma bsgom tshul na shing rta'i dpyad pa bdun gyi sgo nas bsgom tshul dpyad sgom gsal bor bris pa dang / yang chen po gzhan zhig gis/dbu ma 'jug pa dang phyag chen don gcig gsungs shing / lhan cig skyes sbyor —326—

gyi man ngag gi nang du dbu ma'i gtan tshigs chen po bzhi bsgom dgos skad pa'i/ mdor na phyis kyi bka' rgyud pa skad chen rgyang grags kyi bshes gnyen tsho yang / dge lugs dang 'dra min la de'i lugs kyi gnad kyang ma longs de las khungs kyang chung ngu song ba cig byas/ rang lugs su 'dod pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams dang 'gal khyab tu song ba de dpa' lor khyer nas ngo so 'phyar mkhan kho nar 'dug des na lta spyod sgom gsum kun phan tshun 'dra se ba rkyang pa la/'khrug long mang po yod pa 'di rnyed bkur dang kha drag snying la bzhag pas lan/ji skad du/ rgyud las/ 'dzin cing mchod pa byed pa ni/ /'tsho ba'i thabs rgyu phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa der gda'/ 'phros don gyi cal col la zad pa med/ dgos nges kyi gnad don la sgril pa zhu/ mi shes rab can kun 'o re rgyal/ 'phral dbyings su bcad na dga' ba yin/ /da sngar gyi 'phros bshad na/de skabs bya mchu ba rnam rgyal rtogs ldan byas pa la dpon g.yog thams cad smon pa'i gnas su mdzad kyin 'dug ste/ slar khong pas 'phral nyid du rang rtags bstan pa de gsar 'grogs chen po rnams la snying re tshim mo/ /'di'i rigs ka yang yang yod par 'dug kyang / 'jungs med tsho la sun rgyu med/dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ phal cher yongs su 'dris la sdad/ /rtag tu gsar pa gsar pa 'tshol// /ring na gnas pa thams cad ni/ /kun gyi yid du 'ong ba yin/ /zhes 'byung ba de don la gnas pa zhig go /der 'phral du 'gro 'dod yin yang / gsung nan che ba'i mthar thug pa nas rgyang tsam sdod dgos shar/ sgrol ma bla med kyi chos skor cha tshang dang / gcod khrid sogs bzhed —327—

dgongs ltar phul/ chos gzhug ma de'i ming bkra la rtog pa cung zad byung /phyir yong dus snga sgo dus dar sdings nas lcam gcig skra bcad la byon/gzhon nu ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa chos kyi sgor 'jug pa sogs rang re la lam bkra de thog ma rang nas legs/ rkyang la'i la thog par zhabs drung dpon g.yog rnams kyis skyel ma la phebs/ ming bkra de la'ang rten 'brel gyi rtog dpyad cung zad byung zhing / lha rtse nas yar 'gro dus kyi skyel ma'i skabs dang /'di skabs gnyis ka ru zhabs drung rang gis nan bcags mdzad de/ mi dmangs kyi dkyil der zhabs dbang re byed dgos byung ba la'ang / phyag g.yas phal cher bzhin 'gyur/ mun sros ba bzhin du nag thom thom par 'dug dpon g.yog rang la shin tu mi legs pa'i rten 'brel du go /brag ram dang e 'brog pa'i rtswa mtshams kyi kham mchu'i thad nas/ lha ri rtse pa rgyal chen gyis rngan pa chen po zos pa'i zhus stabs nas/ zhabs drung rang gi thugs kyang 'phral 'phral 'gyur 'gro ba'i da lta rang khrims drang po 'di dang 'di lta bu mdzad gsung ba'i zhal len yod 'phro la/ phra ma la khong tshos gang zhus 'dri pa dang / nags phug pa dang rtsod gzhi'i thad la yang / nged tsho'i mi ga tor sku rgyal chad sgrub sogs 'gel ba ltar mdzad cing / lkog tu chad pa'i dngos po blangs grub grub pa de/ slar khong tsho la sprod pa sogs nged la phyi ma nang gi lugs yin pa la/rang yang por gtong ba de 'dra mdzad kyin gda' 'o/ /skyel ma'i sa de nas rta thog khel nas yongs dus/ snod khengs pa thogs pa sum brgya tsam 'phreng du bsgrigs pa dang phrad pa sogs nged rang la ni lam bkra shin tu dge zhing bkra —328—

shis pa'i ngang nas/ lam bar du yang longs spyod wo po dang bcas te/ rim pas bkra shis sgang gi gru la 'thon de bsam grub rtser sleb/ de nyin phebs bsu'i sar/ thog mar rlung che zhing rjes la 'jam pa dang / rgya gar lho phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i bhā ḍa zhig gis skad gsangs mthon pos shis brjod byed pa sogs/ rtsub kyang rtsub la bzang yang bzang ba'i ltas su byung / 'di skabs zhag bcu lhag zhig bsdad/ rkyen sel gyi chos bka' 'bul dgos dkyus mthun du phul zhing / khyad par bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gsar bzhengs su mdzad pa rnams dang / nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi lugs sku sogs rten gsar bzhengs mang po la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab gnas zab rgyas su bgyis/ dkyil 'khor de kha'i steng nas zhabs drung yab sras rang dang / gzhan bla ma dge bshes gcig gnyis dang bcas pa la dbang bskur yang byas/ rab gnas kyi mnga' dbul grub mtshams der/ shing 'bras shin tu ser ba ka to ra gang mchod shoms kyi drung du 'bul mkhan byung /de yang phyogs nas glo bur du byung ba yin/ ched kyi sgrigs pa ma yin rang 'grigs byung ba/ phyi rtags kyi rten 'brel yang legs par go /dkyil 'khor sgrub dang / rten gyi ye shes spyan 'dren sogs kyi skabs nang rtags kyang legs te/ rab gnas shin tu zhal gro bar byung / de nas byang chen brgyud de/ tshong 'dus klu sdengs su 'byor/ tshong 'dus pa'i sde pa sku gzhon pa de chu nad kyis bsnyung bar 'dug pas rdzong rtse la phyin te/ tshe dbang dang gtor dbang zhig byas de phan thogs ni cang ma byung / de skabs nyang stod rtse chen rdzong la haX pa thebs/—329—

dus zing chen po langs te/ rgyal khams gyi 'gyur ldog chen po de'i 'go tshugs so/ /lar rgyal khams kyi 'gyur ldog chen po 'di 'dra cig yod pa'i ltas tsam lo mang po'i snga rol nas yang yang shar/ de stabs kyis snga mo'i dus yang yang 'gro dgos pa'i dpon rigs so so'i sar yang / mi dgos kha med rnams ma gtogs 'gro ba nyung ngu btang nas lo 'ga' shas song ba kun la gsal ba de ga yin/ dang po snga sor gzhon dus nas kyang 'grul shad pher ba rang cig med/dge ldan pa dang karma'i bla ma slob dpon yod pa'i rigs dang po nas min/'gro ba la dga' shos de min pas/ lo star gyis dbus gtsang bskor nus pa cig kyang min/ de stabs nas —rang re la nye zhing sha tsha bar rlom pa 'ga' res kyang / rje grol mchog de gcig tu yun ring mi bzhugs par thams cad du skor zhing gshegs pa yin/ khyed rang yang de bzhin rang byed dgos/ yon bdag so so'i dus dbang sogs la lo gcig ma sleb/ lo gnyis kyang ma sleb na rim pas 'gyur 'gro ba yin zer ba dang / khyad par 'di skabs kyi lo snga ma rnams la'ang / de 'dra'i rigs kyi gros 'debs byed pa mang du byung na 'ang / 'gyur 'gro ba'i rigs kyi slob ma dang yon bdag de/ re zhig ngo gang zin byas kyang phugs rtag thub pa cig mi yong / 'gyur mkhan tsho rang 'gyur/ mi 'gyur mkhan tsho rang ma 'gyur snyam zhe med byas nas bzhag pa yin/ de khas la la ni ma 'gyur te/ ma 'gyur ba tshong lta'i bar du bde bar yod pa de yin/ re mang zhig 'gyur song ste/ nged kyi las stabs la ni ma gnod pa'i steng du gong 'phel la song / 'gyur ba cig la de tsholas 'gyur go bcad pa ma byung / khong rang —330—

rnams so sor khungs stongs pa'i dus su khur yang ba'i khe byung / lar nas dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob ma ni shin tu dkon/ 'jig rten 'phral dpe tsam gyi dpon slob dang / 'jig rten 'phral dpe tsam gyi yon mchod la skyag brtad cing yod/ phaṭa/ de nas bsam sdings su phyin/ theg shas bsdad gtsang nas zhabs drung nyang sdod 'khor nas pa snam du phebs/ byang phyogs la dmag 'degs pa'i dpung gra sgrig pa'i skabs su 'dug dmag bshol ba'i zhu ba nan bcags bstud mar phul na'ang / da res 'di nyid byang lho brag dbus pa sogs khog 'grig pa'i nged tsho shul med la gtong rtsis kyi tshur bgegs kho na yin pas/ dmag bshol mi thub gsung yig rigs tsho ston pa mdzad pa'i rbad gcod kho na byung ba nas/ dmag bshe/la ni ma thub/ rim pa zhu ba gang legs byed pa'i lugs su byas de nas 'dol byung du zhag shas cig bsdad/ dbus la 'gro ba'i khungs kyi chas kha rnams der bzhag nas slar yang yongs yar lam rin chen gling du theg gcig bsdad/ bar skabs lo 'ga' shas cig sde pa snar thang nas yig 'grul sogs kyang bcad/ 'brel thams cad spangs kyang / nged la gnod rgyu ni cang ma byung / 'di skabs sngar phar lam tshong 'dus su sleb skabs kyang ja 'dren dang / 'di ras kyang de'i sang nyin lam/ du thab 'dzin sogs gtong ba mdzad/ byang zhabs drung du snga sor bsam sdings nas snyan 'bul gyi zhu yig zhig kyang phul ba yin na'ang / thugs yid ma ches pa'i dgongs pa log pa zhig shar 'dug skabs 'dir tshor yang / 'jad shar phyogs pa sogs byang rang gi sbyan lam du rgyug pa'i dpon rigs ci rigs pas —331—

kyang / kha 'don dang lag len gyi spyod pa sna tshogs zhig byed du byung na'ang / de 'dra la ma ltas par yang yongs jo nang du sleb mtshams khams ma bde bar zhag shas lus/ lhun grub spe'u pa kun dga' bskul ma car sdod byas shing / g.yin yang nyin re bzhin lha rtse nas byang zhabs drung gi phyag rtags bang chen sogs la/bka' bkod 'phyar rgyag sna tshogs dang bcas pa'i nges nges rang med pa sha stag byung / khams mi bde bzhin du dings su phyin/ der yang khams shin tu mi bde bas zhag 'ga' shas 'gor zhing / 'di dang bde chen du rgyal rtse nas bdag po mthu stobs pa'i drung sogs kyi dkar yang byas chog pa'i zhu ngo dgos tshul byung ba ltar gtsang sar nan bcags zhus kyang don 'grub pa zhig ni ma byung / lar rang dus rgyun du mthong ye med pa la dgos gal 'di 'dra re byung dus khyod shes zer shor bar gda' 'o/ /sngar ni nged dang dge slong srad pa gnyis la phyi mthong 'dra 'dra yin/ sding mthong khong la che lags/ khong gis phan 'dogs gang byung ba de ngas kyang yod ba lags/ de rjes gtsang zhabs drung gi dgongs pa yang yang zhus/ cung zad tsam dgongs bzhes yod pa'i skabs/ nged kyis bde chen du sleb par byas/ snga sor nas ngam ring mkhan chen sogs mkhan slob spyi chos khrims gtso bor gyur pa mang dag gis/ dmag rnams sha ba lung nag tu sleb pa tsam nas gzung / skor g.yang 'dra byed tshul dang / khyad par byang pa rang gi phyag gi rten mchod snang che ba thams cad gtsang sa'i phyag tu song ni grub/gser mang po bskyal yang ni zer/ bka' gsal ni tshig gcig kyang ma byung 'dug gal te byang par phan thogs cig byung na/ ngo so gzhan su la yang ma —332—

shor ba'i khong rang tshos byed bsams pa yang 'dug byang zhabs drung rang nas kyang phar phyogs su de skabs dngos po 'bul sprod snga phyir gang dgos ci yin thams cad ngam ring chos sde pa kho na brgyud nas mdzad pa sogs/ byang pa rang la phan thogs sus byung kyang / ngo so de ngam ring chos sde pa sogs ngam ring rang gi gzhi sdod rtsa ba'i g.yog po'i rigs cig la yod pa byed dgongs pa dang /phyag g.yog phal cher yang de kho na snying la bzhag pa der 'dug ngam ring mkhan slob sogs de dag ni byang pa la phan thogs byung na/ ngo so gang thub dang yus chen pos/ byang pa'i sa na gzhan su yang med pa'i chos srid gnyis ka kho rang tshos 'dzin/ gal te byang pa la phan thogs ma byung na byang pa'i nor phar sprad nas/ khong rang tsho pha rol gyi dpon rigs kha drag can re la sngon ma nas sgos dpon btsal nas 'ju thub pa byas pa'i phyis khas drag pa re byed snyam pa'i zar zir g.yo sgyu de ka ma gtogs mi 'dug na'ang / de mi dgongs pa dbu sbos 'dug ngas nas snga ma nas de ltar go zhib shes kyang / byang rang du phan thogs gang drag zhi e yong bsam/ reng re'i mdzod pa kun dga' dpal bzang gis yang yang skor g.yang zhus zhing / sgo du ma nas nan bcags phul bas/ thog ma'i sa 'jags rags rim la yang phan thogs cher byung zhing / khyad par phra ma btang grub pa'i rjes su yang / zhu nan gang che zhus pas mus lung nang dang /bung chu snyen ra sogs nged kyi ngo chen kho na la rten nas 'phar cha byung / byung zhabs drung rang nas snga sor lha dbang rtse nas nged 'gro dus/ stod smad kyi sde dpon gzhan so so ji ltar yin rung / byang nas gtsang sar log par 'gro ba —333—

sngar yang ma byas shing phyis kyang mi byed pas/ thugs yid ches shing blo brtan pas chog tshul dang / khyed kyis kyang de'i khag theg pas yod tshul zhu dgos gsungs pa'i nan bcags yod pa ltar/ bsam rtser phyin dus snyan du yang phul mod/ 'di skabs nyang byang lho dbus sogs sbrel pa'i yig tshang dang / byang rang gi phyag rtags dang yig ris mngon tshan can thams cad gtsang ba'i phyag tu thebs pa'i nged kyi mig lam du yang 'byor pa dang / byang zhabs drung rang la'ang slar ston pa gnang dus/ spyir zhu thes kyang med pa'i byed dka' ba dang / sgos su snga sor lha dbang rtse'i gsung dgos des nged kyang bslus shing khyi zan du bskyur bar song 'dug 'di skabs rang yang zhabs drung rang chos tshul mdzad/lo gsum gyi bar la rdzong gzhis 'gangs che ba rnams nyis 'dzin du byas/ sa cha rnams rang mos pa la sbyar chog pa zhus/ de rjes thugs dam la sgril ba yin/de'i ngo chen byed dgos gsung ba sogs phebs byung ba'ang zhib tu zhus ni zhus/rgya zhing de tsam la thug nas byis pa'i gsung des mgo skor thongs ris min pa 'dug cing / de rjes lha rtse nas phar phebs dus kyang / nged kyi mi ma sleb pa la mkhan chen khyi gu ba dang / ngor pa mkhan drung sogs su yang yong ma nus/dpon g.yog tsho rang shin tu skrag pas phebs mi nus pa'i gang drag ci drag tu 'dug pa la/ dgon bsam bar du kun dga' dpal bzang gis phebs skyel zhus/ dmag mi sna tshogs kha gtong 'dod nas ltad mo blta bar byung ba rnams kyang bsrungs/ snying thag pa nas zhabs tog tu gang 'gro byas/ bya ba'i 'gros dang gzhis la dpags pa'i phan thogs kyang dga' tshad rang byung ba lags/—334—

phar 'byon dus rngod pa'i rtogs ldan pas chibs sna byed pa sogs ya cha la bkra mi shis pa de 'dra'ang gda'/ 'di skabs lhun grub spe'u ba la'ang sa 'jags sogs ye mi yong ba'i bka' bkyon gyi sgo 'dug kyang nan cher zhus pas sa cha phal cher skyon med du 'jags/ drang srong ba la srog la 'bab pa'i khrims gcod kyi bka' bkyon 'dug kyang / srog la skyon med par ma zad/nor rnams ci bder thon cing / gter rgyus 'bras gshongs lto skal du byung ba dang / ya byang ba drung chen grags pa la yang / snga sor nas 'bul sprod 'bul dgos rnams 'gro mtshams ltas pa'i lo shas ma phul ba dang / dmag gi dus kyang sgrogs gcog gi gdams ngag byas pa sogs/ srog la bab pa'i bka' bkyon yod kyang / srog dang nor la skyon med cing / mchod gzhis brten nas rngo ma lung tsam 'jags pa dang / gdong dga' nas snga song nas gnyis ka mi 'gal ba yin yang / rjes la byang tshor mkhas nyams ngo so rnam grangs mang po de gtsang sar 'phog thug ches pa dang rgod pa skyon du song ba cig byung na'ang nan bcags zhus pas/ da lta'i sa cha 'di rnams rting la gnang ba yin/ gzhan yang dpon rigs mang po la bka' bkyon yod pa rnams la'ang ci rigs ci rigs su phan pa mang du byung / de bzhin du rgyan gnyer pa rnams gong du smos pa ltar/ brag stod la mig gi rwa las ma bde ba de yin kyang / de skabs myos kha thams cad brag stod du skyed dgos pa byung / gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa de ka la zer/ gzhan yang skabs 'dir/ gtsang gzhung chu lho byang mdog smad phal cher la/ nged kyi yul bsrung re btang bas/ dmag gis gnod pa ye ma byung /—335—

phyi nor nang nor khang zhing gang la yang ma skyon/ bdag po 'pho 'byug byung yang gnas khang skyon med du bsdad chog pa'ang nged kyi drin yin/ g.yin shag tshal yan chad dang / 'phyos ma yan chad la nged kyis bsrung mi btang ba rnams ma gtogs ji ltar gyur pa ni kun la gsal/ de skabs nged kyi dgon chos gzhis kun tu/ gzhan thams cad kyi nor skyed sa byas pas/ rgyal khams phal cher la nor gong ma byung ba yin/ nged kyi dgon gzhis 'di dag med pa'am yul bsrung ma btang ba zhig yin na/ gtsang mdog gi gzhung 'di dag kyang stong gog tsam lus pa'i lung stong zhig 'ong ba yod/ phan ni shin tu che ste drin shes pa ni phal cher la mi gda'/ mdo bshad pa dang / dril sna pa dang / khams rings pa la sogs pas 'brel ni che ste/ dang por sor gnas kyi dus na chos lung jo nang gnyis la/ dbang che'i ras gcod dang / bla ma dang chos lugs kyi sgo nas kyang / gzhan rnams khungs ma dang sangs rgyas mngon sum pa/ zhabs tog kyang ri ltar sbungs/ 'di phyogs la bka' bkyon dang khyad gsod kho na byed/'brel pa chu thigs gcig kyang byung gi dogs byed mkhan mang po zhig par skabs der 'di phyogs su 'jigs skyob byed dgos byung zhing yang yul log gi skabs dgra'i dang mal sleb byung kyang / de ma thag kham tshul 'di bzhin song dus/ yang nged la yus chen po yod pa ltar/ re chen pos sleb byung ba na gnod lan ma byas par/ phan cung zad btags pa 'di bzhin yin pas/ chos pa'i tha ma rang zhig byed bsam pa med/ bden mi bden ji ltar yin so so nas bsam mno thong / rgyal khams la dris pas gsal/ gtsang nas sde srid —336—

kyang bde chen la nyin 'khor zhig dngos la 'phrad par phebs shing / nged kyis ri khrod chen por slar 'khor zhag shas song ba na/ sde srid dpon g.yog chibs rags rnams mar lam ri khrod chen po mjal ba'i dgongs pas phebs/ rnyed bkur zhabs tog bzang la rgya che ba yang mdzad/ zhag gsum bzhugs/ 'di dag gi snga phyir dgon mchod gzhis kyi rigs sbyor 'jags gnang ba/ bkra shis gling / rdzong mdun/ khram mda'/ khram phu/ chon brag sna mthil/ bo dong nas bkra shis sgang shar ba sogs them pa 'ga' shas dang / mdog nas 'dam bu bkra shis sgang rnams dang / la stod pha drug tu bkra shis 'dzom sogs mchod gzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang zhing / nags phug 'di sngar sa 'brel la brten nas sel cung zad yod pas ming bsgyur na phugs kyi rten 'brel legs par shes nas ming bkra shis gling du bsgyur ba yin/ de dag so so na yod pa'i dgon gnas ci rigs pa dang / ma ce de dgon gnas/ dgye bsu/ spru mche bsu/ gling sngon/ g.yag po/ bkra shis dge 'phel/ bkra shis rtse sogs dang bcas pa yang sbyor 'jags dang / de rjes mi ring bar mdog lho dgon gnas dang bcas pa'ang byung / dgon bsam 'bras sbungs 'di lha rtse'i dmag gi skabs 'jigs skyob tu byang zhabs drung rang gis kyang bslab ston mdzad cing /chos brgyud kyang gcig pa'i dbang du byas/ nged kyi mi skyong gi khongs byas pas/dgon gnas tham sa cad la dmag gi 'jigs pa sogs ma byung / de mthun sde srid kyis kyang nged la sbyor 'jags gnang / mus mda' dril sna cha lag dang bcas pa dang / lho pha drug gi mkhar lung gnyis thog mar kun dga' dpal —337—

bzang la gnang ba yin kyang / dge rgyun mchod thes su phul bas de mthun mchod gzhis nyid la sbyor 'jags gnang ba yin/ nang pa bod mkhar pa'i brgyud pa nang so rgya tsho ba rgyal chen gyis mdog gi gces dang / 'jad srug mo gnyis dge rgyun mchos thes su phul ba la yang / de rgyun la gnas pa'i 'jags gnas gnang / 'jad kyi dgon pa dbu pa chu chos rdzong / spo mthon sngags pa chos rje tshe ring bas nged la phul ba'ang sbyor 'jags rgyab gnod zhus shing gnang ba sogs/ mdor na mchod gzhis mchod thes nged tsho rang la bltos pa'i rgya che ba dge rgyun du sbyor ba mdzad/ de 'phral nyid dbus phyogs su dmag langs pa'i dpung wo dbus phyogs su 'gyogs pa mdzad song / de lo dgun 'khrid ni dus skabs yol bas bshe/la/ byang zhabs drung la bsnyel ja zhu bar bstan 'dzin sogs btang / khag drug ma gnyis dang / spob rtse bzhi/ kha thi yug sogs 'bul tshan bzang ba rang phul mod/ 'phral gyi ltar dgyes dgyes tsam yang med pa'i thugs khros se ba yod 'dug ngam ring chos sde la mang ja re snga sor nas kyang gtong gin yod pas de mthun zhur btang yang / mkhan chen pas gtso mdzad las 'dzin phal cher zhig mang ja mi 'thung ba yin zer lkog shub dir dir byed kyin yod 'dug pas/ de phyin chad nas ngam ring la mang ja ma btang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun mngon sum du gyur pa cig ni deng sang gang byas mi rnyed/ rtags cha lugs tsam gyi dge 'dun ni gang du'ang rnyed par gda' 'o snyam mo/ /nged kyis 'dir sgrub sde grwa pa dang bcas pa la blo sbyong zhib pa cig byas/ dgun mtshams dam zhing thugs dam 'phel bar byung / bar skabs der —338—

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'byer bde ba 'di brtsams pa yin/ de nas 'phral du dbus phyogs su 'gro bar 'dod kyang / nye skor 'di kun na zi re ba zhig 'dug pa dang / rang re la sde srid kyis mchod gzhis gnang ba la/ don med phrag dog langs pa'i mig ma shong byed mkhan sna tshogs zhig 'dug pas/ re zhig 'di skor rang du bsdad/ dge sbyor 'phel bar byung zhing /gtor ma 'ga' re yang btang / rmi lam gyi ltas ngo mtshar che ba shas cig kyang byung / skabs cig khrol le ma nas lo chen sprul sku'i dbon po mkhas btsun pa nyug tsam phrad par byung dus khong gi rngam 'dre chen pos ja dang zho chang thams cad nyes/ bgegs skrod cig btang bas de 'phral khugs byung / skabs der phyag 'tshal la mo nas rdzong mdo'i bar gyi ri 'di dag gang rung cig la sdod gnas bya'am snyam pa'i blo yang yang skye ba zhig byung ste/ phyis dgon gnas 'di 'dings pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin rgyab ri jo 'bor skyong gi rtser gtor ma rgya che ba zhig gtong ba la phyin dus/ yar lam ri'i rtse 'og nas phar shin tu ngal zhing thang chad pa dang / rkang pa g.yas la rdo zur gyis gnod pa'i rma chen po byung ba sogs lhongs che se ba cig gi ngang nas gtor bsngo phyed tsam song ba na/ rtsub 'gyur dang khams nyog pa sangs rig pa dwangs shing dmigs pa gsal la zil che ba/ dam can chos skyong srungs ma rnams dngos su phang phung du 'dus pa'i nyams snang dang / khyod kyi 'dod don 'phrin las bdag gis bsgrub par bya'o/ /ze ba'i rnam pa byung zhing / 'jug tu bar chad zhi ba'i phyir phyogs mtshams brgyad la zor re 'phangs pas/ 'ur sgra dang /—339—

thug chom chen po dang / sde brgyad rnams rlung nag 'tshubs pa bzhin du phyogs bcur 'gro ba'i rnam pa byung / 'di skabs rtse chen chos sde'i chos bdag dge bsnyen bzang ra ba de/ lus g.yas bskul nas 'dir sleb byung pas/ spyir dpal jo nang pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs/ khong rang gi 'dod don la/rtse chen gyi mkhan po la yongs dgos tshul du 'jug cing / gnas skabs su 'phrin las sgrub pa la gtor ma gsher ba'i tshul yang byed/ de skabs yar klungs kyi dus 'khrug la phyogs gtam sna tshogs smra ba zhig yod pa/ lus g.yar de mi rnams zer ba'i gtam sna tshogs de kha lab par 'dug bzang ra rang khog tu zhugs nas dmag gi gtam smra ba de/ de dang mi mthun par zhib rgyas mang po zer ba 'dug pa/ rting la de ka bden cig thigs par byung / de nas chad mdo mang po zhig byas nas log song / 'di skabs snga phyir rang re'i grwa pa gsar pa rnams la 'jig rten bstan bzhag dang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi mdo dang / gzungs dbang gi rgyal po'i mdo phyir tsam bshad pa yin te/ lo gzhon pa dang rjes la slob dpon dge rgan gyis nan bcags byed mkhan grul thub pa med pas rjes ye ma byung / de skabs yar 'brog nas dbon sa chu shul ma gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gra dbu la 'bod mir sde pa kha ba lung nas 'byor/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin mo bkra shis gling du phyin/ khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ 'ubrug sgra cher bsgrags pa sogs/ rten 'brel gyi sgo 'ga' shas shar/rtogs ldan bzang rgyan pa dang gleng brjod pa 'dra byas dus/ chos rje shongs chen pa dang / dpon po mkhas btsun pa dang / khams rings chos mdzad sogs la —340—

khong gis bo dong btsan thabs yun ring du bslab tshul sogs khong ra'i slob ma rnams ngoms par 'dug lar sems chung dga' mod 'dug ste/ bla chung phal cher la yod pa'i chos brgyad sad su de khong la'ang gda'o/ /snga sor lha rtse'i dmag grol ba nas 'di'i bar du phrag dog can gyi bla ma slob dpon sngags pa bon po dgon sde rigs mang po zhig nas/ nged la bsam sbyor ngan pa'i mthu btad ngan byed rbod gtong sna tshogs byas pa'i ltas mang po rang zhig rmi lam du shar byung na'ang / rnam rtog za ba'i snyems khrigs ye ma byung / ri rtser gtor ma chen po btang ba des/ de dag thams cad phar log pa'i ltas gsal po zhig tshes bco lnga'i dgongs mo de byung ste/ bdag rang khro bo'i sku gcig tu gyur nas/ri nag po gcig bshig cing bsgyel ba dang / yang ngas mi nag po nyi shu rtsa 'dren zhig gi ske bcad de mgo rnams zos/ 'phro rnams g.yang sa la bskyur ba dang /ri brag shin tu mtho ba dog mo gcig tu/ rlung nag 'tshub ma mi bzad pa'i gseb nas/ 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs kyis sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab 'dug thams cad bdag la rgol du byung ba la rang shar bden med sgyu ma lta bu shes nas/ de ka la bzhag pas nged rnams ma 'dzin par gtong rogs kyis zer de thams cad tsab tsob tu 'jug pa la/ phaṭa cig rgyab/ dbyings rig bsres nas bskyur btang bas/ nged rgyal po yin pa la/ nged btsan/ nged gza'/ nged klu yin pa la 'di 'dra byed pa a zer zhing tshom sding gi nam mkha' mtha' med pa cig la yas nas song / sems stong gsal g.yo ba med pa yun ring pa cig tu gnas byung / de mtshams cig nam mkha' nas snying rje sgoms —341—

snying rje sgoms zer ba'i sgra cig byung / spyir nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog rnams stong nyid rkyang pas lam du khyer na/ re zhig lam du longs yod kyang / ro ma gcig ldang nyen yod/ phugs mtha' gtsang yong ba la snying rjes zin pa dgos zer ba'i chos skad la brten nas/ lung bstan rdzus ma byed pa yin par ngo shes byung /mnyam gzhag de kha'i ngang nas 'di skad du/ snying rje'i rgyus dang nga che ste/ mdzo bdag gi klogs su mdzo rab ang / /sems can gdod nas med pa la/ snying rje'o snyam na snyam mkhan 'khrul/ bya ba'i tshig de gsal por lhang gis shar zhing / slar gang du yang bzhags med pa'i mnyam bzhag de ga la/ la bzlas pas/ ja sbyor gnyis gsum tsam song ba na/ rig pa 'jam zhing bde ba mdangs byams snying rje ched bstad bsgoms pa ma yin par rang shugs su shar ba cig byung / sngar gyi 'jigs pa can de rnams gzugs mdzes pa'i rnam pa can du byas nas sgum sgum phyag 'tshal zhing bshags pa 'bul rjes su bzung du gsol zer ba'i rnam pa 'dug pa la yang / dga' tshor dang mtshan 'dzin dang /sred pa dang / rlom sems sogs gang yang ma byung ste/ tshig 'di skad ces thol te smras so/ /'di thams cad nga rang gi rig pa'i rtsal/ /phyi snang srid lha 'dre ga la srid/ /khyod lha 'dre yul nas med pa la/ /rbod gtong dang gnod byed ga la yod/ /nang rig pa yod du skad byas kyang / /byar med kyi ngang la rig pa stor/ /sngar nga rang gi rig pa zer ba byas/ /nga rang nyid med pa la rig pa ci//lus snang ba 'di mi bden rdzun pa'i ngang / /sems rig pa ming stong sgra skad tsam/ khyed gnod pa byed na su la byed/ khyi blun po bya grib kyi rjes la rgyug /—342—

snang srid kyi lha 'dre khyed rnams dang / /mi bdag ces ming skam tha dad kyang / /don rig pa gcig las gnyis su med/ /gnod bya gnod byed kyi rtsa ba bud//khyed bshags pa 'bul na su la 'bul/ /lar bzod gsol len na su yisalen/ /nyes pa ni rmi lam gyi bu dang 'dra/ /'gyod tshangs ni nam mkha'i me tog yal/ /thugs rjes 'dzin bya dang 'dzin byed su/ /mtha' med kyi nam mkha' stong seng la/ /'dzin 'dod kyi spar nom byed pa 'khrul/ /'ja' tshon la rta rgyugs byed mkhan gang / /zhes pa la sogs pa nyams 'ur ba'i tshig mang du yod de/ de tsam ma gtogs da dgos brjed 'dug de nas de rnams khrag gi mchi ma nar nar phyung nas smon lam re btab/ lus sa la bor ba bzhin byas te yal song / de ltar byung ba 'di yang dngos rang ni ci yin rmi lam rang yang ma lags/ gnyid la ni ma song / gsal snang ni nyin mo las kyang che/ nyams sam de ka yin de 'ong / yang skabs 'dir smras pa/ nges don gyi gnad 'gag go ba 'dis chog /mdo rgyud kyi dgongs don thal mar brdal/ /sangs rgyas su sgrog pa la re ma dgos/ khong kha sgrigs mkhan kun yi re mug /lhan skyes kyi blo gros khong nas shar/ /'gal 'brel gyi rig pa zad pa med/ /thal 'phreng la slobaganyer ma dgos tsam/ /pir skyog gi po ti kun rlud la bskur/ /rig pa rang grol 'di gdengs re thub/ /sde brgyad 'byung po kun bka' bzhin nyan/ tag dmar gyi bsnyen pa la mi re tsam/ /raka zha dang thod 'phreng kun srang khar 'thor/ /phung po zan bsgyur 'dis go re chod/ /mthu bto dang 'dre kha la zhal skyengs byung / /yang bzlog la mur nyid mi dgos tsam/ /phur thogs kun gang —343—
