dga' ci dga' gyis/ /stong nyid la 'dun pa sgyur bas chog /sdang dgra la phyi rtags nang mar 'ong / /mdze thod la nor rnying 'chol mi dgos/ /rdzas 'khor lo kun rtsig phugs su rul rus 'dra/ /zhon med kyi snying rje 'di go chod po/dgos nges kyi lha mi kun dbang du 'dus/ /pho rtags la phyag mchod mi dgos tsam/ /dbang sdud kyi sho ril kun chu la shor/ /rtsol med kyi bum can 'di go chod po/ /bde drod kyi ngang la srog thur 'dres/ /rgod rkang dang lcags sbubasal mi re tsam/ khong sha sred 'bu sred kun 'o re brgyal/ /gang shar gyi lha sku go chod po/ /'dod don kun gegs med lhun gyis 'grub/ /rnga brdung la mi tshe skyel ma dgos/ khong re dogs can kun dang 'dra re kan/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas zla ba de kha'i tshes bco brgyad dang bcu dgu la/ dmag brda 'go ma rnams rgyab/ g.yas ru byad pa'i yul langs su grags pa/ dpon g.yog thams cad phung ba/ sku chags kyi zhig cha chen mo de mdzad/ mdo bshad pa dang drang srong pas nged kyi mchod gzhis gsar rnying thams cad la yang yul log gi dmag bskul la/ byang zhabs drung rang gi phyag rtags khyer nas sleb/ de skabs nged yar 'brog la 'brel du 'gro'i chas kha brdeg 'bru tshun chad grub pa yin na yang /zin bun tshes pa'i stabs/ dgag dgos du ma 'dug pa nas/ de res 'gro ma thub/ skabs der 'bras sbungs pa dang bde mchog rtse ba rnams snga sor rang re la 'jigs skyob kyi blo gtad byas pa yin kyang / bar der yul log gi gra la cung zad theb pa'i sdod lugs ma mkhas pa la brten/ byed lugs dang bstun pa'i yong lugs kyi rnam pas gzan so ci rigs pa byung / mtshed pa'i phyag —3slo—

g.yog rnams sa yul 'og gi skabs mi 'tsham pa du ma byas yod kyang / re zhig sgros med du ba theg go /yul log gi zer bun che ba rang gi skabs der yang nged la ni do gal tsam ma byung ste/ mtsham mo ba'i khog nas dpa' 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg khri phrag lnga pa zhig dang rdo rje phag mo la yang de tsam zhig phul/ nyin gcig nag po chen po la yang stong phrag bzhi phul/de dag gi ring la nyin mo kun dga' dpal bzang gis 'go byas/ gzhi sdod rnams kyis shar gyi shol ra chen mo'i shing 'debs rnams byed kyin bsdad/rten 'brel legs pa zhig yin 'dug de dus btang pa'i shing la ma skyes pa cig kyang ma byung / phyogs nas yongs pa'i mi rnams na re/ gtsang mdog gnyis ka na yul langs dang / dmag gi shom lugs dang / da lta rang khyed kyi gnas dgon chos gzhi sa thams cad hab zas la gtong ba tsam gyis rngam 'jigs 'di 'dra la/ 'di ru sleb dus 'di 'dra'i sos dal ba rang ga 'dra yin nam zer mkhan rkyang ba byung / de dus rgya gan nas kyis 'go byas pa'i nyang gtsang gi pho yan sogs kyi dmag rnams ni lam la dal 'gros rang dang bo dong rang du yang zhag bzhi lnga bsdad/ 'di phyogs su yul langs mus mdog gi dmag rnams gzhi med du 'thor grub pa'i rjes la/ nyi ma gnyis gsum nas skad cha nges can tshor ba'i nom pa la rngams nas rgyugs/ de'i sngon la bo dong yan chad la ci yang yong ma nus/ gzhug tu yul 'joms dang ngam ring gi nor sogs nom pa la rngams rgyugs byas pa la dpa' rtags len pa de yang ya cha bar gda'/ gang ltar yul langs gtsang mdog gnyis car la dmag shin tu —345—

mang ba de rgyu mtshan med pa la byer pa de yang bsrung ma rnams kyi bka' chad yin par the tshom med do/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bya ba rbad bskul byas pa rkyang pas 'gro ba rang cig min/ dam tshig ma nyams shing chos bsgom pa la bu bzhin skyong ba cig yin lags/ de nas mi ring bar bde 'jam du song ba dang / rang yul nas a khu lags kyang sku na sna di smin grags pa'i 'gres nad kyis/ zhal ma bzhugs zer 'bod mkhan byung bas rkyen byas te 'phral du bteg grwa pa gang yod rnams khrid nas mtshed kyi mda'i gang rdzong chung chung der/ nged dbus nas 'khor gyi bar grwa pa rnams sdod sa byed pa byas/ nged kyis kyang zhag gnyis bsdad/ rim pas chas 'ongs pas/ dbu rgyan rdzong gi gru khrus po de la zhugs yongs dus/ ga nas byung cha med pa la bud med nag rus le ba 'jigs pa zhig gru nang du zhugs nas mnyam por byung / chu'i dkyil rang du sleb tsam la/ rlung nag lung med zhig langs gru thams cad chus khengs/ sdib la khad pa la/ snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam dang lta bur rang shar te/ snyems khrigs rbad kyis chod pa na/'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku'i rnam pa zhig wal gyis shar/ de kha'i ngang la 'gram du sleb/ rlung yang zhi/ bud med de yang gar song ma byung / mdol byung du sleb dus gtsang sde srid kyang / dbus phyogs kyi byus legs shing yar lam rgyal rtser phebs pa dang 'dzom ste/ 'bod mkhan gnang byung ba ltar rgyal rtser phyin/ rtse chen rgyab kyi dga' thog na kha nas gzung chibs rags mang po dang / ya tshad nas chos sde'i ser bsgreng grangs mang zhing phyag khyer rol mo sogs bzab rgyas dpe med rang gi bkod shoms mdzad 'dug dgongs bzhed ltar gyi rkyen sel —346—

dbang chos ci rigs pa phul/ ngam ring nas byang zhabs drung rang phebs dgos byung ba'i skabs/ mnan gtad 'gom 'jog sogs kyi 'khor lo mang po bris pa rnams shul du lus pa'i rjes ngan bstan/ 'khor lo mang po zhig de skabs khyer 'dug pa/ nged kyi bkru sbyangs byas/ dge tsha chen mo'i gos sku 'grims pa'i nyin chos sde'i sku 'bum chen mor phyin/ chos sder mang ja sbrel ma dang / rta bzang ba gcig gis gtsos pa'i 'gyed dang / bsngo rten rnam ga theg thams cad kyang gang bzang rang bsgrubs/ rten mjal rnams zhib par byas/ bla brang du zhabs drung 'phags pa'i drung dang yang mjal skabs der zhag bcu tsam bsdad/khang sar grwa tshang nas kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan gsung 'byon ma spyan drangs de gsol ba btang/ re zhig rtse ru bzhugs na legs pa 'dra snyan du phul kyang / phyis grwa tshang bas nan bcags zhus nas de 'phral spyan drangs 'dugagazhan yang nyin re bzhin 'phel gdung la sku grib sel byed kyi sku khrus phul bas legs pa'i dge mtshan yang byung / snga sor rmi lam la/ rgyal rtse'i li ma lha khang na rten bcu lhag zhig ram me 'dug gzhan gang yang med pa'i stong sang nge ba de 'dra lan gnyis gsum byung ba/ de skabs mngon sum lta bur gyur 'dug de nas 'gro khar lhun grub spe'u nas rnams ngo chen zhu bar sleb/ rang res snyan du phul bas gang 'os cig yong gsung ba byung / 'gro ba dang thug pas rjes 'thud rgyu ma byung / da lta nyin byed gling pas ngo so yong tsam byas pa'i sa cha 'di yin/byang rang gi dpon g.yog thams cad blo rigs 'dra ba cig ka gdog de skabs ri nang sngags 'chang ba yang 'phrad par byon/ khong shes rab sbus gtsang zhing —347—

sgrub pa nus pa/ rnying ma ba'i lugs la nag myong gis ma khyer/ dge slong gi brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i gam gtsang ba zhig 'dug cing / /nged dang snang ba dag pa zhig yin na'ang / las sbyor dang 'dre 'dul 'ga' zhig gnad du ma song bas lan gda'/ skabs 'dir snying rlung la gnod byed kyis bskyod pa'i blo shin tu mi bde ba tshugs pa med pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug nged kyis gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dbang bskur zhig kyang byas/ cung zad bde ba tsam byung ste/phyis mi ring bar 'tsho ma thub par 'dug rting la bsngo rten sogs skyel mkhan 'brang phur sleb byung ste/ smon lam dang sgrib sbyong gi dmigs btad yang yang byas/ drag sngags 'jig rten pa rnams mang pa'i skyon yin nam/ shin tu rtsub pa'i rnam 'gyur cig gi ngang nas/ 'jug tu lam bde ba'i ltas tsam ni byung ngo / /de skabs mus gling ga sogs mus stod kyi dgon pa rnams dang / dbus kyi gra thang dang / byams pa gling gi 'dzin skyong byed dgos phebs kyin 'dug na'ang / mi phal cher gyi mig lam du mi bde zhing rdzong dpon gyi rigs shin tu rang ma dga' ba cig yong ba dang / nges don kyi bstan pa la phan pa ni mi yong ba 'dug pas/ de dus rang yang dgongs grol zhus/ phyis yi ge 'ga' re phul bas ston ser kha cig khrol byung / de skabs nged rgyal rtse nas g.yung gi la brgyud nas phyin pas/ g.yung dar rgyas pa rnams kyis 'bod mi nan bcags byung nas/ lam zhor la khor tsam phyin/ mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs bsgrubs/yar sris su yar 'brog nas thab 'dzin byung / mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs sgrubs/ de nas myur bar shad 'brang phur sleb/ cho ga sogs btsugs shing /—348—

dgon so sor mang ja 'gyed bcas/ mkha' rag tsho bzhi la thang ston sogs sku rjes bzang thag chod btang / de rjes bal po rgya mtsho sprin sogs bzo bo mkhas pa gsum gyis dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs rgya mtho gang pa re gar lugs su bzhengs pa dang / rang byung gi zangs la bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po'i sku lugs ma mtho gang ba cig rnams nang rten gyi tshul du bzhengs pa/de rnams bzo sgros shin tu gtsang ba rgya gar ba la 'gran bzod par byung / lung pa'i phu na yod pa'i sman chu de yang zhag shas bsten/ skabs cig gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud kyi man ngag la brten te/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa zhig byas pa yang / dri bzang pos lung nang thams cad chod pa dang / sgra chen po dang bcas pa byung / 'di skabs kyang bdud rtsi mang du babs/ 'grub legs shing ya mtshan che bar byung / mi ngo rnams la'ang tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs dang / dbang rjes gnang 'ga' re byas/ mes po rin po che de nyid kyi sku gdung yang dus de thub bzhugs pa dang / a khu lags kyi gdung de yang ring du bzhugs pa la dgos pa mi 'dug pas/ ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ /'od bzhu zhi cho ga zhib 'them dang bcas pa legs par bsgrubs/'di skabs zhig bsam 'grub rtse'i sku khrus rab 'byams pa dkon mchog dpal bzang 'das pa'i bsngo rten rnams 'byor/ khong 'dris che zhing nged la snang ba dag pa zhig yin pas rgyang tsam zhig smon lam mang du btab/ thebs pa'i rtags mtshan bzang tsam cig kyang byung / phyogs kyi chos zhu ba 'dra yang sleb/rang re'i zla la yod pa'i nang zan rnams bde mchog gi cho ga de gtong gin yod —349—

pas/ /zhor la yang 'gro ba 'dug pa tshun 'khor lo bde mchog spyod 'chang dbang po'i lugs kyi gdams pa/ lam slong gi 'khrid snyan rgyud yongs rdzogs dang / gzhung drug gi bshad pa sogs chos skor cha tshang zhig bshad/ 'bras sbungs pa rgya le chos mdzad 'das pa'i bsngo rten bzang rab cig skyel mkhan byung ba dang / 'tshur phu nas drung pa rin po che gu shi grags pa don grub kyi thugs dam gsal 'debs mtshon byed tsam skyel mkhan yang byung / pha tre bo sku skye rin po che'i sprul sku da lta'i 'di dang po rang gang du phebs brtag pa dang sku skye phebs pa'i gsol 'debs dang / skabs 'dir yang yar 'brog nas spyan 'dren gyi brtag pa byed dgos pa'i nan bcags rang mchod dpon pas byed du byung bar ci rigs pa byas pa'ang lags/ de ltar 'brang du zla ba gsum la sna bstad pa zhig bsdad zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu skor la/ lha rgyal gling du sleb tsam dang /sde pa lha 'od pas shog gsung ba ltar g.yul rgyal rdzong du phyin/ tshe dbang dang /rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi rjes gnang sogs dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ lha mdongs kyi klu sdings der/ sde pa kun bzang pa sku mched sogs/ lha mdongs pa'i zhal ngo rnams dang phrad cing / 'o brgyal bar 'dug bsam ste/ brdab lan gang bzab rang phul/ yol rin chen gling du phyin/ mkhan chen blo gros rgyal mtshan pas gzhi len tshogs 'khor sogs bzab rgyas rang byung zhing / shangs chos kyi rigs byin rlabs mgon bka' sngar khong gis ma gsan pa mang dag cig bgyis/ der zhag gsum bsdad pa'i nyin gcig ri gong mjal ba la nyin 'khor byas/ mchod pa snyan dar tshogs 'khor sogs sngar gyi rgyun bzhin mtha' —350—

rgyas su bsgrubs/ sde pa dpal rgyas drung yang 'phrad du byung / chu shul rtser gro mo che pas yod dgos tshul nan bcags dpe med yin tshul byed kyin 'dug na'ang /kho bas grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin yin gyu'i khungs kyis snga sor nas rin po gcig kyang ma byung / rdzong la ni ma phyin/ gzhom du gzhi len cig ni byung /mtshar pa snang bdag mo rje btsun drung gis shog gsung phyin/ dpon g.yog kha cig gi steng du/ shel grong dge slong sogs ri bde ba kha cig bsnan pa'i 'ga' shas la/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang dang / dgon pa ba rnams la chos 'brel cig dang / lha khang gi logs bris pa rab gnas rnams byas/ gzhi len sogs bzab rgyas rang mdzad na'ang / rten 'brel gyi sgo rnams tha mar rang zhig byung / ri bde sngar 'dzugs dus shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi lugs/ 'dzugs pa'i khungs mdzad kyang / bar skabs der thugs 'gyur grub nas lo gcig tsam song ba'i skabs de yin/ de nas rim gyis shin du sleb/ zhabs drung rin po che dang mjal zhag shas cig bsdad/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba yang skabs 'dir nged kyi zla la phebs byung / lha sar 'dzugs rgyu'i dar po che rnams brtsems/rkyen sel gyi dbang rjes gnang 'dra phul/ de nas lha sar phyin/ 'di skabs zhug bdun bsdad/ dar po che btsugs pa'i skabs/ nam mkha' dwangs shing me tog gi char babs/ gzhan dar po che 'dzugs pa la mi mang lag mang dgos pa'i dka' las che tsam 'dug kyang / dka' ba ye ma dgos par/ nyi ma snga thog gcig la ka phal cher tshugs/ dar po che thog ma de slong bzhin pa'i ngang la/mi mang po'i co dir gyi dbus/ dar shing yang 'phred gsegs la 'gul bzhin —351—

pa yin yang / dar shing gi rtse mor bya rog snum zhing bkrag dang ldan pa cig chags/ dar de rtsa ba nas lhongs lhongs kyi bar du chags chags pa de la bsdad/de nas skad snyan po zhig 'don gyin lding 'khor byed pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas dang / yang lho phyogs kyi dar po che gzhan gcig la'ang de mtshungs byung /lha sa go gnyis thams cad du phyag mchod smon lam mar me sogs kyang dkyus mthun 'bul rgyu byung zhing / nyin re bzhin lha khang rnams lan gnyis gsum mjal ba sogs byas sems can thams cad la phan pa'i smon lam mang po btab/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan gsung 'byon ma/ sku'i g.yas g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dang tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan te/ byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po de la/ sgos mchod 'bul ba sogs kyi gnad 'dug pas sgo 'byed gcod can gyi gzhugs khang byas shing / mchod rdzas cha tshang ba bshams/smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma 'di yang de dus brtsams pa yin nub cig jo bo'i drung du yun ring smon lam 'debs shing bsdad/ ra mo cher sngon lto dar po che 'dzugs mkhan cher mi 'dug pa la/ dar po che 'dzugs pa'i srol brtod/ jo shag rnam pa gnyis dang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan la mchod pa phul nas smon lam btab pa'i skabs/ nyams snang gi tshul du ngo mtshar gyi gtam cung zad yod de gleng mi dgos par gda'/ snga sor 'brang na yod pa'i dus nas 'di'i bar du/ o rgyan gzhi ka nas bdag mo'i drung gi rtse zhabs drung gdung brgyud de'i dgongs rdzogs la yod dgos tshul gyi bskyar chags yang yang byung zhing / zhabs drung gdung brgyud de nyid la/ skra bcad tsam ma gtogs chos —352—

bka' thams cad nged kho nas phul ba yin pas gal che sa rang yin yang / de phyogs 'gro ba'i 'dun pa bstad res kyis rang gzhan gnyis kar gyi thad du ltas lod cing 'tshub pa kho na shar bas 'gro thes ni ma byung / zhabs drung bdag mo'ang thugs log cing / shun zhabs drung sogs rang re la thugs nye ba'i khungs rnams kyang da res 'gro dgos rgyu rang yin pa la/ zhes gyod rdal mang po gnang gin 'dug ste thabs ma byung / de nas shun du 'ongs te/ dpon g.yog skya ser phyogs kyi chos zhu ba dang bcas pa/ kar dge 'bu gsum sogs grub mtha' sna tshogs 'dus pa zhig la/ snga dro bzhin skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang / nyin gung zhabs drung dpon g.yog nyung bsdus la/ shangs chos kyi skor dang / dbang rjes gnang ci rigs pa'i chos thun gnyis gsum re don gnyer so so dang bcas pa la byas shing / lan cig phug khang slob dpon pa bsod nams grags pa sngar 'dris yod pa ltar/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang sogs 'dod chos 'ga' zhig zhu ba la byon byung ba/ thugs bzhed kyi chos rnams bshad/ khong dbang po dwangs shing / yon tan sbus gtsang ba zhig 'dug pa la mngon spyod drag las la blo gzhol ba 'di phugs rang nyid la gyong chen por 'gro nyen yod snyam pa yang byung / gzhan mang po la'ang smras/ khong pa rang la'ang zur tsam gros 'debs byas pas/ 'phral bla ma'i sku rim tsam bsgrub pa la mi gzhan gyis phrag dog gi sgo nas brjod gleng byas pa ma gtogs/ de 'dra ye byas pa med gsung gin 'dug na'ang / phyis de bzhin thog tu babs pa kun la gsal/ dpal 'khore lo sdom pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas don gnyer mang dag la —353—

dbang bskur zhig kyang byas/ zhabs drung nas kyang gsan/ yang don gnyer mang dag la phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i 'khrid rgyas pa cig kyang bshad/ yung thang nag gur pa'i chos mdzad la yang ngo sprod bskyar ma dgos zer ba ltar byas shing /lha sar dar po che slong rgyu'i 'phros 'ga' re yod pa sogs/ slar yang lha sar phyin te de res zhag bzhi bsdad/ snga phyi sdoms par dar po che bcu bdun tsam bslangs/ 'di skabs stag lung nas sde pa'i zhabs drung yab sras dang / ban dpon kun dga' rgyal bzang sogs/ stag lung phyogs nas grwa rigs mang po dang / 'phan yul gyi phyogs nas bu slob yon bdag mang po zhig nges 'phrad par byung / so so la 'dod chos kyi 'brel ba re yang byas/ snga phyi gnyis kar sdod sa dga' ldan khang sar du byed dgos byung ste/ rgyal 'gong gi cho 'phrul che ba rang cig gda'/ se ra byes pa'i slob dpon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud du gtogs pa yin gsung ba'i zhal snga nas 'khon btsun yang / nged la 'phrad par phebs shing dgongs bzhed kyi chos mang dag 'dug pa yang byas/ 'di skabs sde pa dga' ldan pas ni yig 'brel tsam yang ma byung / snga sor sde pa yid bzhin gtsang na bug de la yod pa'i skabs/ nged la ltos pa yod pa min yang / sde dpon drag kha zhig 'di ltar bzhugs dgos pa 'phangs bsams te/ zas nor gnyis ka nas 'brel ba gang drag zhus pa yin rung / 'di skabs ni khongs pas kyang cang med/ tshur lam yang shun du zhag shas cig bsdad nas/ phyir yongs dus zhabs drung nyid skyel mar yang phebs/ snye thang gser khang du zhag snga phyi gnyis mkhar rngar zhag gcig rnams bsdad/ chos rdzong gi gnas sngar ma mjal —354—

bas mjal du phyin/ mang ja 'gyed bcas cig btang / gser khang nas nang so gzhon pa rdo rje pad ma'i drung gis/ snying thag pa'i dad pas kun nas blangs te/ bde mchog chos gling gi sgrub sde 'dir gsar 'dzugs dang / khor rang gi sku skal dang gsar 'phar steng nas phogs sogs mchod thes thams cad sbyor ba'i bka' gros rnams byung zhing / de 'phral phyag thog tu 'byon pa 'di yin/bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po la 'phrang phubs bshe7ra kha 'bul gyin yod 'dugade skabs 'phra bu ba stongs pas snyems mda' nas sngar 'byud e yong bde skyid par nan bcags la bas kyang ye ma byung / de nas skyid ru ba sde pa kun rgyal gyis 'bod mi nan bcags stabs/ 'phrang gong du theg gnyis bsdad/ khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ nub gnyis kar la shin tu 'a zheb cha che ba dang / khyad par 'bras sbung gi chos skyong mngon sum du 'ongs nas/ khang pa bsgyel ba'i tshul byed kyin 'dug de rjes kam pa la'i la rtse thub skyel ma la chos mdzad gsal yang mig gcig pa byung ba/ phyi lon gyi tshul du yong lugs 'di bzhin 'dug pas/ rim gro bzlog pa rgya che bar rang dgos tshul byas shing / de mthun rim gro than thun 'dra btang ba'i rigs yin pa 'dug na'ang / dbyings chen ma byung bas mi ring bar skyid ru ba rang la de bzhin shar song / de nub srin po rir bsdad/ sngar 'byud ltar lha khang der nyal/ 'jun pa dpon g.yog rnams byon nas/ chos skyong seng ge nag po'i bskangs gso dang / rnga brdung gi 'ar lung mang po byed kyin 'dug nam tho rangs tsa na hi hi zer ba'i sgra r+ṣa po gcig dang po thog ma pha tshad na yod snyam pa la/ rting la ri klung med khyab cing / nam mkha' —355—

mtha' med kyi bar du yang khyab pa 'dra ba cig yun ring rab byung / de nas gong dkar du 'byor/ gong ma khu dbon dang mjal/ sngar gyi rgyun ltar las thog mar rkyen sel rnams phul rjes spyir dbang chos rnams grangs mang rab byas/khyad par du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi dbang khrid lung bshad pa rnams mtha' rgyas dang bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / lwa ba pa dang / lang ka rgyal bzang gi 'grel ba'i lung sogs phul/ gzhan zur chos zhu mkhan rnam grangs mang ba la/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi rjes gnang 'khrid dmigs than thun mang du byas/ bzhi sde dbu mdzad sogs mang rab cig la nges don rgya mtsho'i lung dang / o rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi 'khrid sogs bshad/chos sder khor tsam phyin zhing / sngar khyud kyi mchod pa snyan dar sogs kyang phul/bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po'i drung du dbang chos 'ga' yang zhus/ de nas rtser sgrol ma nyer gcig gi zhal thang gsar bzhengs rnams 'grems par mdzad nas/ rnam dag gtsug nor lugs kyi rjes gnang rnams phul/ sde pa sger pa rnams kyi thugs 'dod kyi gtso bo bstan 'dzin rin po che'i sku'i skye bar grags pa ngam ring nas yod pa 'di/ sku skye yin nam min/ 'gro don yong ngam mi yong brtag pa dgos zhes snga sor 'brang phur rje drung rtogs ldan pa gsung gin 'dug pas/ de skabs lha sar brtag pa byed par khas blangs/ skabs 'dir tshogs 'khor bzab pa cig dang bcas/ rjes drung sku bgres pas 'dri bar byon byung ba la/ brtag pa ji ltar shar ba bzhin/ rje bstan 'dzin rin po che'i thugs rgyud dngos yin min ci shes/ bar chad ma byung na 'gro don ni ci rigs pa yong ba —356—

'dug smras pas/ sngar mtshan grags de byung phyin 'gro don yong na de chog par 'dug gsung / de 'phral spyan 'dren gyi thugs brtse brtad song / de nas bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po rtser yang spyan 'dres zhus te/ spyir yang chos bka' 'ga' re zhus sngar rdo rje rings pa ba la thob zin yang byin rlabs kyi sgo zhig yod pas/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs rgyas pa de zhus/ 'di shin tu byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan che bar byung / de nas yar lam yang 'brang phur yongs zla phyed skor zhig bsdad/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba la thub pa dgongs rgyan gyi 'dzug khrid zhig byas pa le'u dang po tsam song / lha rgyal gling dang 'de thung la sogs pa'i mchod gzhis la/ ban khral lam pa zhig byas pa'i grwa gsar rnams kyi skra phud re yang blangs/ 'di res zla phyed tsam bsdad/ rang re'i dbon pos kyang skra bcad byas/ 'brang nas yong ba'i snga dro rta thog tu ma mkhyon tsam la/ gzhis ka gong dkar nas paṇa chen chos mdzad ston pa'i sku brnyan 'dra bzhus cig dang /rang res bkod pa byas nas bzhag pa'i dpal lha mo'i thang ka de yang grub 'dug pa khyer nas byung / rten 'brel legs par go rim pa'i sna dkar rtser 'byor/ zhal ngo khu dbon la tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel gyi rim pa rnams dang /gshin rje gshed nag po'i dbang / rdo rje phag mo/ gzhan don gnyer mang dag dang bcas pa la/ kun rig gi dbang dang / gzhan sngags pa 'ga' re la yang chos ci rigs dang / bla brang 'gag pa dpon slob rnams kyang yod pa la/'khrid ci rigs bshad/ yar 'brog tu sdod pa'i bar la/ mchod che'i rigs ster mkhan byung ba kun/ bde mchog chos gling gi dgos che'i dbang du byas —357—

nas/ khong dpon slob la ster bar byas te/ ster mkhan mang po ni ma byung /gang byung ba rnams sprad/ a ma lags kyang khor tsam phebs byung / 'di skabs sna dkar rtser dus rim thog tu 'byor ba'i sngags pa rnams kyis 'tshams sogs zing zing mang po 'dug zhag bco brgyad tsam bsdad/ de nas yar yong dus lam zhor la/ chos sde na dpon sa'i nang brten du thub dbang gi sku brnyan mi tshad gcig bzheng pa mdzad 'dug pa'i rab gnas la byin/ glo bur du rlung 'thob chen po ldang ba dang / rab gnas grub mtshams la/ gzhan po'i bsngo brten 'bul mkhan zhig kyang byung / phyir yong dus lam la yang rlung chen pos mtshams bcad pas 'dra bar zhig byung ba/ sde pa a khu drung pa de mi ring bar sku gshegs pa la blta ba 'dug de nub srin lag gnas su yang so rbe'i bsngo zhus dang / gzhi len byed mkhan sogs shin tu mang bar byung / de nas lam la rim pas rgyud de/ rgyal rtser sleb pa'i lcags mal ngal gsos/ chos sder mang ja 'gyed bcas mkhan chen 'phags pa'i drung du bsngo rten sogs sgrubs rtse chen gyi rgyab der yang slob dpon rnam pa spyi chos khrims thams cad 'phrad par byon/'dir yang mang ja 'byed bcas sogs phul/ de nas 'brong rtse'i mdun du sde pa bgres pa rang byon pa'i ja 'dren zhig byung ba la/ glo bur du rlung 'tshub mi zad pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyang 'gribs/ mun sros pa 'dra ba las phyogs thams cad sngo skya yal yal yod pa lta bu'i spyi dang mi 'dra ba rang zhig byung / 'dol byung du zhag shas bsdad cing / khong tsho'i dus rim dang thug zhal ngo tsho rang gi sku dog cung zad sel ba'i ltas shar/ 'dir skyid phug sku skye ba la gter ma'i chos ci rigs —358—

pa'i lung dang / brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa'i 'go zhig btsugs/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho bas kyang gsan/ de nas bsam sdings su theg lnga tsam bsdad/dgon pa ba rnams la chos 'brel du 'chi med kyi 'khrid zhes byas/ tshong 'dus su yongs skabs nyi ma dwangs po rang yong 'phro la/ phebs bsu'i sa nas klu sdings su sleb kyi bar la/ rlung nag mi bzad pa mun sros pa 'dra ba snga sor 'brong rtsed byung ba de 'dra ba zhig byung / 'brong rtse dang 'di'i ltas gnyis kar de 'phral du yang mkhar bzhag sogs byung zhing / mi ring bar 'das grongs kyang ci rigs byung song ba la blta las che/ de nas zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu la bsam 'grub rtser sleb pa yin/ sleb 'phral la gza' skar dang bstun pa'i kun gzigs steng gi bzab khang la rab gnas kyang byas/ zhag shas snga sor gyi rgyun ltar tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel rnams rim can du phul/ 'dir zla gcig tsam lon nas/ brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa'i 'phros de yang / brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u gsum pa yan chad song de man chad bshad lung tsam byas/ de bar du sku skye ba sogs la gsar rnying ma nges pa'i lung 'dra yang bklags/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho'i drung yang zhal ngo rnams kyis spyan 'dren mdzad pa'i gting skyes rang la phebs song / 'phying ru gong dkar rdo rje gdan nas bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po chos dbyings su sku thim pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba 'debs kyang sleb/ rten bzhengs ma tshar bar sde pa nas bsgo(ra 'debs zhig zhus pa'ang byung / bla ma dam pa de bya btang yin pas rten bzhengs kyi rgyu yang phal cher 'di nas ka bsrings pa yin/ nged shin tu bka' nan ches pa'i stabs/ 'di skabs yun —359—

ring ba zhig sdod dgos byung ste/ sde srid yab sras drung du dpal rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe lngar dbang bskur ba dang / gzhan yang don gnyer dge bshes 'ga' shas dang / khams pa grwa rigs 'ga' dang bcas pa la yang / dbang yongs su rdzogs pa tshar gcig byas/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing / mchod pa'i bkod pa sogs cho ga mtha' rgyas dang gzhan yang gtor ma'i cho ga sogs rdo rje phreng ba dang / man ngag snye ma nas gsung pa ltar/ rang gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du sgrubs/ de skabs sde srid kyi phyag tu 'byor pa'i rten gyi rigs 'gangs che ba rnams la/ sku khrus dang rab gnas kha gso sogs dang / bkral btags kyi gur la bgegs sprod sogs kyang byas/ de rjes sde srid rang la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur yongs rdzogs zhig kyang bsgrubs/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i cho ga la brten pa'i drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lag len gyi yi ge cung zad rgyas pa 'di yang skabs 'di dag tu brtsams pa yin/chos rje shangs pa slob dpon la brtag pa dang po'i le'u bdun pa yan chad kyi bshad pa tsam song / yang 'di skabs mdo khams byang ngos phyogs kyi dgon pa nyug rjes nas/ ka bzhi rgyal mtshan seng ge'i sku skye/ bla ma kun dga' lhun grub pa'i phyag g.yog gnyer pa yang byed pa/ sog po'i yul du 'dzam thang pa'i grwa rigs che chen nang so'i yang g.yogs grag kha byed pa/ kun dga' bkra shis zer ba de ka bzhi pa'i dpon po gnyis dang bcas pa rnams dbus gtsang gi —360—

gnas mjal dang / che chen nang so'i mang skol la byung ba dang brtun/ bla ma kun dga' lhun grub kyi 'bul skyel brda mtshon tsam dang / dbon po gnyis po yang re zhig chos zhu ba'i dbang du byas/ nged la dmigs nas byon/ kun dga' bkra shis g.yog mang dag dang bcas pa la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang /rgyud sde lnga'i dbang / gur zhal gyi rjes gnang sogs 'dod pa bzhin du byas/'di nas sog yul la bla ma zhig nges par rdzong dgos zer nas/ nan bcags ches pas kun dga' blo 'phel ba sogs grwa rigs 'ga' yang bla chas dang bcas te rgyal khams de dag tu 'gro don la rdzong dgos byung / de skabs khong rnams kyis 'dzam thang nas rje rgyal ba seng ge'i sku skye khams du byon pa de ni gshogs/ sku skye gnyis pa'i tshul de dbon po zhu tshang ri shing pa'i zhal ngo drang srong 'di yin zer bar 'dug pas/ 'khrul med yin nam min brtag pa byed dgos zer ba/ cung zad brtags pas yin du ni rung yang / 'dzam thang phyogs su phan thogs pa ni mi yong zer ba byung / de kha ltar zhib rgyas su smras so/ /yang byang zhabs drung nas ngam ring du tshang slog mdzad rgyu byung yang / yong sgo yod ba'i mnga' zhabs lar med pas zhu ngo byed dgos gsung / de mthun ngo chen zhus pas yong sgo drag pa'i dbang du byas zur tsho skor rnams thams cad byung ba yin/ de skabs ngam ring cho se sde pa rnams kyis/ kha snga bang mgyogs byas pas yong sgo drag shos gang sle sogs mang tshad gcig chos sde la 'jags grub 'dugaspyir sde pa las dge 'dun la byung ba de los dga' ste/ byang pa rang la kha 'gegs su song pa de yin/ sde srid nas nged la 'di skabs lho nas 'phyong lung —361—

'brog pa dang / gtsang bsam 'grub bde chen ma lag skor bcas chos bzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang / rtag brtan gyi chos sde 'di 'dzugs pa'i bka' gros nges thams cad kyang de skabs byung ba lags/ sde pa lha srung drung yang chos skor 'jug pa mdzad de/ mtshan kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por btags/ de nas hor zla drug pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu skor la yang btegs nas chos 'khor rtsa'i mdo der snar thang nas thabs 'dzin cig kyang byung / byang chen du zhag gsum bzhi gcig bsdad/ gnas srin po ri'i klu sdings su zhag gcig bsdad pa/ gnas chos sde'i slob dpon sogs skya ser mang po zhig 'phrang mkhan yang byung / cho lo 'brel re yang byas/ lung nag shel dkar nas rgya gan nas chos dgos pa ci 'dra yod kyang / 'bod mi nan can rang gi stabs rdzong rtse la phyin zhag po gnyis bsdad/ tshe dbang dang gur mgon gyi gtor dbang dgos zer ba ltar byas/ de nas tshur lam brag ram gyi gnod spyin la gtor ma zhig kyang dgos pa'i ltas byung ba dang / sngar yul de la ma phyin pas ji ltar 'dug lta ba dang / sbrags khor tsam phyin pas/ gnod spyin de dgyes pa'i ltas cung zad byung / zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu bdun la jo nang du sleb/ grwa btsun rnams kyis bsu ba bzab rgyas byas shing zla gcig tsam ji ltar bde pa'i ngang nas/ khams po ngor dgon pa ba dbon po lhun grub sogs mang rab dang / ka bzhi dpon po sogs la chos kyi rnam grangs lam 'bras la sogs pa mang dag byas/ rang re'i grwa tshang gi grwa pa gsar pa rnams kyis sgrub dkyil rang res sgrigs pa 'di kha'i steng du nas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i —362—

sgrub mchod thog ma 'dzugs pa de/ jo nang rang gi ser kha sgrub mchod kyi steng du 'dzugs pa'i rtsis su byas nas/ bris thig gar sogs sngar nas sbyangs pa rnams kyang de skabs gra 'grig par byas/ hor zla bdun pa'i nang du chog grwa 'grig cing legs par byung / lo 'di'i nang du tsam me sdod ma dgos tsam la/ya ma dang khrag ngan sogs kyis yang yang na ba zhig ka byung / sgrub mchod grol ba'i rjes la dpon po lhun grub sogs 'ga' zhig yul du mgyogs par ldog 'gro ba'i stabs sbyor drug cig kyang 'chad dgos byung / snga phyir bskul mkhan gzhan yang yod la/ khong tshos kyang bskul nas sbyor drug gi 'khrig yig che ba 'di brtsams/ de'i yan lag tu nges par dgos par mthong nas/ rtags tshad kyi yi ge ngo sprod phyi nang 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel rnams kyang ston ka de la ka bris pa yin/ 'dir sleb pa nas gzung de bar du sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan gyi zhig sos legs par grub pa dang / spyi khang skor sogs de lo yang las ka than thun mang du grub/ sku 'bum mthong grol chen mor bri'i skor khang la bzang sgrigs 'ba' zhig go bla re dang / bum ldir la yang de mthun gyi bla re kheng yug /lha khang gzhan ma so sor bar skabs mdzod bzung dus bla bre gyag pa rnams la yang bla bre nyi shu skor cig phul/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char sogs ltas ngo mtshar che bar byung / rang re jo nang pa la bltos pa rnams tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum gang dgos kyang sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo 'di la zhabs tog gi rten 'brel sgrig pa rang gal che ba 'dug 'di rtags mngon gyur du ston mkhan yin pas thams cad kyis 'bad 'bungs byed dgos so/ /gnas gzhi gsar —363—

du 'debs dgos de lo 'di la brtag pa ma chug cing / lo gsar nas shin tu bzang ba'i ltas shar pas de lo then pa yin/ de nas ston gzhug skyid phug tu rab gnas dang bstun te phyi mtshams me la bsdad/ sbyor drug gi bshad pa'i rtsom pa de'i 'go btsugs nas/ gzhi gtan la 'bebs pa'i skor rnams song ba tsam zhig nyin gung thun bar thun bar la bka' bcu ba kun dga' dbang phyug pas bris/ dbon po lhun grub sogs dang khong tshos nan gyis bskul nas/lung rig rgya mtsho sogs 'di kha'i grwa pa 'ga' shas khams phyogs su 'gro don la 'gro 'dod rnams la so so'i 'dod chos than thun 'dra yang ma chag par byed dgos byung / de rjes khong rnams kyang khams phyogs la thegs/ de nas dgun khrid sngar lugs bzhin btsugs/ grwa pa gsar pa'i rigs mang po dang bcas/'khrid gsar pa ltos che bar byung / lo 'di la byang zhabs drung rang la bcur thag cung zad byung ba ni/ snying gi grogs thams cad thang la bor ba'i rnam pas/rgyun du sku rim bsgrubs shing byang pa rang gi phyir du gzhan la gtor rgyag dang /mthu gtad byed mkhan gyi sngags pa'i rigs las thugs nye shos gcig gnyis ma gtogs/ phal cher 'di dang 'di yin no zhes gsal bar zhus pa'i sngags pa rnams la brul drag byung ba'i skabs de yin/ bla ma dkon mchog legs 'dzin pa nged la sngar nas 'dris che ba yin pa la/ khong gi sras po rgan pa de skyon che ba zhig med na'ang / 'phral gyi byed lugs ma shes pas/ bsam 'grub rtser btson nang du 'das/ slar dkon legs pa rang la yang dka' skyon gyi sgo 'dug pa dang / ngo chen zhib sed zhus pas sa skya'i sgo rus du mna' skyal bas —364—

chog par byung / ston pa rdo ra ba yang srog 'dzem la 'di khar bros/ phyis dgongs pa zhus pas yul la phyin chog par byung / des mtshon gzhan 'ga' re la yang phan thogs byung / snga sor ston ka phyag 'tshal la mo nas gtor ma zhig btang ba/ rmi lam du mdangs dkar gyi btsan de gtor ma'i skal ba chad zer slong ba'i rnam pa byung bas/ bar der mdangs dkar rdzong la gtor ma gnyis gsum zhig btang bas/ mi thams cad mdangs dkar la dgon pa gsar 'debs byed rgyu yin par 'dug zer ba'i tshod rgyag gis lung pa bkang / 'di skabs rtse chung gi la mgo la sde pa gzhung gi spe'u 'di rgyag ba mdzad song ste/dgos pa rang ni cang mi gda'/ de dus rje btsun u rgyan mtsho mo'i sku skye'i drung /jo nang gi gnas mjal la phebs gsung ba zhig yod pa'i skabs/ rmi lam du khong dpon slob nang cig nas yar phebs nas/ mtshan brjod 'don gyin 'dug pas/ dum cig nas ma thon bar chad song / de nas 'dir phebs kyang ma byung ste/ khong rang de'u/ slob la 'phrin las kyi bar chad yong ba'i ltas su go /dus khrid grol la khad la rgyal rtse nas bla ma zhabs drung yang phebs/ de nyid glo bur du 'brong rtser rlung 'tshub byung ba de ka 'dra ba zhig byung ste 'dir sku bsnyel ba de la blta ba yin nam/ de min ni legs par byung / tshogs su sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa zhig kyang byas/'dir smras pa/ legs pa'i yon tan 'chang tshul brgya/ khres bya'i mtha' la thug med 'char/ /bsod nams bral ba'i skye bo la/ /rtag tu nub pa'i mtshan mo nyid/ /nyin byed 'od zer gzhig shar bas/ /yul phyogs bye ba brgya —365—

gsal yang / /byang ngam 'og tu kha bltas pa'i/ /phug par rtag tu mun pa nyid/ /skal ldan rnams la bla med byang chub myur ster zhing / /'gro ba kun la bden don mtha' yas 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /zab mo dbu ma bde gshegs snying po'i gtam 'di dang / /zab lam mthar thug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las gzhan ci/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs su smras pa'o/ / / /—366—
